local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class ShortStoryMilkyWaySubProgressorController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMilkyWaySubProgressorController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 0,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.section_values = {
		s5_after_tutorial = 1,
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:progress_to(key)
	local target_progress = self.section_values[key]

	if target_progress == nil then
		exception_stage_exit(string.format('Cannot Progress to [Key : %s]', key))
		return
	end

	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil then
		exception_stage_exit('SubProgressor Quest did not activated.')
		return
	end

	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress < target_progress then
		self:progress_section(target_progress - self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress)
	end
end

function local_class:is_passed(key)
	local target_progress = self.section_values[key]

	if self.cs_controller.QuestProgress == nil then
		return false
	end

	return self.cs_controller.QuestProgress.InnerProgress >= target_progress
end

return local_class

	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 2,
		HasPostSection = true
	}

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	--region Dynamic_npc

	--동적 할당 정보
	self.dynamic_npcs = {
		first_dynamic_npc = {
			npc_list = {},
			dynamic_npc_name = 'first_dynamic_npc_',
			dynamic_npc_data = nil
		},
		second_dynamic_npc = {
			npc_list = {},
			dynamic_npc_name = 'second_dynamic_npc_',
			dynamic_npc_data = nil
		},
		third_dynamic_npc = {
			npc_list = {},
			dynamic_npc_name = 'third_dynamic_npc_',
			dynamic_npc_data = nil
		},
		create_npcs = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then
					-- 적 동적 생성
					local dynamic_npc_spec = {}

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do
						dynamic_npc_spec[npc_data.dynamic_npc_name .. i] = npc_data.dynamic_npc_data[i]
					end

					npc_data.npc_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(dynamic_npc_spec)

					for i = 1, #npc_data.dynamic_npc_data do
						npc_data.npc_list[npc_data.dynamic_npc_name .. i].Position = self.wait_pos
					end
				end
			end
		end,
		dispose_target = function(target_list)
			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(target_list)
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			for name, npc_data in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'create_npcs' and name ~= 'dispose_all' and name ~= 'dispose_target' then
					if npc_data.npc_list then
						load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(npc_data.npc_list)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	--endregion Dynamic_npc

	--region Character

	self.get_character = {
		bombbug_friend = function()
			if self:is_myth_character() then
				--6성
				return get_character('bombbug_friend_screenplay_myth')
			else
				return get_character('bombbug_friend_screenplay')
			end
		end,
		bombbug_friend_gimmick = function()
			if self:is_myth_character() then
				return get_character('bombbug_friend_myth')
			else
				return get_character('bombbug_friend')
			end
		end,
	}

	--endregion Character

	--region Marker

	self.get_marker_pos = {
		center = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_bomb_bug_racing_center_pos_' .. number)
		end,
	}

	--endregion Marker

	self.is_active_crowd_buzz = false
	
	self.crowd_buzz = nil

	self.main_quest_id = 7002201
end

function local_class:is_myth_character()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and (quest_progress.IsComplete or quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 12) then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose_all()
	self.super:dispose()
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	local bombbug_friend = self.get_character.bombbug_friend_gimmick()

	if self.is_active_crowd_buzz and 
			self:is_npc_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'bomb_bug_racing_fly_grid', bombbug_friend) then
		self:start_crowd_buzz()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	local bombbug_friend = self.get_character.bombbug_friend_gimmick()

	if self.is_active_crowd_buzz and 
			self:is_npc_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'bomb_bug_racing_fly_grid', bombbug_friend) then
		self:stop_crowd_buzz()
	end

	return false
end

--endregion Event

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
end

end

function local_class:switching_bombbug_friend(is_screen)
	local bombbug_friend = self.get_character.bombbug_friend()
	local bombbug_friend_gimmick = self.get_character.bombbug_friend_gimmick()

	local bumbbug_friend_pos = bombbug_friend.Position
	local bombbug_friend_gimmick_pos = bombbug_friend_gimmick.Position

	if is_screen then
		bombbug_friend.Direction = bombbug_friend_gimmick.Direction
	else
		bombbug_friend_gimmick.Direction = bombbug_friend.Direction
	end

	bombbug_friend.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	bombbug_friend_gimmick.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	coroutine.yield()

	bombbug_friend.Position = bombbug_friend_gimmick_pos
	bombbug_friend_gimmick.Position = bumbbug_friend_pos
end

function local_class:is_npc_enter_to_cam_grid(e, name, npc)
	if type_util.is_table(name) then
		local grid_names = name
		return lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) and
				(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, npc) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) and
				table_util.contain_value(grid_names, e.CameraGrid.name)
	else
		return lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) and
				(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, npc) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) and
				e.CameraGrid.name == name
	end
end

function local_class:is_npc_leave_to_cam_grid(e, name, npc)
	return lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) and
			(lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, npc) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)) and
			e.CameraGrid.name == name
end

function local_class:start_crowd_buzz()
	if self.crowd_buzz then
		return
	end

	local play_pos = self.get_marker_pos.center(1)

	--사운드 세팅
	self.crowd_buzz = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc',
		play_pos = play_pos,
		fade_in_time = 1,
		max_distance = 5 })
end

function local_class:stop_crowd_buzz()
	if not self.crowd_buzz then
		return
	end

	--사운드 세팅
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.crowd_buzz)
	self.crowd_buzz = nil
end

function local_class:fade_out_crowd_buzz(duration)
	if not self.crowd_buzz then
		return
	end

	--사운드 세팅
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.crowd_buzz,duration)
	self.crowd_buzz = nil
end

return local_class

			basket = 21698,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}

			this.controller:set_background_sorting_order(layer_name, sorting_order)
		end,

		set_background_color = function(this, r, g, b)
			this.controller:set_background_color(r, g, b)
		end,

		fade_in_async = function(this, duration, fade_value)
			local time_passed = 0
			local value = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_value, 1)

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(time_passed / duration, value)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(progress)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end
		end,

		fade_out_async = function(this, duration)
			local time_passed = 0

			local value = this.controller.background_renderer.color.a

			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(value - time_passed)

				this.controller:set_background_alpha(progress)

				coroutine.yield()

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.controller ~= nil then
				this.controller:dispose_loaded()
			end

			this.controller = nil
		end
	}

	--region Etc

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 메인 퀘스트 id
	self.quest_id = 7002203

	self.quest_marker_key = 'sub_bomb_bug'

	self.in_grid = false

	self.minigame_name = 'BombBugRacing'

	self.is_rotate_loop = nil

	self.rotate_end_count = nil

	self.rotate_end_max_count = nil

	self.camera_size = nil

	self.minigame_try_count = 0

	--미니게임 이름
	self.minigame_name = 'BombBugRacing'

	--endregion Etc
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.fx_list = {}

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(function()
		self.background_util:load_resource()

		local constants_data = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/' .. self.minigame_name .. '/Constants')

		local common_constants_data = constants_data.common

		self.camera_size = common_constants_data.camera_size
	end)

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		--재진입 처리
		self.current_state = self.states.try
		start_coroutine(function()
			self.controller:create_npcs()

			--퀘스트 아이콘 출력
			local trainer = self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.npc_list[self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.dynamic_npc_name .. 12]

			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(trainer)

			self:default_npc_setting()
		end)
	else
		start_coroutine(function()
			--노엘+이브 (up, idle, fly)
			self:start_minigame_setting()
			self:start_minigame()
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	self.is_rotate_loop = false

	if self.controller:is_myth_character() then
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.get_character.noel_recall(), active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	self.background_util:dispose()
	self.background_util = nil

	self:fx_dispose_all()
end

function local_class:switching_leader(is_start_minigame)
	local current_leader = nil
	local switch_leader = nil

	if is_start_minigame then
		current_leader = self.get_character.noel()
		switch_leader = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel()
	else
		current_leader = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel()
		switch_leader = self.get_character.noel()
	end

	field_object_util.set_active_state(switch_leader, active_state_type.enabled)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.KeepParty = true
	param.MoveCamera = false
	param.HidePreviousParty = false

	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(switch_leader, param)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(current_leader)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(current_leader, active_state_type.disabled)
end

function local_class:minigame_switching()
	local current_leader = self.get_character.noel()
	local switch_leader = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel()

	-- FlyingVehicleController로 변경
	switch_leader.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.FlyingVehicleController()

	-- 좌표 공중으로 띄움
	character_util.set_position(switch_leader, switch_leader.Position, true)

	-- SetControl 호출 (이 시점에 CharacterControllerManualTouchState로 변경해줌)
	switch_leader.FieldObjectController:SetControl(true)

	local current_state = switch_leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState

	-- 스테이트 변경 대기
	while not lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 변경되자마자 DisabledControls 걸음 (isFly 넣기전 대기)
	current_state:RequestDisableControl(switch_leader, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)

	-- 안전하게 3프레임 대기
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- AnalogueAirbourneStartEvent 호출로 isFly 트루로 변경
	message_system:SendSync(switch_leader, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneStartEvent.Instance)

	-- disableControl Remove
	current_state:RemoveDisableControl(switch_leader)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local trainer = self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.npc_list[self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.dynamic_npc_name .. 12]

	--재입장 시 인터렉트
	if self.current_state == self.states.try and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, trainer) then

		start_coroutine(self.retry_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	--실패 후 재인터렉트
	if self.current_state == self.states.retry and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, trainer) then

		start_coroutine(self.retry_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--실패 후 재도전 처리
function local_class:retry_scene()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self.controller:switching_bombbug_friend(true)

	local leader = self.get_character.noel()
	local trainer = self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.npc_list[self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.dynamic_npc_name .. 12]
	local bombbug_friend = self.get_character.bombbug_friend()

	local center_pos_1 = self.get_marker_pos.center(1)

	--실패 후 재도전 처리
	--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗는다.
	--조련사 머리에 있는 퀘스트 아이콘 제거한다.
	quest_icon_util.remove(trainer)

	--노엘 (right, idle, walk) 애니 적용, 1초에 걸쳐 위 위치로 정렬. async
	wp_util.move_async(leader, center_pos_1 + vector(0, 0, -2),
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--조련사 (left, idle, idle) : 아, 노엘양! 경기라면 언제든지 도전하셔도 됩니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trainer, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_1')

	--재인터렉트 선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
		--[mercy] 도전 할게요.
		{ 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_choose_1', 'mercy' },
		--[normal] 아무 것도 아니에요.
		{ 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_choose_2', 'normal' },
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		--[mercy] 도전 할게요.
		--노엘 (right, idle, nod 2회) async
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

		--화면 1초에 걸쳐 페이드 아웃. async
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		--페이드 인 전 세팅
		--카메라 포커스 노엘
		--카메라 크기 기본값 4.0
		camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

		--조련사, 폭탄벌레3, 노엘, 이브, 선수1, 선수2, 폭탄벌레 1, 폭탄벌레 2 스파인 제거
		--선수1+폭탄벌레 (up, idle, fly)
		--선수2+폭탄벌레 (up, idle, fly)
		self:default_npc_setting(true)
		self:audience_npc_setting()
		self:mini_game_start_scene_third_npc_setting()

		field_object_util.set_active_state(bombbug_friend, active_state_type.disabled)

		--노엘+이브 (up, idle, fly)
		self:start_minigame_setting()

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--ignorecameragrids 적용
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.camera_size, 0)
		camera_util.move_async(self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel().Position, 0, {
			ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = get_party_leader() })

		--1초에 걸쳐 검은색 페이드 인. async
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		--조련사 말풍선 : [shout] 그럼 경기 시작하겠습니다!
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(trainer, self, nil,
				nil, nil,
				{ key = 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_2', skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

		--조련사 말풍선 : [shout] 모두 준비~~!
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(trainer, self, nil,
				nil, nil,
				{ key = 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_3', skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

		if self.minigame_try_count >= 3 then
			self:start_minigame('BombBugRacing_Easy_1')
		else
			self:start_minigame()
		end

		--타이틀 UI 출력 : 3, 2, 1 카운트다운. async
		--레이싱 엑티비티 시작된다.

	else
		--[normal] 아무 것도 아니에요.
		--노엘 (right, idle, idle) : 아뇨, 아무 것도 아니에요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_4')

		--조련사 (left, tired, idle) : 아, 넵.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trainer, self, 'left',
				nil, 'tired', 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_5')

		--조련사 머리 위로 퀘스트 아이콘 재출력
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(trainer)

		--재인터렉트 가능 사양으로 전환
		--플레이어 컨트롤 돌려준다.

		self.controller:switching_bombbug_friend()

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
	end
end

--패배 엔딩
function local_class:failed_ending_scene()
	local noel = self.get_character.noel()
	local trainer = self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.npc_list[self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.dynamic_npc_name .. 12]
	local bombbug_friend = self.get_character.bombbug_friend()

	--단편집 클리어 상황에 따라 재생 되는 필드 BGM 이 다릅니다
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6 })

	field_object_util.set_active_state(bombbug_friend, active_state_type.enabled)

	--페이드 인 전 세팅
	--관중 세팅 제거
	--엑티비티 세팅 리셋
	--서브퀘스트 마커 리셋
	--폭탄벌레 타고 있는 선수 1, 2, 노엘 스파인 제거
	--노엘 (right, idle, idle)
	--이브 (right, idle, idle)
	--선수 1 (right, attack, idle) : 이 녀석, 오늘 상태 왜 이래?
	--선수 2 (left, attack, cross_arm) : 으휴, 이 식충이.
	--폭탄벌레 1 (left, mad, idle) 인터렉트시, angry 이모티콘 출력, async
	--폭탄벌레 2 (right, damaged, idle) 인터렉트 불가
	--폭탄벌레 3 (left, idle, idle)
	--조련사 (left, smile, idle)
	self:exit_minigame_setting()

	self:default_npc_setting()
	self:audience_npc_setting(true)
	self:mini_game_start_scene_third_npc_setting(true)
	self:set_active_all_flag()

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	scene_util.set_emotion(trainer, self, 'smile')

	character_util.remove_relate_event(trainer, self.controller)

	--노엘 이브 위치 세팅
	noel.Position = trainer.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)
	bombbug_friend.Position = trainer.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -1)

	scene_util.set_direction(noel, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'right', false)

	--조련사 머리 위로 퀘스트 아이콘 출력. 인터렉트 가능 상태
	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 검은색으로 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 돌려준다.
	self:exit_minigame()

	--아래 대화연출 진행.
	--해당 대화 연출은 최초 1회만 실행
	if self.minigame_try_count == 1 then
		--조련사 (left, smile, cast2) : 아, 노엘 양! 덕분에 경기가 잘 마무리되었습니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trainer, self, 'left',
				'cast2', 'smile', 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_5_1')

		--조련사 (left, tired, idle) : 우승을 못 한 건 유감이네요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trainer, self, 'left',
				nil, 'tired', 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_5_2')

		--노엘 (right, idle, idle) : 전 괜찮아요. 
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noel, self, 'right',
				nil, nil, 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_5_3')

		--노엘 (right, idle, bomb_idle) : 우승을 노리고 도전한 건 아니었으니까요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noel, self, 'right',
				'bomb_idle', nil, 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_5_4')

		--이브 (right, tired, idle) silence 이모티콘 출력. async
		--이브 스파인 shake (0.03, 0.5)
		scene_util.normal_shake(bombbug_friend, 0.5)
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(bombbug_friend, self, 'right',
				nil, 'tired', 'silence')

		--조련사 (left, doyagao, cross_arm) 상태로 1.2초 대기
		scene_util.play_wait_action(trainer, self, 'left',
				'cross_arm', 'doyagao', 1.2)

		--조련사 (left, smile, idle) : 하하, 노엘 양은 그럴지 몰라도… 
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trainer, self, 'left',
				nil, 'smile', 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_5_5')

		--조련사 (left, smile, release 2회) : 이브는 져 버려서 분한 모양인데요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trainer, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'smile', 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_5_6')

		--노엘 (down, idle, idle) question 이모티콘 출력, async
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(noel, self, 'down',
				nil, nil, 'silence')

		--조련사 (left, smile, idle) : 노엘 양만 원한다면, 언제든지 재도전하셔도좋습니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(trainer, self, 'left',
				nil, 'smile', 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_5_7')
	end

	--조련사 머리 위로 퀘스트 아이콘 출력. 인터렉트 가능 상태
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(trainer)

	character_util.add_listener(trainer, self.controller)

	self.current_state = self.states.retry

	self.controller:switching_bombbug_friend()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

--성공 엔딩
function local_class:success_ending_scene()
	local main_quest_event_controller = get_quest_event_controller('ShortStoryNoelMainController')

	--메인 전쟁 사운드 비활성화 (zone enter)
	main_quest_event_controller.is_war_sfx = false
	
	--중간에 그리드 밖으로 나가면서 사운드가 바뀌어 매니저 중지
	music_player_util.stop_bgm_manager()
	
	do
		--미니게임 파괴
		self:exit_minigame()

		--세팅
		self:set_active_all_flag()

	end

			function()

				local end_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 2.5, -4)

				coroutine_util.while_each_frame(2, function(progress)
					local pos = self:get_curve_pos(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

					leader.Position = pos

					look_at(leader, end_pos)
				end)
				--(현재 방향, idle, boost) 이동 각도에 따라 방향 반영
			end,

				local end_pos = center_pos + vector(-2, 2.5, -4)

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

					character_util.show_emoticon_async(player_1_team, nil, 'notice')
				end,
				function()

					--선수2+폭탄벌레(현재 방향, idle, boost) notice 이모티콘 출력한다. async
					scene_util.set_anim(player_2_team, self, 'boost')
					character_util.show_emoticon_async(player_2_team, nil, 'notice')
				end,
				function()
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_05')

					--fx_noel_camera_snowwind 출력된다.
					self.fx_list['camera_snowwind'] = self.fx.noel_camera_snowwind():Instantiate(
							leader.Position + vector(-7, 0, 0))

					self.fx_list['camera_snowwind'].transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)

					--관중 일동 : [shout] 강풍이다!!!

					--말풍선 크기 1.5배
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
					scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(leader, self, nil,
							nil,
							nil,
							{ key = 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_6',
							  viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.7),
							  skip = false })

				function()
					--관중 일동 : [shout] 조심해!!!

							nil,
							nil,
							{ key = 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_6_1',

	--화면 shake 제거한다.

						nil,
						{ key = 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_7',

						  skip = false,
						  force_sfx = true })
			end,
			function()
				--캐릭터들 스파인 shake 정지한다.
				character_util.stop_shake(leader)
				character_util.stop_shake(player_1_team)
				character_util.stop_shake(player_2_team)

				--화면 shake (0.3, 0.5)
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_pan_wind_01')

				--교체 포스
				local leader_pos = leader.Position
				local player_1_pos = player_1_team.Position
				local player_2_pos = player_2_team.Position

				--노엘+이브 위치에 fx_dead 출력
				self.fx.dead():Instantiate(leader_pos)
				self.fx.dead():Instantiate(player_1_pos)
				self.fx.dead():Instantiate(player_2_pos)

				--노엘+폭탄벌레 탑승중인 스파인 제거
				self:exit_minigame_setting()

				field_object_util.set_active_state(noel, active_state_type.enabled)
				field_object_util.set_active_state(bombbug_friend, active_state_type.enabled)

				local player_1 = self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.npc_list[self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.dynamic_npc_name .. 7]
				local player_2 = self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.npc_list[self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.dynamic_npc_name .. 8]

				local bombbug_1 = self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.npc_list[self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.dynamic_npc_name .. 9]
				local bombbug_2 = self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.npc_list[self.controller.dynamic_npcs.first_dynamic_npc.dynamic_npc_name .. 10]

				camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition, 0)

				field_object_util.set_active_state(leader, active_state_type.disabled)

				--노엘 이브 교체
				noel.Position = leader_pos
				bombbug_friend.Position = leader_pos

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bombbug_friend)

				player_1.Interactable.Talk = ''
				player_2.Interactable.Talk = ''

				--선수 1 교체
				field_object_util.set_active_state(player_1_team, active_state_type.disabled)

				player_1.Position = player_1_pos
				bombbug_1.Position = player_1_pos

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player_1)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bombbug_1)

				--선수 2 교체
				field_object_util.set_active_state(player_2_team, active_state_type.disabled)

				player_2.Position = player_2_pos
				bombbug_2.Position = player_2_pos

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player_2)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bombbug_2)

				local air_spin_speed = 1

				--선수 2+폭탄벌레 각각 오른쪽(x값 +)으로 에어스핀되어 날아간다.
				--선수 2 (left, damaged, embarrassed)
				--회전값 720도
				--속도 5
				--시간 : 1초
				scene_util.set_direction(player_1, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(player_1, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(player_1, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

				scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_1, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(bombbug_1, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(bombbug_1, self, 'fly')

				character_util.air_spin(player_1, {
					speed = air_spin_speed, offset = vector(-6, 0, -6), play_deathsfx = false })
				character_util.air_spin(bombbug_1, {
					speed = air_spin_speed, offset = vector(-6, 0, -5), play_deathsfx = false })

				--시간 종료될 시, fx_dead 출력과 함께 소멸
				--선수 1+폭탄벌레 각각 오른쪽으로 에어스핀되어 날아간다.
				--폭탄벌레 1(left, damaged, fly)
				--회전값 720도
				--속도 5
				--시간 : 1초
				--시간 종료될 시, fx_dead 출력과 함께 소멸
				scene_util.set_direction(player_2, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(player_2, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(player_2, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

				scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_2, 'left', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(bombbug_2, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(bombbug_2, self, 'fly')

				character_util.air_spin(player_2, {
					speed = air_spin_speed, offset = vector(6, 0, 5), play_deathsfx = false })
				character_util.air_spin(bombbug_2, {
					speed = air_spin_speed, offset = vector(6, 0, 6), play_deathsfx = false })
			end,
			function()
				coroutine.yield()

				--	 (341 - queencastle_android_lab 4섹션 연출과 동일)
				--노엘 왼쪽 / 이브 오른쪽 으로 카메라 앞으로 날아온다.
				--노엘 (right, damaged, embarrassed)
				--이브 (left, damaged, fly)
				--회전값 720도
				--시간 : 1초
				local duration = 1.5
				local rotation_dir = -720
				local rotation_dir_bombbug_friend = 720

				scene_util.set_direction(noel, 'right')
				scene_util.set_emotion(noel, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(noel, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

				scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'left')
				scene_util.set_emotion(bombbug_friend, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(bombbug_friend, self, 'fly')

				character_util.spine_rotate(noel, rotation_dir, duration + 0.2)
				character_util.spine_scale(noel, unity_class.vector3.one * 7, duration)
				character_util.set_active_shadow(noel, false)

				character_util.spine_rotate(bombbug_friend, rotation_dir_bombbug_friend, duration + 0.2)
				character_util.spine_scale(bombbug_friend, unity_class.vector3.one * 7, duration)
				character_util.set_active_shadow(bombbug_friend, false)

				local start_pos = noel.Position
				local start_pos_bombbug_friend = bombbug_friend.Position
				local end_add_x = -7
				local end_add_x_bombbug_friend = 1
				local end_pos = noel.Position + vector(end_add_x, 10, -16)
				local end_pos_bombbug_friend = noel.Position + vector(end_add_x_bombbug_friend, 10, -16)

				local time_passed = 0
				while time_passed < duration do
					local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
					local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
					local pos_android = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos_bombbug_friend, end_pos_bombbug_friend, progress)
					local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * end_pos.y
					local y_bombbug_friend = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * end_pos_bombbug_friend.y

					noel.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, y)
					bombbug_friend.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos_android, y_bombbug_friend)
					coroutine.yield(nil)

					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				end

				field_object_util.set_active_state(noel, active_state_type.disabled)
				field_object_util.set_active_state(bombbug_friend, active_state_type.disabled)

				wait_for_sec(1.3)
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				--카메라 포커스 1초에 걸쳐 z-8 만큼 이동한다. async 아님.
				camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(0, 0, -8), 1)

				music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0, 1)

				--1초에 걸쳐 화면 검은 색으로 페이드아웃. async
				screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

				camera_util.resize_to_default_async(0)

				--초기화
				field_object_util.set_active_state(noel, active_state_type.enabled)
				field_object_util.set_active_state(bombbug_friend, active_state_type.enabled)

				character_util.spine_scale(noel, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
				character_util.spine_scale(bombbug_friend, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

				character_util.set_active_shadow(noel, true)
				character_util.set_active_shadow(bombbug_friend, true)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bombbug_friend)
			end
	)
end

			scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(noel_recall, self, nil,

			end,
			function()
				--이브 스파인 shake (0.06, 0.3)
				scene_util.shake(bombbug_friend, 0.06, 0.3)

				--이브, notice 이모티콘 출력과 함께 BGM 재생

				scene_util.play_emoticon_action(bombbug_friend, self, 'right',

	)

	--이브 위치에 fx_lasthit 출력. async 아님.
	self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(bombbug_friend.Position)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()

				bombbug_friend_recall.Position = self.wait_pos

				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(noel_recall, 1, 0)

				character_util.set_active_shadow(bombbug_friend, true)
			end

	character_util.remove_emotion(bombbug_friend)
end

function local_class:get_curve_pos(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
	local corner_pos = vector(end_pos.x, start_pos.y, start_pos.z)

	local remaining_progress = 1 - progress

	local weight_start = remaining_progress * remaining_progress
	local weight_corner = 2 * remaining_progress * progress
	local weight_end = progress * progress

	local current_pos = (start_pos * weight_start)
			+ (corner_pos * weight_corner)
			+ (end_pos * weight_end)

	return current_pos
end

			end

			while self.is_rotate_loop do
				character_util.spine_rotate(target, 360, 2)

				character_util.spine_rotate(target, -360, 0)
			end

			self.rotate_end_count = self.rotate_end_count + 1
		end

		local player_1_team_scale_size = 2
		local player_2_team_scale_size = 0.5

		start_coroutine(actor_rotate_loop, noel)
		start_coroutine(actor_rotate_loop, player_1, player_1_team_scale_size)
		start_coroutine(actor_rotate_loop, player_2, player_2_team_scale_size)

function local_class:npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_tint = target_data.tint
		local target_shake = target_data.shake
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop
		local target_effect = target_data.effect
		local target_alpha = target_data.alpha
		local target_function = target_data.coroutine_function
		local target_listener = target_data.listener
		local target_is_not_active = target_data.is_not_active
		local target_oneline_key = target_data.oneline_key
		local target_oneline_sfx_key = target_data.oneline_sfx_key
		local target_crash_behaviour = target_data.crash_behaviour
		local target_is_leader = target_data.is_leader
		local target_anim_scale = target_data.anim_scale
		local target_is_flying = target_data.is_flying

		character_util.spine_rotate(target, 0, 0)

		if target_is_not_active then
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.disabled)
		else
			field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)
		end

		if target_crash_behaviour then
			target.CrashBehaviour = target_crash_behaviour
		end

		if not target_is_leader then
			target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		end

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos, target_is_flying)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_oneline_key then
			target.Interactable.Talk = target_oneline_key
		end

		if target_oneline_sfx_key then
			target.Interactable.TalkSfx = target_oneline_sfx_key
		end

		if target_listener then
			character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, {
				name = target_anim,
				scale = target_anim_scale,
				loop = target_is_anim_loop,
				one_shot_sfx = false,
				sfx_name = false })
		end

		if target_shake then
			scene_util.shake(target, target_shake, 9999, false)
		end

		if target_tint then
			character_util.add_color(target, 'dark_tint', target_tint.color, target_tint.magnitude, 0)
		end

		if target_alpha then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(target, target_alpha, 0)
		end

		if target_effect then
			local fx = target_effect():Instantiate(target.Position)
			self.fx_list[target.Name] = fx
		end

		if target_function then
			start_coroutine(function()
				target_function(target)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fx_dispose_all()
	if self.fx_list then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
			if target then
				target:Dispose()
				target = nil
			end
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

		})

		self.gnome_info_list = nil
		self.pattern_info = nil

		-- war grid fx 처리용
		self.war_grid_fx = nil
		self.war_grid_smoke_fx_count = 7

		-- 업데이트 진행가능 체크
		self.can_update = true
		-- 메인 퀘스트 id
		self.main_quest_id = 7002201
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
		if quest_progress == nil or quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
			self.can_update = false
		end

		local pro_pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
		local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
		local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_noel_bullet_long_dist'):Clone()
		self.shoot_helpers = {}
		self.npc_table = { 'war_field_shooter_1', 'war_field_shooter_2' }

		for i = 1, #self.npc_table do
			local handler = self:get_handler(self.npc_table[i])
			local gnome = handler:get_npc()

			local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, gnome)
			self.shoot_helpers[i] = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
					ps, proj_spec, pro_pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)
		end

		self.gnome_info_list = {
			{
				npc = self:get_handler(self.npc_table[1]):get_npc(),
				pattern_index = 1,
				time_passed = 0,
			},
			{
				npc = self:get_handler(self.npc_table[2]):get_npc(),
				pattern_index = 1,
				--TODO 섹션 1에서 연출 움직임을 고려하여 이후에 동작
				time_passed = -0.16666,
			}
		}

		self.pattern_info = {
			{
				anim = 'rifle_shoot',
				anim_loop = true,
				duration = 1.2,
			},
			{
				anim = 'rifle_idle',
				anim_loop = true,
				duration = 1,
			},
			{
				anim = 'rifle_shoot',
				anim_loop = true,
				duration = 1.2,
			},
			{
				anim = 'rifle_reload',
				anim_loop = false,
				duration = 1,
			},
			{
				anim = 'rifle_idle',
				anim_loop = true,
				duration = 0.5,
			},
		}

		self:active_war_grid_fx()
		update_util.add_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'shot_update')
	end

	function event:shot_update(dt)
		if not self.can_update then
			return
		end

		for i, gnome_info in ipairs(self.gnome_info_list) do
			gnome_info.time_passed = gnome_info.time_passed + dt

			if gnome_info.time_passed >= self.pattern_info[gnome_info.pattern_index].duration then
				gnome_info.time_passed = 0
				gnome_info.pattern_index = (gnome_info.pattern_index % #self.pattern_info) + 1

				if self.pattern_info[gnome_info.pattern_index].anim == 'rifle_shoot' then
					scene_util.set_anim(gnome_info.npc, self,
							{ name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = true, sfx_name = function()
								music_player_util.play_sfx({
									sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01',
									volume = 0.5,
									parent = gnome_info.npc,
									loop = false
								})
								self.fx.gun_fire():Instantiate(gnome_info.npc.Position + vector(0.5, 1, -0.5))
								self.shoot_helpers[i]:ShootTargetPosition(gnome_info.npc.Position + vector(10, 0.5, 0),
										vector(0.5, 0.5, -0.5), 1)
							end })
				else
					scene_util.set_anim(gnome_info.npc, self,
							{ name = self.pattern_info[gnome_info.pattern_index].anim,
							  loop = self.pattern_info[gnome_info.pattern_index].anim_loop })
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function event:active_war_grid_fx()
		if self.war_grid_fx ~= nil then
			return
		end

		self.war_grid_fx = {}

		local screen_fx = self.fx.war_grid_screen_fx():Instantiate(stage_camera.LookAtPosition,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.transform)

		table.insert(self.war_grid_fx, screen_fx)

		for i = 1, self.war_grid_smoke_fx_count do
			local smoke_fx = self.fx.war_grid_smoke_fx():Instantiate(
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_smoke_pos_' .. i))

			table.insert(self.war_grid_fx, smoke_fx)
		end
	end

	function event:deactive_war_grid_fx()
		if self.war_grid_fx == nil then
			return
		end

		for _, fx in pairs(self.war_grid_fx) do
			fx:Dispose()
		end

		self.war_grid_fx = nil
	end

	function event:exit()
		update_util.remove_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'shot_update')

		self:deactive_war_grid_fx()

		self.gnome_info_list = nil
		self.pattern_info = nil
		self.shoot_helpers = nil
		self.npc_table = nil
		self.super:exit()
	end
end

do
	local event = event_groups.upper_war_group

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.main_quest_id = 7002201

		-- npc
		self.npcs = {
			bombbug_friend = function()
				return get_character('bombbug_friend')
			end,
		}

		--fx
		self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
			explosion_bomb = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Explosion_Bomb_new')
			end,
			war_grid_smoke_fx = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fire_smoke_right_view_weak_noel')
			end,
			gun_fire = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_BasicShot_Gun')
			end
		})

		self.req_cnt = 0
		self.npc_count = 8

		-- 이벤트를 한번 봤는지
		self.show_event = false
		-- 퇴장용 이벤트를 볼 수 있는지 처리용
		self.can_zone_event = true

		-- smoke fx용
		self.smoke_fx_table = nil
		self.smoke_fx_count = 4

		-- sfx
		self.war_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if self.can_zone_event and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'war_upper_zone') then
			start_coroutine(self.zone_enter_scene, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'war_upper_grid' and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.npcs.bombbug_friend()) then
			start_coroutine(self.grid_enter_routine, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'war_upper_grid' and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.npcs.bombbug_friend()) then
			self:grid_leave_setting()

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:zone_enter_scene()
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local bombbug_friend = self.npcs.bombbug_friend()

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		--TODO 폭탄벌레의 컨트롤러를 disable 하면 복구해도 문제가 발생해 State를 Disable 하는 것으로 처리
		local controller = bombbug_friend.FieldObjectController
		cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
		controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Disabled

		-- 이후 플레이어가 트리거 존에 재진입시, 카메라 패닝 이벤트는 생략하고 대사 이후 뒤로 돌어가는 이벤트만 나오게끔 처리.
		if not self.show_event then
			self.show_event = true

			--1초동안 ■타일 지점으로 카메라 패닝.
			camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_zone_marker_' .. 1), 1)

			--2초 대기
			wait_for_sec(2)

			--1초동안 ■타일 지점으로 카메라 패닝.
			camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_zone_marker_' .. 2), 1)

			--2초 대기
			wait_for_sec(2)

			--1초동안 카메라 플레이어한테로 원상복구.
			camera_util.move_to_target_async(bombbug_friend, 1, { end_target = bombbug_friend })
		end

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
		character_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'down')
		--플레이어+탑승중인 폭탄벌레 (down, idle, idle) : 여긴 위험해, 이브. 다른데로 가자.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_oneline_war_1')

		local zone = field:GetZone('war_upper_zone')

		local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone, bombbug_friend, 'down', 1)

		character_util.move_to_async(bombbug_friend, return_pos, 1)

		controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled

		--TODO : 대쉬 조작이 남아있는 부분 처리
		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(bombbug_friend, false)
		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(bombbug_friend.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

	function event:grid_enter_routine()
		self:fx_active()
		self:sfx_play()

		-- 애니메이션 처리
		local gnome_animation_delay = { 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.1, 0 }
		local gnome_anim_start_check = { false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false }
		local ant_animation_delay = { 0.2, 0, 0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.1, 0 }
		local ant_anim_start_check = { false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false }

		self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
		local req_cnt = self.req_cnt
		local time_passed = 0
		local pattern_index = 1
		local pattern_time_list = { 1.5, 2.5, 2, 2.5, 2, 2 }

		local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_leader_pos') + vector(0, 0, -1.5)

		while req_cnt == self.req_cnt do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			for i = 1, self.npc_count do
				-- delay가 time_passed가 0이 되기 전에 전부 체크됨
				if not gnome_anim_start_check[i] and gnome_animation_delay[i] <= time_passed then
					gnome_anim_start_check[i] = true

					local gnome = self:get_handler('gnome_' .. i):get_npc()

					music_player_util.play_sfx({
						sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01',
						volume = 0.5,
						parent = gnome,
						loop = false
					})
					scene_util.set_anim(gnome, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = true, sfx_name = function()
						local fx = self.fx.gun_fire():Instantiate(gnome.Position + vector(0.5, 1, -0.5))
						fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
					end })
				end

				if not ant_anim_start_check[i] and ant_animation_delay[i] <= time_passed then
					ant_anim_start_check[i] = true

					local ant = self:get_handler('ant_' .. i):get_npc()

					music_player_util.play_sfx({
						sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01',
						volume = 0.5,
						parent = ant,
						loop = false
					})
					scene_util.set_anim(ant, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', sfx_name = function()
						local fx = self.fx.gun_fire():Instantiate(ant.Position + vector(-0.6, 1, -0.3))
						fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
						fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
					end })
				end
			end

			if pattern_time_list[pattern_index] <= time_passed then
				time_passed = 0

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01', 0.5)
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
				self.fx.explosion_bomb():Instantiate(field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_bomb_pos_' .. pattern_index))

				pattern_index = (pattern_index % #pattern_time_list) + 1
			end

			local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
			local sfx_pos = vector(camera_pos.x, marker_pos.y, marker_pos.z)

			self:sfx_move(sfx_pos)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	function event:grid_leave_setting()
		self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1

		for i = 1, self.npc_count do
			local gnome = self:get_handler('gnome_' .. i):get_npc()

			character_util.remove_anim(gnome)
		end

		for i = 1, self.npc_count do
			local ant = self:get_handler('ant_' .. i):get_npc()

			character_util.remove_anim(ant)
		end

		self:fx_dispose()
		self:sfx_play()
	end

	function event:fx_active()
		if self.smoke_fx_table ~= nil then
			return
		end

		self.smoke_fx_table = {}

		for i = 1, self.smoke_fx_count do
			local fx = self.fx.war_grid_smoke_fx():Instantiate(
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_smoke_marker_' .. i))
			table.insert(self.smoke_fx_table, fx)
		end
	end

	function event:fx_dispose()
		if self.smoke_fx_table == nil then
			return
		end

		for i, fx in ipairs(self.smoke_fx_table) do
			fx:Dispose()
		end

		self.smoke_fx_table = nil
	end

	function event:sfx_play()
		if self.war_loop_sfx ~= nil then
			return
		end

		local sfx_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_leader_pos')

		self.war_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_war_loop_05', loop = true, play_pos = sfx_pos })
	end

	function event:sfx_move(pos)
		if self.war_loop_sfx == nil then
			return
		end

		self.war_loop_sfx:SetPosition(pos)
	end

	function event:sfx_stop()
		if self.war_loop_sfx == nil then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.war_loop_sfx)
		self.war_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

		self:fx_dispose()
		self:sfx_stop()

		self.req_cnt = -10

		self.super:exit()
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

do
	local event = event_groups.war_field_group_1

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.npc_table = nil

		self.shoot_helpers = nil

		self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
			war_grid_screen_fx = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_stage1_spark_screen_fx_noel')
			end,
			war_grid_smoke_fx = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fire_smoke_right_view_weak_noel')
			end,
			gun_fire = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_BasicShot_Gun')
			end
		})

		self.gnome_info_list = nil
		self.pattern_info = nil

		-- war grid fx 처리용
		self.war_grid_fx = nil
		self.war_grid_smoke_fx_count = 7

		-- 업데이트 진행가능 체크
		self.can_update = true
		-- 메인 퀘스트 id
		self.main_quest_id = 7002201
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
		if quest_progress == nil or quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then
			self.can_update = false
		end

		local pro_pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
		local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
		local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_noel_bullet_long_dist'):Clone()
		self.shoot_helpers = {}
		self.npc_table = { 'war_field_shooter_1', 'war_field_shooter_2' }

		for i = 1, #self.npc_table do
			local handler = self:get_handler(self.npc_table[i])
			local gnome = handler:get_npc()

			local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, gnome)
			self.shoot_helpers[i] = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
					ps, proj_spec, pro_pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)
		end

		self.gnome_info_list = {
			{
				npc = self:get_handler(self.npc_table[1]):get_npc(),
				pattern_index = 1,
				time_passed = 0,
			},
			{
				npc = self:get_handler(self.npc_table[2]):get_npc(),
				pattern_index = 1,
				--TODO 섹션 1에서 연출 움직임을 고려하여 이후에 동작
				time_passed = -0.16666,
			}
		}

		self.pattern_info = {
			{
				anim = 'rifle_shoot',
				anim_loop = true,
				duration = 1.2,
			},
			{
				anim = 'rifle_idle',
				anim_loop = true,
				duration = 1,
			},
			{
				anim = 'rifle_shoot',
				anim_loop = true,
				duration = 1.2,
			},
			{
				anim = 'rifle_reload',
				anim_loop = false,
				duration = 1,
			},
			{
				anim = 'rifle_idle',
				anim_loop = true,
				duration = 0.5,
			},
		}

		self:active_war_grid_fx()
		update_util.add_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'shot_update')
	end

	function event:shot_update(dt)
		if not self.can_update then
			return
		end

		for i, gnome_info in ipairs(self.gnome_info_list) do
			gnome_info.time_passed = gnome_info.time_passed + dt

			if gnome_info.time_passed >= self.pattern_info[gnome_info.pattern_index].duration then
				gnome_info.time_passed = 0
				gnome_info.pattern_index = (gnome_info.pattern_index % #self.pattern_info) + 1

				if self.pattern_info[gnome_info.pattern_index].anim == 'rifle_shoot' then
					scene_util.set_anim(gnome_info.npc, self,
							{ name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = true, sfx_name = function()
								music_player_util.play_sfx({
									sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01',
									volume = 0.5,
									parent = gnome_info.npc,
									loop = false
								})
								self.fx.gun_fire():Instantiate(gnome_info.npc.Position + vector(0.5, 1, -0.5))
								self.shoot_helpers[i]:ShootTargetPosition(gnome_info.npc.Position + vector(10, 0.5, 0),
										vector(0.5, 0.5, -0.5), 1)
							end })
				else
					scene_util.set_anim(gnome_info.npc, self,
							{ name = self.pattern_info[gnome_info.pattern_index].anim,
							  loop = self.pattern_info[gnome_info.pattern_index].anim_loop })
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function event:active_war_grid_fx()
		if self.war_grid_fx ~= nil then
			return
		end

		self.war_grid_fx = {}

		local screen_fx = self.fx.war_grid_screen_fx():Instantiate(stage_camera.LookAtPosition,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.transform)

		table.insert(self.war_grid_fx, screen_fx)

		for i = 1, self.war_grid_smoke_fx_count do
			local smoke_fx = self.fx.war_grid_smoke_fx():Instantiate(
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_smoke_pos_' .. i))

			table.insert(self.war_grid_fx, smoke_fx)
		end
	end

	function event:deactive_war_grid_fx()
		if self.war_grid_fx == nil then
			return
		end

		for _, fx in pairs(self.war_grid_fx) do
			fx:Dispose()
		end

		self.war_grid_fx = nil
	end

	function event:exit()
		update_util.remove_update(self, CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent, 'shot_update')

		self:deactive_war_grid_fx()

		self.gnome_info_list = nil
		self.pattern_info = nil
		self.shoot_helpers = nil
		self.npc_table = nil
		self.super:exit()
	end
end

do
	local event = event_groups.upper_war_group

	function event:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
		self.super:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)

		self.main_quest_id = 7002201

		-- npc
		self.npcs = {
			bombbug_friend = function()
				return get_character('bombbug_friend')
			end,
		}

		--fx
		self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
			explosion_bomb = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Explosion_Bomb_new')
			end,
			war_grid_smoke_fx = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fire_smoke_right_view_weak_noel')
			end,
			gun_fire = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_BasicShot_Gun')
			end
		})

		self.req_cnt = 0
		self.npc_count = 8

		-- 이벤트를 한번 봤는지
		self.show_event = false
		-- 퇴장용 이벤트를 볼 수 있는지 처리용
		self.can_zone_event = true

		-- smoke fx용
		self.smoke_fx_table = nil
		self.smoke_fx_count = 4

		-- sfx
		self.war_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	function event:enter()
		self.super:enter()

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	end

	function event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if self.can_zone_event and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'war_upper_zone') then
			start_coroutine(self.zone_enter_scene, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'war_upper_grid' and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.npcs.bombbug_friend()) then
			start_coroutine(self.grid_enter_routine, self)

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'war_upper_grid' and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.npcs.bombbug_friend()) then
			self:grid_leave_setting()

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function event:zone_enter_scene()
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local bombbug_friend = self.npcs.bombbug_friend()

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		--TODO 폭탄벌레의 컨트롤러를 disable 하면 복구해도 문제가 발생해 State를 Disable 하는 것으로 처리
		local controller = bombbug_friend.FieldObjectController
		cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
		controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Disabled

		-- 이후 플레이어가 트리거 존에 재진입시, 카메라 패닝 이벤트는 생략하고 대사 이후 뒤로 돌어가는 이벤트만 나오게끔 처리.
		if not self.show_event then
			self.show_event = true

			--1초동안 ■타일 지점으로 카메라 패닝.
			camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_zone_marker_' .. 1), 1)

			--2초 대기
			wait_for_sec(2)

			--1초동안 ■타일 지점으로 카메라 패닝.
			camera_util.move_async(field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_zone_marker_' .. 2), 1)

			--2초 대기
			wait_for_sec(2)

			--1초동안 카메라 플레이어한테로 원상복구.
			camera_util.move_to_target_async(bombbug_friend, 1, { end_target = bombbug_friend })
		end

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
		character_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'down')
		--플레이어+탑승중인 폭탄벌레 (down, idle, idle) : 여긴 위험해, 이브. 다른데로 가자.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_oneline_war_1')

		local zone = field:GetZone('war_upper_zone')

		local return_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone, bombbug_friend, 'down', 1)

		character_util.move_to_async(bombbug_friend, return_pos, 1)

		controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled

		--TODO : 대쉬 조작이 남아있는 부분 처리
		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(bombbug_friend, false)
		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(bombbug_friend.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

	function event:grid_enter_routine()
		self:fx_active()
		self:sfx_play()

		-- 애니메이션 처리
		local gnome_animation_delay = { 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.1, 0 }
		local gnome_anim_start_check = { false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false }
		local ant_animation_delay = { 0.2, 0, 0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.1, 0 }
		local ant_anim_start_check = { false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false }

		self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
		local req_cnt = self.req_cnt
		local time_passed = 0
		local pattern_index = 1
		local pattern_time_list = { 1.5, 2.5, 2, 2.5, 2, 2 }

		local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_leader_pos') + vector(0, 0, -1.5)

		while req_cnt == self.req_cnt do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			for i = 1, self.npc_count do
				-- delay가 time_passed가 0이 되기 전에 전부 체크됨
				if not gnome_anim_start_check[i] and gnome_animation_delay[i] <= time_passed then
					gnome_anim_start_check[i] = true

					local gnome = self:get_handler('gnome_' .. i):get_npc()

					music_player_util.play_sfx({
						sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01',
						volume = 0.5,
						parent = gnome,
						loop = false
					})
					scene_util.set_anim(gnome, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = true, sfx_name = function()
						local fx = self.fx.gun_fire():Instantiate(gnome.Position + vector(0.5, 1, -0.5))
						fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
					end })
				end

				if not ant_anim_start_check[i] and ant_animation_delay[i] <= time_passed then
					ant_anim_start_check[i] = true

					local ant = self:get_handler('ant_' .. i):get_npc()

					music_player_util.play_sfx({
						sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_01',
						volume = 0.5,
						parent = ant,
						loop = false
					})
					scene_util.set_anim(ant, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', sfx_name = function()
						local fx = self.fx.gun_fire():Instantiate(ant.Position + vector(-0.6, 1, -0.3))
						fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
						fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
					end })
				end
			end

			if pattern_time_list[pattern_index] <= time_passed then
				time_passed = 0

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01', 0.5)
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
				self.fx.explosion_bomb():Instantiate(field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_bomb_pos_' .. pattern_index))

				pattern_index = (pattern_index % #pattern_time_list) + 1
			end

			local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
			local sfx_pos = vector(camera_pos.x, marker_pos.y, marker_pos.z)

			self:sfx_move(sfx_pos)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	function event:grid_leave_setting()
		self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1

		for i = 1, self.npc_count do
			local gnome = self:get_handler('gnome_' .. i):get_npc()

			character_util.remove_anim(gnome)
		end

		for i = 1, self.npc_count do
			local ant = self:get_handler('ant_' .. i):get_npc()

			character_util.remove_anim(ant)
		end

		self:fx_dispose()
		self:sfx_play()
	end

	function event:fx_active()
		if self.smoke_fx_table ~= nil then
			return
		end

		self.smoke_fx_table = {}

		for i = 1, self.smoke_fx_count do
			local fx = self.fx.war_grid_smoke_fx():Instantiate(
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_smoke_marker_' .. i))
			table.insert(self.smoke_fx_table, fx)
		end
	end

	function event:fx_dispose()
		if self.smoke_fx_table == nil then
			return
		end

		for i, fx in ipairs(self.smoke_fx_table) do
			fx:Dispose()
		end

		self.smoke_fx_table = nil
	end

	function event:sfx_play()
		if self.war_loop_sfx ~= nil then
			return
		end

		local sfx_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_leader_pos')

		self.war_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_war_loop_05', loop = true, play_pos = sfx_pos })
	end

	function event:sfx_move(pos)
		if self.war_loop_sfx == nil then
			return
		end

		self.war_loop_sfx:SetPosition(pos)
	end

	function event:sfx_stop()
		if self.war_loop_sfx == nil then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.war_loop_sfx)
		self.war_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	function event:exit()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

		self:fx_dispose()
		self:sfx_stop()

		self.req_cnt = -10

		self.super:exit()
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local controller_base = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Base/QuestControllerBase')

---@class ShortStoryNoelMainController : QuestControllerBase
local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryNoelMainController', controller_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.super:init(cs_controller)

	-- 사용할 섹션 스크립트 정보. 주석 해제하고 사용
	self.script_config = {
		HasPreSection = false,
		NormalSectionCount = 13,
		HasPostSection = false
	}

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	self.group_controller = nil

	self.tavern_versions = {
		winter = 2,
		snow = 3,
	}

	self.is_war_sfx = true

	-- prefab
	self.load_prefab = metatable_helper.inherit({
		container = nil,
		res_holder = nil
	}, {
		add = function(this, path, name)
			if this.container == nil then
				this.container = {}
			end

			if this.res_holder == nil then
				this.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
			end

			local prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(this.res_holder, path, name)

			table.insert(this.container, prefab)
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			for i, prefab in pairs(this.container) do
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(prefab)
				prefab = nil
			end

			this.container = nil
			this.res_holder = nil
		end
	})
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.group_controller = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Noel/Common/OneLineDataControllerShortStoryNoel')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self:stop_war_sfx()
	self:dispose_tavern()
	self:dispose_group_controller()

	self.is_war_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_war_sfx then
		return false
	end

	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.cs_controller.QuestId)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 2 and quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 8 then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') then
			self:stop_war_sfx(1)
			return true
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'war_field') then
			self:play_war_sfx(0.5, 1)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

	local bombbug_friend_screenplay = get_character('bombbug_friend_screenplay')

	bombbug_friend_screenplay.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'idle'
	bombbug_friend_screenplay.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'walk'

	bombbug_friend_screenplay_myth.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'walk'
	bombbug_friend_screenplay_myth.CustomRunAnimationName = 'run'

	character_util.remove_anim(bombbug_friend_screenplay_myth)

function local_class:on_stage_end()
	self:dispose_group_controller()
end

function local_class:set_tavern(pos, is_show)
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 부유성 여관 로드
	tavern_util.load_async(self, {
		center_pos = pos,
		version = is_show and self.tavern_versions.snow or self.tavern_versions.winter,
	})

	local food_count = 4

		return self:on_interact_event(e)

	if self.current_state == self.states.zone_event and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.item()) then

	local tavern_pos = self.markers.tavern_pos()

	--최초 캐릭터는 상단과 같이 배치
	local leader_end_pos = self.markers.leader_pos()

	--노엘 (up, idle, idle) - [gimmick] fool 오브젝트 중앙에 배치.
	character_util.set_position(leader, leader_end_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')

	character_util.spine_scale(leader, unity_class.vector3.zero, 0)

	self.dynamic_npcs:load_async()

	-- 헤븐 홀드 로드

	self.heavenhold_root = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
			'theatres/heavenhold_theatre', 'heavenhold_theatre')

	self.heavenhold_root.transform.localPosition = tavern_pos

	self.heavenhold_theatre = self.heavenhold_root.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.HeavenholdTheatre))

	coroutine.yield(self.heavenhold_theatre:LoadHeavenHoldTheatre(nil))

	-- Theatre의 Background는 안 쓸 것이므로 비활성화
	self.heavenhold_theatre.transform:GetChild(1).gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.heavenhold_christmas = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,

	camera_util.move_async(tavern_pos, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

		local start_size = 6
		local end_size = 2
		local duration = 4
		local time_passed = 0

		local heavenhold_camera = self.heavenhold_root.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))

		heavenhold_camera.orthographicSize = start_size

		while not self.section_exit and time_passed < duration and heavenhold_camera ~= nil do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			heavenhold_camera.orthographicSize = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_size, end_size, time_passed / duration)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	start_coroutine(camera_zoom_in)

function local_class:start_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local bombbug_friend = self.npcs.bombbug_friend()
	local machine_new = self.npcs.machine_new()

	--최초 NPC는 상단의 이미지와 같이 배치.
	local far_smoke_list = {}

	table.insert(far_smoke_list, self.fx.far_smoke():Instantiate(vector(180.5, 0, 38.75)))
	table.insert(far_smoke_list, self.fx.far_smoke():Instantiate(vector(181.25, 0, 37)))
	table.insert(far_smoke_list, self.fx.far_smoke():Instantiate(vector(182.25, 0, 36.25)))
	table.insert(far_smoke_list, self.fx.far_smoke():Instantiate(vector(184, 0, 35.75)))

	local char_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

	-- 노엘 스케일에 맞춰 휴먼이모션 늘려둠
	local human_emotion_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('human_emotion')
	local default_human_emotion = human_emotion_pool.transform.localScale
	human_emotion_pool.transform.localScale = char_scale

	--노엘 (left, idle, idle)
	--캐릭터 스케일 2배
	character_util.set_position(leader, self.markers.leader_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	character_util.spine_scale(leader, char_scale, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.force_update_spines(leader, 0.5)

	--이브 (left, idle, idle)
	--캐릭터 스케일 2배
	character_util.set_position(bombbug_friend, self.markers.bombbug_friend_pos())
	scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'left', false)
	character_util.spine_scale(bombbug_friend, char_scale, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bombbug_friend)
	character_util.force_update_spines(bombbug_friend, 0.5)

	--최초 카메라는 ■지점 포커스중.
	local camera_end_pos = self.controller:get_star_down_right_pos()

	camera_util.move_async(camera_end_pos + vector(0, 0, 5), 0.5)

	--1.5초 동안 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	local bath_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_bath_night_01',
												  loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, volume = 0.2, type_priority = 'event' })

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--2.5초 동안 화면 아래쪽으로 계산된 자표로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(camera_end_pos, 2.5)

	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--노엘 (left, idle, idle 자세로 0.03값 shake 0.5초) : …해, 해냈다.
	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_main_s11_1')

	--노엘 (left, idle, idle) : 살면서 이렇게 높이 올라온 적은 처음이야.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_main_s11_2')

	--노엘 (right, idle, idle) : 정말 고마워, 이브.
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_main_s11_3')

	--노엘 (right, idle, idle) : 네가 도와주지 않았으면 불가능 했을거야.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_main_s11_4')

	--이브 캐릭터 머리 위에rowdy 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(bombbug_friend, nil, 'rowdy')

	--노엘 (left, idle, idle) 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--노엘 (left, idle, seat) 전환.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'seat')
	--0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--노엘 (left, idle, seat) : …저길 봐, 이브.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_main_s11_5')

	--1초 동안 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(bath_sfx, 1)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 다른 씬 보여주는 부분이라 사이즈 원복
	human_emotion_pool.transform.localScale = default_human_emotion

	self:scene_1()

	self:reset_dynamic_npcs()

	self:scene_2()

	self:reset_dynamic_npcs()

	self:scene_3()

	self:reset_dynamic_npcs()

	-- 다시 노엘 씬이라 스케일 키움
	human_emotion_pool.transform.localScale = char_scale

	--카메라는 다시 노엘, 이브 캐릭터 지점 위치로 복귀.
	--화면 페이드 아웃 완료된 이후, 0.5초 대기
	camera_util.move_async(camera_end_pos, 0.5)

	--1초 동안 화면 일반 페이드 인.
	bath_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_bath_night_01',
											loop = true, fade_in_time = 1, volume = 0.2, type_priority = 'event' })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--노엘 (left, tired, seat) : 모두가 힘들어 하고 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'seat', 'tired', 'ss_noel_main_s11_6')

	--노엘 (left, tired, seat) : 노움들 뿐만 아니라 개미들까지… 모두가.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'seat', 'tired', 'ss_noel_main_s11_7')

	--노엘 (left, tired, seat) : …이대로라면 모두가 공멸하고 말거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'seat', 'tired', 'ss_noel_main_s11_8')

	--노엘 (left, tired, idle) 자세 전환.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--노엘 이동속도 값 1 walk 자세로 left 방향 1.5칸 이동.
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 1)

	--노엘 (left, tired, eat 1초) [끝날때까지 대기]
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--동시 실행

	--노엘 캐릭터의 왼쪽 1칸 옆에 shortstory_noel_machine_new (임시) 스파인 배치.
	character_util.set_position(machine_new, leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.spine_scale(machine_new, unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5, 0)
	--+ FX_dead 이펙트 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_inspector_back_chain_01')
	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(machine_new.Position)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--노엘 (left, tired, idle) : …….
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'idle', 'tired', 'ss_noel_main_s11_9')

	--노엘 (left, tired, idle) : 정말 이 발명품으로 사람들의 마음의 상처를 치료해줄 수 있다면…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, 'tired', 'ss_noel_main_s11_10')

	--노엘 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 정말로… 전쟁이 멈추고…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, 'sleep_deep', 'ss_noel_main_s11_11')

	--노엘 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 모두가 행복해하는 평화가 올수 있다면…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, 'ss_noel_main_s11_12')

	--노엘 캐릭터 머리 위에 (silence) 이모티콘 표시.
	character_util.show_emoticon_with_data_async(leader.Transform, nil, 'silence',
			nil, { offset = vector(0, 2.5, 0) })
	
	--노엘 (left, attack, idle) : 부디… 도와주세요, 웃는 얼굴님…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'ss_noel_main_s11_13')

	--노엘 (left, attack, idle) : 박사님의 뜻이… 모두에게 닿게…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'ss_noel_main_s11_14')

	--노엘 (left, attack, cast 자세로 0.03값 shake) : 모라 그 아이의 상처가 깨끗히 나은 것처럼...!
	scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.5)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'attack', 'ss_noel_main_s11_15')

	--노엘 (left, attack, cast 자세로 0.03값 shake) : 모두의 마음의 상처를 치료하고…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'attack', 'ss_noel_main_s11_16')

	--동시 실행
	--화면 0.3값으로 0.5초 shake.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	--노엘 (left, attack, cast2) : [shout]평화를 가져다 주세요…!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'attack', 'ss_noel_main_s11_17')

	local clang_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true })
	--노엘 (left, attack, eat) 자세 지속
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--shortstory_noel_machine_new 스파인의 ‘open’ 애니메이션 출력 [끝날때까지 대기]
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(machine_new, self, { name = 'open', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--shortstory_noel_machine_new  스파인 0.03값으로 shake 지속.
	scene_util.shake(machine_new, 0.03, 10)
	--shortstory_noel_machine_new  스파인 1.2초 동안 하얀 틴트 값 100% 적용. [끝날때까지 대기]
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	character_util.add_fade_color(machine_new, machine_new.Name, unity_class.color.white, 1, 1.2)
	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	--0.5초 대기
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(clang_sfx, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--shortstory_noel_machine_new  스파인 0.8초 동안 틴트값 원상복구. [async 아님]

function local_class:reset_dynamic_npcs()
	local reset_npc = function(target)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
		character_util.spine_remove_attachment(target, '[base]weapon1')
		character_util.remove_color(target, target.Name, 0)
		character_util.force_update_spines(target, 2)
	end

	for i = 1, self.dynamic_npcs.gnome_count do
		local gnome = self.dynamic_npcs:get('gnome_' .. i)

		reset_npc(gnome)
	end

	for i = 1, self.dynamic_npcs.ant_count do
		local ant = self.dynamic_npcs:get('ant_' .. i)

		reset_npc(ant)
	end
end

function local_class:scene_1()
	local gnomes = {}
	local ants = {}
	local gnome_count = 8
	local ant_count = 8

	local gnome_animation_delay = { 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.1, 0 }

	--노움1~8 (right, attack, rifle_shoot 지속)
	--총을 쏘는 타이밍 (rifle_shoot 애니메이션의 0.1초 구간)에
	--총구에서 FX_Common_BasicShot_Gun 이펙트 (크기 현재의 0.5배로 조정) 이펙트 출력.
	for i = 1, gnome_count do
		local gnome = self.dynamic_npcs:get('gnome_' .. i)

		character_util.set_position(gnome, self.markers.gnome_pos(1, i))
		character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'right')
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(gnome, '[base]weapon1', 'basic_rifle')
		scene_util.set_emotion(gnome, self, 'attack')

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(gnome_animation_delay[i])

			scene_util.set_anim(gnome, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', sfx_name = function()
				local fx = self.fx.gun_fire():Instantiate(gnome.Position + vector(0.5, 1, -0.5))

				fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
				fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
			end })
		end)

		table.insert(gnomes, gnome)
	end

	local ant_animation_delay = { 0.2, 0, 0.1, 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.1, 0 }

	--개미1~8 (left, attack, rifle_shoot 지속)
	--모든 NPC 스파인 : shortstory_noel_ant_soldier 통일
	--basic_rifle 장착
	--총을 쏘는 타이밍 (rifle_shoot 애니메이션의 0.1초 구간)에, 총구에서 FX_Common_BasicShot_Gun 이펙트 출력.
	for i = 1, ant_count do
		local ant = self.dynamic_npcs:get('ant_' .. i)

		character_util.set_position(ant, self.markers.ant_pos(1, i))
		character_util.set_direction(ant, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(ant, self, 'attack')
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(ant, '[base]weapon1', 'basic_rifle')

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(ant_animation_delay[i])

			scene_util.set_anim(ant, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', sfx_name = function()
				local fx = self.fx.gun_fire():Instantiate(ant.Position + vector(-0.6, 1, -0.3))

				fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
				fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
			end })
		end)

		table.insert(ants, ant)
	end

	--최초 카메라는 ■지점 포커스중.
	camera_util.move_async(self.markers.camera_pos(2), 0)

	local dead_action = function(target, play_sfx)
		--NPC에 FX_hit 와 FX_lasthit 이펙트, Damage Squish, Red pulse 출력됨
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)

		--(right, damaged, dead) 자세 전환.
		scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = 'dead', sfx_name = play_sfx and '01_trip_01' or nil })

		--dead 자세 진행 시작했을 때, 1초동안 캐릭터 검은 틴트 70% 효과 적용.
		character_util.add_color(target, target.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 1)
	end

	--■1,2,3,4,5,6,7번 지점에는 fx_fire_smoke_right_view_weak_noel 이펙트 배치.
	local smoke_fx_list = {}
	local smoke_count = 7

	for i = 1, smoke_count do
		local smoke_fx = self.fx.smoke_fx():Instantiate(self.markers.smoke_pos(i))

		table.insert(smoke_fx_list, smoke_fx)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--1초 동안 화면 일반 페이드 인.

		sfx_name = '01_war_loop_05', loop = true, volume = 1, fade_in_time = 1 })
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--7초 동안 카메라 오른쪽으로 28칸 이동.
	camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(28, 0, 0), 7)

	--[카메라가 이동한지 2초가 지났을 때]
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--노움1 액션 실행

	--[카메라가 이동한지 2.5초가 지났을 때]
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--노움4 액션 실행

	--[카메라가 이동한지 4.8초가 지났을 때]

	--개미2 액션 실행

	dead_action(ants[7])

	--[카메라가 이동한지 6초가 지났을 때]
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--1초 동안 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
