local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryNoelMainSection13')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryNoelMain @
		Comment = 노엘이 노움 세상 밖으로 나옴@
		Index = 12 @
		NextSections = 13 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryNoelMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_noel'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		zone_enter = 2
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- npc
	self.npcs = {
		scientist = function()
			return get_character('scientist')
		end,
		bombbug_friend = function()
			return get_character('bombbug_friend_screenplay_myth')
		end,
		noel_ride_bombbug = function()
			return get_character('noel_ride_bombbug_myth')
		end
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		leader_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_leader_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		bombbug_friend_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_bombbug_friend_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		camera_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_camera_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		tavern_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('tavern_pos')
		end,
		trail_fx_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s13_trail_fx_pos')
		end
	}

	-- field objectd
	self.fo = {
		exit = function()
			return get_field_object('s13_exit')
		end
	}

	-- dynamic npc
	self.dynamic_npcs = metatable_helper.inherit({
		container = nil,
		specs = {
			knight_male = 'shortstory_noel_knight_male',
			knight_female = 'shortstory_noel_knight_female',
			princess = 'shortstory_noel_princess',
			maiden = 'shortstory_noel_maiden',
			knight_captain = 'shortstory_noel_knight_captain',
		}
	}, {
		load_async = function(this)
			if this.container ~= nil then
				return
			end

			this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async('main_s13_', this.specs)
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.container == nil then
				return
			end

			load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

			this.container = nil
		end,

		get = function(this, name)
			return this.container[name]
		end
	})

	-- fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		fail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fail')
		end,
		tail_red = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_fairy_tail_red')
		end,
		camera_fx_outside = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_noel_stage_snow_camera_new_outside')
		end,
	})

	self.tail_red_fx = nil

	-- 타이핑 텍스트 관련
	self.res_holder = nil
	self.typing_text = nil
	self.typing_text_go = nil

	self.snow_tavern_version = 2
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	self.controller:dispose_tavern()

	if not is_unity_null(self.typing_text_go) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.typing_text_go)
	end

	self.typing_text_go = nil

	self.typing_text = nil

	if self.tail_red_fx ~= nil then
		self.tail_red_fx:Dispose()
		self.tail_red_fx = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
	end

	self.res_holder = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.zone_enter
		sp_util.start_scene(self.zone_enter_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:load_typing_text()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
				self.typing_text_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.typing_text = self.typing_text_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

				self.typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 350, 1, 50)
				self.typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0.1
				self.typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
				self.typing_text.Label.fontSize = 32
			end)
end

function local_class:show_typing_text(key, wait, with_sfx)
	if wait then
		if with_sfx then
			start_coroutine(function()
				-- Progress = 0 실행까지 한프레임 대기
				coroutine.yield(nil)

				local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '03_dialogue_02', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
				})

				while self.typing_text.Progress < 1 do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				sfx:Stop()
			end)
		end

		yield_return_func(self.typing_text.SetTypedText, self.typing_text,
				game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key), 1000, 0.03)
	else
		start_coroutine_enumerator(self.typing_text:SetTypedText(
				game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key), 1000, 0.03))
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryNoelMainSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryNoelMain @
		Comment = 노엘이 노움들을 응급처치@
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryNoelMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_noel'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		zone_event = 2,
		talk_gnome_commander = 3,
		section_end = 4
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- field object
	self.fo = {
		exit = function()
			return get_field_object('village_in1')
		end
	}

	self.cashed_interactable = nil

	-- npc
	self.npcs = {
		gnome_commander = function()
			return get_character('gnome_commander')
		end,
		help_gnome = function(number)
			return get_character('s1_help_gnome_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		gnome_help_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_gnome_help_pos_' .. number)
		end,
	}

	-- fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		heal = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_heal_a')
		end,
	})

	-- 도와줄 노움 체크
	self.help_gnome_check = {
		{
			check = false,
			func = self.help_gnome_a_scene
		},
		{
			check = false,
			func = self.help_gnome_b_scene
		},
		{
			check = false,
			func = self.help_gnome_c_scene
		},
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	self.fx:create_all()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.cashed_interactable = self.fo.exit().Interactable
	self.fo.exit().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		self.controller:play_war_sfx(0.5)
	else
		music_player_util.start_bgm_manager()
	end

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('village_out1') },
		{ zone = 'war_field', target = self.npcs.gnome_commander() },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.npcs.gnome_commander(), self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.npcs.help_gnome(1), self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.npcs.help_gnome(2), self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.npcs.help_gnome(3), self)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest_2')
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest_3')

	if self.cashed_interactable ~= nil then
		self.fo.exit().Interactable = self.cashed_interactable
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.zone_event and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npcs.gnome_commander()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_gnome_commander
		sp_util.start_scene(self.first_talk_gnome_commander_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	for i = 1, #self.help_gnome_check do
		if not self.help_gnome_check[i].check and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npcs.help_gnome(i)) then
			self.help_gnome_check[i].check = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.help_gnome_check[i].func, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.exit()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

			local leader = get_party_leader()

			--노엘 : 아직 다친 병사들을 치료하지 않았어.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_main_s2_0')

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.zone_event
		start_coroutine(self.zone_enter_talk_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

	--노움 대장(할아버지) (left, tired, idle) : 그런데… 선생님께선 괜찮으신가요?

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryNoelMainSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryNoelMain @
		Comment = 이브를 만나러 감@
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryNoelMainController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_noel'

	-- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		talk_event = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	-- npc
	self.npcs = {
		bombbug_friend = function()
			return get_character('bombbug_friend')
		end,
	}
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 폭탄 벌레 탑승로직 타지 않도록 Interacable 변경
	local bombbug_friend = self.npcs.bombbug_friend()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(bombbug_friend, bombbug_friend.FieldObjectBehaviour)
	bombbug_friend.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	bombbug_friend.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	--최초 메인 퀘스트 마커는 이브 폭탄벌레 NPC를 가리키도록 출력.
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('village_out2') },
		{ zone = 'fly_field', target = self.npcs.bombbug_friend() },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	-- 폭탄 벌레 Interacable 원복
	local bombbug_friend = self.npcs.bombbug_friend()

	bombbug_friend.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	bombbug_friend.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	character_util.add_listener(bombbug_friend, bombbug_friend.FieldObjectBehaviour)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npcs.bombbug_friend()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.talk_event
		sp_util.start_scene(self.talk_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

---플레이어가 이브 폭탄벌레 NPC를 인터렉트 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행.
function local_class:talk_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local bombbug_friend = self.npcs.bombbug_friend()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--1초동안 노엘 캐릭터 ■지점으로 left 방향 walk 자세로 정렬.
	wp_util.move_async(leader, bombbug_friend.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--노엘 (left, idle, sing) : 이브, 잘 있었어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'sing', nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_1')

	--노엘 (left, idle, sing) : 나 없는 동안 다른 애들하고 싸운거 아니지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'sing', nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_2')

	--이브 캐릭터 머리 위에rowdy 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(bombbug_friend, nil, 'rowdy')

	--이브 폭탄 벌레 캐릭터 (right, idle, fly_start) 자세 전환. [자세 전환 완료될 때까지 대기]
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_loop_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(bombbug_friend, self, { name = 'fly_start', count = 1 })

	--이후 이브 폭탄 벌레 캐릭터 (right, idle, fly_idle) 자세로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(bombbug_friend, self, 'fly_idle')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--노엘 (left, idle, idle) : 왜 그러니?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_3')

	--노엘 (left, idle, nod 1회) : 아, 날개가 가렵나 보구나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_4')

	--노엘 (left, idle, idle) : 잠깐 뒤로 돌아볼래?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_5')

	--이브 (left, idle, fly_idle) 자세로 전환.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_loop_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'left', false)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--노엘 이동속도 1값 walk 자세로 left 방향 0.5칸 이동 [끝날때까지 대기]
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1)

	--노엘 (left, idle, eat) 자세로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')

	--1차 QTE 출력.
	--QTE 종류 : 터보탭
	--횟수 : 10번
	--QTE 실패 없음.
	qte_play_util.tap(10, { tap_count_callback = function()
		--1번 성공할 때마다, 이브 캐릭터 0.03값 shake 0.5초 출력
		scene_util.shake(bombbug_friend, 0.03, 0.5)
	end })

	--노엘 (left, idle, eat) : 여기 긁어주는게 좋아?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true }, nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_6')

	--이브 캐릭터 머리 위에 heart 이모티콘 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(bombbug_friend, self, 'smile')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(bombbug_friend, nil, 'heart')

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	--노엘 left 방향 고정한채로 이동속도 1값 walk 자세로 right 방향 0.5칸 이동 [끝날때까지 대기]
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			1, nil, { locked_dir = 'left', last_direction = 'left' })

	--이브 (right, idle, fly_end) 자세 전환. [자세 전환 완료될 때까지 대기]
	scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_emotion(bombbug_friend)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(bombbug_friend, self, { name = 'fly_end', count = 1 })

	--이후 이브 폭탄 벌레 캐릭터 (right, idle, idle) 자세로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(bombbug_friend, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim(bombbug_friend)

	--노엘 (left, idle, nod 1회) : 옳지, 착하다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_7')

	--노엘 (left, idle, idle) : 지금부터 외곽 구역을 날아다니면서 필요한 재료들을 찾으러 다닐거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_8')

	--노엘 (left, idle, idle) : 최근 경비가 삼엄하다고 했으니까, 최대한 조심해서 날아다녀야 해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_9')

	--노엘 (left, idle, idle) : 일 끝나고 나중에 맛있는거 사줄게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
			nil, nil, 'ss_noel_main_s4_10')

	--이브 캐릭터 머리 위에happy 이모티콘 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(bombbug_friend, nil, 'happy')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	self.controller:progress_section()

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_noel'

	-- field object
	self.fo = {
		item = function(number)
			return get_field_object('s5_item_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- 섹션 이벤트
	self.section_event = setmetatable({
		event_controllers = nil,
		data_storage = nil,
		custom_state_key = 's5_save_state',
		event_list = {
			{ path = 'Quest/ShortStory/Noel/Main/GetItemA.lua', clear_value = 1,
			  marker_key = 'main_quest_2', fo = self.fo.item(1) },
			{ path = 'Quest/ShortStory/Noel/Main/GetItemB.lua', clear_value = 2,
			  marker_key = 'main_quest_3', fo = self.fo.item(2) },
		},
	}, {
		__index = {
			init_event = function(this, quest_id)
				if this.event_controllers == nil then
					this.event_controllers = {}
				end

				local storage_create = require('utils/QuestDataStorage')
				this.data_storage = storage_create.create(quest_id)

				local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

				for num, info in ipairs(this.event_list) do
					--클리어 체크
					if (custom_state & info.clear_value) == 0 then
						local is_create, event_controller = global_table_util.try_create(info.path)

						if is_create then
							event_controller:init_controller(self, info.clear_value)
							table.insert(this.event_controllers, event_controller)
						end
					end
				end
			end,

			get_custom_state = function(this)
				local custom_state = this.data_storage:get_data(this.custom_state_key)

				return custom_state < 0 and 0 or custom_state
			end,

			clear_event = function(this, value)
				local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

				custom_state = custom_state | value
				this.data_storage:set_data_async(this.custom_state_key, custom_state)

				if this:check_section_clear() then
					self:clear_section()
				else
					music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
				end
			end,

			check_section_clear = function(this)
				if this.data_storage == nil then
					return
				end

				local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

				for i = 1, #this.event_list do
					if (custom_state & this.event_list[i].clear_value) == 0 then
						return false
					end
				end

				return true
			end,

			active_marker = function(this)
				if this.data_storage == nil then
					return
				end

				local custom_state = this:get_custom_state()

				for i = 1, #this.event_list do
					if (custom_state & this.event_list[i].clear_value) == 0 then
						if this.event_list[i].marker_key == 'main_quest_2' then
							quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.event_list[i].marker_key, {
								{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('village_out2') },
								{ zone = 'fly_field', target = get_field_object('s5_inner_1') },
								{ zone = 'ant_field', target = self.fo.item(1)},
							})
						else
							quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(this.event_list[i].marker_key, {
								{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('village_out2') },
								{ zone = 'fly_field', target = self.fo.item(2) },
							})
						end
					end
				end
			end,

			deactive_marker = function(this)
				for i = 1, #this.event_list do
					quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(this.event_list[i].marker_key)
				end
			end,

			dispose_event = function(this)
				for i = 1, #this.event_controllers do
					this.event_controllers[i] = nil
				end

				this.data_storage = nil
				this.event_controllers = nil
			end
		}
	})
end

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryNoelMainController
	self.controller = controller

			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_scientist_pos_' .. number)

			return field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_gnome_pos_' .. number)

	}

	self.dynamic_npcs = metatable_helper.inherit({
		container = nil,

			gnome_1 = 'shortstory_noel_gnome_male',
			gnome_2 = 'shortstory_noel_gnome_male',
			gnome_3 = 'shortstory_noel_gnome_female',

			gnome_9 = 'shortstory_noel_gnome_male',

		}
	}, {

			if this.container ~= nil then
				return
			end

			this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async('main_s7_', this.specs)
		end,

end

function local_class:need_skip()
	return false
end

function local_class:enter()
	start_coroutine(self.npc_setting, self)

	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		self.stage_music_clip = music_player.CurrentStageMusicName
		music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.cs_section.IsStartedOnThis then
		music_player_util.stop_bgm_manager()
		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = self.stage_music_clip, state = 'field' })
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event', volume = 1 })
		self.controller.amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_amb_cave_01', volume = 0.3, fade_in_time = 1, loop = true })
	end

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = self.npcs.scientist() },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'room_field_1') then
		if self.controller.amb_sfx == nil then
			self.controller.amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '01_amb_cave_01', volume = 0.3, fade_in_time = 1, loop = true })
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') then
		if self.controller.amb_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.controller.amb_sfx, 1)
			self.controller.amb_sfx = nil
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.states.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's7_event_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.states.zone_event
		sp_util.start_scene(self.zone_enter_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

		{ zone = 'room_field_1', target = self.fo.diary().Position + vector(0, 1, 0.5) },
	})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	self.fo.diary().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.controller.load_prefab:dispose_all()

	self.grading_controller = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.fo.diary()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.interact_diary
		sp_util.start_scene(self.show_diary_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:load_bullet()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
			'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom')

	local custom_atlas
	custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
	custom_atlas:Initialize()

	self.bullet = self.fx.custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
	local bullet_sprite = self.bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'small_shot_normal.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:bullet_move(start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	self.bullet.transform.position = start_pos
	local trail_fx = self.fx.shot_trail():Instantiate(start_pos)

	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bullet_whoosh_01')

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_dir = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
				* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos,
				unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration))

		self.bullet.transform.localRotation = cur_dir
		self.bullet.transform.position = cur_pos
		trail_fx.transform.localPosition = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.bullet.transform.position = target_pos
end

function local_class:load_attack_range()
	self.attack_range = attack_range_util.create_rect(vector(999, 0, 999), vector(0.5, 60))
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(start_pos, dir)
	local quaternion = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-90, unity_class.vector3.up)
	local rotate_vector = quaternion * dir

	attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, start_pos)
	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, start_pos, rotate_vector)
	attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')
end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(ant_2, self, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	--1초 동안 카메라 플레이어한테로 원상복구.
	camera_util.move_to_target_async(game_player, 1)

	camera_move_check = true

	--[QTE 피하기 시작]
	character_util.set_position(game_player, center_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(game_player, 'right')
	--scene_util.set_emotion(game_player, self, 'surprise')

	while not check_setting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	while not self.is_stage_exit do
		--플레이어의 위치를 화면 중심으로 기준. 상단의 이미지와 같이 ①번 직사각형의 None (기본값) 어택레인지 출력.
		local start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right',
				game_player.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 2)
		local dir = (game_player.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5) - start_pos).normalized

		self:show_attack_range(start_pos, dir)

		--노엘 (right, surprise, fly 자세로 jump 1회)
		scene_util.set_emotion(game_player, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(game_player, true)

		--노엘 (right, surprise, fly) : 위, 위험해! 이브!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(game_player, 'ss_noel_main_s9_12')

		--QTE 출력.
		--QTE 종류 : 스와이프(←)
		--횟수 : 1번
		--제한 시간 : 2초
		--QTE 동안 암전 처리.
		--QTE 실패 시 연출
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		local is_success = qte_play_util.swipe('left', { duration = 2 })

		attack_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

		if not is_success then
			--①번 지점에서 small_shot_normal 프로젝타일이 플레이어 캐릭터 방향을 향해 날아와(속도:9) 노엘 캐릭터에 맞으며 총알 삭제됨.
			self:bullet_move(start_pos, game_player.Position, 0.3)

			goto continue
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_flying_bug_01')
			--QTE 성공시 하단의 이벤트 진행.
			local target_pos = start_pos + dir * 30
			--노엘 캐릭터 0.25초 동안 left 방향으로 왼쪽 아래 대각선 1.5칸으로 이동.
			character_util.set_direction(game_player, 'left')
			character_util.move_to(game_player, game_player.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -1.5), 0.25)
			--①번 지점에서 small_shot_normal 프로젝타일이 직선 방향을 향해 날아와(속도:9) 화면 바깥으로 나가며 총알 삭제됨.
			self:bullet_move(start_pos, target_pos, 0.9)

			--0.2초 대기
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end

		--플레이어의 위치를 화면 중심으로 기준. 상단의 이미지와 같이 ②번 직사각형의 None (기본값) 어택레인지 출력.
		start_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left',
				game_player.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), -1)
		dir = (game_player.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25) - start_pos).normalized

		self:show_attack_range(start_pos, dir)
		--0.2초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		is_success = qte_play_util.swipe('up', { duration = 2 })

		attack_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

		if not is_success then
			self:bullet_move(start_pos, game_player.Position, 0.3)

			goto continue
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_flying_bug_01')
			--QTE 성공시 하단의 이벤트 진행.
			local target_pos = start_pos + dir * 30
			--노엘 캐릭터 0.25초 동안 up 방향으로 위쪽 1.5칸으로 이동.
			character_util.set_direction(game_player, 'up')
			character_util.move_to(game_player, game_player.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 0.25)
			--②번 지점에서 small_shot_normal 프로젝타일이 플레이어 캐릭터 방향을 향해 날아와(속도:9) 노엘 캐릭터에 맞으며 총알 삭제됨.
			self:bullet_move(start_pos, target_pos, 0.9)

			--0.7초 대기
			wait_for_sec(0.7)

			break
		end

		::continue::

		--프로젝타일이 노엘 캐릭터한테 맞는 타이밍에 맞춰, 화면 0.3값으로 0.5초 shake.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_huntress_hit_01')
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
		--프로젝타일이 노엘 캐릭터한테 맞는 타이밍에 맞춰, 노엘 캐릭터 위치에 FX_hit 와 FX_lasthit 이펙트, Damage Squish, Red pulse 출력됨.
		self.bullet.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(game_player)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(game_player)
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(game_player.Position)
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(game_player.Position)
		--화면 현재 위치에 고정된 채로 유지.
		--동시 실행
		--노엘 캐릭터 damaged 표정으로 전환.
		character_util.set_direction(game_player, 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion(game_player, self, 'damaged')
		--노엘 캐릭터 0.8초동안 회전 3바퀴.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
		character_util.spine_rotate(game_player, 1080, 0.8)
		--노엘 캐릭터 0.8초동안 아래쪽 화면 바깥으로 이동
		character_util.move_to_async(game_player,
				screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', game_player.Position, -2), 0.8)
		--게임오버 서큘러 페이드 아웃.
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6)

		character_util.set_position(game_player, center_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(game_player, 'right')
		character_util.spine_rotate(game_player, 0, 0)
		character_util.remove_emotion(game_player)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6)
	end

	--노엘 (up, idle, fly) : 큰, 큰일날 뻔 했다…!
	character_util.remove_emotion(game_player)
	character_util.set_direction(game_player, 'up')
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(game_player, 'ss_noel_main_s9_13')

	--노엘 (up, idle, fly) : 서두르자, 이브…!
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(game_player, 'ss_noel_main_s9_14')

	--카메라 현재 위치에 고정.
	--노엘+폭탄벌레 캐릭터 이동속도 값 5 으로 화면 위쪽 바깥으로 이동하며 사라짐. [끝날때까지 대기]
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_loop_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(game_player,
			screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', game_player.Position, 1), nil, 5)

	--1초동안 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--TODO 미리 폭탄벌레 지상으로 이동 후 탑승 해제 해줘야함 Y 값은 폭탄벌레 탑승 중 높이
	local stage_controller = get_stage_event_controller('ShortStoryNoelController')

	character_util.set_position(bombbug_friend, vector(0, 2.5, 0))
	bombbug_friend.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsPlayRideSfx = false
	stage_controller.bgm_info.can_change_bgm = false
	bombbug_friend.FieldObjectBehaviour:Land()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	bombbug_friend.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsPlayRideSfx = true
	stage_controller.bgm_info.bgm_name = 'bgm_flight_02'
	stage_controller.bgm_info.can_change_bgm = true
	stage_controller.house_shake_grid_info.req_cnt = stage_controller.house_shake_grid_info.req_cnt + 1
	character_util.set_position(bombbug_friend, vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- 불꽃 fx는 화면 페이드 아웃 이후 제거
	self.controller:progress_section()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryNoelWaveringFaithPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = ShortStoryNoelWaveringFaith @
		Comment = @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
	---@type ShortStoryNoelWaveringFaithController
	self.controller = controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	---@type LuaQuestEventSection
	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
	self.available_stage_names = 'shortstory_noel'

	-- npc
	self.npcs = {
		gnome = function(number)
			return get_character('wavering_faith_gnome_' .. number)
		end,
		missionary = function()
			return get_character('wavering_faith_missionary')
		end,
	}

	-- 불신자 숫자
	self.gnome_count = 3

	-- marker
	self.markers = {
		gnome_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('wavering_faith_gnome_pos_' .. number)
		end,
		missionary_pos = function()
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('wavering_faith_missionary_pos')
		end,
		sacred_object_pos = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('wavering_faith_sacred_object_pos_' .. number)
		end
	}

	-- field object
	self.fo = {
		green_pepper = function()
			return get_field_object('sacred_object_green_pepper')
		end,
		gold_coin = function()
			return get_field_object('sacred_object_gold_coin')
		end,
		candle = function()
			return get_field_object('sacred_object_candle')
		end,
		brazier = function()
			return get_field_object('wavering_faith_brazier')
		end,
		coin_box = function()
			return get_field_object('wavering_faith_coin_box')
		end
	}

	-- fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end
	})

	self.fx_list = nil
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:set_post_section()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	if self.fx_list ~= nil then
		for i, fx_info in ipairs(self.fx_list) do
			fx_info.fx:Dispose()
		end

		self.fx_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if e.IsTurningOn and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, get_field_object('puzzle3_switch_reset_1')) then
		self.controller:reset_brazier()

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:set_post_section()
	--우측 상단 모금함 인터렉트 시, 텍스트 변경
	--현재 모금액 : 100000 골드
	local coin_box = self.fo.coin_box()

	coin_box.Interactable.Message = 'ss_noel_sign_4'

	--노엘이 모아놓은 성물 오브젝트 object_twinkle 파티클 상태로 반짝반짝 빛이 난다.
	local green_pepper = self.fo.green_pepper()
	local gold_coin = self.fo.gold_coin()
	local candle = self.fo.candle()

	green_pepper.Position = self.markers.sacred_object_pos(1)
	gold_coin.Position = self.markers.sacred_object_pos(2)
	candle.Position = self.markers.sacred_object_pos(3)

	green_pepper.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	gold_coin.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	candle.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	self.fx_list = {}

	table.insert(self.fx_list, {
		key = 1,
		fx = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(green_pepper.Position,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, green_pepper.transform)
	})
	table.insert(self.fx_list, {
		key = 2,
		fx = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(gold_coin.Position,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, gold_coin.transform)
	})
	table.insert(self.fx_list, {
		key = 3,
		fx = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(candle.Position,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, candle.transform)
	})

	--선교사와 불신자 노움들 원라인 npc로 전환
	--선교사 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : 웃는 얼굴 님을 믿사오며…
	local missionary = self.npcs.missionary()

	character_util.set_position(missionary, self.markers.missionary_pos())
	character_util.set_direction(missionary, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion(missionary, self, 'sleep_deep')
	missionary.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_noel_wavering_faith_post_1'

	--불신자 노움 1, 2 (right, smile, clap) : 로-멘!!
	local gnome_1 = self.npcs.gnome(1)

	character_util.set_position(gnome_1, self.markers.gnome_pos(1))
	character_util.set_direction(gnome_1, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(gnome_1, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(gnome_1, self, { name = 'clap', one_shot_sfx = false })
	gnome_1.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_noel_wavering_faith_post_2'
	gnome_1.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_clap_01'

	local gnome_2 = self.npcs.gnome(2)

	character_util.set_position(gnome_2, self.markers.gnome_pos(2))
	character_util.set_direction(gnome_2, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(gnome_2, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(gnome_2, self, { name = 'clap', one_shot_sfx = false })
	gnome_2.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_noel_wavering_faith_post_2'
	gnome_2.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_clap_01'

	--불신자 노움 3 (right, smile, eat) : 예금 적금은 무슨! 대세는 헌금이지~!
	local gnome_3 = self.npcs.gnome(3)

	character_util.set_position(gnome_3, coin_box.Position + vector(-0.8, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(gnome_3, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(gnome_3, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(gnome_3, self, 'eat')
	gnome_3.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_noel_wavering_faith_post_3'
	gnome_3.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_drop_gold_01'
end

return local_class

function local_class:set_current_scene_npc(section_state)
	local pre_npc_data = self.pre_npc_data[section_state]

	if pre_npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	linq(pre_npc_data):foreach(function(_, npc_data)
		local npc = get_character(npc_data.name)

		if npc == nil then
			if npc_data.name == 'leader' then
				npc = user_party.Leader
			else
				return
			end
		end

		if npc_data.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_data.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		npc_data.active_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.active_state, active_state_type.enabled)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, npc_data.active_state)


		-- 위치 셋팅
		local npc_pos = nil
		if npc_data.pos ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_data.fly ~= nil and npc_data.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			character_util.set_position(npc, npc_data.pos, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_data.dir ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_direction(npc, npc_data.dir, false)
		end

		if npc_data.emo ~= nil then
			if npc_data.emo == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_data.emo)
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_data.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			elseif type_util.is_table(npc_data.anim_info) then
				npc_data.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_data.anim_info)
			elseif type_util.is_string(npc_data.anim_info) then
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_data.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
			end
		end

		if npc_data.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_data.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_data.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_data.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_data.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_data.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_data.keep_shake ~= nil and npc_data.keep_shake == true then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_data.shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_data.sorting_layer then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_data.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_data.start_deactive_shadow then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, false)
		end

		if npc_data.scale_factor ~= nil then
			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, npc.Name, npc_data.scale_factor)
		end

		if npc_data.attaching_equipment ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, npc_data.attaching_equipment.slot, npc_data.attaching_equipment.equipment)
		end

		if npc_data.tint_color then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_data.tint_color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc_data.tint_color_key, npc_data.tint_color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_data.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_data.talk
		end

		if npc_data.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_data.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_data.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_data.hitbox ~= nil then
			npc.Hitbox = npc_data.hitbox
		end

		if npc_data.post_func ~= nil then
			npc_data.post_func(npc)
		end
	end)
end
--endregion

return local_class

			name = 'sub_zootopia_boss_room_2',
			once = {
				passed = false,
			},
		},
	}

	-- 로프에 매달린 npc
	self.rope_npc = setmetatable({
		rope_state = nil,
		npc_name = 'sub_zootopia_boss_room_mouse_3',
	}, {
		__index = {
			set_rope_npc_async = function(this, npc_name)
				local npc = (npc_name ~= nil) and get_character(npc_name) or get_character(this.npc_name)
				this.rope_state = CS.Oak.CharacterRopeTrappedState(npc,
						character_util.get_direction('right'), npc.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
				message_system:SendSync(npc, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(this.rope_state))

				-- CharacterRopeTrappedState 전환 시 표정이 surprise 로 변경됨
				coroutine.yield()
				coroutine.yield()

				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
			end,
			control_height = function(this, height, duration)
				if this.rope_state ~= nil then
					start_coroutine_enumerator(this.rope_state:Up(height, duration))
				end
			end,
			exit_rope_npc = function(this)
				if this.rope_state ~= nil then
					this.rope_state:Fall()
					this.rope_state:End()
					this.rope_state = nil
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.rope = nil
end

end

function local_class:need_skip()
	return false

function local_class:enter()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()

	self.controller:set_current_scene_npc(self.controller.npc_placement_group.mousetrap_area)
	self.controller:set_current_scene_npc(self.controller.npc_placement_group.underground)
	self.controller:set_current_scene_npc(self.controller.npc_placement_group.underground_runner)
	self.controller:set_current_scene_npc(self.controller.npc_placement_group.boss_room)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self:set_npc_state()

	start_coroutine(function()
		local npc = self.npc.mouse(3)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.set_position(npc, npc.Position + vector(0, 0.25, 0))
		self.rope_npc:set_rope_npc_async()

		character_util.add_listener(self.npc.mafia(1), self.controller)
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.rope_npc:exit_rope_npc()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npc.daughter()) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.downed_boss_daughter then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.on_rescue_boss_daughter, self)

			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.npc.mafia(1)) then
		if self.current_state == self.states.to_the_boss_room then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.play_mafia_boss_meeting_event, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.to_the_underground then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.underground_1.name) then
			if self.zones.underground_1.once ~= nil and not self.zones.underground_1.once.passed then
				self.zones.underground_1.once.passed = true
				start_coroutine(self.on_underground_commotion_zone_event_1, self)

				return true
			end
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.underground_2.name) then
			if self.zones.underground_2.once ~= nil and not self.zones.underground_2.once.passed then
				self.zones.underground_2.once.passed = true
				start_coroutine(self.on_underground_commotion_zone_event_2, self)

				return true
			end
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.underground_3.name) then
			if self.zones.underground_3.once ~= nil and not self.zones.underground_3.once.passed then
				self.zones.underground_3.once.passed = true
				start_coroutine(self.on_underground_commotion_zone_event_3, self)

				return true
			end
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.underground_4.name) then
			if self.zones.underground_4.once ~= nil and not self.zones.underground_4.once.passed then
				self.zones.underground_4.once.passed = true
				start_coroutine(self.on_underground_commotion_zone_event_4, self)

				return true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.states.to_the_boss_room then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.boss_room_1.name) then
			if self.zones.boss_room_1.once ~= nil and not self.zones.boss_room_1.once.passed then
				self.zones.boss_room_1.once.passed = true
				start_coroutine(self.on_boss_room_zone_event_1, self)

				return true
			end
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.zones.boss_room_2.name) then
			if self.zones.boss_room_2.once ~= nil and not self.zones.boss_room_2.once.passed then
				self.zones.boss_room_2.once.passed = true
				start_coroutine(self.on_boss_room_zone_event_2, self)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

	wp_util.move_async(noel, end_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--아가씨 쥐 (right, damaged, prostrate) : 으으… 아파…! 살려줘!

			nil, nil, 'ss_noel_zootopia_1_1')

	--0.5초 대기

	--노엘 (left, idle, eat) 2.5초간 실행 async 아님.

	scene_util.set_anim(noel, self, 'eat')

	scene_util.set_anim(daughter, self, { name = 'hurt' })
	character_util.set_position(daughter, daughter.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))

	local opened_mousetrap = self.field_object.opened_mousetrap()
	local backup_pos = closed_mousetrap.Position
	closed_mousetrap.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	opened_mousetrap.Position = backup_pos

	--shake 해제
	character_util.stop_shake(daughter)
	--노엘 (left, idle, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(noel)

	--카메라 포커스 아가씨 쥐 위치로 변경
	--카메라 크기 3.0
	camera_util.move(daughter.Position, 0, { end_target = daughter })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0)

	--1초에 걸쳐 화면 검은 색으로 페이드 인 . async
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--노엘 (left, idle, release 2회) : 저기, 정신 차리세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(noel, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, nil, 'ss_noel_zootopia_1_3')

	--노엘 (left, idle, question 1회, 마지막프레임 유지) question 이모티콘 출력, async
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(noel, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'question', loop = false, keep = true }, nil, 'question')

	--아가씨 쥐 (right, tired, hurt) : 으으…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(daughter, self, 'right',
			'hurt', 'tired', 'ss_noel_zootopia_1_5')

	--아가씨 쥐 (right, surprise, cast 상태로 jump 1회) notice 이모티콘 출력, async
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(daughter, true)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(daughter, self, 'right',

			function()

				--아가씨 쥐 (right, damaged) get 자세로 jump 1회
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
				scene_util.set_direction(daughter, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(daughter, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(daughter, self, 'get')
				--높이 1.5
				--시간 0.7초
				--도착 위치 벡터값 (x +1.0 , z -0.5)
				character_util.mario_jump_new(daughter, 'right', 0.7, 1.5)
				character_util.move_to_async(daughter,
						self.marker.daughter(1, 2),
						0.7,
						nil,
						false,
						false)
			end,
			function()
				--연출 2
				--0.3초 대기
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				--노엘 위치에 FX_lasthit 출력, async아님
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
				self.fx.lasthit():Instantiate(noel.Bounds.center)

				--노엘 (left, damaged, damaged) 상태로 0.4초간 z +0.5칸만큼 밀려난다.
				scene_util.set_emotion(noel, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(noel, self, 'get')
				character_util.move_to_async(noel,
						self.marker.noel(1, 2),
						0.4,
						nil,
						false,
						false)

	--노엘 (down, tired, cast)
	scene_util.set_direction(noel, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(noel, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(noel, self, 'cast')

	--아가씨 쥐 (right, damaged, run) 애니 적용, 7의 속도로 x +3.5칸 이동. async
	--아가씨 쥐 (down, damaged, run) 애니 적용, 7의 속도로 z -1.5칸 이동 async
	end_pos = {
		daughter.Position + vector(3.5, 0, 0),
		daughter.Position + vector(3.5, 0, -1.5),
	}
	wp_util.move_async(daughter, end_pos, 7, nil)

	--동시실행 (총 시간 1초) async 아님.
	--연출 1
	--아가씨 쥐 (down, attack, jingak 1회), 최대 높이 (2)까지 이동

	--시간 0.7초

	scene_util.set_anim(daughter, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 1 })

			false,
			false)

			false,

	self.fx.butt_bounce():Instantiate(daughter.Bounds.center)

	--[gimmick]wood_crack 작동하여 활성화. async 아님
	local cracked_floor = self.field_object.cracked_floor(1)
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
	damage_info.sender = cracked_floor
	damage_info.target = cracked_floor
	damage_info.damage = 1

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

	--아가씨 쥐 (down, damaged, embarrassed)
	--0.5초간 스파인 크기 0.5로 줄어든다
	--0.5초간 알파페이드아웃
	scene_util.set_direction(daughter, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(daughter, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(daughter, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
	character_util.set_active_shadow(daughter, false)

	local time_passed = 0
	local dur = 0.5

	while time_passed <= dur do

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(interpolations_constants.ease_out_quad(time_passed, 0, 1, dur))
		local scale = 1 - progress

		character_util.set_scale_factor(daughter, 'falling_size', scale)

	--[gimmick]wood_crack 위치에 서브 퀘스트 마커 활성화된다.
	self.quest_marker:add({
		{ zone = 'fly_field', target = cracked_floor },
		{ zone = 'mafia_field', target = self.npc.mafia(1) },
	})

	self.current_state = self.states.to_the_underground

	character_util.set_position(daughter, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_scale_factor(daughter, 'falling_size')
	character_util.set_active_shadow(daughter, true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(noel)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- ObjectPool PreLoad가 필요할 때 뒤에 인자로 주르륵 넣는다
	-- ex) yield_return_func(quest_util.load_pool_resource,'bla1', 'bla2')
	--yield_return_func(quest_util.load_pool_resource,'')

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
		'FX_Object_Twinkle',
		'FX_heal_a'
	)

	local starting_inner_progress = self.starting_inner_progress
	local is_complete = (self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete)

	self:interacting_obj_setting(starting_inner_progress)
	self:park_setting(starting_inner_progress, is_complete)
	self:restaurant_setting(starting_inner_progress, is_complete)
	self:homeless_setting(starting_inner_progress)
	self:apartment_npc_setting(starting_inner_progress)
	self:oneline_npc_setting(starting_inner_progress)
	self:car_setting(starting_inner_progress)

	-- 1~2일차인 경우, 경비원에 인터렉트 가능하게
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		local progress = self.quest_progress.InnerProgress
		if progress >= 1 and progress <= 8 then
			local security = self.get_security()
			character_util.add_listener(security, self)
		elseif progress >= 10 and progress <= 11 then
			-- 섹션 11 부터 12으로 입장 시 bgm 변경
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({
				name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_police_01', state = 'field' })

			if progress == 10 or progress == 11 then
				-- 11, 12섹션에서 경비원 시체 세팅
				local security = self.get_security()
				security.Position = field:GetMarker('security_office_center').position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
				character_util.set_direction(security, 'right')
				character_util.set_emotion(security, { name = 'damaged' })
				character_util.set_anim(security, { name = 'dead', loop = false, scale = 100 })
				security.SpineController:AddColor(security.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0.5)
			end
		elseif is_complete then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({
				name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_main', state = 'field' })
		elseif progress == 12 or progress == 15 then
			-- 섹션 13 / 16으로 입장 시 bgm 변경
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({
				name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_police_01', state = 'field' })
		end
	end

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	-- 화면 우측 하단 시간 표시용 텍스트 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		res_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'label_ac', function(prefab)
			self.date_subtitle = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
			self.date_subtitle:SetActive(false)
			local label_title = self.date_subtitle.transform:GetChild(0)
			local label_shadow = label_title:GetChild(0)
			self.title_ui_localize = label_title:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILocalize))
			self.shadow_ui_localize = label_shadow:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILocalize))
		end)

	res_holder:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- 웨이트리스 상호작용
	local waitress = self.get_waitress()
	if self.waitress_string_key ~= nil and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, waitress) then
		if self.waitress_sfx_name ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.waitress_sfx_name)
		end
		character_util.set_direction(waitress, direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction))
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(waitress, { key = self.waitress_string_key })
		return true
	end

	local consumed = false

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		self:on_stage_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		consumed = self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	if consumed then
		return true
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 책장 상호작용
	local bookshelf = get_field_object('parvati_room_bookshelf')
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, bookshelf) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_bookshelf, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 화분 상호작용
	local flowerpot = get_field_object('parvati_room_flowerpot')
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, flowerpot) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_flowerpot, self, flowerpot)
		return true
	end

	-- 일기장 상호작용
	local diary = get_field_object('parvati_room_diary')
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, diary) then
		-- 다이어리 상호작용을 섹션 내에서 덮어씌워주어야 함.
		if self.override_diary_interact then return false end

		-- (방어 코드) 간헐적으로 자동 인터렉트 반복되는 상황을 대비
		if self.is_inspecting_diary then return false end

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_diary, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 경찰서 문 상호작용
	local police_station_door = get_field_object('police_dept_door')
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, police_station_door) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_police_door, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 미화원 상호작용
	local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, cleaner) then
		if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 8 then
				-- 덕분에 내일쯤이면 청소를 끝낼 수 있겠어.
				character_util.look_at(cleaner, user_party.Leader)
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(cleaner)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_19' })
				return true
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 12 then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.cleaner_corpse_interact_day3, self)
				return true
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 13 or self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.cleaner_corpse_interact_day4, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	-- 아파트 경비 상호작용
	local security = self.get_security()
	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 1 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 4 and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, security) then
			self:interact_security_day1()
			return true
		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 5 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress <= 8 and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, security) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_security_day2, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_enter_restaurant
			and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'restaurant_inside') then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.restaurant_inside_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.cur_police_event_state ~= nil then
		if self.cur_police_event_state ~= nil
				and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'park_police') then
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 5 and
					(self.cur_police_event_state & self.police_event_state.day_1) ~= self.police_event_state.day_1 then
				-- day1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_police_zone_day1, self))
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >=5 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 9 and
					(self.cur_police_event_state & self.police_event_state.day_2) ~= self.police_event_state.day_2  then
				-- day2
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_police_zone_day2, self))
			end
		elseif self.cur_apart_event_state ~= nil
				and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'parking_lot_event') then
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 5 and
					(self.cur_apart_event_state & self.apart_event_state.day_1) ~= self.apart_event_state.day_1 then
				-- day 1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.apart_villager_day1, self))
				return true
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 9 and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 5 and
					(self.cur_apart_event_state & self.apart_event_state.day_2) ~= self.apart_event_state.day_2 then
				-- day 2
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.apart_villager_day2, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'homeless_event')
				and not self.is_enter_homeless_zone then
			self.is_enter_homeless_zone = true
			if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 5 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.homeless_event, self, 1))
			elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 9 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.homeless_event, self, 2))
			end
		end
	end

	if self.playing_apartment_crowd_sfx and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'in_apartment') then
		self.apartment_crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true, play_pos = field:GetMarker('s10_security_start').position })
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.apartment_crowd_sfx and type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'in_apartment') then
		self.apartment_crowd_sfx:Stop()
		self.apartment_crowd_sfx = nil
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	-- 파르바티방의 일기장 세팅
	local diary = get_field_object('parvati_room_diary')
	drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = diary.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0), itemid = 20552, notforinven = true,
		  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.35 })

	-- 칵테일바 세팅
	local is_complete = (self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete)
	if is_complete then
		self:bar_setting(16)
	else
		self:bar_setting(self.starting_inner_progress)
	end

	-- day2 일 때 레스토랑 음식 세팅
	-- 레스토랑 손님 세팅
	local progress = self.starting_inner_progress
	local setting_index = 1
	if progress >= 5 and progress < 9 then
		-- day 2
		setting_index = 2
	elseif progress >= 9 and progress < 13 then
		-- day 3
		setting_index = 3
	elseif progress >= 13 then
		-- day 4
		setting_index = 4
	end

	self:restaurant_item_setting(setting_index)
end

-- 파르바티 일기장 위의 이펙트 제거용 함수
function local_class:turn_off_diary_effect()
	if self.effect_on_diary ~= nil then
		self.effect_on_diary:Dispose()
		self.effect_on_diary = nil
	end
end

-- 파르바티 일기장 위 이펙트 생성용 함수. 각 요일의 시작 섹션에서만 호출되어야한다.
function local_class:turn_on_diary_effect()
	-- 일기 상호작용 하지 않아 이펙트 비활성화 안되었을 경우에는 그대로 사용.
	if self.effect_on_diary == nil then
		local diary = get_field_object('parvati_room_diary')
		self.effect_on_diary = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle'):Instantiate(diary.Position + vector(0, 1, -0.2))
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	local store_android = get_character('store_android_1')
	store_android.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(3, 0.8, 1))

	self.cur_police_event_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.police_event_custom_key)
	if self.cur_police_event_state == -1 then
		self.cur_police_event_state = 0
	end

	self.cur_apart_event_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.apart_event_custom_key)
	if self.cur_apart_event_state == -1 then
		self.cur_apart_event_state = 0
	end
	self:apart_villager_setting(self.starting_inner_progress)

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil then
		if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 5 then
			if (self.cur_police_event_state & self.police_event_state.day_1) == self.police_event_state.day_1 then
				local police_1 = self.get_police(1)
				police_1.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_s4_1'

				local police_2 = self.get_police(2)
				police_2.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_s4_2'
			end

		elseif self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 9 then
			if self.cur_police_event_state & self.police_event_state.day_2 == self.police_event_state.day_2 then
				-- 나 28번지 사건 조사에 차출됐어…
				local police_1 = self.get_police(1)
				character_util.set_emotion(police_1, { name = 'tired' })
				police_1.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_s8_1'

				--경찰2(left, tired, idle) : 한동안 순찰은 혼자 돌아야겠네. 우리도 인력이 충분한 건 아닌데…
				local police_2 = self.get_police(2)
				character_util.set_emotion(police_2, { name = 'tired' })
				police_2.Interactable.Talk  = 'short_story_parvati_s8_4'
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.quest_spec.QuestId then
		-- 아파트 경비원 리스너 세팅
		if e.CurrentProgress >= 1 and e.CurrentProgress <= 8 then
			local security = self.get_security()
			character_util.add_listener(security, self)
		else
			local security = self.get_security()
			character_util.remove_relate_event(security, self)
		end

		-- 시체 미화원 리스너 세팅
		if e.CurrentProgress >= 12 then
			local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()
			character_util.add_listener(cleaner, self)
		end

		-- 섹션 변경 될 때 각 지역 별로 위치나 원라인등을 바꿔야 하는 함수 호출하는 부분
		if e.CurrentProgress == 13 then
			-- day 4로 바뀌는 시점

			-- 아파트 시민 day3 세팅 제거
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local apartment_civil = get_character('apartment_npc_s12_' .. i)
				character_util.set_position(apartment_civil, vector(999, 0, 999))
			end

			-- 일부 원라인 npc 표정 변경
			self:oneline_npc_setting(e.CurrentProgress)

			-- 레스토랑 손님 원라인 대사 변경
			self:set_restaurant_guest(4, e.CurrentProgress)

			-- 아파트 주민 세팅
			self:apart_villager_setting(e.CurrentProgress)

			-- 레스토랑 아이템 세팅
			self:restaurant_item_setting(4)

			-- 공원 세팅
			self:clean_park_setting_day4()

			return true
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 9 then
			-- day 3로 바뀌는 시점
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({
				name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_police_01', state = 'field' })

			-- 공원 npc 변경
			self:clean_park_setting()
			self:one_police_left_park_setting()

			local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()
			character_util.set_position(cleaner, vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.remove_relate_event(cleaner, self)
			cleaner.Interactable.Talk = nil

			local police_1 = self.get_police(1)
			police_1.Interactable.Talk = nil

			-- 일부 원라인 npc 표정 변경
			self:oneline_npc_setting(e.CurrentProgress)

			-- 레스토랑 손님 원라인 대사 변경
			self:set_restaurant_guest(3, e.CurrentProgress)

			-- 아파트 주민 세팅
			self:apart_villager_setting(e.CurrentProgress)

			-- 레스토랑 아이템 해제
			self:restaurant_item_setting(3)

			return true
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 5 then
			-- day 2로 바뀌는 시점

			-- 1일차 공원 앞 시민들 사운드 제거
			self.day_1_civil_park_sfx:Stop()
			self.day_1_civil_park_sfx = nil

			local civil = get_character('park_civil_4')
			civil.Interactable.TalkSfx = nil

			local civil_2 = get_character('park_civil_2')
			civil_2.Interactable.TalkSfx = nil

			-- 1일차 원라인 NPC 공용 이모션 해제
			local oneline_npc_day1_1 = get_character('oneline_npc_day1_1')
			character_util.remove_emotion(oneline_npc_day1_1)

			-- 공원 npc 변경
			local police_1 = self.get_police(1)
			local police_2 = self.get_police(2)
			if self.cur_police_event_state & self.police_event_state.day_2 == self.police_event_state.day_2 then
				-- 나 28번지 사건 조사에 차출됐어…
				police_1 = self.get_police(1)
				character_util.set_emotion(police_1, { name = 'tired' })
				police_1.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_s8_1'

				--경찰2(left, tired, idle) : 한동안 순찰은 혼자 돌아야겠네. 우리도 인력이 충분한 건 아닌데…
				police_2 = self.get_police(2)
				character_util.set_emotion(police_2, { name = 'tired' })
				police_2.Interactable.Talk  = 'short_story_parvati_s8_4'
			else
				police_1.Interactable.Talk = nil
				police_2.Interactable.Talk = nil
			end

			-- 공원 쓰레기 더미들 제거 및 미화원 원라인 대사 제거
			local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()
			cleaner.Interactable.Talk = nil
			character_util.set_position(cleaner, vector(999, 0, 999))

			for i = 1, #self.park_garbages do
				self.park_garbages[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end

			local park_garbage_s4_pos_name = 'park_garbage_pos_s8_'
			local park_garbage_name = 'park_garbage_s8_'
			local garbage_cnt = 10
			for i = 1, garbage_cnt do
				local garbage = get_field_object(park_garbage_name .. i)
				local init_pos = field:GetMarker(park_garbage_s4_pos_name .. i).position
				garbage.Position = init_pos
			end

			local cleaner_side_garbage = get_field_object(park_garbage_name .. 'cleaner_side')
			cleaner_side_garbage.Position = field:GetMarker(park_garbage_name .. 'cleaner_side_pos').position

			-- 공원 시민 세팅
			self:park_civil_setting_day2()

			-- 쓰레기장 세팅
			self:waste_plant_garbage_day_2()

			-- 레스토랑 손님 원라인 대사 변경
			self:set_restaurant_guest(2, e.CurrentProgress)

			-- 아파트 주민 세팅
			self:apart_villager_setting(e.CurrentProgress)

			-- 레스토랑 아이템 세팅
			self:restaurant_item_setting(2)

			return true
		elseif e.CurrentProgress == 8 then
			local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()
			character_util.add_listener(cleaner, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.quest_spec.QuestId then
		-- 레스토랑 손님 다 비활성화
		self:disabled_restaurant_npc()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.ignore_play_stage_music then return false end

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'parvati_room_grid') then
		-- 파르바티 방 입장 시

		-- bgm mute
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		-- 환경음 재생
		self:play_stage_loop_sfx('01_amb_city_02', 1)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'apartment_grid') then
		-- 아파트 복도

		if self.keep_bgm then return true end

		-- bgm mute
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		-- 환경음 재생
		self:play_stage_loop_sfx('01_amb_city_02', 1)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'apartment_hallway_grid') then
		-- 아파트 복도

		-- bgm mute
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		-- 환경음 재생
		self:play_stage_loop_sfx('01_amb_city_02', 1)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'restaurant_grid') then
		-- 레스토랑 입장 시

		-- bgm mute
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		if self.cur_sfx_name == nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')
		end

		-- 환경음 재생
		local is_play_restaurant_sfx = self.quest_progress ~= nil and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete
				and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 13
		local sfx_name = is_play_restaurant_sfx and '01_amb_restaurant_02' or '01_amb_city_02'
		self:play_stage_loop_sfx(sfx_name, 1)
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'bar_grid') then
		-- 바 입장 시
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_restaurant', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'convenience_store_grid') then
		-- 편의점 입장 시
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')

		-- bgm만 교체
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_store',
		                                     state = 'event', mix = 1.2 })
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'street_grid') then
		-- 거리 그리드
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		self.cur_sfx_name = nil
		self:dispose_stage_loop_sfx()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	self:dispose_stage_loop_sfx()

	self:park_civil_3_stop_patrolling()

	-- 레스토랑 아이템 해제
	self:dispose_restaurant_item()

	-- 웨이트리스 리스너 구독해지
	local waitress = self.get_waitress()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(waitress, self)

	-- 일기장 위 이펙트 제거
	self:turn_off_diary_effect()

	if self.apartment_crowd_sfx then
		self.apartment_crowd_sfx:Stop()
		self.apartment_crowd_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.bar_crowd_sfx ~= nil then
		self.bar_crowd_sfx:Stop()
		self.bar_crowd_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.day_1_civil_park_sfx ~= nil then
		self.day_1_civil_park_sfx:Stop()
		self.day_1_civil_park_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.bar_item_table ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.bar_item_table do
			self.bar_item_table[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.bar_item_table = nil
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.date_subtitle) == false then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.date_subtitle)
	end
	self.date_subtitle = nil
	self.title_ui_localize = nil
	self.shadow_ui_localize = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.park_garbages = nil
	self.bookshelf_narration = nil
	self.diary_branch = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

-- 공원 지역 Day를 기준으로 설정하는 함수
-- 섹션에 따라 달라지는 설정은 해당 섹션에서 설정하도록
function local_class:park_setting(progress, is_complete)
	if progress >= 13 or is_complete then -- day 4 ~
		self:clean_park_setting_day4()
		self:police_left_park_setting()
		self:cleaner_corpse_setting()
	elseif progress >= 12 then -- 12섹션 이후 시점
		self:clean_park_setting()
		self:police_left_park_setting()
		self:cleaner_corpse_setting()

		if progress == 12 then
			self:apartment_civil_setting_day3()
		end
	elseif progress >= 9 then -- day 3 ~
		self:clean_park_setting()
		self:one_police_left_park_setting()
	elseif progress >= 5 then -- day 2
		self:waste_plant_garbage_day_2()

		if progress == 8 then
			local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()
			local cleaner_pos = field:GetMarker('park_cleaner_end_s8').position
			character_util.set_position(cleaner, cleaner_pos)
			character_util.add_listener(cleaner, self)
			character_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(cleaner, { name = 'smile' })

			local civil_setting_end = {
				anim = { 'idle', 'idle', 'idle', 'seat'},
				emo = { 'smile', 'smile', 'smile', 'smile'},
				dir = { 'right', 'right', 'up', 'left' },
				key = {
					-- 빨리 깨끗한 공원에서 같이 놀고 싶다.
					'short_story_parvati_s8_37',
					-- 아직 쓰레기가 남아있긴 하지만 어제보다 훨씬 낫네.
					'short_story_parvati_s8_38',
					-- 진작 다 같이 쓰레기를 치워볼 걸 그랬나?
					'short_story_parvati_s8_39',
					-- 나도 누나랑 놀고 싶어!
					'short_story_parvati_s8_40',
				}
			}

			local civil_in_use = { 6, 3, 5, 1}
			for i = 1, #civil_in_use do
				local idx = civil_in_use[i]
				local civil = get_character('park_civil_' .. idx)
				local civil_pos = field:GetMarker('park_civil_s8_pos_' .. idx .. '_' .. 4).position
				character_util.set_position(civil, civil_pos)
				character_util.set_direction(civil, civil_setting_end.dir[i])
				character_util.set_anim(civil, { name = civil_setting_end.anim[i] })
				character_util.set_emotion(civil, { name = civil_setting_end.emo[i] })
				civil.Interactable.Talk = civil_setting_end.key[i]
			end

			local civil_in_unused = { 2, 4 }
			for i = 1, #civil_in_unused do
				local idx = civil_in_unused[i]
				local civil = get_character('park_civil_' .. idx)
				character_util.set_position(civil, vector(999, 0, 999))
			end

			-- 쓰레기장에 쓰레기 추가 배치
			local waste_plant_garbage_idx = { 8, 9, 11, 18, 20, 21, 22, 23 }
			for i = 1, #waste_plant_garbage_idx do
				local idx =  waste_plant_garbage_idx[i]
				local waste_plant_garbage = get_field_object('waste_plant_garbage_' .. idx)
				local waste_plant_garbage_pos = field:GetMarker('waste_plant_garbage_pos_' .. idx).position
				waste_plant_garbage.Position = waste_plant_garbage_pos
			end

			-- 공원 쓰레기 일부 제거
			local civil_garbage = { 4, 3, 1, 2 }
			for i = 1, #civil_garbage do
				local idx = civil_garbage[i]
				local garbage = get_field_object('park_garbage_s8_'.. idx)
				garbage.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end
			local garbage = get_field_object('park_garbage_s8_cleaner_side')
			garbage.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		else
			self:park_civil_setting_day2()
		end
	else -- day 1 ~
		self.park_garbages = {}

		local park_garbage_name = 'park_garbage_'
		local park_garbage_cnt = 24
		local park_garbage_s8_cnt = 6

		-- 쓰레기 봉투 초기화 전 임시 캐싱
		for i = 1, park_garbage_cnt do
			self.park_garbages[i] = get_field_object(park_garbage_name .. i)
		end

		-- s8 핸들네임 달린 쓰레기 봉투 재활용 캐싱
		for i = 1, park_garbage_s8_cnt do
			self.park_garbages[#self.park_garbages + 1] = get_field_object(park_garbage_name .. 's8_'.. i)
		end

		self.park_garbages[#self.park_garbages + 1] = get_field_object(park_garbage_name .. 's8_cleaner_side')

		local park_garbage_s4_pos_name = 'park_garbage_pos_s4_'
		local park_garbage_s4_num = park_garbage_cnt+ park_garbage_s8_cnt

		for i = 1, park_garbage_s4_num do
			local garbage = self.park_garbages[i]
			local init_pos = field:GetMarker(park_garbage_s4_pos_name .. i).position
			garbage.Position = init_pos
		end

		-- 공원 앞에 있는 행인들에게 사운드 처리

		local civil = get_character('park_civil_4')
		civil.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_bad_01'

		local civil_2 = get_character('park_civil_2')
		civil_2.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_negative_02'

		self.day_1_civil_park_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02',
		  loop = true, parent = civil })

		-- 섹션 4에서의 청소부 마지막 세팅 처리 이어지도록.
		if progress > 3 then
			local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()
			character_util.set_emotion(cleaner, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_anim(cleaner, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
			character_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'left')
			character_util.set_position(cleaner, vector(114, 0, -103))
			cleaner.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_s4_17'
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clean_park_setting()
	self:clean_garbage_setting()

	local key = {

		'short_story_parvati_s12_24',
		-- 어머, 언제 이렇게 깨끗해졌지?
		'short_story_parvati_s12_25',
		nil,
		-- 이제야 좀 공원 같네.
		'short_story_parvati_s12_26',
		-- 허허, 마을에 생기가 도는 것 같아 좋구먼.
		'short_story_parvati_s12_27'
	}

	-- 시민들 공원에 배치 및 패트롤 시작
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local civil = get_character('park_civil_' .. i)

		character_util.set_direction(civil, marker.direction)
