-- 섹션별 레스토랑 안 npc 세팅
function local_class:restaurant_setting(progress, is_complete)
	-- 퀘스트 클리어 한 이후에는 아무도 세팅 안함
	if not is_complete then
		-- 레스토랑 손님 세팅
		local setting_index = 1
		if progress >= 5 and progress < 9 then
			-- day 2
			setting_index = 2
		elseif progress >= 9 and progress < 13 then
			-- day 3
			setting_index = 3
		elseif progress >= 13 then
			-- day 4
			setting_index = 4
		end

		-- 안드로이드 웨이트리스 세팅
		local waitress = get_character('restaurant_waitress')
		local android_waitress = get_character('restaurant_android')
		local pos

		-- 15섹션 이후에는 웨이트리스는 암살 당한 상태
		if progress < 15 then
			-- 웨이트리스 세팅
			pos = field:GetMarker('waitress_pos').position
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(waitress)
			character_util.set_position(waitress, pos)
			character_util.set_direction(waitress, 'down')
			character_util.set_active_state(waitress, 'enabled')

			-- 안드로이드 세팅
			pos = field:GetMarker('waitress_android_pos').position
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_waitress)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_waitress)
			character_util.set_position(android_waitress, pos)
			character_util.set_direction(android_waitress, 'right')
			character_util.set_active_state(android_waitress, 'enabled')

			-- 히트박스 조정
			-- default CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.8, 1.1))
			android_waitress.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(3, 0.8, 1))
			android_waitress.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_android_2'
		else
			self.is_enter_restaurant = true

			-- 웨이트리스 세팅
			pos = field:GetMarker('assassinate_waitress_pos').position
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(waitress)
			character_util.set_position(waitress, pos)
			character_util.set_direction(waitress, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(waitress, { name = 'dead', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_active_state(waitress, 'enabled')
			waitress.SpineController:AddColor(waitress.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)

			-- 안드로이드 세팅
			pos = vector(132, 0, -20)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_waitress)
			character_util.set_position(android_waitress, pos)
			character_util.set_direction(android_waitress, 'right')
			character_util.set_active_state(android_waitress, 'enabled')
			android_waitress.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			android_waitress.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_s15_7'
		end

		self:set_restaurant_guest(setting_index, self.starting_inner_progress)
	else
		self.is_enter_restaurant = true
	end
end

-- 레스토랑 손님들 세팅 (일단은 원라인 대사만 변경)
function local_class:set_restaurant_guest(setting_index, progress)
	local is_in_index = function(guest_index, target_index)
		for i = 1, #guest_index do
			if target_index == guest_index[i] then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local string_key
	local guest_index = { }
	local marker_list = { }
	local dir_list = { }
	local emo_list = { }
	local ani_list = { }

	local string_index_list = nil
	local sfx_list = nil

	local waitress = get_character('restaurant_waitress')

	if setting_index == 4 then
		local is_show_secretary = progress >= 15

		-- day 4
		string_key = 'short_story_parvati_restaurant_4_'
		guest_index = is_show_secretary and { 5, 6 } or { 6 }
		marker_list = is_show_secretary and { 5, 1 } or { 1 }
		string_index_list = is_show_secretary and { 1, 2 } or { 2 }

		dir_list = is_show_secretary and { 'left', 'right' } or { 'right' }
		emo_list = is_show_secretary and { 'idle', 'idle' } or { 'idle' }
		ani_list = is_show_secretary and { 'seat', 'seat' } or { 'seat' }

		if is_show_secretary == false then
			character_util.set_anim(waitress, { name = 'eat' })
			character_util.set_direction(waitress, 'right')
			character_util.set_position(waitress, vector(127, 0, -17))

			waitress.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			waitress.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_waitress_3'
			waitress.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(3, 0.8, 1.1))
		end
	elseif setting_index == 3 then
		-- day 3
		string_key = 'short_story_parvati_restaurant_3_'
		guest_index = { 2, 3, 10, 11 }
		marker_list = { 2, 6, 1, 5 }
		dir_list = { 'left', 'right', 'right', 'left' }
		emo_list = { 'idle', 'idle', 'idle', 'mad' }
		ani_list = { 'seat', 'seat', 'eat', 'release' }
		sfx_list = { nil, nil, nil, '03_dialogue_negative_02' }

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(waitress)
		character_util.set_emotion(waitress, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_direction(waitress, 'down')
		character_util.set_position(waitress, field:GetMarker('waitress_pos').position)

		waitress.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		waitress.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_waitress_1'
		waitress.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.8, 3))
	elseif setting_index == 2 then
		local is_show_old_couple = progress <= 6

		-- day 2
		string_key = 'short_story_parvati_restaurant_2_'
		guest_index = is_show_old_couple and { 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 } or { 4, 8, 9 }
		marker_list = is_show_old_couple and { 1, 5, 6, 2, 3 } or { 1, 2, 3 }
		dir_list = is_show_old_couple and { 'right', 'left', 'right', 'left', 'right' } or { 'right', 'left', 'right' }
		emo_list = is_show_old_couple and { 'idle', 'idle', 'idle', 'idle', 'attack' } or { 'idle', 'idle', 'attack' }
		ani_list = is_show_old_couple and { 'eat', 'eat', 'seat', 'eat', 'seat' } or { 'eat', 'eat', 'seat' }
		string_index_list = is_show_old_couple and { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 } or { 1, 4, 5 }

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(waitress)
		character_util.set_emotion(waitress, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_direction(waitress, 'down')
		character_util.set_position(waitress, vector(127, 0, -20))

		waitress.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		waitress.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_waitress_2'
		waitress.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.8, 1.1))
	elseif setting_index == 1 then
		-- day 1
		string_key = 'short_story_parvati_restaurant_1_'
		guest_index = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 }
		marker_list = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 }
		dir_list = { 'right', 'left', 'right', 'left', 'left' }
		emo_list = { 'idle', 'mad', 'scared', 'attack', 'attack' }
		ani_list = { 'eat', 'release', 'seat', 'seat', 'seat' }
		sfx_list = { nil, '03_dialogue_negative_01', '03_dialogue_sadness_02', nil }

		-- default CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.8, 1.1))
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(waitress)
		waitress.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		waitress.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_parvati_waitress_1'
		waitress.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.8, 3))
	end

	local cur_index = 1
	for i = 1, 11 do
		local in_index = is_in_index(guest_index, i)
		local guest = get_character('restaurant_npc_' .. i)
		if in_index == false then
			character_util.set_position(guest, vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest)
			character_util.set_active_shadow(guest, true)
			character_util.set_active_state(guest, 'disabled')
		else
			local marker = field:GetMarker('restaurant_seat_' .. marker_list[cur_index])
			character_util.set_position(guest, marker.position + vector(0, 0.45, 0))
			character_util.set_direction(guest, dir_list[cur_index])
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guest, { name = ani_list[cur_index] }
			, { name = emo_list[cur_index] })
			character_util.set_active_state(guest, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_active_shadow(guest, false)
			guest.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			guest.Interactable.Talk = string_index_list ~= nil
					and string_key .. string_index_list[cur_index] or string_key .. cur_index
			if sfx_list ~= nil and sfx_list[cur_index] ~= nil then
				guest.Interactable.TalkSfx = sfx_list[cur_index]
			end

			cur_index = cur_index + 1
		end
	end
end

--- 일기장 상호작용
function local_class:interact_diary()
	self.is_inspecting_diary = true

	-- 선택지 출력
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 일기를 본다.
		{ 'short_story_parvati_diary_5' },
		-- 그만둔다.
		{ 'short_story_parvati_diary_6' }
	})

	if player_choice == 2 then
		self.is_inspecting_diary = false
		return
	end

	if not self.diary_branch then
		return
	end


	-- 1일차일 경우, 선택문 안나오고 바로 내용 출력 될 수 있도록 적용.
	if self.quest_progress.InnerProgress < 4 then
		player_choice = 1
	else
		player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event(self.diary_branch)
	end

	-- 선택한 날짜 출력
	-- field_ui_util.show_narration_async(
		-- 	{ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_' .. player_choice, mintotalduration = 1 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')

	if player_choice == 1 then
		-- 502. 11. 8.

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_1_1', mintotalduration = 1 })
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_1_2', mintotalduration = 1 })
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_1_3', mintotalduration = 1 })

	elseif player_choice == 2 then
		-- 502. 11. 9.

		local restaurant_result = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key.section_3_restaurant)
		local bar_result = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key.section_5_bar)

		-- A.H. 502년 11월 9일./n
		-- 이사 온 첫날. 새집은 나쁘지 않다. 체격이 좋은 경비원이 항상 현관을 지키고 있지만… 별로 마음에 드는 사람은 아니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_2_1', mintotalduration = 1 })

		-- (1일차 레스토랑에서 유저가 선택한 선택지에 맞춰서 기록됨)
		-- 투데이 레스토랑에서 웨이트리스 추천으로 맛본 미트볼 스파게티는 [괜찮았다][그럭저럭][별로였다]. 다음에 또 방문하면 웨이트리스가 다른 메뉴를 추천해 준다고 했으니 한 번 더 가보는 것도 나쁘지 않을 것 같다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_2_2_' .. restaurant_result, mintotalduration = 1 })

		-- 공원은 쓰레기가 가득했다. 미화원의 착각으로 잠깐 오해가 있었지만 금방 해결됐다. 혼자서 많은 쓰레기를 처리 중이라 그런지 미화원은 상당히 예민해 보였다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_2_3', mintotalduration = 1 })

		-- (1일차 칵테일 바에서 유저가 선택한 선택지에 맞춰서 기록됨)
		-- 칵테일 바에서 어떤 남자가 말을 걸었다. 21번지 일보 기자라던데… 남자가 추천해준 블루 문 칵테일은 [별로였다][괜찮았다][맛있었다].

-- 2일차에 아파트 경비와 상호작용
function local_class:interact_security_day2()
	local security = self.get_security()

	character_util.set_direction(security, 'left')

	-- 이후 경비원과 상호작용 시 경비원의 right에 정렬.
	party_util.align_to_target(security, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	-- 경비원(right, smile, idle): 무슨 일이야?
	character_util.set_emotion(security, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s6_14', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 출력(“궁금한 게 없다.” 선택할 때까지 선택 반복.)
	local choose_result
	while true do
		-- 경비실 비밀번호 / 28번지 사건에 대해 / 혼자 살아? / 궁금한 게 없다.
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'short_story_parvati_s6_14_1', 'mercy' },
															  { 'short_story_parvati_s6_14_2', 'brutal' },
															  { 'short_story_parvati_s6_14_3', 'intellect' },
															  { 'short_story_parvati_s6_14_4', 'normal' } })

		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- 경비실 비밀번호
			-- 경비원(right, smile, idle): 그새 잊어버렸어? 비밀번호는 <b>1111</b> 이야.
			character_util.set_emotion(security, { name = 'smile' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s6_15', skip = true })

			-- 경비원(right, doyagao, idle): 자꾸 물어보지 말고 메모라도 해놔.
			character_util.set_emotion(security, { name = 'doyagao' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s6_16', skip = true })
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			-- 28번지 사건에 대해
			-- 경비원(right, tired, idle): …그건 뭐하러 물어봐. 좋은 얘기도 아닌데.
			character_util.set_emotion(security, { name = 'tired' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s6_17', skip = true })
		elseif choose_result == 3 then
			-- 혼자 살아?
			-- 경비원(right, idle, idle): 마누라랑 딸내미랑 같이 살지!
			character_util.remove_emotion(security)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s6_18', skip = true })

			-- 경비원(left, doyagao, idle): 아가씨는 결혼 안 해? 우리 조카가 딱 아가씨 또래인데, 한 번 만나볼래?
			character_util.set_emotion(security, { name = 'doyagao' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s6_19', skip = true })
		else
			-- 궁금한 게 없다.
			-- 경비원(right, smile, idle): 궁금한 게 있으면 또 물어봐.
			character_util.set_emotion(security, { name = 'smile' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s6_20', skip = true })
			break
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(security)
	end

	-- 이벤트 종료, 컨트롤 풀림.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(security)
end

-- 섹션별 아파트 주민 세팅
function local_class:apart_villager_setting(progress)
	-- 초기화
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local villager = get_character('parking_lot_civil_' .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(villager)
		character_util.set_active_state(villager, 'disabled')
	end

	local ani_list = {}
	local ani_loop = {}
	local emo_list = {}

	local villager_count = 2
	local add_string_index = 1
	local first_string_key = ''
	local is_interact = false

	if progress >= 13 then
		-- day 4
		villager_count = 0
	elseif progress >= 9 and progress < 13 then
		-- day 3
		villager_count = 0
	elseif progress >= 5 and progress < 9 then
		-- day 2
		villager_count = 2
		ani_list = { 'cross_arm', 'idle', 'idle' }
		ani_loop = { true, true }
		emo_list = { 'idle', 'idle', 'idle' }

		add_string_index = 2
		is_interact = (self.cur_apart_event_state & self.apart_event_state.day_2) == self.apart_event_state.day_2
		first_string_key = 'short_story_parvati_s7_'
	else
		-- day 1
		villager_count = 2
		ani_list = { 'idle', 'cross_arm', 'idle' }
		ani_loop = { true, true }
		emo_list = { 'idle', 'idle', 'idle' }

		add_string_index = 0
		is_interact = (self.cur_apart_event_state & self.apart_event_state.day_1) == self.apart_event_state.day_1
		first_string_key = 'short_story_parvati_s3_'
	end

	if villager_count <= 0 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, villager_count do
		local marker = field:GetMarker('parking_lot_pos_' .. i)
		local villager = get_character('parking_lot_civil_' .. i)

		character_util.set_position(villager, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(villager, marker.direction)
		character_util.set_active_state(villager, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(villager, { name = ani_list[i], loop = ani_loop[i] }
		, { name = emo_list[i] })
		if is_interact then
			villager.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			villager.Interactable.Talk = first_string_key .. (i + add_string_index)
		else
			villager.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryParvatiMainSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'shortstory_parvati'

	-- 1 섹션 스크립트 키
	self.script_key = 'short_story_parvati_s1_'

	self.resource_holder = nil

	self.noise_effect = nil

	self.typing_text = nil

	self.time_text = nil

	self.is_bookshelf_interacted = false
	self.is_flowerpot_interacted = false
	self.is_diary_interacted = false

	self.parvati_room_isle = 'parvati_room_isle'

	-- 마커 이름들
	self.parvati_room_center = 'parvati_room_center'

	-- Getters
	function self.get_parvati()
		-- 임시
		return get_character('parvati')
	end

	function self.get_item_in_room_by_idx(idx)
		return get_field_object(self.room_item_names[idx])
	end

	function self.get_position_item_in_room_by_idx(idx)
		local item = self.get_item_in_room_by_idx(idx)
		return item.Position
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self.controller:set_override_interact(true)
	self.controller:turn_on_diary_effect()
	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.opening_routine, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.controller:set_override_interact(false)

	if self.bgm ~= nil then
		self.bgm:Stop()
		self.bgm = nil
	end

	if self.typing_text then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text)
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.resource_holder then
		self.resource_holder:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.parvati_room_isle and
	(not self.is_bookshelf_interacted or not self.is_diary_interacted or not self.is_flowerpot_interacted) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.return_to_room, self)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	-- 타이핑 텍스트
	self.resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.resource_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
			local typing_text_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
			self.typing_text = typing_text_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))
		end)

	self.typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0
	self.typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 100, 1, 0)
	self.typing_text.Label.fontSize = 64
	self.typing_text.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
	self.typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 책장 상호작용
	local bookshelf = get_field_object('parvati_room_bookshelf')
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, bookshelf) then
		quest_marker_util.remove(bookshelf.Name)
		self.is_bookshelf_interacted = true
		self:varify_all_item_inspected()
		return true
	end

	-- 화분 상호작용
	local flowerpot = get_field_object('parvati_room_flowerpot')
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, flowerpot) then
		quest_marker_util.remove(flowerpot.Name)
		self.is_flowerpot_interacted = true
		self:varify_all_item_inspected()
		return true
	end

	-- 일기장 상호작용
	local diary = get_field_object('parvati_room_diary')
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, diary) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_diary, self, diary)
		return true
	end
end

--- 일기장 상호작용
function local_class:interact_diary(diary)
	-- 선택지 출력
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 일기를 본다.
		{ 'short_story_parvati_diary_5' },
		-- 그만둔다.
		{ 'short_story_parvati_diary_6' }
	})

	if player_choice == 2 then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_1_1', mintotalduration = 1 })
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_1_2', mintotalduration = 1 })
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_diary_1_3', mintotalduration = 1 })

	quest_marker_util.remove(diary.Name)
	self.is_diary_interacted = true
	self:varify_all_item_inspected()
	self.controller:turn_off_diary_effect()
end


function local_class:varify_all_item_inspected()
	if self.is_bookshelf_interacted and self.is_flowerpot_interacted and self.is_diary_interacted then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.progress_section, self))

	wait_for_sec(text_exposure_duration)

	-- (F.I)남들처럼 평범하게… 행복하게 살길 바란다고.(F.O)
	text = game_string:GetString(self.script_key .. '3')

function local_class:fade_typing_text_in(typing_text, duration)
	local cur_time = 0
	typing_text.Label.alpha = 0
	while cur_time < duration do
		cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_time / duration
		if typing_text.Label.alpha >= 1 then break end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	typing_text.Label.alpha = 1
end

function local_class:fade_typing_text_out(typing_text, duration)
	local cur_time = 0
	local init_text_alpha = typing_text.Label.alpha

	while cur_time < duration do
		cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		typing_text.Label.alpha = init_text_alpha - (cur_time / duration)
		if typing_text.Label.alpha <= 0 then break end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	typing_text.Label.alpha = 0
end

end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'main_s10_security') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_security, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.open_door and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_security(), 'security_office') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hide_security, self)

		return true
	end

	for _, marker_data in pairs(self.quest_marker_data) do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, marker_data.zone_name) then
			self:add_quest_marker(marker_data.get_target())
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.get_mission and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'in_exclusion_zone') then

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.in_exclusion_zone, self, true)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_telephone_box, self)

	local password_button = self.get_password_button()
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.assassinate_security and

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_password_button, self)

		(type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_apartment_hallway_outer()) or
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_apartment_inner())) then

--- 경비병 암살
function local_class:assassinate_security()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local security = self.get_security()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(security, self.controller)

	party_util.align_party(
		security.Position + vector(0.55, 0, 0), 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 암살 QTE
	local qte_complete = false
	local tap_count = 0

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
				qte_complete = true
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap then
				tap_count = tap_count + 1

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

				-- 연타 시 파르바티(right, idle, push) 경비원(right, attack, damged) 둘 다 shake 0.03
				character_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.2)
				character_util.shake(security, 0.03, 0.2)
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 게임패드 사용중이면 이벤트 핸들러 세팅
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	-- 게임패드 핸들러가 세팅되있다면 게임패드 이벤트 구독
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('right')

	while not qte_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_monster_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_04')
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'shoot', scale = 1.5 })
	character_util.set_emotion(security, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(security, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(security.Position + vector(0.1, 0.2, 0))

	-- 암살 탭
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	while tap_count <= 10 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.touch_handler = nil

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(security)

	-- 짧은 카메라 쉐이크와 함께 fx_lasthit 뜨며 경비원 (right, dead, dead)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(security.Position)
	character_util.set_emotion(security, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(security, { name = 'dead', keep_anim = true, sfx = '01_hit_npc_01' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 파르바티 left 봤다가 다시 right
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	-- 파르바티 (right, tired, question): 이대로 두면 금방 들킬 거야…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s10_13', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	security.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	local password_button = self.get_password_button()
	self.origin_password_button_interactable = password_button.Interactable
	password_button.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
		self.get_security_office_center() + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
		unity_class.vector2(8, 6),
		CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76),
		CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)
	)

	self.attack_range:Show()

	-- 마커 위치 갱신
	self:add_quest_marker(self.get_password_button())
	self.quest_marker_data['apartment'].get_target = self.get_password_button
end

--- 비밀번호 입력기에 상호작용
function local_class:interact_password_button()
	local password_button = self.get_password_button()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')

	party_util.align_to_target(password_button, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	-- 비밀번호를 입력하세요.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_s10_14', mintotalduration = 1 })

	local password = { 1, 1, 1, 1 }
	local success_password = true

	for index = 1, 4 do
		-- 번호 입력 인터페이스
		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ '0' }, { '1' }, { '2' }, { '3' }, { '4' }, { '5' }
		})

		if player_choice ~= password[index] + 1 then
			success_password = false
		end
	end

	if not success_password then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
		-- 잘못된 번호입니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_s10_16', mintotalduration = 1 })

		-- 파르바티: 분명 1111이라 했지…?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
			{ key = 'short_story_parvati_s10_16_1', skip = true })

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress - 1
		return
	end

	password_button.Interactable = self.origin_password_button_interactable

	-- 보안 해제 완료.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_parvati_s10_15', mintotalduration = 1 })

	-- 마커 위치 갱신
	self:add_quest_marker(self.get_security(), true)
	self.quest_marker_data['apartment'].get_target = self.get_security

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('security_office_door', false))
	wait_for_sec(2)
end

	local security = self.get_security()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 경비원을 들고있는 상태면 던짐
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(security.Holdable.Holder, leader) and
		lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then
		command_util.execute_throw(leader, security, vector(0, 0, 1),
			leader.Position, 6, false)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 경비원 던져지는 상태 끝날 때까지 대기
	while lua_helper.type_compare(security.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.controller:play_stage_loop_sfx('01_amb_city_02', 2)
	self.controller.keep_bgm = false

	-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_police_01) -> Muted, 2

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')

	local petition = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = security.Position, target = leader.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0), itemid = 20560,
		  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 파르바티(left, idle, idle): 첫 번째 업무 완료.

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.exit_fos == nil then
		self:set_exit_fos()
	end

	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.police_cheescake_start and
			type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'convenience_store_grid') then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.main_quest_marker)

		local store_android_marker_fo = self.get_store_android_makrer_fo()
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, store_android_marker_fo)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.main_quest_marker)
		local cam_grid_info = e.CameraGrid
		for i = 1, #self.exit_fos do
			local exit_fo = self.exit_fos[i]
			if self:check_collision_bounds(cam_grid_info.bounds, exit_fo.Bounds) then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, exit_fo)
				return true
			end
		end

		if self.cur_progress == self.progress.police_cheescake_start then
			local store_entrance = self.get_store_entrance()
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, store_entrance)
		elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.police_cheescake_get then
			local police_4 = self.get_police(4)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, police_4)
		else
			local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, cleaner)
		end
	end
end


function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
		if self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
			if zone_name == self.police_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.passing_police_zone, self)
			end
		elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.corpse_carry_activity then
			if zone_name == self.top_block_zone_name then
				local return_pos = leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -2)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.return_to_activity_area, self, return_pos))
			elseif zone_name == self.corpse_carry_clear_zone_name then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.corpse_carry_activity_clear, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

		if self.cur_progress == self.progress.police_cheescake_start then

		end
	end

function local_class:cleaner_kill()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.main_quest_marker)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(cleaner, self.controller)

	--미화원과 상호작용 시 이벤트, 미화원 좌측에 정렬.
	party_util.align_party(cleaner.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'left', 1)

	-- 암살 QTE
	local qte_complete = false
	local tap_count = 0

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
				qte_complete = true
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap and qte_complete then
				tap_count = tap_count + 1

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

				-- 연타 시 파르바티(right, idle, push) 경비원(right, attack, damged) 둘 다 shake 0.03
				character_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.2)
				character_util.shake(cleaner, 0.03, 0.2)
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 게임패드 사용중이면 이벤트 핸들러 세팅
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	-- 게임패드 핸들러가 세팅되있다면 게임패드 이벤트 구독
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('right')

	while not qte_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'shoot', scale = 1.5 })
	wait_for_sec(0.05)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(cleaner.Bounds.center)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_monster_01')
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cleaner)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(cleaner, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'scared' })

	-- QTE 연타 출력
	self.tap_count = 0
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	while tap_count <= 10 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.touch_handler = nil

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cleaner)

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(cleaner.Position)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(cleaner,
			{ name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 1초 뒤 웨이트리스 시체 검게 페이드.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_06')
	cleaner.SpineController:AddColor(cleaner.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 이대로 두면 금방 들킬 거야…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s12_19', skip = true })

	self.patrol_npc = {}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local patrol_npc = self.get_patrol_npc(i)
		patrol_npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
		table.insert(self.patrol_npc, patrol_npc)
	end

	self.patrol_npc[1].FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
			self.patrol_npc[1], self.corpse_detected_event)

	self.patrol_npc[4].FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
			self.patrol_npc[4], self.corpse_detected_event)

	self.controller:park_civil_3_stop_patrolling()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.patrol_npc[3].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self:reset_patrol_npc()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	command_util.execute_holdup(leader, cleaner, leader.Position)

	self.cur_progress = self.progress.corpse_carry_activity

	local waste_plant_marker_obj = get_field_object('waste_plant_marker_obj')
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, waste_plant_marker_obj)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
end

	self.controller = nil

	return false

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'main_s10_security') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_police, self)

		return true
	end

	for _, marker_data in pairs(self.quest_marker_data) do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, marker_data.zone_name) then
			self:add_quest_marker(marker_data.get_target())
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local telephone_box = self.get_telephone_box()
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.talk_police and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, telephone_box) then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_telephone_box, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local sofa = self.get_sofa()
	local angry_guest = self.get_restaurant_guest(5)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sofa)
			and self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		-- 웨이트리스 이벤트
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.restaurant_event
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_sofa, self, sofa)
		return true
	end

	-- 문 상호작용
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
			self:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.restaurant_outside_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_state >= self.section_state.restaurant_event then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.restaurant_outside_zone, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.assassinate_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.restaurant_event then
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.assassinate_waitress
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.assassinate_waitress, self)

	return false

function local_class:assassinate_waitress()
	local waitress = self.controller.get_waitress()
	local parvati = user_party.Leader

	-- 암살 QTE
	local qte_complete = false
	local tap_count = 0
	local is_tap_action = false

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
				qte_complete = true
				return true
			end

			if is_tap_action and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap then
				tap_count = tap_count + 1

				-- 연타 시 파르바티, 웨이트리스 둘 다 shake 0.03
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.shake(parvati, 0.03, 0.2)
				character_util.shake(waitress, 0.03, 0.2)
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 게임패드 사용중이면 이벤트 핸들러 세팅
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
	end

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 웨이트리스에게 접근 시 트리거 존(붉은 선) 이벤트, 웨이트리스 뒤에 정렬.
	party_util.align_party(waitress.Position - vector(0.55, 0, 0), 'right', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 웨이트리스(left, smile, eat): 특별히 신선한 재료들만 골라서…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(waitress, { key = self.first_string_key .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 웨이트리스(left, awesome, eat): 손님이 깜짝 놀랄 정도로 맛있게 만드는 거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(waitress)
	character_util.set_emotion(waitress, { name = 'awesome' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(waitress, { key = self.first_string_key .. 11, skip = true })

	-- QTE 드래그(우에서 좌) 출력, qte 입력 시 와이어를 웨이트리스의 목에 건다. (와이어 특수모션 미제작 시 push 모션으로 대체)
	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	-- 게임패드 핸들러가 세팅되있다면 게임패드 이벤트 구독
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('left')
	while not qte_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_monster_01')
	if self.marian_lab_sfx ~= nil then
		self.marian_lab_sfx:Stop()
		self.marian_lab_sfx = nil
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)

	-- 파르바티가 와이어를 웨이트리스 목에 건다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_linda_scream_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(waitress.Position + vector(0.1, 0.2, 0))
	character_util.set_anim(parvati, { name = 'shoot' , scale = 1.5 })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(waitress)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(waitress, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

	-- 웨이트리스: 컥…! 커헉…!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(waitress, { key = self.first_string_key .. 12, skip = true })

	-- QTE 연타 출력
	is_tap_action = true
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	while tap_count <= 10 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	is_tap_action = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.touch_handler = nil

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(parvati)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(waitress)

	-- 연타 종료 후 1초 뒤 짧은 카메라 쉐이크와 함께 fx_lasthit 뜨며 둘 다 shake 멈춤.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(waitress.Position)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(waitress, { name = 'dead', sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01'
	, loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.shake(waitress, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 1초 뒤 웨이트리스 시체 검게 페이드.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_06')
	waitress.SpineController:AddColor(waitress.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 파르바티 뒷걸음질 2회 후 1.5초 대기하고 하단 대사 출력.
	character_util.move_to_async(parvati, parvati.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5,
			nil, 1.5, false, true)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 파르바티(left, tired, seat) :  …아쉽네. 오늘 추천 메뉴 기대했는데.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(parvati, { key = self.first_string_key .. 9, skip = true })

	-- 이벤트 종료, 컨트롤 풀림
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(parvati)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

function local_class:changed_exit_interact_fo()

	local exit_names = { 'exit_parvati_room_inner', 'exit_parvati_room_outer', 'apartment_hallway_inner'

	, 'exit_restaurant_outer', 'exit_bar_outer', 'exit_bar_inner', 'exit_cvs_outer', 'exit_cvs_inner' }

	self.exit_teleport_names = { 'parvati_room_outer', 'parvati_room_inner', 'apartment_hallway_outer'

	, 'restaurant_room_inner', 'bar_inner', 'bar_outer', 'cvs_inner', 'cvs_outer' }

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)

		if self.current_event == self.event_progress.bar then
			quest_marker_util.remove( self.main_quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_id, true, self.room_inner)
		end
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.hallway_grid_name) then
		if self.current_event == self.event_progress.bar then
			quest_marker_util.remove( self.main_quest_marker_name)

		return true

		if self.current_event == self.event_progress.bar then
			quest_marker_util.remove( self.main_quest_marker_name)

		end
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.restaurant_grid_name) then
		if self.current_event == self.event_progress.bar then
			quest_marker_util.remove( self.main_quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_id, true, self.restaurant_inner)
		end
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.street_grid_name) then
		if self.current_event == self.event_progress.bar then
			quest_marker_util.remove( self.main_quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_id, true, self.bar_outer)
		elseif self.current_event == self.event_progress.roof and self.parvati.Position.y > 1 then

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_id, true, self.bar_male)

			self.controller:play_stage_loop_sfx('01_amb_city_01', 1)
		end
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.store_grid_name) then

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)

end

	local paper = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = 20559, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = self.parvati.Position + vector(1.3,0.7,0), sprscale = 0.7, showoncharacter = true, skip_text = true })

	local duration = 1
	local timer = 2
	local init_pos = self.parvati.Position + vector(1.3,0.7,0)
	local dist = self.bar_male.Position
	local ease_out = function(progress)
		if progress < 0 then progress = 0 end
		if progress > 1 then progress = 1 end
		return math.sin(math.pi * 0.5 * progress)
	end
	local ease_in_out = function(progress)
		if progress < 0 then progress = 0 end
		if progress > 1 then progress = 1 end
		return 0.5 - math.cos(math.pi * progress) * 0.5
	end

	local target_data = {
		{ pos = init_pos, duration = 0},
		{ pos = parvati_pos + vector(0.6, 0.7, 0), duration = 1},

	}

	while true do
		if timer > duration then
			init_pos = target_data[mv_level].pos
			paper.Position = init_pos
			mv_level = mv_level + 1
			if mv_level > 4 then break end
			if mv_level == 4 then
				paper.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end
			duration = target_data[mv_level].duration
			dist = target_data[mv_level].pos - init_pos
			timer = 0
		end

		local prog = timer / duration
		paper.Position = init_pos + dist * ease_in_out(prog)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryParvatiMainSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryParvatiMain @
		Comment = ShortStoryParvatiMain 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'parvati_main_s2'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.parvati_room_zone_name = 'in_parvati_room'
	self.apartment_hall_zone_name = 'in_apartment_hallway'
	self.apartment_entrance_zone_name = 'in_apartment'
	self.meet_security_zone_name = 'main_s10_security'
	self.street_zone_name = 'in_street'
	self.convenience_store_zone_name = 'in_convenience_store'
	self.restaurant_zone_name = 'in_restaurant'
	self.bar_zone_name = 'in_bar'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_security = controller.get_security

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_telephone_box = controller.get_telephone_box

	-- 공중전화박스가 들고 있던 원래 Interactable
	self.origin_telephone_box_interactable = nil

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		meet_security = 1
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	local telephone_box = self.get_telephone_box()
	self.origin_telephone_box_interactable = telephone_box.Interactable
	telephone_box.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	-- 이전 섹션에서 넘어왔을 경우, 파르바티의 방 출구쪽에 마커를 찍어준다.
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 1 then
		self:marker_name_parse_and_show('exit_parvati_room_inner')
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 사용한 마커를 지워줌
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	local telephone_box = self.get_telephone_box()
	telephone_box.Interactable = self.origin_telephone_box_interactable
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.parvati_room_zone_name then
				self:marker_name_parse_and_show('exit_parvati_room_inner')
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.apartment_hall_zone_name then
				self:marker_name_parse_and_show('apartment_hallway_inner')
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.apartment_entrance_zone_name then
				if self.current_progress < self.progress.meet_security then
					self:marker_name_parse_and_show('apartment_security')
				else
					self:marker_name_parse_and_show('exit_apartment_inner')
				end
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.meet_security_zone_name and
				self.current_progress < self.progress.meet_security then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_security, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.street_zone_name then
				self:marker_name_parse_and_show('telephone_box')
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.convenience_store_zone_name then
				self:marker_name_parse_and_show('exit_cvs_inner')
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.restaurant_zone_name then
				self:marker_name_parse_and_show('exit_restaurant_inner')
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.bar_zone_name then
				self:marker_name_parse_and_show('exit_bar_inner')
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local telephone_box = self.get_telephone_box()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, telephone_box) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_telephone_box, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--- 마커 이름을 파싱해서 좌표/오브젝트 위치에 퀘스트 마커 표시
--- @param name string 좌표/오브젝트 이름
function local_class:marker_name_parse_and_show(name)
	local position = nil

	for x, y, z in string.gmatch(name, 'vector%((-?%d+)%s*,%s*(-?%d+)%s*,%s*(-?%d+)%s*%)') do
		x = tonumber(x)
		y = tonumber(y)
		z = tonumber(z)
		position = vector(x, y, z)
	end

	if position then
		--quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, position, true)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, position)
	else
		local marker_object = get_field_object(name)

		if marker_object == nil then
			marker_object = get_character(name)
		end

		--quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, marker_object, true)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, marker_object)
	end
end
--endregion

	self.controller = controller

		none = 1,
		parking_lot_event = 2,
		restaurant_event = 3,
		drink_event = 4,
		ending = 5
	}
	self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- field object
	self.get_sofa = function() return get_field_object('restaurant_sofa') end

	-- zone
	self.parking_lot_event_zone_name = 'parking_lot_event'
	self.drink_event_zone_name = 's3_restaurant_exit_event'

	self.section_3_restaurant_choose_custom_state = 'section_3_restaurant_choose'

	self.parvati_s3_script = 'short_story_parvati_s3_'

	self.pos_marker_name = 'parking_lot_pos_'

	self.is_exit = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- 의자 상호작용 가능하도록
	local sofa = self.get_sofa()
	sofa.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	sofa.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.6, 0.5, 0.5), vector(0.2, 1, 0.5))

	-- 이벤트 진행을 위해 ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable
	self:changed_exit_interact_fo()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 세팅
	local exit_fo_name = self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 2 and 'exit_parvati_room_inner'
			or 'exit_restaurant_outer'
	local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_fo_name)
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, exit_fo)
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	self.is_exit = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local sofa = self.get_sofa()

	-- 레스토랑 이벤트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sofa)
			and self.cur_section_state <= self.section_state.parking_lot_event then
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.restaurant_event

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_sofa, self, sofa)
		return true
	end

	-- 문 상호작용
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
			self:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.drink_event_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_state == self.section_state.drink_event then
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.ending
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.parvati_drink, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- ExitInteractable의 Interactable를 원복하는 함수
function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

function local_class:changed_exit_interact_fo()
	self.cached_exit = {}
	self.exit_interact_fo = {}

	local exit_names = { 'exit_parvati_room_inner', 'exit_parvati_room_outer', 'apartment_hallway_inner'
	, 'apartment_hallway_outer', 'exit_apartment_inner', 'exit_apartment_outer', 'exit_restaurant_inner'
	, 'exit_restaurant_outer', 'exit_bar_outer', 'exit_bar_inner', 'exit_cvs_outer', 'exit_cvs_inner' }

	self.exit_teleport_names = { 'parvati_room_outer', 'parvati_room_inner', 'apartment_hallway_outer'
	, 'apartment_hallway_inner', 'apartment_outer', 'apartment_inner', 'restaurant_room_outer'
	, 'restaurant_room_inner', 'bar_inner', 'bar_outer', 'cvs_inner', 'cvs_outer' }

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		table.insert(self.exit_interact_fo, exit_fo)
	end

	local sofa = self.get_sofa()

	self.marker_fo_list = { self.exit_interact_fo[3], self.exit_interact_fo[1]
	, self.exit_interact_fo[5], self.exit_interact_fo[3], self.exit_interact_fo[8], self.exit_interact_fo[5]
	, self.exit_interact_fo[8], sofa, self.exit_interact_fo[10], self.exit_interact_fo[8]
	, self.exit_interact_fo[12], self.exit_interact_fo[8] }
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 루틴
function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(index)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.teleport_party_for_marker
	, self, self.exit_teleport_names[index], self.marker_fo_list[index]))
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 함수
function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker(marker_name, quest_marker_fo)
	-- 마커 재 조정
	local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)
	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute(marker)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local quest_marker_name = self.controller.quest_marker_name
	if lua_helper.type_compare(quest_marker_fo, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3) then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, quest_marker_fo)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(quest_marker_fo, CS.Oak.Character) or lua_helper.type_compare(quest_marker_fo, CS.Oak.FieldObject) then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, quest_marker_fo)
	end
end

return local_class

		['parvati_room_grid'] = get_field_object('exit_parvati_room_inner'),
		['apartment_hallway_grid'] = get_field_object('apartment_hallway_inner'),
		['apartment_grid'] = get_field_object('exit_apartment_inner'),

end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	self.grid_exit_pairs = nil
end

	return false
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.sweeper_event_zone then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.entered_park, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	local is_user_leader = lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)
	local is_user_party  = lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party)
	local camera_grid = e.CameraGrid

	if is_user_leader or is_user_party then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.park_quest_marker)

		-- 이동한 구역이 실내 구역이라면 마커 표시할 exit 오브젝트 찾아서 그 위에 배치.
		local exit_fo = self.grid_exit_pairs[camera_grid.name]
		if exit_fo ~= nil then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.park_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, exit_fo)
			return true
		end

		-- 그 어디라도 아니라면 공원에다가 마커 설정
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.park_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, get_field_object('park_marker_obj'))
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	self:dispose_setting()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_table()) then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.exit_bar
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.bar_event, self)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_exit()) and
			self.current_event_state == self.event_state.exit_bar then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.done
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bar_exit_event, self))
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.grid_table do
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.grid_table[i].grid)
				and self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.done then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_key, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					true, get_field_object(self.grid_table[i].marker))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	self.is_exit = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local sofa = self.get_sofa()

	-- 레스토랑 이벤트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sofa)
			and self.cur_section_state <= self.section_state.parking_lot_event then
		self.cur_section_state = self.section_state.restaurant_event

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_sofa, self, sofa)
		return true
	end

	-- 문 상호작용
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
			self:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- ExitInteractable의 Interactable를 원복하는 함수
function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

function local_class:changed_exit_interact_fo()
	self.cached_exit = {}
	self.exit_interact_fo = {}

	local exit_names = { 'exit_parvati_room_inner', 'exit_parvati_room_outer', 'apartment_hallway_inner'
	, 'apartment_hallway_outer', 'exit_apartment_inner', 'exit_apartment_outer', 'exit_restaurant_inner'
	, 'exit_restaurant_outer', 'exit_bar_outer', 'exit_bar_inner', 'exit_cvs_outer', 'exit_cvs_inner' }

	self.exit_teleport_names = { 'parvati_room_outer', 'parvati_room_inner', 'apartment_hallway_outer'
	, 'apartment_hallway_inner', 'apartment_outer', 'apartment_inner', 'restaurant_room_outer'
	, 'restaurant_room_inner', 'bar_inner', 'bar_outer', 'cvs_inner', 'cvs_outer' }

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		table.insert(self.exit_interact_fo, exit_fo)
	end

	local sofa = self.get_sofa()

	self.marker_fo_list = { self.exit_interact_fo[3], self.exit_interact_fo[1]
	, self.exit_interact_fo[5], self.exit_interact_fo[3], self.exit_interact_fo[8], self.exit_interact_fo[5]
	, self.exit_interact_fo[8], sofa, self.exit_interact_fo[10], self.exit_interact_fo[8]
	, self.exit_interact_fo[12], self.exit_interact_fo[8] }
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 루틴
function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(index)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.teleport_party_for_marker
	, self, self.exit_teleport_names[index], self.marker_fo_list[index]))
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 함수
function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker(marker_name, quest_marker_fo)
	-- 마커 재 조정
	local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)
	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute(marker)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local quest_marker_name = self.controller.quest_marker_name
	if lua_helper.type_compare(quest_marker_fo, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3) then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, quest_marker_fo)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(quest_marker_fo, CS.Oak.Character) or lua_helper.type_compare(quest_marker_fo, CS.Oak.FieldObject) then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, quest_marker_fo)
	end
end

return local_class
