function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_id = self.controller.quest_progress.QuestId

	-- 경찰 npc 얻기
	self.get_police = function(idx)
		return get_character('park_police_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 미화원 얻기
	self.get_cleaner = function()
		return get_character('park_cleaner')
	end

	-- 시민 얻기
	self.get_civil = function(idx)
		return get_character('park_civil_' .. idx)
	end

	self.get_garbage = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('park_garbage_s8_' .. idx)
	end

	self.civil_in_unused = { 2, 4 }

	-- self.civil_in_use[self.name_to_num.kid_girl] 처럼 사용
	self.civil_in_use = { 6, 3, 5, 1}
	self.name_to_num = {
		kid_girl = 1,
		civil_male = 2,
		old_man = 3,
		kid_boy = 4
	}

	self.get_civil_pos = function(idx, progress)
		if progress == 1 then
			return field:GetMarker('park_civil_s8_pos_' .. idx).position
		else
			return field:GetMarker('park_civil_s8_pos_' .. idx .. '_' .. progress).position
		end
	end

	-- 시민들이 치우는 쓰레기 1~4
	self.civil_garbage = { 4, 3, 1, 2 }

	-- 미화원 존 이름
	self.cleaner_notice_zone_name = 'park_top_enter'

	-- 공원 지역 전체 존 이름
	self.park_zone_name = 'park_area'

	-- 공원 청소 이벤트 존 북쪽
	self.park_top_exit_name = 'park_top_exit'

	-- 공원 청소 이벤트 존 서쪽
	self.park_left_exit_name = 'park_left_exit'

	-- 폐기 처리장 지역 이름
	self.waste_plant_zone_name ='waste_plant_area'

	self.progress = {
		none = 1,
		activity_start = 2,
		activity_clear = 3
	}
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.none

	self.garbage_clean_target_num = 3

	self.get_park_marker_obj = function()
		return get_field_object('park_marker_obj')
	end

	self.get_waste_plant_marker_obj = function()
		return get_field_object('waste_plant_marker_obj')
	end

	-- 메인 퀘스트 마커 키
	self.main_quest_marker = 'main_quest_marker'

	self.get_reset_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
	end

	self.cleaned_garbage = {}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	-- 미화원 초기 설정
	--미화원, 공원 우측 상단 쓰레기 봉지 옆에서 eat 모션
	--미화원에 마커, 접근 시 트리거 존 이벤트
	local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()
	local cleaner_pos = field:GetMarker('park_cleaner_start_s8').position
	character_util.set_position(cleaner, cleaner_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(cleaner, { name = 'eat' })
	self.cleaner_eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, parent = cleaner })

	self.park_bounds = field:GetZone(self.park_zone_name).Bounds
	self.waste_plant_bounds = field:GetZone(self.waste_plant_zone_name).Bounds

	self:set_exit_fos()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 7 then
		local marker_fo = get_field_object('exit_restaurant_inner')
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, marker_fo)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.civil_in_unused do
		local idx = self.civil_in_unused[i]
		local civil = self.get_civil(idx)
		character_util.set_position(civil, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end

	local civil_setting = {
		anim = { 'cast2', 'idle', 'cast', 'seat' },
		emo = { 'attack', 'tired', 'idle', 'tired' },
		dir = { 'down', 'down', 'left', 'right' },
		key = {
			'short_story_parvati_s8_21',
			'short_story_parvati_s8_22',
			'short_story_parvati_s8_23',
			'short_story_parvati_s8_24'
		}
	}

	for i = 1, #self.civil_in_use do
		local idx = self.civil_in_use[i]
		local civil = self.get_civil(idx)
		local civil_pos = self.get_civil_pos(idx, 1)
		character_util.set_position(civil, civil_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(civil, civil_setting.dir[i])
		character_util.set_anim(civil, { name = civil_setting.anim[i] })
		character_util.set_emotion(civil, { name = civil_setting.emo[i] })
		civil.Interactable.Talk = civil_setting.key[i]
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_reset_fx()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.main_quest_marker)

	if self.cleaner_eat_sfx ~= nil then
		self.cleaner_eat_sfx:Stop()
		self.cleaner_eat_sfx = nil
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.exit_fos == nil then
		self:set_exit_fos()
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party) then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.main_quest_marker)
		local cam_grid_info = e.CameraGrid
		for i = 1, #self.exit_fos do
			local exit_fo = self.exit_fos[i]
			if self:check_collision_bounds(cam_grid_info.bounds, exit_fo.Bounds) then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, exit_fo)
				return true
			end
		end

		local park_marker_obj = self.get_park_marker_obj()
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, park_marker_obj)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if zone_name == self.cleaner_notice_zone_name and self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_cleaner_zone, self))
			end
		end

		if self.cur_progress == self.progress.activity_start then
			local garbage_data = self.garbage[e.FieldObject.Name]
			if garbage_data ~= nil then
				local garbage = self.garbage[e.FieldObject.Name].fo
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, garbage) and zone_name == self.waste_plant_zone_name then
					garbage_data.in_waste_plant_zone = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if e.FullLeave then
		local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
		local zone_bound = e.Zone.Bounds
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
			if self.cur_progress == self.progress.activity_start then
				if zone_name == self.park_top_exit_name and zone_bound.center.z < leader.Position.z then
					local top_return_pos = field:GetMarker('park_top_exit_return_pos').position
					local return_pos = vector(leader.Position.x, 0, top_return_pos.z)
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.return_to_activity, self, return_pos)
					return
				elseif zone_name == self.park_left_exit_name and zone_bound.center.x > leader.Position.x then
					local left_return_pos = field:GetMarker('park_left_exit_return_pos').position
					local return_pos = vector(left_return_pos.x, 0, leader.Position.z)
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.return_to_activity, self, return_pos)
					return
				end
			end
		end

		if self.cur_progress == self.progress.activity_start then
			local garbage_data = self.garbage[e.FieldObject.Name]
			if garbage_data ~= nil then
				local garbage = garbage_data.fo
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, garbage) then
					if (zone_name == self.park_top_exit_name and zone_bound.center.z < garbage.Position.z) or
							(zone_name == self.park_left_exit_name and zone_bound.center.x > garbage.Position.x) then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
								util.cs_generator(self.garbage_reset_pos, self, garbage))
					elseif zone_name == self.waste_plant_zone_name then
						garbage_data.in_waste_plant_zone = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.activity_start then
		if self.garbage[e.Target.Name] ~= nil then
			self:activate_waste_plant_quest_marker()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.activity_start then
		if self.garbage[e.Target.Name] ~= nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.check_thrown_garbage_cleaned, self, e.Target))
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:set_exit_fos()
	local exit_names = { 'exit_parvati_room_inner', 'apartment_hallway_inner'
	, 'exit_apartment_inner', 'exit_restaurant_inner', 'exit_cvs_inner' }

	self.exit_fos = {}
	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.exit_fos, exit_fo)
	end
end

function local_class:enter_cleaner_zone()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local cleaner = self.get_cleaner()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.main_quest_marker)

	party_util.align_party(cleaner.Position, 'left', 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.cleaner_eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(cleaner)
	character_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(cleaner, nil, 'notice')

	--미화원: 어제 그 아가씨네?!
	character_util.normal_jump(cleaner, true)
	character_util.set_emotion(cleaner, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_5', skip = true })

	--미화원: 어때? 쓰레기가 많이 줄었지?
	character_util.set_anim(cleaner, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_6', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(cleaner)

	--미화원 공원 주위를 보고 다시 파르바티를 보며
	local look_around_dir = { 'left', 'right' }

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(look_around_dir) do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, look_around_dir[i])
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	--파르바티 nod 2회
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	--미화원: 혼자라도 계속 치우다 보면 언젠가는…
	character_util.remove_emotion(cleaner)
	character_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_7', skip = true })

	-- 미화원 (right, idle, question) emoticon_bubble_silence
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(cleaner, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(cleaner, nil, 'silence')

	--미화원: 저기 괜찮다면 나를 도와줄 수 있어? 둘이 치우면 더 빨리 끝낼 수 있을 거야.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cleaner)
	character_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_8', skip = true })

	--파르바티: …….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_9', skip = true })

	--미화원: 지금은 아무도 없지만… 쓰레기가 사라지면 사람들도 다시…
	character_util.set_emotion(cleaner, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_10', skip = true })

	--미화원: 부탁이야, 청소를 도와줘!
	character_util.remove_emotion(cleaner)
	character_util.set_anim(cleaner, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_11', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(cleaner)

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	--미화원: 고마워!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(cleaner, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.normal_jump(cleaner, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_12', skip = true })

	--미화원: 어려운 일은 아니야.
	character_util.remove_emotion(cleaner)
	character_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_13', skip = true })

	--미화원: 쓰레기 봉지 몇 개만 같이 버려주면 돼.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(cleaner, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' } )
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_14', skip = true })

	--카메라 패닝하여 처리장 보여주고 돌아옴
	local waste_plant_pos = field:GetMarker('park_waste_plant_cam_pos').position
	camera_util.move_async(waste_plant_pos, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--미화원: 그럼 잘 부탁…
	character_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_15', skip = true })

	-- demon_kid_girl(down, smile, 점프1회) : 우리도 도울게요!
	local civil_num = #self.civil_in_use
	for i = 1, civil_num do
		local idx = self.civil_in_use[i]
		local civil = self.get_civil(idx)
		character_util.remove_anim(civil)
		character_util.set_emotion(civil, { name = 'smile' })
	end

	local kid_girl = self.get_civil(self.civil_in_use[self.name_to_num.kid_girl])
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_group_direction({ cleaner, leader }, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_girl, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_25', skip = true,
															world_pos = leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
															scale = 1.2, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	local wait_idx = 0
	local civil_num = #self.civil_in_use
	for i = 1, civil_num do
		local idx = self.civil_in_use[i]
		local civil = self.get_civil(idx)
		local target_pos = self.get_civil_pos(idx, 2)
		character_util.move_waypoint(civil, target_pos, 2.5, true,
				'stop', 'floor', 'down',
				true, 0, function()
					wait_idx = wait_idx + 1
				end)

		civil.Interactable.Talk = nil
		civil.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	cleaner.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	while wait_idx < civil_num do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--demon_oldman (down, smile, clap) : 젊은 친구가 좋은 뜻으로 청소하는데 기꺼이 도와야지.
	local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_02', loop = true })
	local old_man = self.get_civil(self.civil_in_use[self.name_to_num.old_man])
	character_util.set_anim(old_man, { name = 'clap' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(old_man, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_26', skip = true })
	clap_sfx:Stop()

	--demon_kid_boy (down, smile, 점프) : 저희가 도와드리면 더 빨리 치울 수 있을 거예요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	local kid_boy = self.get_civil(self.civil_in_use[self.name_to_num.kid_boy])
	character_util.normal_jump(kid_boy, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid_boy, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_27', skip = true })

	local kid_girl_garbage = self.get_garbage(self.civil_garbage[self.name_to_num.kid_girl])
	local kid_girl_wp = {
		vector(kid_girl.Position.x, 0, kid_girl_garbage.Position.z),
		vector(kid_girl_garbage.Position.x + 0.8, 0, kid_girl_garbage.Position.z)
	}

	local kid_boy_garbage = self.get_garbage(self.civil_garbage[self.name_to_num.kid_boy])
	local kid_boy_wp = {
		vector(kid_boy_garbage.Position.x + 0.8, 0, kid_boy_garbage.Position.z)
	}

	local old_man_garbage = self.get_garbage(self.civil_garbage[self.name_to_num.old_man])
	local old_man_wp = {
		vector(old_man_garbage.Position.x - 1, 0, old_man_garbage.Position.z)
	}

	local civil_male = self.get_civil(self.civil_in_use[self.name_to_num.civil_male])
	local civil_male_garbage = self.get_garbage(self.civil_garbage[self.name_to_num.civil_male])
	local civil_male_wp = {
		vector(civil_male.Position.x, 0, civil_male_garbage.Position.z),
		vector(civil_male_garbage.Position.x - 1, 0, civil_male_garbage.Position.z)
	}

	local eat_sfx = nil
	local move_to_garbage = function(fo, fo_wp, last_dir)
		character_util.remove_anim(fo)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, fo_wp, 2.5, true,
				'stop', 'floor', last_dir, true)
		character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'eat' })
		if eat_sfx == nil then
			eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		end
	end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(move_to_garbage, kid_girl, kid_girl_wp, 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(move_to_garbage, kid_boy, kid_boy_wp, 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(move_to_garbage, old_man, old_man_wp, 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(move_to_garbage, civil_male, civil_male_wp, 'right'),
	})

	--미화원(up) : 다들 감사합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(cleaner, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_28', skip = true })

	--미화원(right, smile, victory_get) : 그럼 후딱 치워보자고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(cleaner, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(cleaner, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(cleaner, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cleaner, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_29', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(cleaner)
	character_util.set_anim(cleaner, { name = 'eat' })

	self:cleaning_activity_preparation()

	eat_sfx:FadeOut()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:cleaning_activity_preparation()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.activity_start

	-- 엑티비티 시작 준비
	self.garbage = {}
	self.quest_marker_garbage = {}
	local idx = 5
	while true do

		if garbage == nil then
			break
		end
		idx = idx + 1

		garbage.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()
		garbage.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
		garbage.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_destroy_tree_01'

		local garbage_data = {
			fo = garbage,
			origin_pos = garbage.Position,
			in_waste_plant_zone = false
		}
		self.garbage[garbage.Name] = garbage_data
		table.insert(self.quest_marker_garbage, garbage)
	end

	-- 폐기 처리장에 범위 표시
	self.waste_plant_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
			self.waste_plant_bounds.center + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
			unity_class.vector2(self.waste_plant_bounds.size.x, self.waste_plant_bounds.size.z),
			CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76),
			CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)
	)

	-- 들 수 있는 쓰레기에 마커
	self:activate_garbage_quest_markers()

-- 쓰레기 상태 리셋
function local_class:garbage_reset_pos(garbage, play_fx, activate_markers)
	local playfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_fx, true)
	local marker_reset = lua_helper.get_or_default(activate_markers, true)

	if garbage.Holdable.IsHeld then
		local holder = garbage.Holdable.Holder
		garbage.Holdable:GetThrownBy(holder)
		message_system:SendSync(garbage, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		message_system:SendSync(holder, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(holder))
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(garbage.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) then
		message_system:SendSync(garbage, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
	end

	garbage.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour()
	self.garbage[garbage.Name].in_waste_plant_zone = false

	local origin_pos = self.garbage[garbage.Name].origin_pos
	local prev_pos = garbage.Position
	garbage.Position = origin_pos

	if playfx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_warp_01')
		self.get_reset_fx():Instantiate(prev_pos)
		self.get_reset_fx():Instantiate(origin_pos)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	garbage.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()
	garbage.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	garbage.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_destroy_tree_01'

	if marker_reset then
		self:deactivate_waste_plant_quest_marker()
	end
end

function local_class:check_thrown_garbage_cleaned(thrown_garbage)
	thrown_garbage.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	local garbage_bhv = thrown_garbage.FieldObjectBehaviour
	cast(garbage_bhv, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectBehaviour))
	while true do
		if lua_helper.type_compare(garbage_bhv.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState) then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	thrown_garbage.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	thrown_garbage.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_destroy_tree_01'

	if self.garbage[thrown_garbage.Name].in_waste_plant_zone then
		local garbage_cleaned_num = 0
		for _, garbage_data in pairs(self.garbage) do
			local garbage = garbage_data.fo
			if self:check_collision_bounds(self.waste_plant_bounds, garbage.Bounds) then
				garbage_cleaned_num = garbage_cleaned_num + 1
				table.insert(self.cleaned_garbage, garbage)
				if garbage_cleaned_num == self.garbage_clean_target_num then
					self:cleaning_activity_end()
				end
			end
		end
		self.cleaned_garbage = nil
		self.cleaned_garbage = {}
	end

	-- 쓰레기가 착지된 시점에 리더가 무언가(쓰레기)를 들고 있다면 마커 업데이트를 하지 않는다.
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	if leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		return
	end

	self:deactivate_waste_plant_quest_marker()
end

function local_class:return_to_activity(return_pos)

	if leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then

	else
		--쓰레기를 들지 않은 상태 : 쓰레기를 처리장에 버려야 해.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_parvati_s8_36', skip = true })

	end

	character_util.move_to_async(leader, return_pos, nil, 2.5, true, true)
end

function local_class:activate_waste_plant_quest_marker()
	-- 쓰레기 처리장으로 마커 설정
	local waste_plant_marker_obj = self.get_waste_plant_marker_obj()
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.main_quest_marker, self.quest_id, true, waste_plant_marker_obj)
	self.is_waste_plant_quest_marker_on = true

	self:deactivate_garbage_quest_markers()
end

function local_class:deactivate_waste_plant_quest_marker()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.main_quest_marker)
	self:activate_garbage_quest_markers()
end

function local_class:activate_garbage_quest_markers()
	if self.garbage ~= nil and self.waste_plant_bounds ~= nil then
		for _, garbage_data in pairs(self.garbage) do
			local garbage = garbage_data.fo
			if not self:check_collision_bounds(self.waste_plant_bounds, garbage.Bounds) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, garbage.Name, garbage)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:deactivate_garbage_quest_markers()
	if self.garbage ~= nil then
		for _, garbage_data in pairs(self.garbage) do
			local garbage = garbage_data.fo
			quest_marker_util.remove(garbage.Name)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_collision_bounds(bounds1, bounds2)
	if bounds2.min.x <= bounds1.max.x and bounds2.max.x >= bounds1.min.x
			and bounds2.min.z <= bounds1.max.z and bounds2.max.z >= bounds1.min.z then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

return local_class

end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then

function local_class:bartender_interact_scene()
	-- 타일 위치 가져오기
	local tile_pos = self:get_bartender_pos() - vector(0, 0, 1)

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.opened_mini_game then
		local bartender = self:get_bartender()
		quest_icon_util.remove(bartender)
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		-- 무기 숨김
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
		end

		-- 리더 무적 처리
		if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
			leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
					stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
		end

		-- 리더가 HoldUpState일 경우 들고 있는 오브젝트 내려 놓도록
		local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
			--TODO: HoldTarget이 nil일 때는 버그 일텐데 굳이 체크하는게 맞을지...?
			if hold_target ~= nil then
				command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction)
				, leader.Position, 4, false)
			end
		end

		-- 플레이어 ■타일로 정렬하며 up 방향 바라봄.
		party_util.align_party(tile_pos, 'down', 1)

		-- 실패 한 적 있는지 여부 체크 해서 연출 분리
		if self.mini_game_failed_flag then
			-- 바텐더 (down, idle, release) : 일할 준비됐나? 남은 빚이 산더미야!
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bartender)
			character_util.set_direction(bartender, 'down')
			character_util.set_anim(bartender, {name = 'release'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bartender, { key = 'short_story_rt_bar_part_time_job_21', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bartender)
		else
			-- 바텐더 (down, attack, jump 1회) : 앗! 그때 그 꼬맹이!
			character_util.set_direction(bartender, 'down')
			character_util.set_emotion(bartender, {name = 'attack'})
			character_util.normal_jump(bartender, '01_jump_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bartender, { key = 'short_story_rt_bar_part_time_job_3', skip = true })

			-- 바텐더 (down, attack, release) : 빨리 일할 준비해! 지금 한창 손님 몰릴 때라 일손이 부족하다고!
			character_util.set_emotion(bartender, {name = 'attack'})
			character_util.set_anim(bartender, { name = "release", sfx_name = "01_swing_01" })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bartender, { key = 'short_story_rt_bar_part_time_job_4', skip = true })

			-- 바텐더 (down, idle, idle) :남은 빚도 빨리 갚아야 할거 아냐!
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bartender)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bartender, { key = 'short_story_rt_bar_part_time_job_5', skip = true })
		end

		-- 선택지 출력.
		local choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'short_story_rt_bar_part_time_job_6', 'mercy' }, { 'short_story_rt_bar_part_time_job_7', 'brutal' } })

		if choice == 1 then
			-- 『서빙을 준비한다.』 (mercy)
			-- 바텐더 (down, attack, jump 1회) : 좋아! 시간이 없으니 서두르자고!
			character_util.set_emotion(bartender, {name = 'attack'})
			character_util.normal_jump(bartender, '01_jump_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bartender, { key = 'short_story_rt_bar_part_time_job_8', skip = true })

			-- 페이드 아웃
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0, 1)
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
			-- 미니게임 챌린지 파트로 진입.
			yield_return_func(self.start_mini_game_routine, self)
		else
			-- 『도망친다.』 (brutal)
			yield_return_func(self.run_away_bartender_scene, self)
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(bartender)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bartender)
	end
end

function local_class:run_away_bartender_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local goal_pos = leader.Position - vector(0, 0, 3)

	-- 플레이어(엘비라)가 down 방향 damaged 표정, run 자세로 아래로 3칸 달려감.
	-- 이후 idle 표정, idle 자세로 변환 뒤 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	-- 이후 플레이어가 NPC재인터렉트시 동일한 이벤트 진행.
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'run', loop = true })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, goal_pos, nil, 7, true, false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.opened_mini_game

	-- 리더 무적 해제
	if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	-- 무기 다시 보이게
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local bartender_table = self:get_bartender_table()

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, bartender_table) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.opened_mini_game then
			start_coroutine(self.bartender_interact_scene, self)
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.playing_mini_game
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.mini_game_name or self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		return false
	end

	if e.Success then
		start_coroutine(self.success_mini_game, self)
	else
		-- 미니게임 재도전 이벤트 연출 여기서 작성
		start_coroutine(self.failed_mini_game, self)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sheriff, { key = 'shortstory_rt_bartender_s1_2_1', skip = true })

	--보안관 NPC left 방향 seat 자세로 변경.
	character_util.set_direction(sheriff, 'left')

	--region 보안관 NPC의 대각선 1칸 윗방향으로 골드 아이템이 떨어진다. 이후 하단의 대사 출력.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	local gold_big = self.get_gold_effect_pool():Instantiate(
			sheriff.Position + vector(-1, 0.5, 1))

	-- 오브젝트 풀 gold 포물선 이동
	local temp_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = 0.5
	local start_pos = sheriff.Position
	local end_pos = sheriff.Position + vector(-1, 0.5, 1)
	local height = 0.5

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / final_duration)

		-- 아이템 포물선운동
		local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * h
		gold_big.transform.localPosition = temp_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_drop_gold_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--탁자 위에 떨어진 골드 아이템은 0.5초 뒤 알파값이 줄어들며 사라짐.
	-- 불가능해서 다른 방식으로 처리했음
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get'):Instantiate(gold_big.transform.localPosition)
	gold_big:Dispose()
	--region end

	--보안관(left, idle, seat): 차 한잔 주게나, 바텐더.

	while self.is_slide_beer_end == false do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	self.is_slide_beer_end = false

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bartender)

	--보안관(left, idle, idle): 또 실패했군… 벌써 2만 골드나 써버렸어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	----보안관(dowm idle, idle): 저 잔을 받기만 하면 1000L 이용권을 얻는 건데!

	--character_util.set_anim(sheriff, { name = 'question', loop = false })

	--보안관(down, idle, release):  이봐, 나는 도저히 안될 거 같으니, 자네가 대신해 줄 수 있겠나?
	local is_release_anim = true
	local release_anim = function(fo)
		while is_release_anim do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(fo, { name = 'release', count = 1 })
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)

	character_util.set_direction(sheriff, 'down')
	start_coroutine(release_anim, sheriff)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sheriff, { key = 'shortstory_rt_bartender_s1_6', skip = true })

	is_release_anim = false
	--보안관(down, idle, idle): 참가비는 내가 대신 내줄 테니, 딱 한 번만 성공하면 돼!
	character_util.set_anim(sheriff, { name = 'idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sheriff, { key = 'shortstory_rt_bartender_s1_7', skip = true })

function local_class:interact_chair()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local bartender = self.get_bartender()
	local chair = self.get_chair()
	local leader_pos_org = leader.Position

	--music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.5)

	character_util.look_at(leader, chair)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'jump' })
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.move_to(leader, chair.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0), 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'seat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local choose_result = -1

	local nar_data = {
		--나레이션 박스: 무엇을 하시겠습니까?
		key = 'shortstory_rt_bartender_s1_9'
	}
	local branch_data = {
		-- 탄산 보리차를 주문한다.
		{ 'shortstory_rt_bartender_s1_10', 'mercy' },
		-- 자리에서 일어난다.
		{ 'shortstory_rt_bartender_s1_11', 'normal' },
	}

	self.success_pre_game = false
	-- 자리에서 일어나거나, qte를 성공하기 전까지 계속 반복.
	while choose_result ~= 2 do
		if self.success_pre_game == true then
			choose_result = 1
		else
			choose_result = field_ui_util.show_narration_talk_branch_async(nar_data, branch_data)
			--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		end

		if choose_result == 1 then
			start_coroutine(self.slide_beer, self, leader, true, self.current_progress)
			while self.is_slide_beer_end == false do
				coroutine.yield()
			end
			self.is_slide_beer_end = false

			if self.is_beer_qte_success then
				-- qte 성공시 탈출
				if self.current_progress ~= self.section_progress.qte_third then
					--2라운드 삭제함. 바로 3라운드로 넘어가기
					self.current_progress = self.section_progress.qte_third
					self.success_pre_game = true
				else
					leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'bar_drink_blackrussian')
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
					character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, { name = 'smile' })
					wait_for_sec(1.4)
					break
				end
			else
				-- qte 실패시
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
				character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'annoyed')
			end

		end

	end
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--엔딩연출
		--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.ending, self)
		start_coroutine(self.ending, self)
		while self.is_ending_end == false do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
		self.is_ending_end = false

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--character_util.look_at(leader, leader_pos_org)
		--character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bartender)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bartender, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
		character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'jump' })
		character_util.move_to(leader, leader_pos_org, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		--music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1.0)
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1.0)
	end

end

			--FoxMainSection24 참조 포물선 운동
			local time_passed = 0
			local final_duration = 0.16
			local height = 1
			local start_pos = beer_item.Position
			local end_pos = beer_item.Position + vector(2.0, -1, 0)

			-- beer 높이 0 이하 되는 순간 탈출
			while beer_item.Position.y > 0 do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				if time_passed >= final_duration then
					break
				end
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / final_duration) / 2

				-- 아이템 포물선운동
				-- y = sin(pi/2 + pix) - 1
				-- 즉, sin 함수 pi/2 ~ pi 까지 범위. 1부터 시작해서 0으로 떨어지니 1을 뺀다.
				local h = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * (progress + 0.5)) * height - 1
				temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + unity_class.vector3.up * h
				beer_item:SetPosition(temp_pos, true)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			--fx_obj_oilbottle_break 이펙트 출력과 동시에 재생
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_glass_01')

			local splash_effect_child_count = splash_effect.transform.childCount
			splash_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8
			for i = 0, splash_effect_child_count - 1 do
				splash_effect.transform:GetChild(i).transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8
			end
			--		:GetChild(8)

			beer_item:ConsumeComplete()
			beer_item = nil
			wait_for_sec(2.0)

			if splash_effect ~= nil then

				splash_effect = nil
			end

function local_class:qte_tap(count, duration, time_mod, is_wait_duration)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 99999)
	is_wait_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_wait_duration, false)

	local tap_count = 0
	local event_listener = {}

	-- TouchEvent EventListener 생성
	event_listener.on_touch_event = function(self, e)
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			if tap_sfx_name then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(tap_sfx_name)
			end

			tap_count = tap_count + 1
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	-- 게임패드 사용중이면 이벤트 핸들러 세팅
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
	end

	local qte_tap_routine = function()

		if time_mod then
			screen_util.show_turbo_tap()
			time_util.mod('qte_mod', time_mod)
		end

		message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

		local time_passed = 0

		while tap_count < count and time_passed < duration do
			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		if tap_count >= count then
			start_coroutine(function()
				yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1.0, '03_gimmick_jingle_01')
			end)

		end

		screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		-- is_wait_duration가 true일 경우, duration 시간을 모두 대기하고 qte를 끝냄
		while is_wait_duration and time_passed < duration do
			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		if time_mod then
			time_util.unmod('qte_mod')
		end
	end

	-- 혹시 모를 예외를 위해, 코루틴이 끝나면 이벤트 구독해제와 unmod 처리
	local qte_tap_coroutine = coroutine_class.coroutine(util.cs_generator(qte_tap_routine))
											 :Finally(function()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

		if time_mod then
			time_util.unmod('qte_mod')
		end
	end)

	coroutine.yield(qte_tap_coroutine)

	return tap_count >= count
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	local guide = self.get_guide()
	self.fx_star_piece = self.get_fx_star_piece():Instantiate(guide.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, guide.Transform)

	self:open_quest()

	return true

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	local guide = self.get_guide()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(guide, self.controller)
	quest_icon_util.remove(guide)

	if self.fx_star_piece ~= nil then
		self.fx_star_piece:Dispose()
		self.fx_star_piece = nil
	end

	if self.sand_fxs ~= nil then

			self.sand_fxs[i]:Dispose()
		end

	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self:remove_all_loop_sfx()

	self.game_end = true

	if self.optimized_npc ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npc)
		self.optimized_npc = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local guide = self.get_guide()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, guide) and self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		start_coroutine(self.intro_guide_talk_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id then
		self:open_quest()
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.mini_game_name then
		return false
	end

	if e.Success then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.success_mini_game, self)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'play_desert_bull_worm_opening_scene' then
			start_coroutine(self.mini_game_opening_scene, self)
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:open_quest()
	-- 메인 3섹션 종료 이후 이벤트 시작 가능
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
	self.can_start_quest = main_quest_progress ~= nil and
			(main_quest_progress.InnerProgress >= self.target_main_quest_progress or
					main_quest_progress.Grade >= 0)

	if self.can_start_quest then
		local guide = self.get_guide()
		character_util.add_listener(guide, self.controller)
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(guide)

		--문이 화면에 보이면 천천히 열리는 거 보여주고, 아니면 바로 연다.
		local door = self.get_door()
		if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(door.Position) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door.Name, true))
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door.Name, false))
		end

		local signboard = self.get_signboard()
		signboard.Interactable.Message = 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_oneline_2'

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	end
end

function local_class:intro_guide_talk_event()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.guide_talk

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local guide = self.get_guide()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, true)

	--안내원 A QuestIcon 제거

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(guide, 'release', { sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_2')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_3')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_4')

		--0.1초 뒤 DropGold로 500골드를 플레이어 위치에 생성해서 안내원 A 위치로 던짐
		wait_for_sec(0.2667)
		local gold = CS.Oak.DropGold.Create(leader.Bounds.center, guide.Position, 500)

		--0.4초 뒤 안내원 A가 DropGold 습득

		gold.ConsumeTarget = guide

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--안내원 A (left, smile, nod) : 접수 완료되었습니다!
		scene_util.nod_the_head(guide, 1)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guide, 'smile')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_8')

		--안내원 A (left, idle, idle)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guide)

		--안내원 A 점프 (1, 0.5), 점프 종료될 때까지 0.5초 대기
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(guide, 1, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--안내원 A (left, smile, cast2) : 아, 한 가지 빠뜨렸네요!
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(guide, 'cast2')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guide, 'smile')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_9')

		--안내원 A 종이를 꺼내서 손에 듬 (left, doyagao, cast), 스프라이트 이름 - paper_piece
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(guide, 'cast')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guide, 'doyagao')

		local paper_piece = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = guide.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0.275), itemid = self.paper_piece_id,
			notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.8, showoncharacter = true })

		--안내원 A (left, doyagao, cast) : 여기에 사인만 해주세요!

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_10')

		--나레이션 박스 : 참가자는 레이스 중 어떠한 문제가 발생하더라도 주최 측에 책임을 묻지 않을 것

		wait_for_sec(1)
		paper_piece:ConsumeComplete()

		--안내원 A (left, smile, clap) : 좋아요! 레이스 장소로 모시겠습니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(guide, 'clap')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guide, 'smile')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_12')

		--화면 1초간 circular 페이드 아웃
		self:accept_race_event()
	else
		--안내원 A QuestIcon Notice 다시 추가
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(guide)

		character_util.remove_anim(guide)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guide, 'smile')

		self.cur_progress = self.progress.none

		character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:accept_race_event()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.accept_race_event

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local guide = self.get_guide()
	local participants = {}

	for i = 1, 6 do
		local participant = self.get_participants(i)
		table.insert(participants, participant)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 위치 정보
	local race_start_pivot = self.get_race_start_pivot_pos()
	local participants_pos = {
		race_start_pivot + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
		race_start_pivot + vector(-1, 0, 0),
		race_start_pivot + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.5),
	}

	local top_runner = self.get_participants(5)
	local bot_runner = self.get_participants(6)

	--리더 세팅
	leader.Position = race_start_pivot + vector(2.5, 0, 0)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', nil)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	local attack_ranges = {}

	for i = 1, 3 do
		--참가자 세팅
		local participant = participants[i]
		participant.Position = participants_pos[i]
		scene_util.set_direction(participant, 'right', nil)
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(participant, 'victory_extra')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(participant, 'attack')

		-- 어텍레인지 세팅
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(participants_pos[i] + self.attack_range_offset,
				1.5, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Hide()
		table.insert(attack_ranges, attack_range)
	end

	top_runner.Position = race_start_pivot + vector(1.5, 0, 1.5)
	bot_runner.Position = race_start_pivot + vector(1.5, 0, -1.5)

	--사막황소벌레 세팅
	self.optimized_npc = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		worm_1 = 'shortstory_rt_boss_graboid',
		worm_2 = 'shortstory_rt_boss_graboid',
		worm_3 = 'shortstory_rt_boss_graboid',
	})

	local rosetta_global_data = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/ShortStory/Rosetta/ConstantsData')
	local worm_shadow_size = rosetta_global_data.desert_bull_worm_shadow_size
	for _, worm in pairs(self.optimized_npc) do
		worm.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = worm_shadow_size
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_03')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--Shout 말풍선 (위치는 엘비라 우측 위) : 오싹오싹 유사 레이스 참가자 여러분, 환영합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bike_rush_02')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_13',
			true,{ screen_pos = vector(-300, 450) })

	--Shout 말풍선 (위치는 엘비라 우측 위) : 레이스 규칙은 아주 간단합니다, 여러분 앞의 트랙을 달려서 가장 먼저 결승점에 도착한 사람이 우승하는 거죠!
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_14',
			true, { screen_pos = vector(-300, 450) })

	--참가자 1 (right, smile, cast2) : 너무 쉽잖아?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(participants[1], 'cast2')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(participants[1], 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(participants[1], 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_15')

	--참가자 3 (right, smile, victory_get(loop x)) : 달리기 속도는 날 따라올 사람이 없지!
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(participants[3], 'victory_get', { sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01' })
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(participants[3], 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(participants[3], 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_16')

	--참가자 1, 3 (right, attack, idle)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local participant = participants[i]
		character_util.remove_anim(participant)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(participant, 'attack')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(bot_runner)

	--Shout 말풍선 (위치는 엘비라 우측 위) : 참가자 여러분, 모두 제자리에…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_17',
			true,{ screen_pos = vector(-300, 450) })

	--1초간 카메라 사이즈 3으로 변경
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--Shout 말풍선 (위치는 엘비라 우측 위) : 준비…!!
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_18',
			true, { screen_pos = vector(-300, 425) })

	--카메라 진동 (0.15, 무한)
	self:play_loop_sfx('01_earthquake_03')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 99999)

	--참가자 1, 2, 3, 플레이어 점프 (1, 0.5)
	character_util.jump(participants, 1, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--전부 (right, surprise, cast)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'cast')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'surprise')

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local participant = participants[i]
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(participant, 'cast')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(participant, 'surprise')
	end

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(bot_runner, 'cast')

	--두리번거리는 연출
	--플레이어 위, 참가자 1 좌측, 참가자 2 아래, 참가자 3 위 바라봄
	--0.7초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction(participants[1], 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(participants[2], 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(participants[3], 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction(top_runner, 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(bot_runner, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--플레이어 아래, 참가자 1 위, 참가자 2 위, 참가자 3 좌측 바라봄
	--0.7초 대기
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(participants[1], 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction(participants[2], 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction(participants[3], 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(top_runner, 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction(bot_runner, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--플레이어 좌측, 참가자 1 아래, 참가자 2 우측, 참가자 3 위 바라봄
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(participants[1], 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(participants[2], 'right')
	scene_util.set_direction(participants[3], 'up')
	scene_util.set_direction(top_runner, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(bot_runner, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--참가자 2 (right, surprise, cast) : 이게 무슨 소리지…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(participants[2], 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_19')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rise_01')

	--참가자 1 ~ 3 위치에 반지름 1.5의 원형 AttackRange 생성
	for i = 1, 3 do
		attack_ranges[i]:Show()
	end

	--카메라 0.5초 간 사이즈 2.5로 변경
	--0.5초 대기
	camera_util.resize_to(2.5, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local attack_range = attack_ranges[i]
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(attack_range.gameObject)
	end

	--황소벌레 등장 연출
	self.optimized_npc.worm_1.Position = participants_pos[1]
	self.optimized_npc.worm_2.Position = participants_pos[2]
	self.optimized_npc.worm_3.Position = participants_pos[3]

	--참가자들 위치에 사막 황소벌레(boss_graboid) 3마리가 out 애니메이션으로 등장
	for _, worm in pairs(self.optimized_npc) do
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(worm, { name = 'out' })
		self.get_fx_sand_out():Instantiate(worm.Position)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sink_sand_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_dendrobium', state = 'event' })

	--황소벌레에 참가자들 가리는 순간, 참가자들 비활성화
	for i = 1, 4 do
		character_util.set_active_state(participants[i], 'disabled')
		participants[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	local scream_start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local scream_ended = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		--Shout 말풍선 (위치는 황소벌레들을 가리지 않는 우측 위) : 크아아악!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(participants[1], 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_20',
				true, { screen_pos = vector(-200, 410)} )
		scream_ended = true
	end)

	--황소벌레들 out 애니메이션 종료되면 idle 애니메이션
	--이전 카메라 진동 제거
	wait_for_sec(1)
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	self:remove_loop_sfx('01_earthquake_03')

	--카메라 진동 (0.3, 0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	--엘비라 좌측 보고 점프(1, 0.5) + (left, scared, embarrassed)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'embarrassed')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'scared')

	--참가자 4 좌측 보고 점프(1, 0.5) + (left, scared, idle)
	character_util.jump(top_runner, 1, 0.5)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(top_runner, 'scared')

	--참가자 5 좌측 보고 점프(1, 0.5) + (left, scared, embarrassed)
	character_util.jump(bot_runner, 1, 0.5)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(bot_runner, 'embarrassed')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(bot_runner, 'scared')

	while not scream_ended do
		if unity_class.time.time - scream_start_time > 2 then
			scream_ended = true
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--말풍선 사라지거나 연출 시작된 지 2초 지나면 1초간 카메라 크기 원복
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--엘비라 (left, scared, embarrassed) : 뭐가 어떻게 된 거야?!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_21')

	--Shout 말풍선 (위치는 엘비라 우측 위) : 설명을 깜박했군요! 이 레이스에는 여러분들 외에도 귀여운 황소 벌레들이 참가한다는 사실!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_22',
			true,{ screen_pos = vector(-300, 450) })

	--Shout 말풍선 (위치는 엘비라 우측 위) : 황소벌레의 먹이가 되고 싶지 않다면 1등으로 결승선을 통과해야겠죠?
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_23',
			true,{ screen_pos = vector(-300, 450) })

	--Shout 말풍선 (위치는 엘비라 우측 위) : 레이스 시작!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_24',
			true,{ screen_pos = vector(-300, 450) })

	--엘비라 right 방향으로 run 자세로 달려감. 이때, 카메라는 엘비라를 따라가지 않고 고정됌.
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0)

	local x_dis = screen_util.get_world_screen_size().x
	local speed = 7
	local move_dur = x_dis / speed

	character_util.move_waypoint(leader, leader.Position + vector(x_dis, 0, 0), speed, true)

	character_util.move_waypoint(top_runner, top_runner.Position + vector(x_dis, 0, 0), speed, true)

	character_util.remove_anim(bot_runner)
	character_util.move_waypoint(bot_runner, bot_runner.Position + vector(x_dis, 0, 0), speed, true)

	--오른쪽으로 달려가는 엘비라 (right, scared, run) : 으아아아악!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_02')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(leader, { key = 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_36', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	--사막 황소벌레 3마리 또한 right 방향으로 달려감.
	self.sand_fxs = {}
	for _, worm in pairs(self.optimized_npc) do
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(worm, 'idle')

		worm.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)
		local sand_fx = self.get_fx_sand():Instantiate(worm.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, worm.Transform)
		table.insert(self.sand_fxs, sand_fx)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_01')

		local worm_wp_pos = worm.Position + vector(x_dis, 0, 0)
		character_util.move_waypoint(worm, worm_wp_pos, speed, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(move_dur)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	character_util.stop(leader)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(leader)

	for i = 1, #self.sand_fxs do
		self.sand_fxs[i]:Dispose()
	end
	self.sand_fxs = nil

	for _, worm in pairs(self.optimized_npc) do
		character_util.stop(worm)
	end

	--황소벌레 미니게임 챌린지 시작
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, 'shortstory_rosetta_challenge', function()
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'desert_bull_worm_opening_scene_exist', 'repeat_opening_scene' }))
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	ui_quest_marker:Show(self.main_quest_id, false)

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)

	for _, worm in pairs(self.optimized_npc) do
		worm.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
end

function local_class:success_mini_game()
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.race_clear

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local guide = self.get_guide()

	--안내원 A (left, smile, idle)
	local guide_pos = self.get_guide_origin_pos()
	guide.Position = guide_pos
	character_util.remove_anim(guide)
	scene_util.set_direction(guide, 'left', nil)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guide, 'smile')

	--엘비라 (right, attack, idle)
	local leader_pos = guide_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)
	leader.Position = leader_pos
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', nil)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'attack')

	--어텍레인지 생성
	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(guide_pos + self.attack_range_offset,
			1.2, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	attack_range:Hide()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.5 })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--안내원 A (left, smile, clap) : 축하드려요! 당신이 이번 레이스의 우승자입니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(guide, 'clap')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_25')

	--엘비라 (right, attack, release) : 덕분에 죽는 줄 알았잖아!! 상품은 어딨어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'release', { sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_26')

	--엘비라 애니메이션 해제
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--안내원 A (left, doyagao, question(loop x)) : 아 우승 상품 말이죠? 잠시만 기다려 보세요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(guide, 'question')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(guide, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_27')

	--안내원 A (right, doyagao, eat)
	scene_util.set_direction(guide, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(guide, 'eat')

	--1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--선인장 열매 주는 연출
	local guide_speak_end = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		--안내원 A (left, doyagao, release) : 여기 우승 상품입니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(guide, 'short_story_rt_desert_worm_28')
		guide_speak_end = true
	end)

	scene_util.set_direction(guide, 'left')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(guide, { name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	wait_for_sec(0.2667)

	--안내원 A가 애니메이션 실행하고 0.2초 뒤, 선인장 열매(sprite - cactus_fruit) DropItem으로 안내원 A 위치에서 생성되어 엘비라 위치로 던져짐
	--안내원 A release 애니메이션 종료되면 idle
	--1초 대기
	local cactus_fruit = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = guide.Bounds.center, target = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Bounds.center),
		itemid = self.cactus_fruit_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	cactus_fruit.ConsumeTarget = leader
	cactus_fruit:Fly()
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	while not guide_speak_end do
		if self.game_end then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local bot_runner = self.get_participants(6)

function local_class:play_loop_sfx(sfx_name)
	if self.sfx_loop == nil then
		self.sfx_loop = {}
	end

	self.sfx_loop[sfx_name] = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name, loop = true })
end

function local_class:remove_loop_sfx(sfx_name, mix_time)
	if self.sfx_loop[sfx_name] ~= nil then
		if mix_time == nil then
			self.sfx_loop[sfx_name]:Stop()
		else
			self.sfx_loop[sfx_name]:FadeOut(mix_time)
		end

		self.sfx_loop[sfx_name] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:remove_all_loop_sfx(mix_time)
	if self.sfx_loop ~= nil then
		for sfx_name, _ in pairs(self.sfx_loop) do
			self:remove_loop_sfx(sfx_name, mix_time)
		end

		self.sfx_loop = nil
	end
end

	end

	-- 돈다발 세팅
	local credit_pos = self.get_credit_marker().position + vector(0, 0, 0.2)

	local credit_pos_list = {

		credit_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.1), credit_pos + vector(0.3, 0, 0.05),

	}

		, notforinven = true, showoncharacter = false, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.6 })

	end

			character_util.set_anim(npc_list[2], { name = 'dead', scale = 99, loop = false })
			character_util.add_color(npc_list[2], npc_list[2].Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			npc_list[2].SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
		end)

			npc.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'rifle_walk'
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, { name = 'rifle_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })

function local_class:gunfight_event()
	local npc_list = {}
	local npc_count = 2
	for i = 1, npc_count do
		local npc = self.get_gunfight_npc(i)
		npc.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		table.insert(npc_list, npc)
	end
	local string_sub_key = '2_'

	-- 무법자 (right, attack , rifle_idle) : 알았지? 세 발자국 걸어서 먼저 쏜 놈이 저 돈을 전부 갖는 거야!
	self:play_npc_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_02', npc_list[2])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_list[2], { key = self.string_key .. string_sub_key .. 1 })
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 총잡이 (left, attack , rifle_idle) : 말이 많군. 어서 시작하자고.
	self:play_npc_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_03', npc_list[1])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_list[1], { key = self.string_key .. string_sub_key .. 2 })
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 1초 대기, 이후 총잡이 NPC와 무법자 NPC가 동시에 각각 left 방향, right 방향으로 rifle_walk 한칸씩 전진.
	wait_for_sec(1)
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(npc_list[1])
	wp_util.move(npc_list[1], npc_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 1, nil)
	character_util.remove_anim(npc_list[2])
	wp_util.move_async(npc_list[2], npc_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 1, nil)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 1초 대기, 이후 또 다시 총잡이 NPC와 무법자 NPC가 동시에 각각 left 방향, right 방향으로 rifle_walk 한칸씩 전진.
	wp_util.move(npc_list[1], npc_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.left, 1, nil)
	wp_util.move_async(npc_list[2], npc_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 1, nil)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 	이후 총잡이 NPC right, doyagao, rifle_reload 1회 실행하고, 무법자 NPC rifle_walk로 1타일 전진.
	local move_end = 'npc_move_end'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_list[2], npc_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 1
	, nil, self, move_end, {})

	character_util.set_direction(npc_list[1], 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(npc_list[1], { name = 'doyagao' })
	self:play_npc_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01', npc_list[1])
	self:play_npc_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01', npc_list[2])
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(npc_list[1], { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end)
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 이후 곧바로 총잡이 NPC가 right 방향으로 전환하며 sniper_shoot 애니메이션 실행.
	character_util.set_direction(npc_list[2], 'left')
	self:play_npc_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01', npc_list[1])
	character_util.set_anim(npc_list[1], { name = 'sniper_shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 동시에 무법자 NPC한테서 FX_hit 이펙트 출력되며 하단의 대사 출력.
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(npc_list[2].Position + vector(-0.15, 0.1, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc_list[2])
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc_list[2])

	-- 무법자 (right, hurt , dead) : 으아악!!!
	self:play_npc_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01', npc_list[2])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc_list[2], { key = self.string_key .. string_sub_key .. 3
	, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	character_util.set_emotion(npc_list[2], { name = 'hurt' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(npc_list[2], { name = 'dead', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- dead 애니메이션 되며 캐릭터가 까맣게 틴트 다운됌. ( 사망 처리 연출 )
	character_util.add_color(npc_list[2], npc_list[2].Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(npc_list[1])
	wp_util.move_async(npc_list[1], {
		npc_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.back,
		self.get_credit_marker().position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	}, 4, nil, { name = 'run' })

	-- 이후 총잡이 NPC가 아래로 한칸 내려간뒤 right 방향 바라보고 eat 자세로 대사 출력.
	character_util.set_anim(npc_list[1], { name = 'eat' })

	-- 총잡이 (right, doyagao , eat) : 세 발자국 같은 소리 하긴… 멍청한 놈.
	self:play_npc_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01', npc_list[1])
	self:play_npc_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_01', npc_list[1])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_list[1], { key = self.string_key .. string_sub_key .. 4 })

	-- 대화가 끝난 이후, 총잡이 NPC가 했던 마지막 대사는 원라인으로 변경됌.
	npc_list[1].Interactable.Talk = self.string_key .. string_sub_key .. 4
	for i = 1, #npc_list do
		npc_list[i].OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	end

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.gunfight_event_key, 1)
end

--endregion

-- 선인장 나무들을 보여주는 함수
function local_class:show_wood_list()
	self:hide_wood_list()
	self.wood_list = self.mini_game:create_tree_items('rosetta')
end

-- 선인장 나무들을 숨겨주는 함수
function local_class:hide_wood_list()
	self:dispose_wood_list()
end

function local_class:dispose_wood_list()
	if self.wood_list then
		for i = 1, #self.wood_list do
			self.wood_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.wood_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_west_cactus()
	local target_pos = field:GetMarker('oasis_cactus_pos').position
	local cactus_count = 4

	for i = 1, cactus_count do
		local cactus = get_field_object('oasis_cactus_' .. i)
		cactus.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		local x = (i % 2 == 0) and 0 or 1
		cactus.Position = target_pos + vector(x, 0, -(i - 1))
	end
end

function local_class:disable_west_cactus()
	local cactus_count = 4

	for i = 1, cactus_count do
		local cactus = get_field_object('oasis_cactus_' .. i)
		cactus.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self:dispose_wood_list()

	if self.credit_item_list then
		for i = 1, #self.credit_item_list do
			self.credit_item_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.credit_item_list = nil
	end

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.mini_game = nil
	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	time_util.mod('slow_mod', 0.1)

	local duration = 0.4
	camera_util.move(center_pos, duration * 2)

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = red_hood.Position
	local end_pos = red_hood.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 1)
	local height = 1

	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'right')
	scene_util.set_prostrate_anim(red_hood, false)

	-- 엘비라가 점프한 즉시 조직원 3 모두 up, attack, rifle_shoot을 실행.

		wait_for_sec(0.05)

		group_action(shoot_ready_gangs, function(target)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(target, 'rifle_shoot')
		end)

		for _ = 1, 3 do

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_y = math.sin(math.pi / 2 * progress) * height
		local cur_xz = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		character_util.set_position(red_hood, vector_util.get_x0z(cur_xz, cur_y), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	height = red_hood.Position.y

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	for i = 1, #last_gangs do
		local gang = last_gangs[i]
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(gang, move_end_pos[i], nil, 1, self, waypoint_key, { run = true })
	end

	for i = 2, 4 do
		local gang = reservoir_gangs_3[i]
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(gang, vector_util.get_xy0(gang.Position, reservoir_gangs_3[3].Position.z + 1.5),
			nil, 1, self, waypoint_key, { run = true })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, waypoint_key)

	move_end_pos = {
		red_hood.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.7),

		red_hood.Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0),

		wp_util.move(gang, move_end_pos[i], nil, duration)

	wait_for_sec(0.35)

	camera_util.move(red_hood.Position, 0)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, #last_gangs do
		local gang = last_gangs[i]
		character_util.cancel_jump(gang)
		gang.Position = move_end_pos[i]
	end

	-- Fx가 캐릭터들을 모두 가리는 타이밍에 엘비라 연막 안속에서 right, tired, unique/limp_walk로 6번 위치를 향해 이동

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(target, target.Position + vector(12, 0, 0),

	self:in_bar()

		},
		{
			shoot_offset = vector(-1.2, 0, 0),
			shooter = {
				self.reservoir_gangs_1[3]
			},
			cur_effect_time = {},
			shoot_anim = {}
		},
		{
			shoot_offset = vector(0.5, 0, -1.5),
			shooter = {
				self.reservoir_gangs_1[4],
				self.reservoir_gangs_1[5],
			},
			cur_effect_time = {},
			shoot_anim = {}
		}
	}

	local cur_gunshot_time = 0
	local cur_change_shoot_time = 0

	while not self.end_gunshot_effect do
		-- 지정한 시간마다 총격 패턴 변경
		if unity_class.time.time - cur_change_shoot_time > 1 then
			-- 이전에 총 쏘던 npc 초기화
			for i = 1, #shoot_data[index].shooter do
				local shooter = shoot_data[index].shooter[i]
				shoot_data[index].shoot_anim[shooter] = false
				shoot_data[index].cur_effect_time[shooter] = nil
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
				scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(shoot_data[index].shooter[i], 'rifle_reload',
					{ upper = true, remove_after = 1 })
			end

			index = index + 1

			if index == 4 then
				index = 1
			end

			cur_change_shoot_time = unity_class.time.time
		end

		local cur_shoot_data = shoot_data[index]

		-- 지정한 시간마다 난사 이펙트 생성
		if unity_class.time.time - cur_gunshot_time > 0.1 then
			local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
			local target_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, 0.4)
			local target_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, 0.4)
			local shoot_offset = cur_shoot_data.shoot_offset
			self.get_fx_gunshot():Instantiate(get_party_leader().Position + shoot_offset + vector(target_x, 0, target_z))

			cur_gunshot_time = unity_class.time.time
		end

		for i = 1, #cur_shoot_data.shooter do
			local shooter = cur_shoot_data.shooter[i]

			-- 초기 총격 타이밍 조절
			if not cur_shoot_data.cur_effect_time[shooter] then
				cur_shoot_data.cur_effect_time[shooter] = unity_class.time.time - 0.333 + 0.1 * (i - 1)
			end

			-- 애니메이션에 맞춰서 실행
			if unity_class.time.time - cur_shoot_data.cur_effect_time[shooter] > 0.333 then
				-- 애니메이션 실행
				if not cur_shoot_data.shoot_anim[shooter] then
					cur_shoot_data.shoot_anim[shooter] = true
					scene_util.set_anim_loop(shoot_data[index].shooter[i], 'rifle_shoot', { upper = true })
				end

				-- 이펙트 생성
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_02')
				self.get_fx_shoot():Instantiate(shooter.Position + vector(0.65, 0, 0.3),
					unity_class.quaternion.identity, shooter.Transform)

				cur_shoot_data.cur_effect_time[shooter] = unity_class.time.time
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 바 내부 연출
function local_class:in_bar()

		end
	end

	local reservoir_gangs_boss = self:create_optimized_npcs_table(1,

	local gangs_pos = {
		reservoir_gangs_boss.Position + vector(2.5, 0, -1),
		reservoir_gangs_boss.Position + vector(1.5, 0, -1.5),
		reservoir_gangs_boss.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -2),
		reservoir_gangs_boss.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -2),

		reservoir_gangs_boss.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, -1)
