	local reservoir_gangs = self:create_optimized_npcs_table(6, gangs_pos, 'up')
	group_action(reservoir_gangs, function(target)
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(target, '[base]weapon1', 'ak')
		target.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
		target.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'rifle_walk'
	end)

	-- 로제타 세팅
	local rosetta = self:create_optimized_npcs_table(1,
		{ event_pos + vector(4.5, 0.5, 8.5) }, 'right', 'shortstory_rt_rosetta')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(rosetta, 'seat')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(rosetta, 'sleep_deep')

	local bar_table = self.get_bar_table()
	bar_table.Position = event_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 3.5)
	bar_table.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)

	camera_util.move_async(event_pos + vector(0, 0, 10), 0)

	self.pooled_bullet = self:preload_bullet(6)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_restaurant_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
		{ name = 'ondemand/short_story_rosetta/audio:bgm_rosetta_saloon', state = 'event', mix = 2, volume = 0.3 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 연출 시작
	local camera_move_duration = 3

	-- 1번 지점에서 패닝 출발 후 0.5초 뒤 손님 17 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_happy 출력.
	camera_util.move(event_pos + vector(0, 0, 6), camera_move_duration)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local bar_guest = self.get_bar_guest()
	character_util.show_emoticon(bar_guest, nil, 'happy')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이후 0.5초 뒤 손님 14의 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_drink 출력.
	character_util.show_emoticon(self.get_bar_oneline(14), nil, 'drink')
	wait_for_sec(camera_move_duration - 1)

	-- 카메라 2번 지점 도착할 시 하단의 대사 순서대로 출력.
	local guest_talk = function()
		-- 손님 9 (down, smile, seat) : 어때 자기, 여기 음식 맛있지?
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.get_bar_oneline(9), 'short_story_rt_main_s1_50')

		-- 손님 10 (down, smile, seat) : 응 오빠! 언제 또 이런 곳을…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.get_bar_oneline(10), 'short_story_rt_main_s1_51')
	end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(camera_util.move_async, event_pos + vector(0, 0, 2), camera_move_duration),
		util.cs_generator(guest_talk)
	})

	-- 동시에 NPC 8 ~ 14 일제히 down, tired 방향 바라봄.
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(loop_sfx, 1)
	for i = 7, 14 do
		local oneline_npc = self.get_bar_oneline(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oneline_npc)
		character_util.set_direction(oneline_npc, 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(oneline_npc, 'tired')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bar_guest)
	character_util.set_direction(bar_guest, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(bar_guest, 'tired')

	--조직원 : [shout] 저쪽으로 갔다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_sapa_shout_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(reservoir_gangs_boss, 'short_story_rt_main_s1_20_1', true,
		{ screen_pos = vector(-75, -200) })

	-- 상단 대사 종료되면 카메라 화면 하단에서 FX_Common_SmokeScreen 출력되며 화면 크게 shake.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_car_door_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.get_fx_smoke():Instantiate(event_pos + vector(0, 0, -2))
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	-- 동시에 8 ~ 14 NPC들 엘비라 방향을 바라보며 surprise, seat 실행.
	for i = 7, 14 do
		local oneline_npc = self.get_bar_oneline(i)

		if oneline_npc then
			if i < 9 then
				character_util.set_direction(oneline_npc, 'left')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(oneline_npc, 'right')
			end

			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(oneline_npc, 'surprise')
			character_util.normal_jump(oneline_npc)
		end
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(bar_guest, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(bar_guest)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 배치된 테이블에 부딪히며 착지. 착지시에 엘비라 shake 1회 + 테이블 오브젝트 1회 shake
	-- Fx 출력 타이밍에 엘비라 left, damaged, prostrate 자세로 한바퀴 회전하며 내부로 들어와 지정된 지점에 착지.
	local move_duration = 0.4
	red_hood.Position = event_pos + vector(0, 0, -4)
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(red_hood, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_prostrate_anim(red_hood, false)
	character_util.jump(red_hood, 1, move_duration)
	character_util.spine_rotate(red_hood, 360 * 2, move_duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	character_util.move_to_async(red_hood, event_pos + vector(0, 0, 2.5), move_duration)

	-- 엘비라 shake 1회 + 테이블 오브젝트 1회, 화면 shake 1회 + 엘비라 근처로 Fx_hit 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	bar_table:Shake(0.04, 0.5)
	character_util.shake(red_hood, 0.04, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_rotate(red_hood, 0, 0)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(red_hood.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0.8))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 엘비라 left, damaged, prostrate로 1번 위치에 배치된 상태. 카메라 엘비라 중심.
	character_util.shake(red_hood, 0.04, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(red_hood, 'attack')

	-- 조직원 : [shout] 조져!!!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(reservoir_gangs_boss, 'short_story_rt_main_s1_21', true,
		{ screen_pos = vector(-75, -200) })

	-- 이후 사격 Fx1 영역에서 아래에서 위를 향해 기관총 Fx가 올라오며 화면 shake 지속. 상태 실행.
	self.aim_pos = event_pos + vector(0, 0, -5)
	local red_hood_end_pos = event_pos + vector(0, 0, 9.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.04, 9999)
	local gunshot_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_05', loop = true })
	start_coroutine(self.gunshot_effect_loop, self)

	-- 동시에 엘비라 attack, 7 ~ 14 NPC scared 표정으로 변경.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	for i = 7, 14 do
		local oneline_npc = self.get_bar_oneline(i)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(oneline_npc, 'scared')
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(bar_guest, 'scared')

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(red_hood, 'attack')
	self:move_aim(event_pos + vector(0, 0, -3.5), 0.5)

	-- 엘비라 올라오는 기관총 Fx를 피해 up, idle, unique/limp_walk를 실행하여 2번 위치로 이동 시작.
	local red_hood_waypoint = {
		red_hood.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
		red_hood.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 1)
	}

	-- 엘비라가 올라가는 것에 맞춰 사격 fx가 엘비라의 속도를 천천히 따라잡으며 가까워짐.
	move_duration = 2

	start_coroutine(self.move_aim, self, event_pos + vector(0, 0, 1.5), move_duration + 2)

	camera_util.move(event_pos + vector(0, 0, 1.5), move_duration)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(red_hood)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(red_hood, 'unique/limp_walk')
	wp_util.move_async(red_hood, red_hood_waypoint, nil, move_duration)

	-- 엘비라 2번 위치에 도착할 시 배치된 obj_table4에 right, attack, attack 취하고, 애니메이션 출력에 맞춰 엘비라에게 Fx_lasthit 출력.
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(red_hood, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(red_hood, 'attack')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_01')
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(red_hood.Position + vector(1, 2, -2))
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(red_hood)

	-- 상단 연출 종료되면 obj_table4 하단의 예시처럼, 로테이션 90도 회전 + Z축으로 1타일 다운을 실행
	local rotation_duration = 0.3
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_rot_z = 0
	local end_rot_z = -60

	local start_pos_z = bar_table.Position.z
	local end_pos_z = bar_table.Position.z - 0.5

	while time_passed < rotation_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / rotation_duration)

		local cur_pos_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos_z, end_pos_z, progress)
		bar_table.Position = vector_util.get_xy0(bar_table.Position, cur_pos_z)

		local cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_rot_z, end_rot_z, progress)
		bar_table.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, cur_rot_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 테이블이 누워지면 엘비라 3번 위치로 이동하여 down, damaged, push 상태가 되고
	wp_util.move_async(red_hood, red_hood.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 1)

	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(red_hood, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(red_hood, 'push')

	-- 눕혀진 테이블을 향해 기관총 Fx가 2초간 사격하고, Fx와 맞붙은 obj_table4 2초간 shake 실행.
	bar_table:Shake(0.04, 2)
	self:move_aim(self.aim_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(gunshot_loop_sfx)
	self.end_gunshot_effect = true
	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	-- 엘비라 down, surprise, embarrassed 실행
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(red_hood)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(red_hood, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_embarrassed_anim(red_hood)

	-- 말풍선 출력과 함께 화면 크게 shake하고 카메라 3번 상태로 줌 인.
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)

	-- 조직원 : [shout] 날려버려!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(reservoir_gangs_boss,
		{ key = 'short_story_rt_main_s1_21_1', screen_pos = vector(-175, -200), type_speed = 0, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 미사일 발사
	time_util.mod('slow_mod', 0.3)
	local missile_duration = 0.5
	time_passed = 0
	local missile_start_pos = event_pos + vector(0, 0, -5)
	local missile_end_pos = event_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)
	local is_play_missile_sfx = false

	local missile = self.get_fx_missile():Instantiate(red_hood.Position + vector(0, 0, -5))

	while time_passed < missile_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / missile_duration)
		missile.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(missile_start_pos, missile_end_pos, progress)

		if not is_play_missile_sfx and time_passed > 0.2 then
			is_play_missile_sfx = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_missile_launch_01')
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	time_util.unmod('slow_mod')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	missile.transform.position = missile_end_pos
	missile:Dispose()
	self:get_fx_missile_explosion():Instantiate(missile_end_pos)
	bar_table.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	-- Fx 폭발과 함께 엘비라 4번 지점의 테이블까지 down, damaged, damaged 상태로 1 ~ 2회 회전
	move_duration = 0.3
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	character_util.hide_weapon(red_hood, true)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(red_hood, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(red_hood, 'damaged')
	red_hood.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(red_hood, 360 * 2, move_duration)
	camera_util.move(red_hood_end_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5), move_duration)
	character_util.move_to_async(red_hood, red_hood_end_pos, move_duration)

	-- 엘비라 테이블에 Y축이 0.5 상승한 상태로 부딪히며 Fx_hit와 함께 shake 1회 실행하고, 해당 위치에 1초간 정지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	character_util.shake(red_hood, 0.04, 0.3)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(red_hood.Position + vector(0, 0.01, 0.2))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 이후 3번 위치 바닥에 right, damaged, prostrate 상태로 떨어진다.
	local fall_duration = 0.2
	local fall_time_passed = 0
	local start_offset_y = red_hood.SpineController.SpineOffset.y
	local end_offset_y = red_hood.SpineController.SpineOffset.y - 0.5

	while fall_time_passed < fall_duration do
		fall_time_passed = fall_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(fall_time_passed / fall_duration)
		local offset_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_offset_y, end_offset_y, progress)
		red_hood.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.get_x0z(red_hood.SpineController.SpineOffset, offset_y)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'right')
	scene_util.set_prostrate_anim(red_hood)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 조직 보스 생성
	local dist = red_hood.Position.z - 7 - reservoir_gangs_boss.Position.z
	reservoir_gangs_boss.Position = reservoir_gangs_boss.Position + vector(0, 0, dist)

	group_action(reservoir_gangs, function(target)
		target.Position = target.Position + vector(0, 0, dist)
	end)

	-- 카메라 하단에서부터 보스 조직원 1인과 일반 조직원 6인이 지정된 위치로 이동.
	local waypoint_key = 'gangs_start_move'
	local move_dist = red_hood.Position.z - reservoir_gangs_boss.Position.z - 3
	local move_speed = 2
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(reservoir_gangs_boss,
		reservoir_gangs_boss.Position + move_dist * unity_class.vector3.forward,
		move_speed, nil, self, waypoint_key)

	group_action(reservoir_gangs, function(target)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(target, target.Position + move_dist * unity_class.vector3.forward,
			move_speed, nil, self, waypoint_key)
	end)

function local_class:create_optimized_npcs_table(count, pos, dir, spec_name, exception_data)
	if not self.optimized_npcs_list then
		self.optimized_npcs_list = {}
	end

	local npc_spec_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(spec_name, 'shortstory_rt_reservoir_member')
	local spec_data = {}
	for i = 1, count do
		spec_data['npc_' .. i] = npc_spec_name

		if exception_data and exception_data.index == i then
			spec_data['npc_' .. i] = exception_data.spec_name
		end
	end

	local optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(spec_data)
	table.insert(self.optimized_npcs_list, optimized_npcs)

	local optimized_npcs_table = {}
	for i = 1, count do
		local optimized_npc = optimized_npcs['npc_' .. i]
		optimized_npc.Position = pos[i]
		character_util.set_direction(optimized_npc, dir)
		table.insert(optimized_npcs_table, optimized_npc)
	end

	if count == 1 then
		return optimized_npcs_table[1]
	end

	return optimized_npcs_table
end

--- 조직원 및 엘비리가 쏜 탄환 피격 연출
function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	if label == 0 and lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.vfo_list[1]) then
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(hit_info.position)
	end

	-- 피격된 엘비라 현재 상태로 (red_pulse, squish) 출력한 뒤, 출력이 끝나면 left, damaged, prostrate로 쓰러진다.
	if label == 1 and lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, get_party_leader()) then
		start_coroutine(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(hit_info.position)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(hit_info.target, 'damaged')
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(hit_info.target)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(hit_info.target)
			wait_for_sec(0.03)

			-- 피격 연출 종료되면 슬로우모션 종료.
			time_util.unmod('slow_mod')
		end)
	end

	-- 오프닝 씬 달리는 중 엘비라가 추격자에게 쏜 총알
	if label == 5 then
		self.get_fx_bomb():Instantiate(hit_info.position)

		for i = 1, #self.vfo_list do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.vfo_list[i]) then
				if not self.explosion_sfx then
					self.explosion_sfx = true
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_03', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_villain_scream_04', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_villain_scream_03', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
				end
				self.vfo_list[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				character_util.stop(self.reservoir_gangs_1[i])
				character_util.remove_anim(self.reservoir_gangs_1[i], true)
				character_util.air_spin(self.reservoir_gangs_1[i], { offset = vector(-3, 0, 0) })
				break
			end
		end
	end

	-- 지정된 조직원을 향해 엘비라 전용무기 공격이 날아가고, 착지 지점에 FX_Explosion_Bomb_new가 출력되며 조직원 에어 스핀으로 사망함.
	if label > 10 then
		local target = self.shoot_target[label - 10]
		self.get_fx_bomb():Instantiate(target.Position)

		if label % 5 ~= 0 and label % 5 ~= 1 then
			return
		end

		local air_spin_offset = vector(3, 0, 0)
		if target.Position.x < get_party_leader().Position.x then
			air_spin_offset = vector(-3, 0, 0)
		end

		character_util.air_spin(target, { offset = air_spin_offset })
	end
end

function local_class:move_aim(target_pos, duration)
	local start_pos = self.aim_pos
	local end_pos = target_pos

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		self.aim_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 난사 이펙트 루프
function local_class:gunshot_effect_loop()
	self.end_gunshot_effect = false

	while not self.end_gunshot_effect do
		local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
		local target_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.4, 0.8)
		local target_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.4, 0.8)
		self.get_fx_gunshot():Instantiate(self.aim_pos + vector(target_x, 0, target_z))

		wait_for_sec(0.03)
	end
end

--- 로제타의 사격
function local_class:sniper_shoot(sniper, target_pos, bullet, callback)
	local bullet_speed = 60
	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - sniper.Position).normalized
	local start_pos = sniper.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0.2)
	local end_pos = target_pos - shoot_dir * 0.3

	local bullet_sprite = bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local bullet_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = bullet_rotation
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	self.get_fx_cannon_fire():Instantiate(start_pos)

	local fx_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
	local smoke_effect = self.get_fx_smoke_trail():Instantiate(start_pos, fx_rotation, nil)
	smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(2, 1, 1)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
		start_pos, end_pos, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)

	if callback then
		callback()
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
		end_pos, end_pos + shoot_dir * 10, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)

	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end

--- 총알 로드
function local_class:preload_bullet(count)
	local custom_atlas

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.resource_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
			custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
			custom_atlas:Initialize()
		end)

	local pooled_bullet = {}

	for _ = 1, count do
		local bullet = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local bullet_sprite = bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()

		table.insert(pooled_bullet, bullet)
	end

	return pooled_bullet
end

		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(gun, 0, 1)
	end)
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self:restore_exit_interact_fo()

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 문 상호작용

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
			start_coroutine(self.teleport_party_for_marker, self, self.exit_interact_fo[i]
			, self.exit_teleport_names[i], self.marker_fo_list[i])
			return true
		end
	end

	return false

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_puzzle_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.none then
		self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.enter_loop_zone
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.enter_puzzle_grid_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.climbing_zone_name)
			and self.cur_section_progress < self.section_progress.ending then
		self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.ending
		start_coroutine(self.directing_climbing_event, self)

	end

	return false

function local_class:enter_puzzle_grid_event()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local rosetta = self.controller.get_rosetta()

	character_util.set_anim(red_hood, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 3, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(red_hood)

	-- 로제타 (left, idle, bomb_idle) : 그럼 선인장 열매를 하나 따오도록 해.
	character_util.play_speech_action(rosetta, 'bomb_idle', nil, self.string_key .. 4)

	-- 엘비라 (right, idle, idle) emoticon_bubble_question
	character_util.remove_emotion(red_hood)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(red_hood, nil, 'question')

	-- 엘비라 (right, tired, question) : 고작 그게 다야…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	, 'tired', self.string_key .. 5)

	-- 엘비라 idle 표정,  left 0.7초, 이후 right <- 실행하면서 동시에 아래 대사 출력

	-- 로제타 right 보면서 카메라가 무빙 이벤트 진행.

	character_util.set_direction(rosetta, 'right')
	scene_util.pointing_at(rosetta, 1)

	-- 시작 위치 : 플레이어(엘비라) 카메라

	local cliff_pos = self.get_cliff_point().position + unity_class.vector3.forward

	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'surprise' })

	-- 대기 1.5초. 이후 다시 카메라 무빙 이벤트 진행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 시간 : 3 -> 1.5초
	-- 시작 위치 : 절벽 위의 선인장 오브젝트
	-- 도착 위치 : 플레이어(엘비라) 카메라
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(rosetta, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 엘비라 (right, surprised, jump 1회) : [shout] 저 위에 있는 걸 가져오라고?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	character_util.normal_jump(red_hood, true)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(red_hood, self.string_key .. 7)

	-- 로제타 (left, idle, idle) : 그밖에 선인장 열매가 어디에 있다는 거지?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rosetta, self.string_key .. 8)

	-- 화면 4 -> 3으로 줌 인(시간 1초)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(rosetta, rosetta.Position + unity_class.vector3.left, nil, 1)

	-- 로제타 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 방금까지만 해도 기세가 등등하더니…
	character_util.play_speech_action(rosetta, 'cross_arm', nil, self.string_key .. 9)

	-- 로제타 (left, doyagao, bomb_idle) : 고작 저 정도 높이에 겁먹은 건 아니겠지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(rosetta, { name = 'doyagao' })
	character_util.play_speech_action(rosetta, 'bomb_idle', nil, self.string_key .. 10)

	-- 엘비라 right, attack, idle emoticon_bubble_exclamation
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(red_hood, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(red_hood, nil, 'notice')

	-- 엘비라 (right, mad, release) : 누가 겁을 먹었다고…!
	character_util.play_speech_action(red_hood, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, 'mad', self.string_key .. 11)

	-- 엘엘비라 (right, attack, shoot) : 저런 거 하나 따오는 것쯤은 일도 아니야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.play_speech_action(red_hood, 'shoot', nil, self.string_key .. 12)

	-- 로제타 (left, idle, bomb_idle) : 그래? 그럼 잘해봐.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(rosetta)
	character_util.play_speech_action(rosetta, 'bomb_idle', nil, self.string_key .. 13)

	-- 로제타 (left, doyagao, idle) : 애송아.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.65)
	wait_for_sec(0.65)
	character_util.set_emotion(rosetta, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rosetta, { key = self.string_key .. 14, force_sfx = true })

	-- 로제타가 루트를 따라 이동하며 화면 바깥으로 사라짐. 로제타 NPC가 □타일 위치에 도달할시 엘비라가 left 방향으로 전환.

	-- 화면 바깥으로 로제타NPC 사라진 이후 대화 이벤트 진행.
	-- 로제타가 루트를 따라 이동하며 화면 바깥으로 사라짐. 로제타 NPC가 □타일 위치에 도달할시 엘비라가 left 방향으로 전환.
	wp_util.move_async(rosetta, { rosetta.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	, rosetta.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -1) }, 2.6)

	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'left')
	wp_util.move_async(rosetta, rosetta.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 9, 2.6)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rosetta)
	character_util.set_active_state(rosetta, 'disabled')

	-- 엘비라 (right, attack, idle) : 흥! 저 정도쯤이야…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'right')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(red_hood, self.string_key .. 15)

	-- 엘비라 (right, smile, victory_get) : 순식간에 따올 테니까! 두고 봐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }
	, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(red_hood, self.string_key .. 16)

	twinkle_effect:Dispose()

	-- 화면 0.5초간 원래대로 4로 줌 아웃.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(red_hood)

	local marker_pos = cliff_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 3
	-- 2 ~ 5번 인덱스 마커 타겟을 절벽으로 변경
	local start_index = 2
	local end_index = 4
	for i = start_index, end_index do
		self.marker_fo_list[i] = marker_pos
	end

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	-- 화면 우측 상단의 트리거 존에 마커 출력.
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, marker_pos)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

-- 백년초 열매 암벽등반 이벤트
function local_class:directing_climbing_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.ending

	-- 오아시스 npc 원복
	self:restore_oasis_one_line()

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

--region Exit 관련

-- 이벤트 진행을 위해 ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable로 변경하는 함수
function local_class:changed_exit_interact_fo()
	self.cached_exit = {}
	self.exit_interact_fo = {}

	local exit_names = { 'rosetta_room_inner_1', 'rosetta_room_outer_1', 'bar_outer_1'
	, 'bar_outer_2', 'bar_inner_1', 'bar_inner_2' }

	self.exit_teleport_names = { 'rosetta_room_inner_1', 'rosetta_room_outer_1', 'bar_outer_1'
	, 'bar_outer_2', 'bar_inner_1', 'bar_inner_2' }

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		table.insert(self.exit_interact_fo, exit_fo)
	end

	self.marker_fo_list = { self.exit_interact_fo[2], self.controller.get_rosetta(), self.controller.get_rosetta()
	, self.controller.get_rosetta(), self.exit_interact_fo[3], self.exit_interact_fo[4] }
end

-- ExitInteractable의 Interactable를 원복하는 함수
function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 함수
function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker(exit_fo, marker_name, quest_marker_fo)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent.Create(exit_fo.Name))

	-- 마커 재 조정
	local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)
	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute(marker)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if quest_marker_fo == nil then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
		return
	end

	local quest_marker_name = self.controller.quest_marker_name
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
end

--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')

	-- 연출용 황소 벌레 세팅
	self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		worm_1 = 'shortstory_rt_boss_graboid',
		worm_2 = 'shortstory_rt_boss_graboid',
		worm_3 = 'shortstory_rt_boss_graboid',
	})

	-- 사막 황소벌레 그림자및 소팅 레이어 세팅
	local worm_count = 3
	local rosetta_global_data = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/ShortStory/Rosetta/ConstantsData')
	local worm_shadow_size = rosetta_global_data.desert_bull_worm_shadow_size

	for i = 1, worm_count do
		local worm = self.optimized_npcs['worm_' .. i]
		worm.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)
		worm.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = worm_shadow_size
	end

	-- 절벽 위 꽃 세팅
	self.flower_list = {}
	local flower_pos = self.get_fruit_cliff_point().position + vector(-0.3, 1.75, -0.1)
	local flower = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = self.flower_id, pos = flower_pos
	, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true, sprscale = 0.8 })
	table.insert(self.flower_list, flower)

	-- 꽃 반짝이 이팩트
	self.twinkle_effect = self.get_fx_twinkle_effect():Instantiate(flower_pos)

	-- 중앙 꽃 세팅
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker('s3_fruit_center_pos').position
	local center_flower_pos_list = {
		center_pos + vector(0, 0.15, 0), center_pos + vector(-0.4, 0, 0.5),
		center_pos + vector(0.25, 0, 0.6), center_pos + vector(-0.4, 0, -0.1),
		center_pos + vector(0.3, 0, 0.1), center_pos + vector(-0.2, 0, -0.7),
		center_pos + vector(0.25, 0, -0.475)
	}
	for i = 1, #center_flower_pos_list do
		flower = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = self.flower_id, pos = center_flower_pos_list[i]
		, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.8 })
		table.insert(self.flower_list, flower)
	end

	-- 주변 꽃 세팅
	local around_flower_count = 12
	for i = 1, around_flower_count do
		flower_pos = field:GetMarker('s3_fruit_pos_' .. i).position
		flower = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = self.flower_id, pos = flower_pos
		, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.8 })
		flower.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		table.insert(self.flower_list, flower)
	end

	-- 표지판 세팅
	local sign_board = self.get_sign_board()
	sign_board.Position = field:GetMarker('s3_red_hood_fall_point').position + vector(1, 0, 0.5)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3 then
		start_coroutine(self.section_start_event, self)
	else
		start_coroutine(self.directing_climbing_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	self:dispose_twinkle_effect()

	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	if self.optimized_npcs then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.flower_list then
		for i = 1, #self.flower_list do
			if self.flower_list[i] ~= nil then
				self.flower_list[i].ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				self.flower_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
			end
		end
		self.flower_list = nil
	end
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.mini_game_name then
		return false
	end

	if e.Success then
		start_coroutine(self.success_mini_game, self)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_stage_end = true

	return true
end

--endregion

-- 이벤트 시작 했을 때
function local_class:section_start_event()
	local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
	local climbing_point = self.get_climbing_point_marker(1).position

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(red_hood)
	character_util.set_position(red_hood, climbing_point - vector(1, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'right')

	-- 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	yield_return_func(self.directing_climbing_event, self)
end

-- 백년초 열매 암벽등반 이벤트
function local_class:directing_climbing_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 무기 숨김
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 플레이어 트리거 존 진입 시 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
	local climbing_point = self.get_climbing_point_marker(1).position
	wp_util.move_async(red_hood, climbing_point + unity_class.vector3.right * 2, 3
	, { last_direction = 'up' })

	-- 엘비라 (right, idle, idle) : 저기 있다.
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'up')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 카메라 무빙 이벤트 진행. 1초
	local cliff_pos = self.get_cliff_point().position + unity_class.vector3.forward
	camera_util.move_async(cliff_pos, 1)

	-- 대기 1.5초 이후 카메라 무빙 이벤트 진행.
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 시간 : 1초
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 엘비라 (right, idle, idle) : 저 절벽만 올라가면…!
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 첫번째 qte 이벤트
	-- 엘비라 뒤로 4 물러섬
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(red_hood, climbing_point, nil, 2.5, false, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	self:first_qte_event(red_hood)

	-- 두번째 qte 이벤트
	self:second_qte_event(red_hood)

	-- 세번째 qte 이벤트
	self:third_qte_event(red_hood)

	-- 네번째 qte 이벤트
	self:fourth_qte_event(red_hood)

	-- 마지막 qte 이벤트
	self:last_qte_event(red_hood)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	-- 엘비라 (left, smile, idle) : 됐어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 3, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(red_hood)

	-- 엘비라가 ■타일에 정렬한 뒤 left 방향으로 선인장 바라봄. 이후 2초 동안 eat 자세.
	local target_pos = self.get_fruit_cliff_point().position + vector(0.15, 0, 0.25)
	wp_util.move_async(red_hood, target_pos, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(red_hood, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(2)
	eat_sfx:Stop()

	self:dispose_twinkle_effect()
	self.flower_list[1].ConsumeTarget = red_hood
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self.flower_list[1] = nil

	red_hood.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'sword_idle'
	red_hood.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'sword_walk'
	red_hood.CustomRunAnimationName = 'bomb_run'

	-- 엘비라 손에 (flower) 아이템이 들려짐.
	character_util.hide_weapon(red_hood, false)
	local red_hood_weapon = red_hood.Weapon1.WeaponSpec.SpriteName
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(red_hood, '[base]weapon1', 'cactus_fruit')

	-- 엘비라 (left, smile, victory_get) : 하하! 어때! 이 엘비라님에게 이 정도는 아무것도…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 4, skip = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fat_gnome_03')
	camera_util.move_async(red_hood.Position, 0)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(red_hood, 'left')
	character_util.spine_rotate(red_hood, -15, 0.75)
	wp_util.move_async(red_hood, red_hood.Position + vector(0.1, 0, 0), nil, 0.75)

	-- 엘비라 (left, surprised, embarrassed) : 어어… 안돼…!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 5, skip = true })

	-- 엘비라가 ■타일 위치에서 ⑤번 위치로 떨어짐.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	target_pos = field:GetMarker('s3_red_hood_fall_point').position + vector(1, 0, 0.5)
	camera_util.move(target_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), 1)
	character_util.spine_rotate(red_hood, -441.25, 0.4)

	local sign_board = self.get_sign_board()
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.5
		local add_height = 2
		local start_pos = red_hood.Position

		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * add_height
			red_hood.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.set_position(red_hood, target_pos)
		character_util.spine_rotate(red_hood, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(red_hood, 'none')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })

		sign_board.Position = sign_board.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.4
		sign_board.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(80, 87, 2)
		sign_board.transform:Find('shadow').gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end)
	wait_for_sec(0.475)

	camera_util.shake(0.6, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	self.get_fx_smokescreen():Instantiate(target_pos)
	wait_for_sec(2.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

	local shake_count = 2
	for _ = 1, shake_count do
		scene_util.shake(red_hood, 0.03, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 엘비라 (right, idle, prostrate) 0.7초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(red_hood)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 엘비라 (right, tired, prostrate) : …뭐야 이건…?
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 6, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(red_hood)
	character_util.set_anim(red_hood, { name = 'sword_idle', mix_duration = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.2, 0.7)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 엘비라 (up, idle, idle) : 이곳은… 사막… 황소 벌레… 출몰 구역…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 7, skip = true })

	-- 0.7초간 화면 3.2에서 2.5로 줌 인. 이후 대사 출력.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0.7)
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 엘비라 (up, idle, idle) : 강한 진동에 민감하게 반응하므로… 각별히 주의하시오?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 8, skip = true })

	-- 화면 shake 강도가 더욱 짙어지며 0.5초 뒤, 엘비라 scared 표정으로 left 방향 전환 1회, right 방향 전환 1회.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_04')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 2)
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'scared' })
	scene_util.look_around(red_hood, { 'left', 'right' }, nil, 0.5)

	-- 엘비라의 왼편 □타일에, 사막 황소벌레 3마리(boss_graboid) 가 in 동작을 하며 출현.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	local sand_fx_list = {}
	local showing_worm = function(worm, pos)
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)
		character_util.set_position(worm, pos)

		character_util.set_active_state(worm, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_anim(worm, { name = 'out', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_out_sand_01')
		self.get_sand_out_fx():Instantiate(worm.Position)
		local sand_fx = self.get_sand_fx():Instantiate(worm.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity
		, worm.Transform)
		table.insert(sand_fx_list, sand_fx)
	end

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event' })

	local worm_count = 3
	local worm = self.optimized_npcs['worm_1']
	local worm_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker('s3_red_hood_fall_point').position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)
	showing_worm(worm, worm_spawn_pos)

	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'left')
	character_util.normal_jump(red_hood)
	character_util.move_to(red_hood, red_hood.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 1.5
	, 0.3, nil, false, false)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 표지판 오브젝트가 펑(FX_dead)하고 사라짐.
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(sign_board.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
	sign_board.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	-- 엘비라 (left, scared, shake 상태) : 히이이이익!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.shake(red_hood, 0.02, 9999)
	character_util.normal_jump(red_hood, true)
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 9, skip = true })

	-- 화면 얕은 강도로 shake 1.5초 이후, 강한 shake와 함께 ②번타일에 사막 황소벌레 1마리(boss_graboid) 가 out 동작을 하며 출현.
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	worm = self.optimized_npcs['worm_2']
	worm_spawn_pos = worm_spawn_pos + vector(2, 0, 2)
	showing_worm(worm, worm_spawn_pos)

	-- 2번 황소벌레 out동작하며 나옴과 동시에 엘비라 up 방향 전환하며 idle자세로 jump 1회.
	character_util.normal_jump(red_hood, true)
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim(red_hood)
	wp_util.move_async(red_hood, red_hood.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 2, 4
	, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'up' })
	character_util.set_anim(red_hood, { name = 'cast' })

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	worm = self.optimized_npcs['worm_3']
	worm_spawn_pos = worm_spawn_pos + vector(0, 0, -4)
	showing_worm(worm, worm_spawn_pos)

	character_util.stop_shake(red_hood)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.jump_move(red_hood, red_hood.Position + vector(2.25, 0, 2), 6.5
	, 1, true, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(red_hood.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(red_hood)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(red_hood)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 1,2,3번 황소벌레가 엘비라 캐릭터 있는 방향으로 1칸씩 움직임.
	character_util.shake(red_hood, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(red_hood)
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.normal_jump(red_hood, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sink_sand_02')
	local pos_z_list = { 0, -0.3, 0.3 }
	for i = 1, worm_count do
		worm = self.optimized_npcs['worm_' .. i]
		wp_util.move(worm, worm.Position + vector(0.3, 0, pos_z_list[i]), nil, 0.5)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 엘비라 (left, smile, sing) : 착, 착하지~? 얌전하게 굴어줄래~?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.stop_shake(red_hood)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 가운데 사막 황소벌레 한마리  (angry 이모지) 표시. 이후 사막황소 벌레의 attack 동작과 동시에 엘비라 표정 scared로 전환. 이후 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	local worm_2 = self.optimized_npcs['worm_1']
	character_util.show_emoticon_with_data_async(worm_2.transform, nil, 'angry'
	, nil, { offset = vector(0.1, 4.5, 0) })

	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.remove_anim(red_hood)
	character_util.normal_jump(red_hood, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sink_sand_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	for i = 1, worm_count do
		worm = self.optimized_npcs['worm_' .. i]
		character_util.set_anim(worm, { name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })
	end

	-- 이때 엘비라 아래 샤우트 대사 “으아아아악!!!” 하면서 left, scared, embarrassed
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(red_hood, 'embarrassed', nil
	, { key = self.string_key .. 11, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	-- 엘비라 right 방향으로 run 자세로 달려감. 이때, 카메라는 엘비라를 따라가지 않고 고정됌.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	wp_util.move(red_hood, red_hood.Position + vector(12, 0, 0), nil, 1.5, { run = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 사막 황소벌레 3마리 또한 right 방향으로 달려감.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_04')
	for i = 1, worm_count do
		worm = self.optimized_npcs['worm_' .. i]
		character_util.remove_anim(worm)
		wp_util.move(worm, worm.Position + vector(12, 0, 0), nil, 1.5)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	-- 화면 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 모래 이팩트 dispose
	for i = 1, #sand_fx_list do
		sand_fx_list[i]:Dispose()
	end

	character_util.stop_shake(red_hood)
	red_hood.CustomIdleAnimationName = nil
	red_hood.CustomWalkAnimationName = nil
	red_hood.CustomRunAnimationName = nil

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, 'shortstory_rosetta_s3', function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

		to = red_hood.Position + vector(-0.8, 0.1, 0),

		duration = 0.1

		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local rotation_timer = 0
			while rotation_timer < 0.5 do
				rotation_timer = rotation_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local rotation_progress = rotation_timer / sine_move_data.duration
				sprite.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(240 * 4 * rotation_progress
				, unity_class.vector3.up)
				local current = sprite.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles
				sprite.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, current.y, 0)

function local_class:qte_tap_event(target_tap_count)
	local tap_count = 0

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap
					or e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.DoubleTap then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				tap_count = tap_count + 1
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 게임패드 사용중이면 이벤트 핸들러 세팅
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	-- 게임패드 핸들러가 세팅되있다면 게임패드 이벤트 구독
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	-- QTE 연타 출력
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	while tap_count <= target_tap_count and not self.is_stage_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- 구독 해지
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.touch_handler = nil
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end
end

		self.twinkle_effect = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.get_rosetta()) then
		if self.cur_section_progress < self.section_progress.start_mini_game then
			self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.start_mini_game
			start_coroutine(self.interact_rosetta, self)
		elseif self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.search_room then
			self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.wake_rosetta
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.interact_rosetta_in_rosetta_house, self)
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_rosetta_room_key())
			and self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.wake_rosetta then
		self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.get_room_key
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.interact_room_key, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_rosetta_weapon())
			and self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.open_room then
		self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.ending
		start_coroutine(self.interact_weapon_basket, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_rosetta_room_door())
			and self.cur_section_progress == self.section_progress.get_room_key then
		self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.open_room
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.interact_rosetta_room_door, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_black_russian()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_black_russian, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 문 상호작용
	if self.exit_interact_fo then
		for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
				start_coroutine(self.teleport_party_for_marker, self, self.exit_interact_fo[i]
				, self.exit_teleport_names[i], self.marker_fo_list[i])
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.mini_game_name then
		return false
	end

	if e.Success then
		start_coroutine(self.success_mini_game, self)
	else
		-- 미니게임 재도전 이벤트 연출 여기서 작성
		start_coroutine(self.failed_mini_game, self)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.is_loop = false
	self.is_stage_end = true

	return true
end

	local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
	local move_speed = 3

	camera_util.move_async(vector(31.5, 0, -69), 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	local sleep_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sleep_02', type_priority = 'event'
	, loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, player_priority = 'npc' })

	screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 로제타(right, idle, bomb_idle): 어서 다음 일 하러 가야지.

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(rosetta, 'down')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rosetta, { key = self.string_key .. '8_2', skip = true })

function local_class:interact_rosetta()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 무기 숨김
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	-- 리더가 HoldUpState일 경우 들고 있는 오브젝트 내려 놓도록
	local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		--TODO: HoldTarget이 nil일 때는 버그 일텐데 굳이 체크하는게 맞을지...?
		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction)
			, leader.Position, 4, false)
		end
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
	local rosetta = self.controller.get_rosetta()
	local bartender = self.get_bartender()

	-- 플레이어(엘비라) ● 타일 위치로 정렬 후 right 방향 바라봄.
	party_util.align_party(vector_util.get_x0z(rosetta.Position, 0), 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 로제타 (right, sleep_deep, seat) : 바텐더, 늘 마시던 걸로.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rosetta, { key = self.string_key .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 바텐더 (down, attack, idle shake 0.03) : …지금 밀린 외상이 얼만지 알고 하는 말이야…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	-- 바텐더 (down, mad, idle) : 전부 갚기 전까진 주문할 생각 마!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(bartender, { name = 'mad' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bartender, { key = self.string_key .. 12, skip = true })

	-- 로제타 NPC idle 표정으로 전환되며, 캐릭터 위에 (emoticon_bubble_silence) 표시.
	character_util.remove_emotion(rosetta)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(rosetta, nil, 'silence')

	-- 로제타 (right, smile, seat) : 돈이라면 걱정 말라고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(rosetta, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rosetta, { key = self.string_key .. 13, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(rosetta)

	-- 로제타 (left, idle, release) : 이 애송이가 대신 낼 테니까.

-- 미니게임 시작 함수
function local_class:start_mini_game_routine()
	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

	if not self.mini_game_loaded then
		mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, 'rosetta', function()
			self.mini_game_loaded = true
		end)
	end

	while not self.mini_game_loaded do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 미니게임 failed scene 설정
	self.mini_game.failed_scene = self.pre_failed_mini_game
	self.mini_game.pre_play_scene = self.pre_play_mini_game
	self.mini_game.game_bound = self:get_game_bound_zone().Bounds

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

-- 미니게임 시작 직전에 재생되는 연출
function local_class:pre_play_mini_game()
	local mini_game_bartender = get_character('bar_bartender')
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 바텐더(down, idle, release) (말풍선 방향 right/down)

function local_class:failed_mini_game()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 무기 숨김
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	-- 리더가 HoldUpState일 경우 들고 있는 오브젝트 내려 놓도록
	local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		--TODO: HoldTarget이 nil일 때는 버그 일텐데 굳이 체크하는게 맞을지...?
		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction)
			, leader.Position, 4, false)
		end
	end

	start_coroutine(self.start_mini_game_routine, self)
end

function local_class:set_rosetta_house_event()
	local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
	local rosetta = self.controller.get_rosetta()
	local door = self.get_rosetta_room_door()

	local is_open_door = door.FieldObjectBehaviour.Opened

	-- 로제타 세팅
	local target_pos = field:GetMarker('s6_start_pos').position

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rosetta)
	character_util.set_direction(rosetta, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(rosetta, { name = 'sleep' }, { name = 'sleep' })
	character_util.set_position(rosetta, target_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.25))
	character_util.set_active_state(rosetta, 'enabled')

	-- 로제타 방쪽에 엘비라 승급 무기 세팅
	local rosetta_weapon = self.get_rosetta_weapon()
	rosetta_weapon.Position = vector(28, 0, -59.75)
	rosetta_weapon.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 2))
	self.rosetta_weapon_sprite = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = rosetta_weapon.Position
	, itemid = self.rosetta_weapon_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 })
	self.rosetta_weapon_twinkle = self.get_fx_twinkle_effect():Instantiate(rosetta_weapon.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	rosetta_weapon.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 로제타 방 술병 세팅
	local liquor_bottle_count = 6
	local center_pos = self.get_rosetta_marker(1).position
	local pos_list = {
		center_pos + vector(-2.35, 0, -0.2), center_pos + vector(-1.6, 0, 0.8),
		center_pos + vector(0.25, 0, 1.15), center_pos + vector(1.2, 0, -0.4),
		center_pos + vector(2.8, 0, 0.4), center_pos + vector(4.4, 0, 0.8) }
	local rotate_value_list = { -50, -10, -55, 20, 65, -65 }
	self.rosetta_room_item_list = {}
	for i = 1, liquor_bottle_count do
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = pos_list[i], sprscale = 0.8
		, itemid = self.liquor_bottle_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rotate_value_list[i], 0)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, rotate_value_list[i], 0)
		table.insert(self.rosetta_room_item_list, item)
	end

	local black_russian_fo = self.get_black_russian()
	local black_russian = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = vector_util.get_x0z(black_russian_fo.Position, 0.6)
	, sprscale = 0.75, itemid = self.black_russian_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
	table.insert(self.rosetta_room_item_list, black_russian)
	black_russian_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 로제타 옆 열쇠 세팅
	self.room_key = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = 20861, pos = rosetta.Position
	, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true, sprscale = 0.55 })
	self.room_key.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.51, -0.03)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(red_hood)

	field_util.tint(self.tent_tint_key, unity_color({ 0.15, 0.15, 0.4, 1 }), 0)

	if not is_open_door then
		-- 로제타 문 안 열었을 때만 상호작용 가능하도록
		character_util.add_listener(rosetta, self.controller)

		-- 엘비라 세팅
		character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'up')
		character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_position(red_hood, field:GetMarker('rosetta_room_inner_1').position
				+ unity_class.vector3.back * 2)
	else
		character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'right')
		character_util.set_position(red_hood, vector(27.5, 0, -69))
	end
end

function local_class:start_save_point()
	screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local door = self.get_rosetta_room_door()
	if not door.FieldObjectBehaviour.Opened then
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
		self:red_hood_soliloquy()
	else
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
		character_util.hide_weapon(red_hood, false)
		self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.open_room

		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

		stage_launch_util.directional_stage_entry(red_hood.Position, CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
				game_string:GetString('shortstory_rosetta'), false, true)

function local_class:interact_rosetta_in_rosetta_house()
	local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
	local rosetta = self.controller.get_rosetta()

	-- 엘비라 캐릭터 로제타의 왼쪽에 right 방향 바라보며 정렬.
	party_util.align_party(rosetta.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')
	camera_util.move_async(red_hood.Position, 0.5, { end_target = red_hood, ignorecameragrids = true })

	local sleep_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sleep_01', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 엘비라 (right, tired, idle) : …뭐야?
	character_util.play_speech_action(red_hood, nil, 'tired', self.string_key .. 36)

	-- 엘비라 (right, attack, cross_arm) : 온갖 고생 다 시켜놓고선, 혼자서 퍼질러 자고 있어?
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.play_speech_action(red_hood, 'cross_arm', nil, self.string_key .. 37)

	-- 엘비라 (right, attack, jump 1회) : 여긴 내 침대니까 비켜!
	character_util.normal_jump(red_hood, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(red_hood, self.string_key .. 38)

	-- 로제타 캐릭터 머리 위로 (emoticon_bubble_sleep) 출력.
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(rosetta, nil, 'sleep')

	-- 엘비라 (right, attack, release) : 일어나!!
	character_util.play_speech_action(red_hood, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, nil, self.string_key .. 39)

	-- 엘비라가 로제타 캐릭터 왼쪽에 바싹 붙어서 push 자세 지속.
	wp_util.move_async(red_hood, red_hood.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 0.25, 1, nil)

	-- 화면 shake와 함께 / 엘비라 (right, mad, push) : 일어나라고!!!
	-- 엘비라가 push 자세 진행할 동안 로제타 캐릭터가 0.03 값으로 shake.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

	local rustle_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = true })
	character_util.shake(rosetta, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'shoot' }, { name = 'mad' })
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(red_hood, self.string_key .. 40)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 로제타 (left, sleep, sleep) : …으음…
	sleep_sfx:Stop()
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rosetta, self.string_key .. 41)

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 로제타 left, sleep, seat
	rustle_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.stop_shake(rosetta)
	character_util.set_anim(rosetta, { name = 'seat' })
	character_util.remove_anim(red_hood)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 엘비라 (right, attack, walk) 왼쪽으로 살짝 뒷걸음질(로제타 왼쪽에 붙기 전 정렬 위치)
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.move_to_async(red_hood, red_hood.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5
	, nil, 1, false, true)

	-- 엘비라(right, attack, release): 나도 피곤하니까 일어났으면 나와!
	character_util.play_speech_action(red_hood, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil
	, self.string_key .. 42)

	-- 로제타(left, sleep, seat): 바텐더… 한 잔 더…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rosetta, self.string_key .. '42_1')

	-- 2초 동안 화면 4에서 3.5으로 줌 인 + 엘비라 (right, mad, idle shake 0.04)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	character_util.shake(red_hood, 0.04, 2)
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'mad' })
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 하단 샤우트 시 0.5초간 카메라 shake 세기 0.2
	-- 엘비라 (right, mad, cast2): [shout] 일어나라니까!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	character_util.play_speech_action(red_hood, 'cast2', nil
	, { key = self.string_key .. '42_2', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 엘비라 (right, mad, idle) 로제타 (left, sleep_deep, seat)
	character_util.set_emotion(rosetta, { name = 'sleep_deep' })

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 로제타 left, sleep_deep, idle (seat에서 idle로 일어나면서 열쇠가 떨어짐)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(rosetta, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_desertelfhunter')
	character_util.set_anim(rosetta, { name = 'handgun_idle' })

	-- 로제타 (left, sleep_deep, idle shake 0.03): …뱀 같은… 녀석들…
	character_util.shake(rosetta, 0.03, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rosetta, self.string_key .. '42_3')

	-- 엘비라 right, surprise, idle
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 0.2초간 타임 스케일(0.2) 로제타 left, sleep_deep, handgun_idle -> handgun_attack (화면 3.5 에서 3으로 줌 인도 동시에)
	local gunfire_mod_key = 'gunfire'
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.2)
	time_util.mod(gunfire_mod_key, 0.2)
	character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'surprise' })

	local fire_count = 3
	local fire_pos_list = {
		rosetta.Position + vector(-6, 0, 1),
		rosetta.Position + vector(-7, 0, 0),
		rosetta.Position + vector(-6, 0, -1),
	}

	local shoot_count = 0
	local is_complete_shoot = false
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01')
	character_util.set_anim(rosetta, { name = 'dualgun_attack', mix_duration = 0.3 })
	wait_for_sec(0.37)

	time_util.unmod(gunfire_mod_key)

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.jump(red_hood, 0.75, 0.3)
		wp_util.move(red_hood, red_hood.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 1.25, nil, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	end)

	for i = 1, fire_count do
		start_coroutine(self.sniper_shoot, self, rosetta, fire_pos_list[i], self.pooled_bullet[i], '02_gun_shoot_02'
		, false, true, function()
					shoot_count = shoot_count + 1
					if shoot_count == 1 then
					elseif shoot_count == fire_count then
						is_complete_shoot = true
					end
				end)
		wait_for_sec(0.05)
	end

	while not is_complete_shoot and not self.is_stage_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_anim(rosetta, { name = 'handgun_idle' })

	-- 바닥 슬라이드할 때 뒤에 흙먼지 이펙트(플레이어 달릴 때 뒤에 붙는 먼지 이펙트)

	-- 엘비라 left, scared, prostrate shake 0.03 1초
	character_util.shake(red_hood, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 1.5초간 화면3에서 4로 줌 아웃.
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 로제타 left, sleep, handgun_idle: 더… 가져…와…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	local rosetta_move_end_key = 'rosetta_move'
	character_util.remove_anim(rosetta)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rosetta, rosetta.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward,
			0.5, nil, self, rosetta_move_end_key, {})
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rosetta, self.string_key .. '42_4')
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, rosetta_move_end_key)

	-- 로제타 1초간 up, idle shake 0.03
	character_util.shake(rosetta, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 로제타 left, sleep, sleep
	character_util.set_direction(rosetta, 'left')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(rosetta, { name = 'sleep' }, { name = 'sleep' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 0.5초 후 로제타 emoticon_bubble_sleep
	sleep_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sleep_01', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(rosetta, nil, 'sleep')
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(rosetta, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	-- 엘비라 get 점프로 일어난 뒤 right, scared, idle
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(red_hood, 'left')

	-- 엘비라 (right, scared, cast): 무…무슨 잠꼬대가 저래!
	character_util.shake(red_hood, 0.03, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(red_hood, { name = 'cast' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(red_hood, self.string_key .. '42_5')

	-- 열쇠 상호작용 가능하도록
	local key_interactable = self.get_rosetta_room_key()
	key_interactable.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_start_pos'))
	key_interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 컨트롤 풀림
	character_util.remove_relate_event(rosetta, self.controller)
	rosetta.Interactable.Talk = self.string_key .. '42_4'

	sleep_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.25)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(red_hood)
end

function local_class:preload_bullet(count)
	local custom_atlas

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resource_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	local pooled_bullet = {}

	for _ = 1, count do
		local bullet = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local bullet_sprite = bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas

		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()

		table.insert(pooled_bullet, bullet)
	end

	return pooled_bullet
end

function local_class:sniper_shoot(sniper, target_pos, bullet, sfx_name, is_use_target_pos, is_use_smoke, callback)
	local bullet_speed = 60
	local shoot_dir = (target_pos - sniper.Position).normalized
	local start_pos = sniper.Bounds.center + vector(shoot_dir.x * 0.75, 0, 0.1)
	is_use_target_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_use_target_pos, true)
	local end_pos = is_use_target_pos and target_pos or target_pos - shoot_dir * 0.3

	local bullet_sprite = bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local bullet_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = bullet_rotation
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_name)
	local cannon_fire = self.get_fx_cannon_fire():Instantiate(start_pos)
	cannon_fire.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(shoot_dir.x, 1, 1)

	is_use_smoke = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_use_smoke, false)
	if is_use_smoke then
		local fx_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir) * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
		local smoke_effect = self.get_fx_smoke_trail():Instantiate(start_pos, fx_rotation, nil)
		smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(2, 1, 1)
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			start_pos, end_pos, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)

	if callback then
		callback()
	end

	if is_use_target_pos then
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		return
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite.transform,
			end_pos, end_pos + shoot_dir * 10, -1, nil, bullet_speed, false)

	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end

function local_class:qte_tap_event(red_hood)
	local tap_count = 0
	local target_tap_count = 12

	local is_show_speech_bubble = false
	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap
					or e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.DoubleTap then
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.05)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clang_01')
				tap_count = tap_count + 1

				if tap_count > 3 and not is_show_speech_bubble then
					is_show_speech_bubble = true
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
					character_util.set_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'burning' })
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(red_hood
					, { key = self.string_key .. 51, force_sfx = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
				end

				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 게임패드 사용중이면 이벤트 핸들러 세팅
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	-- 게임패드 핸들러가 세팅되있다면 게임패드 이벤트 구독
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	-- QTE 연타 출력
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	while tap_count <= target_tap_count and not self.is_stage_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- 구독 해지
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.touch_handler = nil
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end
end

--region Exit 관련

-- 이벤트 진행을 위해 ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable로 변경하는 함수
function local_class:changed_exit_interact_fo()
	self.cached_exit = {}
	self.exit_interact_fo = {}

	local exit_names = { 'rosetta_room_inner_1', 'rosetta_room_outer_1', 'bar_outer_1'
	, 'bar_outer_2', 'bar_inner_1', 'bar_inner_2' }

	self.exit_teleport_names = { 'rosetta_room_inner_1', 'rosetta_room_outer_1', 'bar_outer_1'
	, 'bar_outer_2', 'bar_inner_1', 'bar_inner_2' }

	for i = 1, #exit_names do
		local exit_fo = get_field_object(exit_names[i])
		table.insert(self.cached_exit, exit_fo.Interactable)
		exit_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		table.insert(self.exit_interact_fo, exit_fo)
	end

	self.marker_fo_list = { self.exit_interact_fo[2], self.exit_interact_fo[5], self.exit_interact_fo[5]
	, self.exit_interact_fo[5], self.controller.get_rosetta(), self.exit_interact_fo[4] }
end

-- ExitInteractable의 Interactable를 원복하는 함수
function local_class:restore_exit_interact_fo()
	if self.exit_interact_fo == nil then
		return
	end

	-- ExitInteractable -> ExitInteractable로 원복
	for i = 1, #self.exit_interact_fo do
		local exit_fo = self.exit_interact_fo[i]
		exit_fo.Interactable = self.cached_exit[i]
	end

	self.exit_interact_fo = nil
	self.marker_fo_list = nil
	self.cached_exit = nil
end

-- ExitInteractable 대신 이동해주는 함수
function local_class:teleport_party_for_marker(exit_fo, marker_name, quest_marker_fo)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ExitInteractTeleportStartEvent.Create(exit_fo.Name))

	-- 마커 재 조정
	local marker = field:GetMarker(marker_name)
	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute(marker)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local quest_marker_name = self.controller.quest_marker_name
	if quest_marker_fo == nil then
		quest_marker_util.remove(quest_marker_name)
		return
	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, quest_marker_name, quest_marker_fo, true)
end

--endregion

	if self.rosetta_weapon_twinkle then

		self.rosetta_weapon_twinkle = nil

		self.wind_sfx = nil
	end

	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:start_mini_game_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 무기 숨김
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
	local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
	local rosetta = self.controller.get_rosetta()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	-- ●[빨간 점]에 서있는 로제타(down, idle, idle)
	-- 상호작용 시 로제타 아래 정렬 후 연출 진행
	-- 엘비라(up, idle) (-112.5, 0, 81)
	party_util.align_party(rosetta, 'down', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 로제타(down, idle, idle): 왔군. 그럼 바로 단련 시작하지.

	-- 엘비라(up, idle): 여기서 뭘 시작한다는 거야?

	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 31, skip = true })

-- 미니게임 성공
function local_class:success_mini_game()
	local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
	local rosetta = self.controller.get_rosetta()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	self.cur_section_progress = self.section_progress.success_mini_game

	-- 엘비라 (right, damaged, prostrate) (-112.5, 0, 80.5)
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(red_hood, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_position(red_hood, vector(-112.5, 0, 80.5))

	-- 로제타 (left, idle, idle) (-111.5, 0, 80.5)
	character_util.set_direction(rosetta, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rosetta)
	character_util.set_position(rosetta, vector(-111.5, 0, 80.5))

	local cactus_list = {}
	local cactus_count = 3
	local target_pos = vector(-113.5, 0, 81)
	local pos_list = {
		target_pos,
		target_pos + vector(-0.26, 0, -0.65),
		target_pos + vector(0.26, 0, -0.65),
	}
	for i = 1, cactus_count do
		local cur_item_id = i == 1 and self.cactus_head_id or self.cactus_stump_id
		local cactus = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = pos_list[i], sprscale = 0.5
		, itemid = cur_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })
		if i == 1 then
			cactus:SetSortingLayerAndOrder('Under Effects', 2, 'Under Effects', 0)
		end
		table.insert(cactus_list, cactus)
	end

	-- 여기서 커스텀 스테이지 이벤트 발생
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'open_mini_game_timber_challenge' }))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 0, volume = 0.5 })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 엘비라 (right, damaged, prostrate): 이…이거 진짜 단련되는 거 맞아…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red_hood, { key = self.string_key .. 33, skip = true })

	-- 로제타 (left, idle, idle): 고작 하루했다고 당연히 힘이 세지진 않지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rosetta, { key = self.string_key .. 34, skip = true })

	-- 로제타 (left , idle, idle): 지쳐 쓰러질 때까지 움직여 보고, 자신의 한계를 파악해두라고 시킨 거다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rosetta, { key = self.string_key .. 35, skip = true })

	-- 로제타 (left , sleep_deep, cross_arm): 자신의 한계를 알고 전투에 임하는 것과 모르고 임하는 것. 둘은 큰 차이가 있으니까…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(rosetta, 'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', self.string_key .. 36)

	-- 엘비라 (right, idle, prostrate ): 자신의 한계를 파악해두라고…?
	character_util.remove_emotion(red_hood)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(red_hood, self.string_key .. 37)

	-- 로제타 (left, idle, release): 이만 더 늦기 전에 돌아가자.
	character_util.play_speech_action(rosetta, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil
	, self.string_key .. '37_1')

	-- 로제타 (left, doyagao, idle): 네가 벤 선인장은 쓸 데가 있으니 챙기는 거 잊지 말고.
	character_util.play_speech_action(rosetta, nil, 'doyagao', self.string_key .. '37_2')

	-- 로제타 화면 아래로 walk
	local rosetta_move_end_key = 'rosetta_move_end'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rosetta, rosetta.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 8,
			3, nil, self, rosetta_move_end_key, {})
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(red_hood, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(red_hood)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'down')
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, rosetta_move_end_key)

	-- 엘비라(down, tired, idle): 칫… 기다렸다가 같이 가면 좀 덧나…?
	character_util.play_speech_action(red_hood, nil, 'tired'
	, self.string_key .. '37_3')

	-- 엘비라 left, idle, eat 모션, 1초 후 0.7초 간격으로 선인장작 3개 습득(위, 좌, 우 순서)
	character_util.set_direction(red_hood, 'left')
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(red_hood, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	for i = 1, #cactus_list do
		cactus_list[i].ConsumeTarget = red_hood
		cactus_list[i]:Fly()
		wait_for_sec(0.7)
	end

	-- 엘비라 get 자세로 일어난 후 컨트롤 풀림, 이벤트 종료.
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.save_state_key, 2)
	self.cur_save_state = 2

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(red_hood)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rosetta)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(rosetta, self.controller)
	character_util.set_position(rosetta, vector(999, 0, 999))

	target_pos = field:GetMarker('default_start').position + unity_class.vector3.right
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target_pos)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	-- 리더 무적 해제
	if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	-- 무기 다시 보이게
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
	end

	local target_marker_pos = field:GetMarker('default_start').position + unity_class.vector3.right
	for i = 2, 4 do
		self.marker_fo_list[i] = target_marker_pos
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 미니게임 실패
function local_class:failed_mini_game()
	start_coroutine(self.start_mini_game_routine, self)
end

function local_class:ending_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 무기 숨김
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	local red_hood = self.controller.get_red_hood()
	local rosetta = self.controller.get_rosetta()
	local bath_barrel = self.get_bath_barrel()

	local move_end_key = 'red_hood_move'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(red_hood, red_hood.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 6,
			nil, 2.3, self, move_end_key, {})
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 화면 3으로 줌 인 되어있는 상태
	local bath_scene_pos = self.get_bath_scene_marker().position
	local camera_pos = bath_scene_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)
