function local_class:enter_cave_zone()
	--npc
	local shuran = get_party_leader()
	local following_npc_list = {}

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(following_npc_list, user_party[i])
	end

	local successor_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.successor_num do
		table.insert(successor_list, self.get_successor(i))
	end

	--pos
	local standard_pos = self.get_preparation_pos()
	local shuran_pos = standard_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local cam_pos = standard_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)

	local following_npc_align_data = {
		pos = {
			standard_pos + vector(1, 0, -2),
			standard_pos + vector(-1, 0, -2),
			standard_pos + vector(0, 0, -2),
		},
		last_direction = {
			'up',
			'up',
			'up'
		}
	}

	--컨트롤 뺏기며 bgm 볼륨 0.6, 믹스 디폴트	bgm_china_night. event임.
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)

	local is_cam_move_complete = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 1)
		is_cam_move_complete = true
	end)

	--플레이어 하단 존에 진입 시 컨트롤 뺏기고 정렬
	--원걸 파티에 없을 시 해당 자리 비워 놓고 출력
	--
	do
		local move_key = 'align_party_member'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuran,
				shuran_pos,
				4,
				nil,
				self, move_key,
				{ last_direction = 'up' })

		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local npc = following_npc_list[i]
			local npc_pos = following_npc_align_data.pos[i]
			local npc_last_direction = following_npc_align_data.last_direction[i]
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc,
					npc_pos,
					4,
					nil,
					self, move_key,
					{ last_direction = npc_last_direction })
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	while not is_cam_move_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--이후 대화
	if not self.already_enter_cave_zone then
		self.already_enter_cave_zone = true

		--C NPC (down, idle, idle): 사자 동굴에 온 것을 환영하오.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_master_shout_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[3], self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				'short_story_sr_lion_cave_10_1')

		--B NPC (down, idle, idle): 오랜만에 나타난 도전자군.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				'short_story_sr_lion_cave_10_2')
		--선택지 등장
		local choose_table = {
			--윈링 (up, idle): 할아버지들은 누구세요?
			{ 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_10_3', 'normal' },
			--윈링 (up, idle): 사자 동굴이 뭐죠?
			{ 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_15_1', 'normal' }
		}

		local reaction_table = {
			function()
				--윈링 (up, idle): 할아버지들은 누구세요?
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_10_3')

				--B NPC (down, idle, idle): 세월이 많이 흘렀으니 우리를 잘 모를 수도 있겠구려.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_10_4')

				--B NPC (down, idle, idle): 먼저 우리를 소개하겠네.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_10_5')

				--카메라는 2.5크기로 줌인되며 아래 대사 진행하는 NPC 중심으로 0.7초에 걸쳐 이동
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_evolve_result_01')
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0.4)
				camera_util.move_async(successor_list[1].Position, 0.4)

				--이동 완료되면 0.2초 후 대사 출력
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				--A NPC (left, attack, bow_idle): 나는 현무권의 시험관!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
				scene_util.set_direction(successor_list[1], 'down')
				scene_util.set_emotion(successor_list[1], self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(successor_list[1], self, 'dualsword_idle')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[1], self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_11')

				--해당 NPC 대사 출력 완료되면 0.5초 후 다음 NPC 중심으로 카메라 이동
				camera_util.move_async(successor_list[2].Position, 0.5)

				--B NPC (down, attack, dagger_idle): 나는 주작권의 시험관!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
				scene_util.set_direction(successor_list[2], 'down')
				scene_util.set_emotion(successor_list[2], self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(successor_list[2], self, 'bomb_idle')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_12')

				--해당 NPC 대사 출력 완료되면 0.5초 후 다음 NPC 중심으로 카메라 이동
				camera_util.move_async(successor_list[3].Position, 0.5)

				--C NPC (down, attack, dagger_idle): 나는 청룡권의 시험관!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
				scene_util.set_direction(successor_list[3], 'down')
				scene_util.set_emotion(successor_list[3], self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(successor_list[3], self, 'dagger_idle')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[3], self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_13')

				--해당 NPC 대사 출력 완료되면 0.5초 후 다음 NPC 중심으로 카메라 이동
				camera_util.move_async(successor_list[4].Position, 0.5)

				--D NPC (right, attack, bow_idle): 나는 백호권의 시험관!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
				scene_util.set_direction(successor_list[4], 'down')
				scene_util.set_emotion(successor_list[4], self, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim(successor_list[4], self, 'bow_idle')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[4], self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_14')

				--이후 카메라 0.5초 걸쳐 4의 크기로 변경되며 아래와 같이 이동
				camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
				camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 0.5)


				--아래와 같이 말풍선 등장
				--사자 동굴 사천왕이오!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
				camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(successor_list[3],
						{ key = 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_15', bubble_type = 'shout',
						  skip = true, scale = 2.0,
						  viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8) })

				--이후 말풍선 사라지면 A, B, C, D NPC (down, idle, idle) 출력

			end,
			function()
				--윈링 (up, idle): 사자 동굴이 뭐죠?
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_15_1')

				--B NPC (down, idle, idle): 사자 동굴은 자신의 실력을 시험할 수 있는 곳이라네.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_15_2')

				--B NPC (down, idle, idle): 예전과 달리 규모는 작아졌지만 명성은 여전하다네.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_15_3')

				--C NPC (down, idle, idle): 명성만큼 시험에 통과하긴 어려울 거요.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[3], self,
						nil, nil, nil,
						'short_story_sr_lion_cave_15_4')

			end,
		}

		-- 선택지를 전부 선택해 사라질 때 까지 계속 진행
		while #choose_table ~= 0 do
			local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_table)

			for i = 1, 4 do
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(successor_list[i])
				character_util.set_direction(successor_list[i], 'down')
			end

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			reaction_table[choose_result]()

			table.remove(choose_table, choose_result)
			table.remove(reaction_table, choose_result)


		end

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		for i = 1, 4 do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(successor_list[i])
			character_util.set_direction(successor_list[i], 'down')
		end

		--B NPC (down, idle, idle): 우리의 시험에 통과한다면 사자 동굴의 비보를 주겠네.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				'short_story_sr_lion_cave_16')

		--C NPC (down, idle, idle): 도전해 보겠소?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[3], self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				'short_story_sr_lion_cave_17')
	else
		--B NPC (down, idle, idle): 준비가 되었는가?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[3], self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				'short_story_sr_lion_cave_20')
	end

	--선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_yes', 'forced' },
		{ 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_no', 'normal' } }
	)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--예 (forced)

		--‘예’ 선택 이후 바로 위에 1번 도어가 open되고
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('lion_cave_door_1', false))

		--C NPC (down, idle, idle): 좋은 기백이오!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_master_shout_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[3], self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				'short_story_sr_lion_cave_17_1')

		--B NPC (down, idle, idle): 그럼 안으로 들어오시게나.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				'short_story_sr_lion_cave_18')

		--NPC들 아래와 같이 ①~④ 순서대로 7의 속도로 이동
		local move_key = 'successor_move_to_test_pos'
		local successor_waypoint_list = {
			{
				--standard_pos + vector(-3, 0, 1.5),
				standard_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
				standard_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 10),
				self.successor_org_pos_list[1]
			},
			{
				--standard_pos + vector(-1, 0, 1.5),
				standard_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1.5),
				standard_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 10),
				self.successor_org_pos_list[2]
			},
			{
				--standard_pos + vector(1, 0, 1.5),
				standard_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1.5),
				standard_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 10),
				self.successor_org_pos_list[3]
			},
			{
				--standard_pos + vector(3, 0, 1.5),
				standard_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1.5),
				standard_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 10),
				self.successor_org_pos_list[4]
			},
		}
		for i = 1, self.successor_num do
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(successor_list[i],
					successor_waypoint_list[i],
					7,
					nil,
					self, move_key,
					{ last_direction = 'down', run = true })
		end

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_accept_test

		--이 시점부터 윈링 혼자 진행되며 원걸(right, idle, idle)과 토끼(right, idle, idle) 상태로 아래의 위치에 대기
		self:convert_party_member_to_npc()

		self.test_order = 1
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.test_order_custom_state, self.test_order)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	else
		--아니오(normal)

		--B NPC (down, idle, idle): 생각있으면 언제든지 찾아오시게나.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[3], self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				'short_story_sr_lion_cave_19')

		for i = 1, self.successor_num do
			successor_list[i].Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
			character_util.add_listener(successor_list[i], self.controller)
		end

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
		--다시 빨간 존 진입 시 아래와 같이 출력하면 선택지 동일하게 등장
	end
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
end

	--아래의 빨간 존에 진입 시 나레이션 박스 출력
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_21' })

	--해당 존은 클리어 전까지 활성화되며 클리어 이후에는 제거
	--
	--
	--시험을 포기하시겠습니까?
	--선택지 출력
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_yes', 'normal' },
		{ 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_no', 'forced' } }
	)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--예 [forced]
		--원걸과 토끼가 파티에 합류하며 진행
		self:convert_npc_to_party_member()
		--이후 아래의 존에 진입 시 나레이션 박스 출력
	else
		--아니오[normal]

		--진입 반대 방향으로 0.5칸 뒷걸음질 하며 컨트롤 회복
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local move_pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter('lion_cave_preparation_exit', leader, 'up', 1)
		wp_util.move_async(leader, move_pos, 4, nil, { locked_dir = 'down' })
	end
end

function local_class:convert_party_member_to_npc()
	-- 파티원 제외
	self.cached_party = {}
	local move_key = 'convert_and_align'
	local standard_pos = self.get_preparation_pos()
	local party_index = 1
	local party_pos = {
		standard_pos + vector(-3, 0, -2),
		standard_pos + vector(-2, 0, -2),
		standard_pos + vector(2, 0, -2),
		standard_pos + vector(3, 0, -2),
	}

	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		table.insert(self.cached_party, party_member)
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'down')
		character_util.convert_to_npc(party_member)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(party_member,
				party_pos[party_index],
				7,
				nil,

				{ last_direction = 'right' })

function local_class:start_test(test_num)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--미니게임 제한시간
	local max_time_limit = 30

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('lion_cave_door_1', true))

	-- 리더 무적
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)

	--계승자 웨이포인트 루틴
	self:setting_routine_waypoint()

	local is_test_success = false
	local time_passed = 0
	self.is_activity_end = false

	for i = 1, self.successor_num do
		self.get_successor(i).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	local activation_table = self.activation_character_per_test[test_num]

	--시작 위치에 서 있도록
	for idx = 1, #activation_table do
		if activation_table[idx] then
			self.get_successor(idx).Position = self.successor_waypoint_start_pos[idx]
			scene_util.set_emotion(self.get_successor(idx), self, 'attack')
		else
			self.get_successor(idx).Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end
	end

	camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, { end_target = user_party.Leader })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_shaolin_figo', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, false)

	sp_util.exit_scene({ show_weapon = false }, user_party.Leader)

	-- 타이머 시작
	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
		timer_util.start_timer(
				{ duration = max_time_limit, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_test

		for idx = 1, #activation_table do
			if activation_table[idx] then
				--0.3초 대기 후 루틴 시작

				start_coroutine(self.successor_waypoint_routine, self, idx)
			else
				self.is_dead_successor[idx] = true
			end
		end

		while not self.is_activity_end do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if self.is_clear_activity then
				is_test_success = true
				break
			elseif time_passed > max_time_limit then
				is_test_success = false
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.is_activity_end = true
		self:timer_finished()

		for i = 1, self.successor_num do
			character_util.stop(self.get_successor(i))
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('lion_cave_door_1', false))

		--리더 무적 해제
		character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, false)

		if is_test_success then
			self.is_clear_activity = false
			self.is_activity_end = false
			if test_num == 4 then
				self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.success_final_test, self)
			else
				start_coroutine(self.success_test, self, test_num)
			end
		else
			self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.fail_test, self, test_num)
		end

	end)
end

function local_class:restore_leader_health()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	-- 리더 체력 풀피로
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = leader
	heal_info.target = leader
	heal_info.heal = leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
end

function local_class:fail_test(test_num)
	local standard_pos = self.get_test_pos()
	local shuran_pos = standard_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local cam_pos = standard_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)

	local shuran = self.get_shuran()
	local successor_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.successor_num do
		table.insert(successor_list, self.get_successor(i))
	end

	--60초 내에 A, B, C, D NPC을 쓰러트리지 못하면 실패 연출 진행

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_test

	--윈링(right, tired, frustration 1회 진행), NPC(right, idle, victory_extra) 출력
	character_util.set_direction(shuran, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'tired')
	start_coroutine(function()
		local sfx_timing = spine_util.get_animation_duration(shuran, 'frustration')
		character_util.set_anim(shuran, { name = 'frustration', loop = false })
		wait_for_sec(sfx_timing)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	end)

	local is_falling = false

	local function table_is_empty(table)
		local is_empty = true
		for key, value in pairs(table) do
			is_empty = false
			break
		end

		return is_empty
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local limit_time = 5
	local table_is_not_empty = not table_is_empty(self.waypoint_routine_info)

	while table_is_not_empty and time_passed < limit_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		table_is_not_empty = not table_is_empty(self.waypoint_routine_info)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, self.successor_num do
		local successor = successor_list[i]
		character_util.set_direction(successor, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(successor, self, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_anim(successor, self, 'victory_extra')

		if successor.Position.y > 0 then
			is_falling = true
			local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
			local fall_duration = 0.5
			local start_pos = successor.Position
			local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, successor.Position.y, 0)
			start_coroutine(function()
				while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
					free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
					local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

					if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
						character_util.set_position(successor, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
					else
						character_util.set_position(successor, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
					end
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end
				character_util.set_position(successor, vector_util.get_x0z(successor.Position, 0), true)
				is_falling = false
			end)
		end
	end

	--위 연출 출력되고 2초 후
	wait_for_sec(2)

	while is_falling do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--1초에 걸쳐 fade out되고 1초에 걸쳐 fade in 진행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--윈링 (left, damaged, prostrate)
	shuran.Position = shuran_pos
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)
	character_util.set_direction(shuran, 'up')

	--A, B, C, D NPC(down, idle, idle)
	local successor_pos_list = {
		standard_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
		standard_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 2.5),
		standard_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 2.5),
		standard_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 2.5),
	}
	for i = 1, self.successor_num do
		successor_list[i].Position = successor_pos_list[i]
		character_util.set_direction(successor_list[i], 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion(successor_list[i], self, 'idle')
		scene_util.set_anim(successor_list[i], self, 'idle')
	end

	self:restore_leader_health()

	camera_util.move(cam_pos, 0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	--아래의 도어는 open 상태

	--fade in 될 때
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_china_night', mix = 2, volume = 0.6 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local npc_list = {
		successor_list[4],
		successor_list[1],
		successor_list[2],
		successor_list[3],
	}

	--short_story_sr_lion_cave_55	시험관 D (남)	아직 저의 보법을 따라오는 게 벅찬가 봅니다.
	--short_story_sr_lion_cave_56	시험관 A (남)	나의 강인한 외공을 누가 막을쏘냐!
	--short_story_sr_lion_cave_57	시험관 B (남)	경공법은 처음보겠구나. 아마 쫓아오기 바빴을 것이야.
	--short_story_sr_lion_cave_58	시험관 C (남)	괜찮소. 나를 쓰러트리는 것은 불가능한 것이오.
	if test_num == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	end
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_list[test_num], self,
			nil, 'cross_arm', nil,
			'short_story_sr_lion_cave_' .. 54 + test_num)

	--C NPC(down, idle, idle): 사자 동굴은 언제나 열려있으니 준비가 되면 다시 찾아오시오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			'short_story_sr_lion_cave_59')

	for i = 1, self.successor_num do
		successor_list[i].Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		character_util.add_listener(successor_list[i], self.controller)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀
end

function local_class:accept_next_test(test_num)
	local successor_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.successor_num do
		table.insert(successor_list, self.get_successor(i))
	end

	if not self.already_listen_second_test_tutorial then
		self.already_listen_second_test_tutorial = true
		if test_num == 1 then
			--B NPC(down, sleep_deep, idle): 너의 첫 번째 상대는…
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
					nil, nil, nil,
					'short_story_sr_lion_cave_25')

function local_class:success_final_test()

	local successor_list = {}

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_direction(shuran, 'up')

			standard_pos + vector(1, 0, -1),
			standard_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1),
			standard_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
		},
		last_direction = {
			'up',
			'up',
			'up'
		}
	}

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do

		standard_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 2.5),
		standard_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 2.5),

		standard_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 2.5),
	}

		table.insert(successor_list, self.get_successor(i))
		successor_list[i].Position = successor_pos_list[i]
		character_util.set_direction(successor_list[i], 'down')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(successor_list[i])
	end

	self:restore_leader_health()

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_china_night', mix = 2, volume = 0.6 })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--마지막에 처리된 NPC 쓰러진 후 1초 후 1초에 걸쳐 fade out되고 1초에 걸쳐 fade in 진행
	--fade in 되었을 때 아래와 같이 정렬
	--
	--이후 대화
	--B NPC(down, idle, clap): 한 수 앞을 읽다니… 많이  배웠다네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[3], self,
			nil, 'clap', nil,
			'short_story_sr_lion_cave_61')

	--B NPC(down, idle, idle): 약조대로 사자 동굴의 비보를 주겠네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			'short_story_sr_lion_cave_62')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			'short_story_sr_lion_cave_63')

	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

	--문 열리는 연출 후 카메라 복귀되며 서브 퀘스트 클리어 연출 진행
	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, false,
			false, false, false)
end

function local_class:interact_to_retake_test()
	--다시 A, B, C, D NPC 인터렉트 시 아래와 같이 정렬되며 대화 진행
	local standard_pos = self.get_test_pos()
	local shuran_pos = standard_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local cam_pos = standard_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)

	local shuran = self.get_shuran()
	local successor_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.successor_num do
		table.insert(successor_list, self.get_successor(i))
	end

	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, true)

	sp_util.enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	--윈링 수련장 내부 진입 후 해당 존에 들어가면 아래와 같이 정렬
	local start_pos = shuran.Position
	local end_pos = cam_pos
	local move_speed = 4
	local move_duration = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / move_speed
	local is_cam_move_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		camera_util.move_async(end_pos, 1)
		is_cam_move_end = true
	end)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)

	wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran_pos, 4, nil)
	character_util.set_direction(shuran, 'up')

	while not is_cam_move_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end


	--B NPC(down, idle, idle): 오호. 준비가 되었는가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
			nil, nil, nil,
			'short_story_sr_lion_cave_64')
	--선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_yes', 'forced' },
		{ 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_no', 'normal' } }
	)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--예(forced)
		self:accept_next_test(self.test_order)
	else
		--아니오 (normal)
		--B NPC(down, idle, idle): 회복할 시간이 필요한가 보군. 준비가 되면 다시 말해 주시게나.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(successor_list[2], self,
				nil, nil, nil,
				'short_story_sr_lion_cave_44')

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, false)

		sp_util.exit_scene({ show_weapon = false }, user_party.Leader)
	end
	--윈링 컨트롤 복귀
end

function local_class:successor_waypoint_routine(successor_idx)
	local successor = self.get_successor(successor_idx)
	local waypoints = self.successor_waypoint_list[successor_idx]
	local speed = self.successor_speed[successor_idx][self.life_successor[successor_idx]]
	local move_type = self.successor_move_type[successor_idx]
	local routine_key = 'waypoint_routine' .. successor_idx

	self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = true

	local move_function_list = {
		-- 1, 걷기
		function(waypoint)
			local start_pos = successor.Position
			local end_pos = waypoint
			local time_passed = 0
			speed = self.successor_speed[successor_idx][self.life_successor[successor_idx]]
			local wait_time = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed
			local anim_name = 'run'

			if speed > 4 then
				--달리기 스모크 붙여줌. 속도에 따라 애니메이션 달라지지는 않음.
				local smoke_delay = 0.25
				start_coroutine(function()
					while not self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] and
							not self.is_activity_end do

						if not self.is_stun[successor_idx] then
							stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(successor.Position)
						end

						wait_for_sec(smoke_delay)
					end
				end)
			end

			character_util.set_anim(successor, { name = anim_name })
			while time_passed < wait_time do
				if not self.is_stun[successor_idx] and not self.is_harden_routine[successor_idx] then
					if self.successor_dash_sfx == nil then
						self.successor_dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
								{ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = successor })
					end

					--루틴 중간에 (데미지를 받거나 기타 다른 요인으로) 방해 받으면, 초기화
					if self.is_routine_change[successor_idx] then
						self.is_routine_change[successor_idx] = false
						local speed_new = self.successor_speed[successor_idx][self.life_successor[successor_idx]]
						time_passed = 0
						start_pos = successor.Position
						end_pos = waypoint
						wait_time = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed_new

						character_util.set_anim(successor, { name = anim_name })
					end

					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					local progress = time_passed / wait_time
					local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
					local lerp_distance = lerp_pos - successor.Position
					local direction = vector_util.to_direction(lerp_distance)
					character_util.set_direction(successor, direction)

					--region 폭탄에 충돌했는지 체크. 충돌하면 스턴 상태로 만듬
					local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(successor.Bounds, lerp_distance)
					for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
						local obj = obj_list[i]

						if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BombFieldObjectBehaviour) and
								not self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] and
								not self.is_stun_cool_time[successor_idx] and
								not self.is_exist_harden_pattern[successor_idx] then

							if self.successor_dash_sfx ~= nil then
								music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.successor_dash_sfx)
								self.successor_dash_sfx = nil
							end

							start_coroutine(self.stun_successor, self, successor_idx)
						end
					end

					obj_list:Dispose()
					--endregion

					character_util.set_position(successor, lerp_pos, false)
				else
					if self.successor_dash_sfx ~= nil then
						music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.successor_dash_sfx)
						self.successor_dash_sfx = nil
					end
				end

				if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then

					if self.successor_dash_sfx ~= nil then
						music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.successor_dash_sfx)
						self.successor_dash_sfx = nil
					end

					self:stop_dead_successor(successor)
					self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
					return
				elseif self.is_activity_end then

					if self.successor_dash_sfx ~= nil then
						music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.successor_dash_sfx)
						self.successor_dash_sfx = nil
					end

					self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
					return
				end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end,
		--2, 점프 이동
		function(waypoint)
			local start_pos = successor.Position
			local end_pos = waypoint
			local time_passed = 0
			local wait_time = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed
			local height = 1.5

			if start_pos.x - end_pos.x > 0 then
				character_util.set_direction(successor, 'left')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(successor, 'right')
			end
			music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', parent = successor, loop = false })
			character_util.set_anim(successor, { name = 'get', loop = false })

			while time_passed < wait_time do
				if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
					self:stop_dead_successor(successor)
					self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
					return
				elseif self.is_activity_end then
					self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
					return
				end

				if not self.is_stun[successor_idx] then
					--루틴 중간에 (데미지를 받거나 기타 다른 요인으로) 방해 받으면, 초기화
					if self.is_routine_change[successor_idx] then
						self.is_routine_change[successor_idx] = false
						local speed_new = self.successor_speed[successor_idx][self.life_successor[successor_idx]]
						time_passed = 0
						start_pos = successor.Position
						end_pos = waypoint
						wait_time = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / speed_new
					end

					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					local progress = time_passed / wait_time
					local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
					local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
					local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)

					character_util.set_position(successor, cur_pos, true)
				end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			character_util.set_position(successor, vector_util.get_x0z(successor.Position, 0), true)
			--0.1초 뒤 (attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) 출력
			local already_boong_attack = false
			local boong_attack_wait_time = 0.1

			--0.5초 뒤 (attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) 출력
			--이후 1 0.3초 뒤 다시 비행 시작 => 0.4초 대기
			wait_time = 0.4
			time_passed = 0
			character_util.set_anim(successor, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
			while time_passed < wait_time do
				if not self.is_stun[successor_idx] then
					--region 폭탄에 충돌했는지 체크. 충돌하면 스턴 상태로 만듬
					local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(successor.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
						local obj = obj_list[i]

						if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BombFieldObjectBehaviour) and
								not self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] and
								not self.is_stun_cool_time[successor_idx] then
							start_coroutine(self.stun_successor, self, successor_idx)
						end
					end
					--endregion

					--0.5초 뒤 (attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) 출력
					if not already_boong_attack and
							wait_time > boong_attack_wait_time then
						already_boong_attack = true
						character_util.set_anim(successor, { name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop' })
					end

					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				end

				if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
					self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
					self:stop_dead_successor(successor)
					return
				elseif self.is_activity_end then
					self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
					return
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end,
		-- 3, 순간이동
		function(waypoint)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')
			self.fx:blink():Instantiate(successor.Position)
			successor.Position = waypoint

			local time_passed = 0
			local wait_time = speed

			local already_shake = false
			local shake_wait_time = 0.5

			character_util.stop_shake(successor)
			character_util.set_anim(successor, { name = 'dagger_idle' })
			while time_passed < wait_time do

				if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
					self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
					self:stop_dead_successor(successor)
					return
				elseif self.is_activity_end then
					self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
					return
				end

				if not self.is_stun[successor_idx] then
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					if not already_shake and
							time_passed > shake_wait_time then
						already_shake = true
						character_util.shake(successor, 0.03, wait_time - shake_wait_time)
					end

					--region 폭탄에 충돌했는지 체크. 충돌하면 스턴 상태로 만듬
					local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(successor.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
						local obj = obj_list[i]

						if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BombFieldObjectBehaviour) and
								not self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] and
								not self.is_stun_cool_time[successor_idx] then
							character_util.stop_shake(successor)
							start_coroutine(self.stun_successor, self, successor_idx)
						end
					end
					--endregion
				end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end
	}

	local start_idx = self.waypoint_idx_successor[successor_idx]

	if self.is_exist_harden_pattern[successor_idx] then
		start_coroutine(self.harden_successor_routine, self, successor_idx)
	end

	while not self.is_activity_end do
		for i = 1, #waypoints do
			if start_idx ~= 1 then
				i = start_idx
				start_idx = 1
			end
			move_function_list[move_type](waypoints[i])

			if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] or self.is_activity_end then
				self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
				return
			end

			if i == #waypoints then
				i = 1
			end
		end
	end

	self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
end

function local_class:damage_successor(idx)
	if self.is_dead_successor[idx] or self.is_harden[idx] then
		return
	end

	--체력 감소
	self.life_successor[idx] = self.life_successor[idx] - 1
	local life = self.life_successor[idx]
	local successor = self.get_successor(idx)

	if life > 0 then
		--표정 변경
		character_util.set_emotion(successor, { name = 'damaged' })
		if idx == 1 then
			--이 정도로 쓰러지지 않는다!
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_china_master_shout_01', parent = successor, loop = false })
			start_coroutine(function()
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(successor, { key = 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_54', skip = false })
				if not self.is_dead_successor[idx] and not self.is_activity_end then
					character_util.set_emotion(successor, { name = 'attack' })
				end
			end)


			--루틴 변경
			self.is_routine_change[idx] = true

			--단단해지기 패턴 3초 동안 무력화
			start_coroutine(function()
				self.is_paused_harden_pattern[idx] = true
				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				self.is_paused_harden_pattern[idx] = false
				start_coroutine(self.harden_successor_routine, self, idx)
			end)
		end
	end

	--체력이 0 이하면 사망
	if self.life_successor[idx] <= 0 then
		self.is_dead_successor[idx] = true
	end

	--사망 시 전체 계승자 다 죽었으면 클리어 처리
	local is_dead_all = true
	for i = 1, #self.is_dead_successor do
		if not self.is_dead_successor[i] then
			is_dead_all = false
		end
	end

	if is_dead_all then
		self.is_clear_activity = true
	end
end

function local_class:stop_dead_successor(successor)
	character_util.stop(successor)
	character_util.set_direction(successor, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_master_scream_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(successor, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(successor, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })
	if successor.Position.y > 0 then
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local fall_duration = 0.5
		local start_pos = successor.Position
		local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, successor.Position.y, 0)
		start_coroutine(function()
			while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
				free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

				if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
					character_util.set_position(successor, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
				else
					character_util.set_position(successor, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
				end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			character_util.set_position(successor, vector_util.get_x0z(successor.Position, 0), true)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:stun_successor(successor_idx)
	local successor = self.get_successor(successor_idx)
	local routine_key = 'stun_routine' .. successor_idx

	self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = true

	if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
		self.is_stun[successor_idx] = false
		return
	end

	self.is_stun[successor_idx] = true

	successor.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
	successor.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

	scene_util.set_anim(successor, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_emotion(successor, self, 'damaged')

	--공중에 있으면 떨어뜨림.
	if successor.Position.y > 0 then
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local fall_duration = 0.5
		local start_pos = successor.Position
		local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, successor.Position.y, 0)
		start_coroutine(function()
			while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
				if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
					self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
					self.is_stun[successor_idx] = false
					return
				end
				free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
				local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

				if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
					character_util.set_position(successor, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
				else
					character_util.set_position(successor, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
				end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			character_util.set_position(successor, vector_util.get_x0z(successor.Position, 0), true)
		end)
	end

	--1초 대기
	local time_passed = 0
	local wait_time = 1

	while time_passed < wait_time do
		if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
			self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
			self.is_stun[successor_idx] = false
			return
		end
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(successor, 0.02, 0.5)

	--0.5초 대기
	time_passed = 0
	wait_time = 0.5

	while time_passed < wait_time do
		if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
			self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
			self.is_stun[successor_idx] = false
			return
		end
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	----마리오 점프 직접 구현 character_util.mario_jump_new(successor, 'right', 0.4, 0.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
	time_passed = 0
	wait_time = 0.4
	scene_util.set_anim(successor, self, 'get')
	character_util.jump(successor, 0.3, wait_time)
	while time_passed < wait_time do
		if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
			self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
			self.is_stun[successor_idx] = false
			return
		end
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(successor)

	--0.6(0.5 + 0.1)초 대기
	time_passed = 0
	wait_time = 0.6

	while time_passed < wait_time do
		if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
			self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
			self.is_stun[successor_idx] = false
			return
		end
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
	self.is_routine_change[successor_idx] = true
	self.is_stun[successor_idx] = false

	if not self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
		scene_util.set_emotion(successor, self, 'attack')
	end

	--스턴 쿨타임
	time_passed = 0
	wait_time = 1

	self.is_stun_cool_time[successor_idx] = true

	while time_passed < wait_time do
		if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] then
			self.is_stun_cool_time[successor_idx] = false
			self.is_stun[successor_idx] = false
			return
		end
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_stun_cool_time[successor_idx] = false
end

function local_class:harden_successor_routine(successor_idx)
	local successor = self.get_successor(successor_idx)
	local routine_key = 'harden_routine' .. successor_idx

	self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = true

	while not self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] or not self.is_activity_end do
		local time_passed = 0
		local wait_time = 3

		while time_passed < wait_time do
			if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] or self.is_activity_end then
				self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
				self.is_harden[successor_idx] = false
				return
			elseif self.is_paused_harden_pattern[successor_idx] then
				self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
				self.is_harden_routine[successor_idx] = false
				self.is_harden[successor_idx] = false
				return
			end
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		time_passed = 0
		wait_time = 0.5

		--region is_harden_routine = true. 이동 루틴 멈춤
		self.is_harden_routine[successor_idx] = true
		scene_util.set_anim(successor, self, 'idle')

		while time_passed < wait_time do
			if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] or self.is_activity_end then
				self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
				self.is_harden[successor_idx] = false
				return
			elseif self.is_paused_harden_pattern[successor_idx] then
				self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
				self.is_harden_routine[successor_idx] = false
				self.is_harden[successor_idx] = false
				return
			end
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		--region is_harden = true. 스턴 및 데미지 받지 않음.
		self.is_harden[successor_idx] = true

		scene_util.set_anim(successor, self, 'boong_attack_ready_loop')
		--단단해지기!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_oghma_shield_01', parent = successor, loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(successor, { key = 'short_story_sr_lion_cave_60' })

		time_passed = 0
		wait_time = 3

		while time_passed < wait_time do
			if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] or self.is_activity_end then
				self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
				self.is_harden[successor_idx] = false
				return
			elseif self.is_paused_harden_pattern[successor_idx] then
				self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
				self.is_harden_routine[successor_idx] = false
				self.is_harden[successor_idx] = false
				return
			end
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(successor)
		self.is_harden[successor_idx] = false
		--endregion is_harden = false. 스턴 및 데미지 다시 받음.

		time_passed = 0
		wait_time = 0.5

		while time_passed < wait_time do
			if self.is_dead_successor[successor_idx] or self.is_activity_end then
				self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
				self.is_harden[successor_idx] = false
				return
			elseif self.is_paused_harden_pattern[successor_idx] then
				self.waypoint_routine_info[routine_key] = nil
				self.is_harden_routine[successor_idx] = false
				self.is_harden[successor_idx] = false
				return
			end
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShuranMain @
		Comment = 윈링이 들어가는 모습을 보고 원걸과 난옥이 계략를 짜는 씬 @

-- 윈링을 보며 원걸과 난옥이 계략을 짜는 씬
function local_class:opening_scene()
	local shuran_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_shuran_pos_1')

	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()

	self.dynamic_jungpa_master = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		jungpa_master_silhouette = 'shortstory_sr_jungpa_master_silhouette' })

	local jungpa_master = self.dynamic_jungpa_master['jungpa_master_silhouette']
	local nanok = self.controller.get_nanok()

	do
		-- 윈링 세팅

		-- 윈링 방향 조절
		scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'left', false)
		character_util.set_position(shuran, shuran_pos)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	end

	do
		-- 원걸 세팅

		-- 원걸 방향 조절
		scene_util.set_direction(jungpa_master, 'up', false)
		character_util.add_color(jungpa_master, jungpa_master.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		character_util.set_active_state(jungpa_master, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(jungpa_master, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_jungpa_master_pos_1'))
		jungpa_master.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	end

	do
		-- 난옥 세팅

		-- 난옥 방향 조절
		scene_util.set_direction(nanok, 'up', false)
		character_util.add_color(nanok, nanok.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.9, 0)
		character_util.set_active_state(nanok, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(nanok, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_nanok_pos_1'))
		nanok.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	end

	local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_camera_pos') - vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(target_pos, 0)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 화면 1초 간 circular 페이드 인
	local amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_forest_03'
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', fade_in_time = 3 })

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	wp_util.move_async(shuran, target_pos, 4, nil)
	stage_camera:SetTarget(shuran)

	-- 윈링 (left, damaged,cast2): 으으으… 피곤해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left', 'cast2', 'damaged'
	, 'short_story_sr_s1_1')

	-- 윈링 (left, tired, bomb_idle): 어제 약초 한 더미만 더 캔다는 게 너무 무리했네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left', 'bomb_idle', 'tired'
	, 'short_story_sr_s1_2')

	-- 윈링 (left, mad, idle): 진짜 그 아프다고 난리친 할아버지만 아니였어도…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left', 'nil'
	, { name = 'mad', keep = true }, 'short_story_sr_s1_3')

	-- 윈링 (left, mad, idle)(jump1회): 이래놓고 안 오기만 해봐!
	character_util.normal_jump(shuran, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left', 'nil'
	, 'mad', 'short_story_sr_s1_4')

	-- 윈링 좌측 3칸 이동 속도는 4
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_shuran_pos_2'), 4, nil
	, { last_direction = 'up' })

	-- 윈링(up,idle,idle): 진짜 말도 안되게 쓴 약을 처방해 줄테니까!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuran, 'short_story_sr_s1_5')

	-- 대사 진행 후 윈링 (left, idle, idle) 상태 출력 후 아래 동선으로 4 속도로 걸어서 이동 
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_shuran_pos_3')
	, 4, nil)

	do
		-- 윈링 퇴장

		-- 윈링 애니메이션 이모션 제거
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(shuran, 0, 0.5)
		wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 1, nil)
	end

	-- 카메라가 아래로 내려오는 연출
	-- 윈링이 사라지고 1초 뒤 카메라는 2초에 걸쳐 2번 카메라 위치까지 아래와 같이 이동
	local target_camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	camera_util.move_async(target_camera_pos, 0)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_position(shuran, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(shuran, 1, 0)

	local blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true
	, volume = 0.5, fade_in_time = 3 })

	target_camera_pos = target_camera_pos - vector(0, 0, 4)
	camera_util.move_async(target_camera_pos, 2)

	-- (1번) 의 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_silence 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(nanok, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(jungpa_master, nil, 'silence')

	-- 난옥(up, idle): 정말 네가 전달한 정보가 확실한 거겠지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(nanok, 'short_story_sr_s1_6')

	-- 원걸(up, idle): 내 전부를 걸고 얻은 정보이니 따라만 주시면 되오.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(jungpa_master, 'short_story_sr_s1_7')

	-- 난옥(up, idle): 전부라… 그토록 문파를 증오하다니 아주 재밌군.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(nanok, 'short_story_sr_s1_8')

	-- 난옥 뛰어 내려가는 연출
	local function jump_nanok()
		-- 난옥 get 애니메이션
		scene_util.set_anim(nanok, self, 'get')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(nanok, 2, 0.5)
		wp_util.move_async(nanok, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_nanok_pos_2')
		, nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'up' })

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(nanok, 2, 0.75)
		wp_util.move_async(nanok, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_nanok_pos_3')
		, nil, 0.75, { last_direction = 'up' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(nanok)
		blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(3)
	end

	start_coroutine(jump_nanok)

	-- 0.3초 뒤
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	do
		-- 원걸 (up, jump)모션으로 뒤따라 뛰어내림

		-- 원걸 점프
		scene_util.set_anim(jungpa_master, self, 'get')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(jungpa_master, 2, 0.5)
		wp_util.move_async(jungpa_master, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_jungpa_master_pos_2')
		, nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'up' })
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(jungpa_master, 2, 0.75)
		wp_util.move_async(jungpa_master, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_jungpa_master_pos_3')
		, nil, 0.75, { last_direction = 'up' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(jungpa_master)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 페이드 아웃
	amb_sfx:FadeOut(3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_color(nanok, nanok.Name, 0)
	nanok.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	character_util.remove_color(jungpa_master, jungpa_master.Name, 0)
	jungpa_master.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_active_state(nanok, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(jungpa_master, 'disabled')

	self:enter_pharmacy()
end

-- 윈링이 약방에 도착한 연출
function local_class:enter_pharmacy()
	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()

	-- 윈링 시작 위치에서, 이동 속도 1.5로 빨간 화살표를 따라 3칸 이동
	local shuran_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_shuran_pos_4')
	scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'up', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)
	character_util.set_position(shuran, shuran_pos)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 카메라는 계속 윈링을 중심에 두고 1번 위치에서 2번 위치로 이동함
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran.Position + vector(0, 0, 4)
	, 1.5, nil)

	-- 윈링(left, tired, cross_arm): 오늘은 조금 늦어버렸네. 서둘러야 겠어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, { dir = 'left', sfx = false }
	, { name = 'cross_arm', keep = true }, 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s1_9')

	-- 윈링(left, idle, cast): 매대랑 준비해 둔 약만 빠르게 확인하자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left', nil
	, 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s1_10')

	-- 윈링 (left, attack, victory_get) 출력 이후 플레이어 컨트롤 풀리며 2섹션 진행 시작
	scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'left', false)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'victory_get')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)

	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.remove_anim(shuran)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	local path = 'Quest/ShortStory/Shuran/Common/ShuranPharmacy'
	self.pharmacy = get_or_create_global_table(path)

	-- 선반 두개 상호작용 가능하면서 퀘스트 마커 세팅
	local interacting_shelf = { 2, 5, 6 }
	for i = 1, #interacting_shelf do
		local shelf = self.pharmacy.get_shelf(interacting_shelf[i])
		shelf.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(shelf.Name, self.controller.quest_id, true, shelf)
	end

	self.elixir_check_state = { false, false, false }
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.check_medicine

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.pharmacy:dispose()
	self.pharmacy = nil

	self.elixir_check_state = nil
	self.interact_counter_func = nil

	self.fx = nil
	self.interact_func = nil
	self.patient_group_spec = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.check_medicine then
		local shelf = self.pharmacy.get_shelf(2)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, shelf) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_b_shelf, self, shelf)
			return true
		end

		shelf = self.pharmacy.get_shelf(5)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, shelf) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_e_shelf, self, shelf)
			return true
		end

		shelf = self.pharmacy.get_shelf(6)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, shelf) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_f_shelf, self, shelf)
			return true
		end

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.enter_customer then
		local pharmacy_counter = self.pharmacy.get_counter()

		-- 카운터의 상호작용
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, pharmacy_counter) then
			start_coroutine(self.interact_counter_func[self.cur_delivery_event_index], self, pharmacy_counter)
			return true
		end

		return self.pharmacy:interact_shelf(self, e.Target, self.controller.get_shuran(),
				function(elixir_id)
					-- 영약을 처음 얻었을 때라면 카운터로 마커 이동
					if self.cur_have_elixir_id < 0 then
						self.pharmacy:dispose_quest_marker_for_shelf()
						self.pharmacy:set_quest_marker_for_counter(self.controller)
					end

					-- 소지 엘릭서 id 세팅
					self.cur_have_elixir_id = elixir_id
				end)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.already_open and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_open_pharmacy_zone_1') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_customer
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_customer_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()

	self.elixir_check_state[1] = true
	quest_marker_util.remove(shelf.Name)
	shelf.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 정렬
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, shelf.Position - vector(0, 0, 1), 2, nil
	, { last_direction = 'left' })

	-- 윈링(right, idle, eat) 동작 1초 간 출력 후 대화 진행

	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'eat')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(shuran)

	-- 윈링(left, smile, idle): 좋아, 어제 고생한걸로 할아버지 약은 충분하겠어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left', nil
	, 'smile', 'short_story_sr_s2_1')

	-- 윈링(left, sleep_deep, cross_arm): 빨리 몸이 나으셔야 내가 이 고생을 안할텐데.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left', 'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep'
	, 'short_story_sr_s2_2')

	-- 모든 선반을 확인 했는지 체크하는 로직
	if self:is_all_elixir_check() then
		self:complete_shelf_check(shuran)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

	shelf.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 정렬
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, shelf.Position - vector(1, 0, 0), 2, nil
	, { last_direction = 'right' })

	-- 윈링(right, idle, eat) 동작 1초 간 출력 후 대화 진행
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'eat')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(shuran)

	-- 윈링(tired , idle): 영양환은 생각보다 많이 안팔렸잖아?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', nil
	, 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s2_3')

	-- 윈링(idle , question): 약효를 조금 더 상세하게 쓸 필요가 있으려나?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'question'
	, nil, 'short_story_sr_s2_4')

	-- 모든 선반을 확인 했는지 체크하는 로직
	if self:is_all_elixir_check() then
		self:complete_shelf_check(shuran)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- 모든 선반을 다 체크 후 연출
function local_class:complete_shelf_check(shuran)
	-- 윈링(left/right, smile, clap): 좋았어, 크게 문제는 없는 거 같네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, nil, 'clap', 'smile'
	, 'short_story_sr_s2_5')

	-- 윈링(left.right, idle, nod): 이제 문만 열면 되겠어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, nil, 'nod', nil
	, 'short_story_sr_s2_6')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.already_open

	local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_shuran_pos_1') - vector(0, 0, 4)
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point('open_pharmacy', self.controller.quest_id
	, true, target_pos)
end

-- 모든 선반을 다 체크 했는지 확인하는 로직
function local_class:is_all_elixir_check()
	for i = 1, #self.elixir_check_state do
		if self.elixir_check_state[i] == false then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

--endregion 약방 준비 전 연출 

-- 윈링이 약방을 열러가는 연출
function local_class:enter_customer_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	quest_marker_util.remove('open_pharmacy')

	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_shuran_pos_1'), 3, nil
	, { last_direction = 'down' })

	-- 손님 세팅
	local customer_list = {}
	for i = 1, #self.customer_group_spec do
		local spec = self.customer_group_spec[i]
		local npc = get_character(spec.npc_name)

		scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'up', false)
		character_util.set_position(npc, spec.start_pos - vector(0, 0, 1))
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

		table.insert(customer_list, npc)
	end

	local move_end_key = 'move_end_key'

	-- 이후 윈링 아래와 같이 이동하며 대사 출력
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuran, shuran.Position - vector(0, 0, 2.5)
	, 2, nil, self, move_end_key)

	-- 윈링(down, idle, idle): 조금 늦긴 했는데 많이 기다리고 있진 않겠지?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuran, 'short_story_sr_s2_7')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 대사 출력될 때, 윈링 (down, surprise, idle) 상태로 jump 1회 진행
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(shuran, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 아래의 위치에서 [shout] 말풍선 대사 출력
	-- 윈링 양! 빨리 문 좀 열어봐요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_doorknock_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(customer_list[1], 'short_story_sr_s2_8', true
	, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.3), scale = 1.3 })

	-- 윈링(down,tired,qeustion): 많이 늦었나…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'down', 'question', 'tired'
	, 'short_story_sr_s2_9')

	-- 윈링 (X28.5 / Z81.75) 위치까지 이동 후 (down,idle,push) 상태
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, vector(28.5, 0, 82), 4, nil)
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'push')

	-- QTE 발생 (UP) 실패 X
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	qte_play_util.swipe('up')

	-- 입력시
	-- 윈링(down,idle,bomb_idle) 0.5초 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_push_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이때 화면 shake0.1 /0.3초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	-- 윈링 (surprise,idle)(jump1회) 후 0.5초간 1칸 위로 뒷걸음질 (walk)
	character_util.remove_anim(shuran)
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(shuran, '01_player_jump_01')

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuran, shuran.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	, nil, 0.5, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = 'down' })

	-- 화면 중앙 shout말풍선 : 열렸다! 열렸어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_06')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(customer_list[1], 'short_story_sr_s2_9_1', true
	, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5), scale = 1.2 })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 대화창 꺼지면 화면 전체 shake 0.05 세기로 출력되고 위와 같이 NPC가 등장
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_03')
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 9999)

	-- 1~10 NPC (up, run) 모션 출력한 상태로 7의 속도로 입장
	for i = 1, #customer_list do
		local npc = customer_list[i]

		-- 스모크 매니저에 등록
		stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(npc)

		npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

		-- npc들 4칸 뛰어 올라옴
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, customer_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 4)
		, 7, nil, self, move_end_key, { run = true })
	end

	-- 윈링 회피 연출
	local function runaway_shuran()
		wait_for_sec(0.15)

		wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran.Position + vector(0, 0, 3.5), 7, nil
		, { play_sfx = true, run = true })

		scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'prostrate')
		character_util.jump(shuran, 0.75, 0.3)
		wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran.Position - vector(1.25, 0, 0), 5, nil
		, { play_sfx = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'damaged')
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(shuran)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(shuran)
		self.fx:hit():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(shuran.Position, 0.05))
	end

	start_coroutine(runaway_shuran)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gong_01', loop = false, volume = 0.7 })

	-- 이후 NPC 들은 아래와 같은 동선으로 이동되며 카메라는 넘어져있는 윈링을 계속 비춤
	for i = 1, #self.customer_group_spec do
		local spec = self.customer_group_spec[i]
		local npc = customer_list[i]

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, spec.move_way_point_list
		, 7, nil, self, move_end_key, { run = true, last_direction = spec.last_dir
				, end_callback = function()
						character_util.stop(npc)
						character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
						if spec.anim ~= nil then
							character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = spec.anim })
						end

						if spec.emotion ~= nil then
							character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = spec.emotion })
						end
						npc.Interactable.Talk = spec.interact_string_key
						npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = spec.talk_sfx
					end })
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2, volume = 0.6 })

	-- 스모크 매니저 등록 제거
	for i = 1, #self.customer_group_spec do
		local npc = customer_list[i]
		npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
		stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(npc)
	end

	-- 윈링 일어남
	scene_util.shake_and_wakeup(shuran, 'left', 2, 'attack', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	-- 윈링 (right, mad, release 2회):  약 받으러온 사람들이 왜 이렇게 쌩쌩한거야!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false }
	, { name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'mad', 'short_story_sr_s2_10')

	-- 윈링 (right, tired, idle):  왜 내 약방은 항상 이런 분위기로 시작하는거지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', nil
	, 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s2_11')

	-- 윈링 (right, tired, question): 부모님 시절엔 이 정도는 아니였던 거 같은데.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', { name = 'question', keep = true }
	, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'short_story_sr_s2_12')

	-- 카메라 1초간 ( 6 )번 할아버지 한테 이동 후 0.3초 대기
	camera_util.move_async(customer_list[6].Position, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)
	scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'up', false)

	-- 할아버지 (down,idle,idle): 윈링아, 조금 뛰었더니 더 아픈 거 같다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_master_shout_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(customer_list[6], 'short_story_sr_s2_13', true)

	-- 할아버지 (down,idle,release): 어서 약좀 주려무나.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(customer_list[6], self, 'down'
	, 'release', nil, 'short_story_sr_s2_13_1')

	-- 카메라 1초간 다시 윈링에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	scene_util.set_direction(customer_list[6], 'left', false)

	-- 윈링(up, idle, idle)(jump1회): 금방 갈게요! 기다려요!
	character_util.normal_jump(shuran, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuran, 'short_story_sr_s2_14')

	-- 퀘스트 마커를 카운터에
	self.pharmacy:set_quest_marker_for_counter(self.controller)

	-- 군중 sfx 세팅
	self.controller:set_crowd_buzz_sfx()

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_customer

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- 첫번째 손님이랑 대화 및 전달 이벤트 시작
function local_class:start_delivery_event(pharmacy_counter)
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 정렬
	party_util.align_party(pharmacy_counter.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	local spec = self.customer_group_spec[1]
	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()
	local customer = get_character(spec.npc_name)

	-- 윈링(right, smile, idle): 어떤 약이 필요하세요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', nil, 'smile'
	, 'short_story_sr_s2_15')

	-- 1번 NPC(left, blush, cast): 어제 폭포를 맞으면서 수련을 했더니 감기에 걸린 것 같아요. 콜록.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(customer, 'short_story_sr_s2_16')

	-- 1번 NPC(left, blush, cast): 열도 나고… 콜록… 계속… 콜록.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.shake(customer, 0.03, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(customer, 'short_story_sr_s2_17')

	-- 윈링(right, idle, idle): 말은 최대한 안하는 게 좋아요. 얼른 약 가져올게요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuran, 'short_story_sr_s2_18')

	-- 선반 상호작용 가능하도록 변경
	self.pharmacy:interactable_shelf()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 세팅
	self.pharmacy:dispose_quest_marker_for_count()
	self.pharmacy:set_quest_marker_for_shelf(self.controller)

	self.cur_delivery_event_index = self.cur_delivery_event_index + 1

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

-- 첫번째 손님 상호작용 연출
function local_class:interact_first_customer(pharmacy_counter)
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local spec = self.customer_group_spec[1]
	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()
	local customer = get_character(spec.npc_name)

	-- 정렬
	party_util.align_party(pharmacy_counter.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	local is_wrong_elixir = self.cur_have_elixir_id ~= spec.need_elixir_id
	local send_elixir_id = self.cur_have_elixir_id

	-- 공통 영약 전달 연출
	local elixir = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = shuran.Position + vector(0.25, 1, -0.25),
		itemid = self.cur_have_elixir_id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		sprscale = 1,
		showoncharacter = true,
		skip_text = is_wrong_elixir,
	})
	self:common_delivery_scene(shuran, elixir)
	self.cur_have_elixir_id = -1

	character_util.remove_anim(customer)

	-- 잘못된 영약을 전달할 경우
	if is_wrong_elixir then
		scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(customer)

		if send_elixir_id == 21099 then
			-- 1번 NPC(left, tired, idle): 콜록… 노, 노쇠요? 제가 나이가 그렇게 많아보이시나요?
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(customer, self, 'left', nil, 'tired'
			, 'short_story_sr_s2_32')
		else
			-- 1번 NPC(left, tired, idle): 제, 제가 수련하다 어디가 삔 건 아닌데요….
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(customer, self, 'left', nil, 'tired'
			, 'short_story_sr_s2_34_1')
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(customer, self, 'blush')

		-- 윈링(right, surprise, idle): 어라? 제가 잠깐 착각했나봐요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuran, 'short_story_sr_s2_33')

		-- 윈링(right, damaged, cast): 감기에 잘 드는 약으로 금방 가져다 드릴게요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'cast', 'damaged'
		, 'short_story_sr_s2_34')

		-- 영약 다시 회수
		self:common_retrieve_elixir_scene(shuran, elixir)

		return
	end

	-- 1번 NPC(left, blush, idle): 저한테 잘 맞는 약이네요. 감사합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(customer, 'short_story_sr_s2_35')

	-- 1번 NPC(left, tried, idle): 언제까지 이렇게 내공을 수련해야 할까요…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(customer, self, 'left', nil
	, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'short_story_sr_s2_36')

	-- 1번 NPC(left, tired, cast): 먹기만 해도 내공이 오르는 약이 있다면 좋겠어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(customer, self, 'left', 'cast', nil
	, 'short_story_sr_s2_37')

	-- 윈링(right, idle, idle): 그런 약을 팔 수 있었으면 진작에 잔뜩 팔고 부자가 됐겠죠.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'bomb_idle', nil
	, 'short_story_sr_s2_38')

	-- 윈링(right, sleep_deep, question): 최소한 재료로 영물의 내단 정도는 써야 한다니까요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'question', 'sleep_deep'
	, 'short_story_sr_s2_39')

	-- 1번 NPC(left, blush, idle): 그렇겠죠… 빨리 감기부터 나아야겠어요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(customer, 'short_story_sr_s2_40')

	elixir.ConsumeTarget = customer
	elixir:Fly()
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	local move_end_key = 'customer_move_end'

	-- 손님 퇴장
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(customer)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(customer, customer.Position - vector(0, 0, 8)
	, 4, nil, self, move_end_key)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 남은 손님 두명 앞으로 땡김
	local second_customer = get_character(self.customer_group_spec[3].npc_name)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(second_customer, second_customer.Position - vector(1, 0, 0)
	, 2, nil, self, move_end_key)

	local third_customer = get_character(self.customer_group_spec[6].npc_name)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(third_customer, third_customer.Position - vector(1, 0, 0)
	, 2, nil, self, move_end_key)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	character_util.set_active_state(customer, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_position(customer, vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- 윈링(right, smile, idle): 안녕하세요. 어떤 약이 필요하실까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', nil
	, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'short_story_sr_s2_41')

	-- 3번 NPC(left, idle, salute_china 1회): 소인 수련을 하다 발목이 다쳐서 왔소.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(second_customer, self, 'left', 'salute_china', nil
	, 'short_story_sr_s2_42')

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.delivery_elixir then
		local pharmacy_counter = self.pharmacy.get_counter()

		-- 영약을 가져오고 카운터의 상호작용 했을 때
		if self.cur_have_elixir_id > 0 and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, pharmacy_counter) then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.delivery_elixir_scene, self, pharmacy_counter)
			return true
		end

		-- 선반에 상호작용 했을 때
		return self.pharmacy:interact_shelf(self, e.Target, self.controller.get_shuran(),
				function(elixir_id)
					-- 영약을 처음 얻었을 때라면 카운터로 마커 이동
					if self.cur_have_elixir_id < 0 then
						self.pharmacy:dispose_quest_marker_for_shelf()
						self.pharmacy:set_quest_marker_for_counter(self.controller)
					end

					-- 소지 엘릭서 id 세팅
					self.cur_have_elixir_id = elixir_id
				end)
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.recovery_jungpa_master then
		local jungpa_master = self.controller.get_jungpa_master()

		-- 원걸에게 상호작용 했을 때 
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, jungpa_master) then
			if self.cur_have_elixir_id < 0 then
				-- 원걸:  으윽
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(jungpa_master, { key = 'short_story_sr_s3_53_1' })
			else
				sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_jungpa_master, self)
			end

			return true
		end

		return self.pharmacy:interact_shelf(self, e.Target, self.controller.get_shuran(),
				function(elixir_id)
					-- 영약을 처음 얻었을 때라면 원걸에게 마커 세팅
					if self.cur_have_elixir_id < 0 then
						self.pharmacy:dispose_quest_marker_for_shelf()
						quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(jungpa_master.Name
						, self.controller.quest_id, true, jungpa_master)
					end

					-- 소지 엘릭서 id 세팅
					self.cur_have_elixir_id = elixir_id
				end)
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.prepare_an_elixir then
		local super_elixir = self.get_super_elixir()

		-- 화온단 재료 선반에 상호작용 했을 때 
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, super_elixir) then
			start_coroutine(self.interact_super_elixir, self, super_elixir)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.prepare_an_elixir then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's3_leave_pharmacy_zone') then
		-- 화온단 재료를 챙기지 않고 약방을 나가려고할 때
		sp_util.start_scene(self.leave_pharmacy_before_taking_elixir, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
