-- 난옥이 등장해서 영약을 요구하는 씬
function local_class:opening_scene()
	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()
	local nanok = self.controller.get_nanok()

	local nanok_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_nanok_pos_1')

	local camouflage_sapa_count = 2

	do
		-- 난옥 세팅 
		-- 난옥 좌표 세팅
		character_util.set_position(nanok, nanok_pos)
		character_util.set_active_state(nanok, 'enabled')
		scene_util.set_direction(nanok, 'up', false)
	end

	do
		-- 위장한 사파 세팅
		for i = 1, camouflage_sapa_count do
			local camouflage_sapa = self.dynamic_npc_list['s3_camouflage_sapa_' .. i]
			camouflage_sapa.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

			local pos = nanok_pos + vector(i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1, 0, 0)
			character_util.set_position(camouflage_sapa, pos)
			character_util.set_active_state(camouflage_sapa, 'enabled')

			scene_util.set_direction(camouflage_sapa, 'up', false)
		end
	end

	-- 3섹션 부터 시작 했다면
	local is_cur_section_start = self.controller.starting_inner_progress >= 2
	if is_cur_section_start then
		sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

		self:set_pharmacy_customer()

		character_util.set_position(shuran, field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_shuran_pos_1'))
		scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'right', false)

		self.controller:set_crowd_buzz_sfx()

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6 })

		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	end

	-- 윈링(sleep_deep,bomb_idle)  : 그래도 당장 급한 환자들은 끝낸 거 같네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'bomb_idle', 'sleep_deep'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_1')

	-- 윈링(down) 방향으로 전환
	scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 카메라가 1초간 하단 그리드 끝까지 이동한다. ( x 28.5 중심 )
	local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_nanok_pos_2')
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_push_01')

	local move_end_key = 's3_move_end'

	for i = 1, camouflage_sapa_count do
		local camouflage_sapa = self.dynamic_npc_list['s3_camouflage_sapa_' .. i]
		local pos = camera_pos + vector(i % 2 == 0 and 1 or -1, 0, 0)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(camouflage_sapa, pos, 4, nil, self, move_end_key)
	end

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(nanok, camera_pos, 4, nil, self, move_end_key)
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)
	stage_camera:SetTarget(nanok)

	local sapa_move_spec = {
		{
			pos_list = {
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_camouflage_sapa_pos_1_1'),
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_camouflage_sapa_pos_1_2')
			},
			dir = 'left',
		},
		{
			pos_list = {
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_camouflage_sapa_pos_2_1'),
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_camouflage_sapa_pos_2_2')
			},
			dir = 'right',
		}
	}

	for i = 1, camouflage_sapa_count do
		local camouflage_sapa = self.dynamic_npc_list['s3_camouflage_sapa_' .. i]

		local move_spec = sapa_move_spec[i]

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(camouflage_sapa, move_spec.pos_list
		, 4, nil, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = move_spec.dir })
	end

	-- 이동이 끝나면 (x28.5 z81) 위치에 난옥 (sr_sapa_nanok) 이 속도 4(walk) 모션으로 위로 올라온다.
	wp_util.move_async(nanok, field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_nanok_pos_3')
	, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	-- 난옥이 (x28.5) (z95) 위치까지 이동하였다면 (left,idle,idle) 0.5초 
	-- 이때 윈링(right)방향
	scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'right', true)

	-- 카메라 0.5초 동안 윈링에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 난옥이 속도 3으로 (walk) 좌측 1.5칸 이동한다.
	wp_util.move_async(nanok, field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_nanok_pos_4')
	, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	-- 윈링(right,tired,idle): 찾으시는 약이라도 있으실까요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', nil, 'tired'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_2')

	-- 난옥(left,doyagao,idle): 이곳에 아주 굉장한 약이 있다고 들었는데.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'left', nil
	, { name = 'doyagao', keep = true }, 'short_story_sr_s3_3')

	-- 난옥(left,doyagao,bomb_idle): 먹기만 해도 내공의 수위가 단숨에 절정의 경지로 오르는 약 말이야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'left', 'bomb_idle'
	, nil, 'short_story_sr_s3_4')

	-- 윈링(smile,nod 2회):아… 단숨에 절정의 경지로 오르는 약이요? 알겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'nod', 'smile'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_5')

	character_util.remove_emotion(nanok)

	-- 윈링 속도4 (walk)로 상단 2칸 이동 후 좌측 4칸 이동
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, {
		shuran.Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
		shuran.Position + vector(-4, 0, 2),
	}, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	-- 윈링(tired,bomb_idle): 또 어디서 바보같은 얘기를 듣고 온 모양이네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left', 'bomb_idle', 'tired'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_6')

	-- 윈링(sleep_deep,nod2회): 적당히 아무 약이나 쥐어주면 알아서 착각하겠지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left', 'nod', 'sleep_deep'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_7')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	self.pharmacy:set_quest_marker_for_shelf(self.controller)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.delivery_elixir

	-- 3섹션 부터 시작 했다면 컨트롤 스타트 이벤트 날림
	if is_cur_section_start then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- 약방 손님들 세팅 (3섹션부터 시작할 때)
function local_class:set_pharmacy_customer()
	-- 기존 약방 손님들 위치에 세팅
	for i = 1, #self.customer_spec do
		local spec = self.customer_spec[i]
		local npc = get_character(spec.npc_name)

		character_util.set_position(npc, spec.pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(npc, spec.dir)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

		if spec.emotion ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, spec.emotion)
		end

		if spec.anim ~= nil then
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = spec.anim, one_shot_sfx = false })
		end

		npc.Interactable.Talk = spec.interact_string_key
		npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = spec.talk_sfx
	end

	do
		-- 원걸 세팅

		-- 원걸
		local jungpa_master = self.controller.get_jungpa_master()
		character_util.set_position(jungpa_master, field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_customer_pos_8_4'))
		scene_util.set_direction(jungpa_master, 'right')
		character_util.set_active_state(jungpa_master, 'enabled')
		jungpa_master.Interactable.Talk = 'short_story_sr_s2_customer_8'
	end
end

-- 난옥에게 아무 영약이나 줄 때 연출
function local_class:delivery_elixir_scene(pharmacy_counter)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()
	local nanok = self.controller.get_nanok()
	local jungpa_master = self.controller.get_jungpa_master()
	jungpa_master.Interactable.Talk = nil

	party_util.align_party(pharmacy_counter.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	local sapa_count = 7

	do
		-- 만귀종 등장 위치에 세팅 로직
		-- 만귀종 초기 좌표용
		local cur_target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_nanok_pos_1')

		-- 만귀종 멤버 세팅
		for i = 1, sapa_count do
			local sapa = self.dynamic_npc_list['s2_sapa_' .. i]
			local target_x = i % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1
			cur_target_pos = cur_target_pos + vector(target_x, 0, -0.5)

			stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(sapa)
			scene_util.set_direction(sapa, 'up', false)
			character_util.set_position(sapa, cur_target_pos)
			character_util.set_active_state(sapa, 'enabled')
		end
	end

	local customer_list = {}

	-- 도망갈 손님들 세팅
	for i = 1, #self.customer_spec do
		local customer = get_character(self.customer_spec[i].npc_name)
		table.insert(customer_list, customer)
	end

	-- 테이블 위에 윈링이 환단 스프라이트를 내려놓는다.
	local elixir = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = shuran.Position + vector(0.25, 1, -0.25),
		itemid = self.cur_have_elixir_id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		sprscale = 1,
		-- showoncharacter = true
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'push')
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(shuran, vector(0.25, 0, 0), 0.4, 0.3)
	drop_item_util.move_item(elixir, shuran.Position + vector(1, 1, -0.25)
	, { duration = 0.4 })
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	character_util.remove_anim(shuran)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 윈링(right,idle,idle): 여기있습니다. 손님.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuran, 'short_story_sr_s3_8')

	-- 난옥(idle,bomb_idle): 이게 내가 찾던 절정의 경지로 오르는 약이라고?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'left', 'bomb_idle', nil
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_9')

	-- 윈링(right,smile,nod2회): 맞아요. 손님.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'nod', 'smile'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_10')

	-- 윈링(right,smile,clap): 한입만 드셔도 온 몸에 기운이 솟는 걸 아실걸요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'clap', 'smile'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_11')

	-- 난옥(sleep_deep,cross_arm) (silence) 이모티콘 버블
	scene_util.set_emotion(nanok, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(nanok, self, 'cross_arm')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(nanok, nil, 'silence')

	-- 이때 윈링(surprise)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(shuran, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 이때 화면 shake 0.1 /0.3초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	local move_end_key = 'nanok_move_end'

	character_util.remove_anim(nanok)
	scene_util.set_emotion(nanok, self, 'mad')
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(nanok, nanok.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0), 2
	, nil, self, move_end_key, {
				locked_dir = 'left',
				end_callback = function()
					scene_util.set_anim(nanok, self, { name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop', loop = false })
				end
			})

	-- 난옥(mad,boong_attack_ready_loop)[shout]: 지금 누굴 속이려 들어?!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(nanok, 'short_story_sr_s3_12')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	local mod_key = 'throw_elixir'
	time_util.mod(mod_key, 0.5)

	-- QTE 발생 (down) 실패 X
	-- QTE 입력시 이벤트 재생
	-- 타임스케일 0.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	qte_play_util.swipe('down', { darken = true, anim_unscaled_time = true })

	-- 동시에 0.5 초 동안 윈링(down,damaged,prostrate 0.2속도) y 0.4 뛰어오르는 동시에 하단으로 1칸 이동
	scene_util.set_anim(nanok, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false })
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'prostrate')

	character_util.jump(shuran, 0.4, 0.5)
	wp_util.move(shuran, shuran.Position - vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 0.5, {
		end_callback = function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
		end
	})

	local target_pos = elixir.Position - vector(3.5, 0, 0)
	do
		-- 영약 날라가는 연출
		-- 동시에 난옥 앞에 스프라이트 속도7로 1초에 4번 회전하며 좌측으로 이동 0.5초 후 fx_dead와 함께 소멸
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		self.fx:hit():Instantiate(nanok.Position + vector(-0.75, 0.8, 0))

		local air_spin_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_air_spin_01', loop = true })
		drop_item_util.move_item(elixir, target_pos, { angle = 1440, duration = 0.5 })

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		time_util.unmod(mod_key)
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		-- 스프라이트 소멸할 때 화면 shake 0.1 /0.3초
		air_spin_sfx:Stop()
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', loop = false, volume = 0.7 })
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
		self.fx:dead():Instantiate(target_pos)
		elixir:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 윈링 (right) 방향으로 마리오 점프 기상
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'attack')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(shuran, 'right')

	-- 이때 난옥(down) 방향 
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(nanok)
	scene_util.set_direction(nanok, 'down', false)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(nanok, nanok.Position - vector(0.25, 0, 0), 2
	, nil, self, move_end_key)

	-- 윈링 (mad,release): 지금 뭐하는 거야?! 여긴 가문 대대로 내려온 가게라고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'release', 'mad'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_13')

	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'attack')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 난옥(sleep_deep,idle): 그래… 바로 네 가문.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'left', nil, 'sleep_deep'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_14')

	-- 이때 화면 sahke0.1 / 0.2초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)

	-- 이때 윈링(surprise,idle)(jump 1회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(shuran, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 이때 NPC들 (surprise,idle)(jump 1회)
	for i = 1, #customer_list do
		local customer = customer_list[i]

-- 원걸에서 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_jungpa_master()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()
	local jungpa_master = self.controller.get_jungpa_master()

	-- 윈링이 속도4로 원걸 좌측 0.5칸에 정렬
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, jungpa_master.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0), 2, nil
	, { last_direction = 'right' })

	-- 윈링(right,idle,eat)0.5초
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)

	-- 윈링 속도 4 (walk)로 0.5칸 좌측으로 뒷걸음질
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0), 2, nil
	, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	-- 잘못된 영약을 원걸에게 전달 했을 때
	local function send_wrong_elixir(string_key)
		local shake_count = 2

		-- 원걸 Shake로 두번 부들부들 거림
		for _ = 1, shake_count do
			scene_util.shake(jungpa_master, 0.03, 0.3)
			wait_for_sec(0.6)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		-- 윈링(right,tired,question): 흠… 열이 나긴 하지만 내상의 문제는 아닌 것 같아.
		-- 윈링(right,tired,question): 아직 젊어보여서 기를 보충한다고 나아지진 않겠지.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'question', 'tired'
		, string_key)

		-- 들고 있는 엘릭서 초기화
		self.cur_have_elixir_id = -1

		-- 원걸퀘스트 마커 제거
		quest_marker_util.remove(jungpa_master.Name)

		-- 선반에 다시 퀘스트마커
		self.pharmacy:set_quest_marker_for_shelf(self.controller)

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	end

	-- 올바르지 않은 영약을 가져왔을 때
	if self.cur_have_elixir_id == 21113 then
		send_wrong_elixir('short_story_sr_s3_54')
		return
	elseif self.cur_have_elixir_id == 21099 then
		send_wrong_elixir('short_story_sr_s3_54_1')
		return
	end

	self:recovery_jungpa_master_scene(shuran, jungpa_master)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

-- 올바른 영약으로 원걸을 회복시킨 이후 연출
function local_class:recovery_jungpa_master_scene(shuran, jungpa_master)
	self:dispose_pharmacy()
	quest_marker_util.remove(jungpa_master.Name)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(jungpa_master, self.controller)

	-- 원걸 (confused, prostrate)(shake0.03 / 0.5초)
	scene_util.shake(jungpa_master, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

function local_class:interact_super_elixir(super_elixir)
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(super_elixir.Name)
	
	local shuran = self.controller.get_shuran()

	local shelf_object_count = 2
	for i = 1, shelf_object_count do
		table.insert(shelf_objects, self.get_s3_shelf(i))
	end

	-- 윈링 (X 14.5 / Y 94.5) 위치에 (left,damaged,push) 상태로 정렬
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, super_elixir.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'push')

	-- QTE (right) 발생 (실패 X)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	qte_play_util.swipe('right')

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)

	local duration = 1
	character_util.shake(shuran, 0.03, duration)
	wp_util.move(shuran, shuran.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, duration
	, { locked_dir = 'left' })

	do
		-- 선반 이동 로직

		-- 시간
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos_list = { shelf_objects[1].Position, shelf_objects[2].Position }
		local end_pos_list = {
			shelf_objects[1].Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			shelf_objects[2].Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
		}

		for i = 1, #shelf_objects do
			field_object_util.shake(shelf_objects[i], 0.03, duration)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_up_01')
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			for i = 1, #shelf_objects do
				local shelf = shelf_objects[i]
				local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos_list[i], end_pos_list[i], progress)
				shelf.Position = cur_pos
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)

	do
		-- 윈링 속도 4로 위로 1.5칸 이동 후 / 좌측으로 1칸 이동 후 / 아래로 1.5칸 이동

		-- 윈링 이동
		wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 4, nil)
		scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'down')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran.Position - vector(1.35, 0, 0), 4, nil)
		scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'down')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran.Position - vector(0, 0, 1.5), 4
		, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	-- 윈링(right,tired,eat): 분명히 이 근처였을텐데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'eat', 'tired'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_106')

	-- 윈링(right,idle,question): 살짝 위인가?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'question', nil
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_107')

	-- 윈링(right,idle,eat) QTE (UP) 발생 (실패 X)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'eat')
	qte_play_util.swipe('up')

	-- 윈링(right,tired,eat): 조금 더 오른쪽… 인가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', nil, 'tired'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_108')

	-- 윈링(right,idle,eat) QTE (RIGHT) 발생 (실패 X)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	qte_play_util.swipe('right')

	-- 윈링(right,attack,eat): 아, 여기다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_109')

	-- 윈링(right,attack,eat) QTE (연타) 발생 (실패 X)
	qte_play_util.tap(8, {
		tap_count_callback = function()
			for i = 1, #shelf_objects do
				field_object_util.shake(shelf_objects[i], 0.03, 0.3)
			end
		end
	})

	-- 윈링(right,idle,idle) 상태로 화은단 스프라이트가 윈링에게 획득된다.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)

	local elixir = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = shelf_objects[1].Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0.3),
		itemid = 21099,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		sprscale = 1,
		showoncharacter = true,
		skip_text = true,
	})
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	elixir.ConsumeTarget = shuran
	elixir:Fly()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 윈링(right,tired,question): 흠… 안에 미완성된 단약도 들어있네.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'question', 'tired'
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_110')

	-- 윈링(right,idle,nod2회): 혹시 모르니 챙겨두자. 쓸데가 있을지 모르니까.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right', 'nod', nil
	, 'short_story_sr_s3_111')

	-- 윈링(right,idle,eat) 상태로 페이드 아웃 1초
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'eat')
	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	-- 페이드아웃 1초 
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

		view_herb = 3,

		defense_rock_scene = 5
	}

	end

	self.get_hit()
end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local is_viewed_intro_scene = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.exchange_custom_state)

	local complete_intro_scene = 1

	--커스텀 스테이트 세팅
	if is_viewed_intro_scene == complete_intro_scene then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.intro_scene
	end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_shuran_4'), true)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('door_shuran_2'), true)

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.start then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.intro_scene
		sp_util.start_scene(self.intro_scene, self)

	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

	self.controller = nil

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, nil,
			'cross_arm', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s4_20')

	--원걸(attack,boong_attack) 재생 0.3초 후 원걸 우측 0.25칸에 fx_hit 재생

	scene_util.set_anim(jungpa, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, nil,
			'question', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s4_24')

	--원걸(right,attack,cast): 산의 이점이라니… 뭔가 방법이 있는 것이오?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, nil,
			'cast', 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s4_25')

	--원링(left,smile ,release2회): 그래! 여긴 활용할 수 있는 희귀한 약재들이 잔뜩 있잖아!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s4_26')

			nil, nil, 'short_story_sr_s4_27')

	--원링(left,idle,nod2회): 그러니 잘만 활용하면 이 정도 바위는 손쉽게 해결할 수 있어.

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_rock_flower_pos')}
	})

	do
		-- fake로 교체
		-- bock 이름
		local bock_names = self.herb_object_names[1]
		local bock = get_field_object(bock_names.origin)
		local fake_bock = get_field_object(bock_names.fake)

		fake_bock.Position = bock.Position
		bock.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self.herb_object_names = nil
	self.sr_util = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	--composition상태가 아닐때만
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
		self:get_medicine(e:GetParamAt(2))
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	local data = self.block_zone_data[zone_name]

	if not type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, zone_name) then
		return false
	end

	if data ~= nil then
		self:block_zone_event(zone_name)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.start and
			zone_name == self.rock_flower_zone_name then

		self.current_state = self.section_state.find_rock_flower

		self.sr_util:start_scene(self.find_rock_flower_event, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.find_bock and
			zone_name == self.bock_zone_name then

		self.current_state = self.section_state.catch_bock

		self.sr_util:start_scene(self.find_bock_event, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.broken_rock and
			zone_name == self.catch_rabbit_zone_name then

		self.current_state = self.section_state.chaser_rabbit

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.find_rabbit_event, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.catch_rabbit and
			zone_name == self.follow_rabbit_zone_name then

		self.current_state = self.section_state.none

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.rabbit_zone_leave_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state >= self.section_state.create_medicine then
		for i = 1, #self.herb_object_names do
			local fake_herb = get_field_object(self.herb_object_names[i].fake)

			if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, fake_herb) then
				self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.escape_area_without_destroy_rock, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.create_medicine and
			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_interact_rock()) then

		self.current_state = self.section_state.broken_rock

		start_coroutine(self.interact_rock_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_rabbit()) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.catch_rabbit

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.catch_rabbit_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.is_stage_end = true

	return true
end

function local_class:create_medicine()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key)

	--해당 약재 채집 시 이벤트 재생 ( 조합 기믹 출력 x )
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()

	-- 복룡 아이템 페이크로 먹이도록 수정
	local bock_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = ring.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
		itemid = 21103,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		sprscale = 1,
		showoncharacter = true,
	})
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	bock_item.ConsumeTarget = ring
	bock_item:Fly()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--초록(원걸) 노랑(윈링) 속도 4 로 해당 위치까지 정렬 (walk)
	local ring_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_shuran_pos_3')
	local jungpa_align_pos = ring_align_pos + unity_class.vector3.left
	local align_key = 'align_ring_jungpa'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ring, ring_align_pos, 4, nil,
			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(jungpa, jungpa_align_pos, 4, nil,
			self, align_key, { last_direction = 'down' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

	--fake_bock PublishInteractable로 변경
	local fake_bock = get_field_object('s5_fake_bock')
	fake_bock.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	do
		-- 석곡도 가짜로 변경
		local fake_seokgok = get_field_object(self.herb_object_names[2].fake)
		local origin_seokgok = get_field_object(self.herb_object_names[2].origin)

		fake_seokgok.Position = origin_seokgok.Position
		fake_seokgok.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		fake_seokgok.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		origin_seokgok.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	--원걸(right,idle,question): 정말 이런 약재로 문제를 해결할 수 있단 말이오?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(jungpa, 'right', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, nil,
			'question', 'idle', 'short_story_sr_s5_13')

	--윈링(left,sleep_deep,nod2회): 물론 평범한 사람이라면 불가능하지.
	scene_util.set_direction(ring, 'left', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, nil,
			'nod', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s5_14')

	--윈링(left,doyagao,bomb_idle): 하지만 연단술을 응용한다면 해결할 수 있어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 'short_story_sr_s5_15')

	--카메라 0.5초간 사이즈 3 까지 줌
	local camera_size_duration = 0.5
	camera_util.resize_to(3, camera_size_duration)
	wait_for_sec(camera_size_duration)

	local function  pot_scene()
		local pot = get_character('gimmik_leg_pot')
		local pot_start_pos = ring.Bounds.center
		local pos = ring.Position
				+ vector((direction_util.to_vector3_ver2('left').x * 0.25), 0, -0.1)

		character_util.set_active_state(pot, 'enabled')

		--시작 크기 0.5
		pot.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
		pot.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

		character_util.set_position(pot, pot_start_pos)

		scene_util.set_anim(ring, self, 'push')

		local pot_move_duration = 0.2

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame,pot_move_duration, 0.5, 1, function(progress, cur_value)
				local scale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_value
				pot.transform.localScale = scale
			end),
			util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, pot, pos, nil, pot_move_duration, { locked_dir = 'right' }),
		})

		character_util.remove_anim(ring)

		--sr_three_leg_pot 가 1스케일이 되면 fire 애니메이션 재생
		scene_util.set_anim(pot, self, 'fire')
		--scene_util.set_anim(pot, self, '[sub]idle')

		character_util.spine_set_attachment(ring, '[base]weapon1', 'sr_pat_fan')

		scene_util.set_anim_async(ring, self, { name = 'unique/boiling_pot', count = 1.5, scale = 1.5 })

		--sr_three_leg_pot가 fx_dead와 함께 사라지면서
		self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(pot.Position)

		character_util.spine_set_attachment(ring, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

		character_util.remove_anim(pot)

		character_util.set_position(pot, self.pot_wait_pos)
		character_util.set_active_state(pot, 'disabled')
	end

	--TODO세발솥을 끓이는 유니크 애니메이션 사용
	--추가 예정, 임시로 (handgun_attack) 5회 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_plate_01')
	pot_scene()

	--윈링(left,smile,victory_get) 1회
	--해당 모션 시작할 때 손에 (임시) blue_potion 를 든다.
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(ring, '[base]weapon1', 'sr_medicine')

	scene_util.set_emotion(ring, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(ring, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep = true })

	--이때 원걸 (surprise)(jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(jungpa, '01_player_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ring)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(ring, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	character_util.set_equipment(ring, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, 9092584, true)
	ring.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'staff_idle'
	ring.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'staff_walk'
	ring.CustomRunAnimationName = 'staff_run'
	ring.CustomDamagedAnimationName = 'staff_damaged'

	--이때 카메라 사이즈 1초간 4로 복귀
	local camera_reset_size_duration = 1
	camera_util.resize_to_default(camera_reset_size_duration)
	wait_for_sec(camera_reset_size_duration)

	--원걸(attack,cast): 굉장하군요…! 순식간에 약을 제조하다니.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s5_16')

	--윈링(doyagao,bomb_idle): 원래 연단술은 정성보단 기술이 더 중요한거라고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 'short_story_sr_s5_17')

	--윈링(smile,nod2회): 따라와! 진짜는 지금부터니까.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
			'nod', 'smile', 'short_story_sr_s5_18')

	--메인 마커 위치 변경
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('s5_rock_interact')}
	})

	--제작 시켜주기
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'custom_interacting', 'bock' }))

	-- 바위 상호작용 가능하도록
	local interact_rock = self.get_interact_rock()
	interact_rock.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.block_zone_data[self.bock_block_zone_name].is_block_start = true

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:block_zone_event(zone_name)
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()

	local data = self.block_zone_data[zone_name]
	local index = data.index
	local is_block_start = data.is_block_start

	--한번 실행하였으면 끝날 때 까지 추가로 들어오는 함수는 막는다
	if self.block_zone_play_wait then
		return
	end

	self.block_zone_play_wait = true

	if index == 1 and self.current_state == self.section_state.find_rock_flower and is_block_start == true then

		self.sr_util:start_scene(function()

			--약초를 습득하지 않은 채로 빨간색존 진입시
			--윈링(left,tired,idle): 내 정신 좀 봐… 약재부터 챙겨야지.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
					'idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s5_6')

			--오른쪽으로 속도1 / 0.5칸 뒷걸음질 (walk)
			local pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone_name, ring, 'right', 0.5)

			wp_util.move_async(ring, pos, nil, 1, { locked_dir = 'left' })
			character_util.reset_locked_dir(ring)

			self.block_zone_play_wait = false
		end)
	elseif index == 2 and self.current_state == self.section_state.catch_bock and is_block_start == true then

		self.sr_util:start_scene(function()

			--약초채집 전에 노란색 존 진입시
			--윈링(down,tired,idle)(jump1회): 앗! 이런… 찾기만 하고 채집을 안했네…
			character_util.normal_jump(ring, '01_jump_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
					'idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s5_12')

			--속도1 위로 0.5칸 방향 고정된채로 이동 (walk)
			local pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone_name, ring, 'up', 0.5)

			wp_util.move_async(ring, pos, nil, 0.5,
					{ locked_dir = 'down' })
			character_util.reset_locked_dir(ring)

			self.block_zone_play_wait = false
		end)
	elseif index == 3 and self.current_state == self.section_state.create_medicine and is_block_start == true then

		self.sr_util:start_scene(function()
			--빨간존 진입시
			--여기서 지체할 시간은 없어.
			character_util.normal_jump(ring, '01_jump_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
					'idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s5_19')

			--속도1 하단으로 0.5칸 이동 (walk)
			local pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone_name, ring, 'up', 0.5)

			wp_util.move_async(ring, pos, nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'down', y_mode = 'floor' })
			character_util.reset_locked_dir(ring)

			self.block_zone_play_wait = false
		end)

	elseif index == 4 and self.current_state == self.section_state.find_rock_flower and is_block_start == true then
		self.sr_util:start_scene(function()

			--약초를 습득하지 않은 채로 빨간색존 진입시

	--윈링(sleep_deep,idle): 바위같은 무생물처럼 손 쉽게 성질을 바꿀 수 없단 얘기야.

function local_class:find_rabbit_event()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key)

	--해당 빨간존 진입시

		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'attack')

	end

	party_setting(ring)

	character_util.normal_jump_async(rabbit, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--카메라 0.5초 동안 윈링에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(camera_duration)

	--윈링(down,attack,release): 찾았다! 이 털복숭이 녀석!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
			'release', 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s5_29')

	-- 원걸(down,attack,cast2): 서둘러 붙잡아야 하오!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'down',
			'cast2', 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s5_29_1')

	-- 접근하면 도망가는 컨트롤러로 변경
	local way_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)
	way_list:Add('1, 3')
	way_list:Add('0, 2')
	way_list:Add('1, 3')
	way_list:Add('0, 2')
	rabbit.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.FugitiveCharacterController.Create(way_list, 4.5, 10, nil)
	rabbit.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.block_zone_data[self.follow_rabbit_zone_name].is_block_start = true
	self.block_zone_data[self.chaser_rabbit_zone_name].is_block_start = true

		{ zone = 'main_field', target = rabbit}})


	-- 토끼 추적 루틴 시작
	start_coroutine(self.chaser_rabbit_routine, self)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:chaser_rabbit_routine()
	local time_passed = 0
	local limit_time = 5

	-- 해당 이벤트 시작 5초가 지난 후 유저가 토끼 주변 (3) 범위 안으로 진입시 이벤트 재생
	while time_passed < limit_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local rabbit = self.get_rabbit()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 토끼가 도망을 멈추었을 때까지 대기
	while not lua_helper.type_compare(rabbit.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
			CS.Oak.FugitiveCharacterControllerWatchState) and not self.is_stage_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 토끼 NPCCharacterController 로 원복
	rabbit.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	rabbit.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	local target_dist = 3

	-- 거리가 3보다 작아질 때까지 대기
	while not self.is_stage_end do
		local diff = (leader.Position - rabbit.Position).sqrMagnitude

		if diff < target_dist then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	self.block_zone_data[self.follow_rabbit_zone_name].is_block_start = false
	self.block_zone_data[self.chaser_rabbit_zone_name].is_block_start = false

	-- 토끼 잡는 연출 재생
	self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.catch_rabbit_event, self)
end

function local_class:catch_rabbit_event()
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()
	local rabbit = self.get_rabbit()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key)

	-- 토끼 들 수 있는 상태로 변경
	rabbit.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	-- 현재 상태 토끼 잡은 것으로 변경
	self.current_state = self.section_state.catch_rabbit

	-- 윈링 y 1 높이로 뛰어 오르면서 (attack) 표정 (prostrate) 애니메이션 (0.2) 배속으로 재생 동시에 토끼 위치까지 1초간 이동
	character_util.look_at(ring, rabbit)

	scene_util.set_emotion(ring, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(ring, self, 'prostrate')

	-- 이때 원걸 표정 (surprise)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.jump(jungpa, 0.3, 0.5)

	local move_end_key = 'move_end_key'
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(ring, 0.75, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ring, rabbit.Position, nil, 0.5, self, move_end_key)

	local mod_key = 'jump_mod'
	local count = 0
	do
		-- 타임스케일이 점점 0으로 내려가는 로직
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

		-- 타겟 타임 스케일
		local time_scale = 0.5
		while count < 4 do
			count = count + 1
			time_util.mod(mod_key .. count, time_scale)
			wait_for_unscaled_sec(0.225)
		end
	end

	count = count + 1
	time_util.mod(mod_key .. count, 0)

	local tap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_tap_guide_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	field_util.darken('darken', 0.5, 0)
	qte_play_util.tap(1, { anim_unscaled_time = true })

	tap_sfx:Stop()

	-- 타임 스케일 1로 복귀
	field_util.undarken('darken')

	for i = 1, count do
		time_util.unmod(mod_key .. i)
	end

	-- 윈링 착지 완료까지 대기
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 윈링 토끼에게 이동 이동 끝나면 해당 자리에 FX_Common_SmokeScreen 이펙트 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	self.get_fx_smoke_screen():Instantiate(ring.Position)

	scene_util.set_direction(rabbit, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(ring, 'right', false)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rabbit)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ring)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	command_util.publish_holdup(ring, rabbit, ring.Position, 0, false)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 윈링(smile,hold): 좋아! 잡았다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right', nil, 'smile'
	, 'short_story_sr_s5_29_3')

	-- 윈링이 토끼를 자신 우측 1칸에 내려놓고 원걸은 그 우측 1칸에 0.5초 동안 정렬
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	command_util.publish_throw(ring, rabbit, vector(1, 0, 0), ring.Position, 4, true)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	character_util.remove_emotion(jungpa)
	wp_util.move_async(jungpa, ring.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), nil
	, 0.5, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 윈링 속도 1로 (walk) 0.5칸 우측으로 이동 후 (eat)모션 1초
	local ring_move_offset = vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(ring, ring.Position + ring_move_offset, 1, nil)

	--(eat)모션 시작할 때 토끼 (shake0.03 / 0.5초)
	scene_util.shake(rabbit, 0.03, 0.5)

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	scene_util.play_wait_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'eat', 'idle', 1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

local local_class = newclass('ShuranMainSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShuranMain @
		Comment = ShuranMain 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 5 @
		NextSections = 6 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.section_state = {
		start = 1,
		look_bear = 2,
		kick_out_bear = 3,
		broken_rock = 4,
		broken_road = 5,
		jumping_rabbit = 6,
		thorn_road = 7,
		find_mushroom = 8,
		get_mushroom = 9,
	}

	self.block_zone_data = {
		s6_block_zone_1 = {
			index = 1,
		},
		s6_block_zone_2 = {
			index = 2,
		},
		s6_block_zone_3 = {
			index = 3,
		},
		s6_block_zone_4 = {
			index = 4,
		}
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.start

	self.mushroom_item = nil

	self.get_ring = self.controller.get_shuran
	self.get_jungpa = self.controller.get_jungpa_master

	self.quest_marker_key = 'main_quest'

	self.get_rabbit = self.controller.get_spirit_rabbit

	self.get_fake_bear = function()
		return get_character('tutorial_bear')
	end

	self.find_bear_zone_name = 's6_enter_zone_1'
	self.broken_road_zone_name = 's6_enter_zone_2'
	self.find_mushroom_zone_name = 's6_enter_zone_3'
	self.broken_rock_zone_name = 's6_broken_rock_zone'
	self.thorn_zone_name = 's6_thorn_zone'

	self.broken_rock_flag = false
	self.quest_marker_change_insam = false

	self.sr_util = self.controller.sr_util

	self.stage_event_controller = nil

	self.bear_sleep_sfx_loop = nil

	self.block_zone_play_wait = false

	self.get_fx_dead = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	end

	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_dead()
	self.get_fx_hit()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')

	self.stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('ShuranMedicineManagerController')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:field_setting()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local rock = get_field_object('s6_broken_rock')

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.kick_out_bear and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, rock) then

		self.broken_rock_flag = true

		if zone_util.contains_fo(self.broken_rock_zone_name, get_party_leader(), false) then
			self.current_state = self.section_state.broken_rock

			self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.broken_rock_event, self)
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local data = self.block_zone_data[zone_name]

	if data ~= nil then
		self:block_zone_event(zone_name)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.start and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.find_bear_zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.look_bear

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.look_bear_event, self)

	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.kick_out_bear and self.broken_rock_flag and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.broken_rock_zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.broken_rock

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.broken_rock_event, self)

	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.broken_rock and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.broken_road_zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.broken_road

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.broken_road_event, self)

	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.jumping_rabbit and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.thorn_zone_name) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.thorn_road

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.thorn_road_event, self)

	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.thorn_road and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.find_mushroom_zone_name) then

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.find_mushroom_event, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 천보환을 소지중인지
	local manager = self.stage_event_controller.medicine_manager

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.look_bear and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character('tutorial_bear')) and
			manager:check_medicine(manager.medicine_table.medicine_sleepwalk.bit) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.kick_out_bear

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.interact_bear_event, self)
	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.broken_road and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_field_object('s6_interact_rabbit_jump')) and
			manager:check_medicine(manager.medicine_table.medicine_jump.bit) then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.jumping_rabbit

		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.jumping_rabbit_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	--composition상태가 아닐때만
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
		self:get_medicine(e:GetParamAt(2))
	end
end
--endregion
function local_class:get_medicine(medicine_name)
	local manager = self.stage_event_controller.medicine_manager
	local bear = self.get_fake_bear()
	local rabbit_jump = get_field_object('s6_interact_rabbit_jump')
	if manager:check_medicine(manager.medicine_table.medicine_sleepwalk.bit) then

		--인터렉터블을 세팅하면, 히트박스 세팅이 풀려버려서 재지정
		bear.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		bear.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.25), vector(2, 1, 2))
	else

		bear.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		bear.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.25), vector(2, 1, 2))
	end

	if manager:check_medicine(manager.medicine_table.medicine_jump.bit) then

		if not self.quest_marker_change_insam then

			self.quest_marker_change_insam = true
			quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key)
			quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
				{ zone = 'main_field', target = rabbit_jump }
			})
		end

		rabbit_jump.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	else

		rabbit_jump.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.find_mushroom and medicine_name == 'mushroom' then
		--아이템 흡수
		self.mushroom_item.ConsumeTarget = get_party_leader()

		local mushroom_interact = get_field_object('s6_interact_mushroom')
		mushroom_interact.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	end

	--	이때 화면 shake 0.03/0.3초

	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(jungpa, '01_player_jump_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'scared', 'short_story_sr_s6_3')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jungpa)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	--	윈링(left,mad,cast2): 빨리 엎드려!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
			'cast2', 'mad', 'short_story_sr_s6_4')

	--	토끼 (up,idle,idle) 윈링 원걸 (damaged,prostrate) 0.5초
	scene_util.set_direction(rabbit, 'up', false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_emotion(ring, self, 'damaged')

	scene_util.set_anim(jungpa, self, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_anim(ring, self, 'prostrate')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--	x(36.5) 위치에서 그리드 밖으로 안나가는 선에서 카메라 1초 동안 이동
	local bear_end_pos = fake_bear.Position + vector(0, 0, -9)
	local camera_look_pos = fake_bear.Position + vector(0, 0, -5)
	local camera_wait_duration = 1
	camera_util.move_async(camera_look_pos, camera_wait_duration)

	--	카메라가 도착하면 곰(sr_sleep_bear)(1.5배 스케일)이 그리드 밖에서 부터 속도2로 하단 6.5칸 이동
	local move_one_frame_stage_logic = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic

	local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(bear_end_pos - fake_bear.Position)
	local look_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(look_dir)

	scene_util.set_anim(fake_bear, self, 'walk')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fake_bear, self, 'idle')

	local time_passed = 0
	local speed = 2
	--local move_dis = 2

	local dur = 9 / speed

	--	이동 시작하면 화면 shake0.03/0.3초 이 후 0.7초 후 다시 같은 shake 2회 반복
	local screen_shake_flag = true

	start_coroutine(function()
		while screen_shake_flag do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.3)
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end
	end)

	while time_passed < dur do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		move_one_frame_stage_logic.ExecuteMove(fake_bear, look_dir_vec, speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	screen_shake_flag = false

	character_util.remove_anim(fake_bear)

	--	곰 이동 끝나면 0.5초 대기 후 속도 2로 우측 2칸 이동 후 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(fake_bear, 'right', false)

	bear_end_pos = fake_bear.Position + vector(2, 0, 0)

	look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(bear_end_pos - fake_bear.Position)
	look_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(look_dir)

	scene_util.set_anim(fake_bear, self, 'walk')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fake_bear, self, 'idle')

	time_passed = 0
	speed = 2
	--local move_dis = 2

	dur = 2 / speed

	--	이동 시작할 때 화면 shake0.03/0.3초
	--	이때 카메라도 곰 따라 우측 2칸 이동
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.3)
	camera_util.move(bear_end_pos, 1)

	while time_passed < dur do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		move_one_frame_stage_logic.ExecuteMove(fake_bear, look_dir_vec, speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(fake_bear)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	self.bear_sleep_sfx_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_sleep_02',
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc',
		loop = true,
		parent = fake_bear,
		max_distance = 5
	})

	scene_util.set_anim(fake_bear, self, 'block_sleep')
	scene_util.set_emotion(fake_bear, self, 'deep_sleep')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--	곰 (right,deep_sleep,sleep) 상태로 전환후 0.5초 후 2초간 윈링에게 카메라 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

	--	윈링 원걸 (shake0.03/0.5초) 후 마리오 점프로 기상 0.5초 후 (up,idle,idle) 1초
	--	이때 토끼는 (right,idle,idle)
	local mario_jump_duration = 0.5
	local shake_duration = 0.5
	scene_util.shake(jungpa, 0.03, shake_duration)
	scene_util.shake(ring, 0.03, shake_duration)

	wait_for_sec(shake_duration)

	scene_util.set_direction(rabbit, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(jungpa, 'right', mario_jump_duration, 0.5)
	character_util.mario_jump_new(ring, 'left', mario_jump_duration, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(mario_jump_duration)

	--	윈링 (left,idle,idle) 원걸 (right,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(ring, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(jungpa, 'right')

	--	윈링(tired,bomb_idle): 진짜 큰일날 뻔 했네. 곰들이 낮잠자는 시간이라 다행이야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_5')

	--	원걸(attack,cast): 그것보다도 저 곰이 길을 막고 있는 것 아니오?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s6_6')

	--	원걸(attack,release2회): 소생이 저 곰을 깨워 길을 비키게 만들겠소!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s6_7')

	--	윈링(left,tired,idle): 뭐?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
			'idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_8')

	--	선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'short_story_sr_s6_choose_1', 'brutal' },
														  { 'short_story_sr_s6_choose_2', 'brutal' },
														  { 'short_story_sr_s6_choose_3', 'brutal' } })

	--	곰은 사람을 찢어. (brutal)
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--	윈링(left,tired,bomb_idle): 너 제정신이니? 곰은 사람을 찢어.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_9')

		--	윈링(left,tired,release2회): 아무리 단약술이 뛰어나도 찢어진 몸을 붙일 순 없는 걸?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_10')

		--	죽음에서 돌아오고싶어? (brutal)
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--	윈링(left,tired,bomb_idle): 곰이랑 싸워서 살아남은 사람 얘기 몰라?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_11')

		--	윈링(left,tired,release2회): 그 사람도 거의 죽다 살아돌아왔었다니까!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_12')

		--	바보같이 죽고싶어? (brutal)
	else
		--	윈링(left,tired,bomb_idle): 우리 가문에 내려오는 바보같이 죽는 법 책이 있거든?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_13')

		--	윈링(left,tired,release 2회): 그리고 그 첫페이지에 써있는 게 약초캐다 곰건드리기야.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_14')
	end

	--	상단 세 선택지 공통 진행
	--	원걸(right,tired,cast): 그, 그렇다면 다른 방법이라도 있는 것이오?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'right',
			'cast', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_15')

	--	윈링(left,sleep_deep,cross_arm) 흠… 그거라면.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
			'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s6_16')
	--
	--	윈링 속도 4로 2.5칸 상단으로 이동 후 (left)(right) 1초 간격으로 방향 전환
	local ring_move_offset = ring.Position + vector(0, 0, 2.5)

	wp_util.move_async(ring, ring_move_offset, 4, nil)

	scene_util.look_around(ring, { 'left', 'right' })

	--	윈링(right,smile,idle)(jump1회) 0.5초 후 카메라 그리드 안넘어가도록 약초B로 이동
	scene_util.set_emotion(ring, self, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(ring, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local camera_move_pos = fake_bear.Position + vector(10, 0, 0)
	local camera_duration = 0.5

	camera_util.move_async(camera_move_pos, camera_duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	wait_for_sec(camera_duration)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(camera_duration)

	--	윈링(right,smile,nod2회): 저 약초만 있다면 문제없지!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'nod', 'smile', 'short_story_sr_s6_17')

	--	컨트롤 해제 메인 퀘스트 마커 곰에게 지정.
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = fake_bear }
	})

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
	--	몽유환 소지한채로 곰에게 인터랙트시 하단의 이벤트 진행
end

function local_class:interact_bear_event()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local rabbit = self.get_rabbit()
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key)

	--사용된 약초 삭제 이벤트 보내주기
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'custom_clear' }))

	local fake_bear = self.get_fake_bear()
	fake_bear.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	--해당 대열로 정렬 회색(토끼) 초록(원걸) 노랑(윈링) (right,idle,idle)
	--0.5칸 간격으로 서있다.
	local ring_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_align_pos_2')
	local jungpa_align_pos = ring_align_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	local rabbit_align_pos = ring_align_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
	local align_key = 'align_move'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(ring, ring_align_pos, 1, nil, self,
			align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rabbit, rabbit_align_pos, 1, nil, self,
			align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(jungpa, jungpa_align_pos, 1, nil, self,
			align_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_key)

	--윈링 속도 1 로 우측 0.5칸 (walk) 이동 후 (eat)모션 1초 후
	local ring_move_pos = ring.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(ring, ring_move_pos, 1, nil)

	local sfx_eat = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc' })

	scene_util.play_wait_action(ring, self, 'left',
			'eat', 'idle', 1)

	sfx_eat:Stop()

	self.bear_sleep_sfx_loop:Stop()
	self.bear_sleep_sfx_loop = nil

	--곰 속도 1 로 애니메이션 (sleep_walk) 표정 (sleep) 우측 2칸 이동 후 다시 애니메이션 (sleep) 표정 (deep_sleep)
	self:bear_routine_event()

	--임시 리소스 애니메이션(walk) 표정 (idle) -> 이동 후 애니메이션 (sleep) 표정 (yeti_sleep)
	self:kick_out_bear_event()
end

function local_class:bear_routine_event()
	local bear = self.get_fake_bear()
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()
	local bear_move_speed = 1

	--곰(shake0.03/0.5초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.shake(bear, 0.03, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_emotion(bear)

	--	--곰 (right,idle,idle) 상태로 전환
	--	--동시에 원걸 (surprise)(jump1회)
	--	--원걸(left,attack,cast): 고, 곰이 깨어났소!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_roar_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(bear, 'right', false)
	character_util.remove_anim(bear)

	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa. self, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(jungpa, '01_player_jump_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s6_18')

	--원걸(left,damaged,dagger_idle): 곰은 소생이 막을테니 소저는 어서 도망을…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'left',
			'dagger_idle', 'damaged', 'short_story_sr_s6_19')

	--윈링(right,sleep_deep,dualgun_attack_right (0.2속도 loop X): 조용히 해봐.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring,
			self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'dualgun_attack_right', loop = false, scale = 0.2 },
			'sleep_deep',
			'short_story_sr_s6_20'
	)

	--곰 표정 (sleep)으로 변경 1초 대기
	scene_util.set_emotion(bear, self, 'idle')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--곰 이동
	--곰 속도 1 로 애니메이션 (sleep_walk) 표정 (sleep) 우측 2칸 이동 후 다시 애니메이션 (sleep) 표정 (deep_sleep)
	--곰 이동 시작 할때 원걸 (right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(bear, self, 'sleep')
	scene_util.set_anim(bear, self, 'sleep_walk')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_direction(ring, 'left')

	local end_pos = bear.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_async(bear, end_pos, bear_move_speed, nil)

	character_util.remove_anim(bear)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	character_util.set_active_state(bear, 'disabled')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local change_bear = get_character('bear_1')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(change_bear)

		scene_util.set_emotion(change_bear, self, 'sleep')
		change_bear.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

		character_util.set_position(change_bear, bear.Position)

		scene_util.set_direction(change_bear, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(change_bear, self, 'block_sleep')
		scene_util.set_emotion(change_bear, self, 'deep_sleep')

		self.stage_event_controller.align_table.bear_1.sleep_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_sleep_02',
			type_priority = 'event',
			player_priority = 'npc',
			loop = true,
			parent = change_bear
		})
	end))
end

function local_class:kick_out_bear_event()
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key)

	--원걸(attack,release 2회): 소저! 이번에야말로 무슨 도술을 부린 것이오?!
	--이때 윈링 (left)
	scene_util.set_direction(ring, 'right')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s6_21')

	--윈링(sleep_deep,cross_arm): 그냥 약을 입에 흘려넣었을 뿐, 도술같은 게 아니야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s6_22')

	--윈링(idle,idle): 방금 석꽃과 함께 넣은 섞은 건 불 속성의 영기를 가진 절연화야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'idle', 'short_story_sr_s6_23')

	--윈링(doyagao,bomb_idle): 목 속성의 영기로 불 속성의 영기를 강화시켜 저절로 몸이 움직이도록 뜨겁게 달구는 거야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'doyagao', 'short_story_sr_s6_24')

	--원걸(attack,cast): 오행의 기운을 이리 능숙히 다루다니… 역시 연단술은 대단한 것 같소.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s6_25')

	--윈링(sleep_deep,nod2회): 약재의 영기를 다루는 섬세하고 까다로운 기술이니까.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'nod', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s6_26')

	--윈링(idle,idle): 약재의 종류나 양이 조금만 틀어져도 약효가 완전히 사라져버린다고.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'idle', 'short_story_sr_s6_27')

	--컨트롤 해제 메인 마커 위치 변경
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('s6_interact_rabbit_jump') }
	})

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:broken_rock_event()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()
	local rabbit = self.get_rabbit()

	local ring_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_broken_rock_align_pos_1')
	local jungpa_align_pos = ring_align_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	local rabbit_align_pos = ring_align_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5)

function local_class:broken_road_event()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local rabbit = self.get_rabbit()
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key)

	--해당 지역에 약초 A는 배치되지 않은 상태.
	--빨간존 진입시 1초동안 해당 대열로 정렬
	local ring_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_align_pos_3')
	local jungpa_align_pos = ring_align_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local rabbit_align_pos = ring_align_pos + vector(-1, 0, -0.5)

	local waypoint_ring = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(ring, ring_align_pos, false)
	local waypoint_jungpa = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(jungpa, jungpa_align_pos, false)
	local waypoint_rabbit = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(rabbit, rabbit_align_pos, false)

			align_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rabbit, waypoint_rabbit, nil, 1, self,
			align_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(jungpa, waypoint_jungpa, nil, 1, self,
			align_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--노랑(윈링) 초록(원걸) 회색(토끼) (right,idle,idle)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_48')

	--원걸(attack,release 2회): 간단하오. 힘껏 뛰어 넘으면 되는 것이오!

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s6_49')

	--윈링(surprise,idle): 지금 여길 뛰어넘겠다고?!

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jungpa)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	scene_util.set_direction(jungpa, 'up', false)

	character_util.normal_jump(ring, '01_small_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
			'idle', 'surprise', 'short_story_sr_s6_50')

	--윈링(tired,idle): 방금 너 상처도 다 안나아서 넘어졌었잖아.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
			'idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_51')

	-- 그… 그렇지만.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'up',
			'idle', 'idle', 'short_story_sr_s6_52')

	--윈링(sleep_deep,question): 근처에 뭔가 쓸만한 약재도 없어보이고…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
			'question', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s6_53')

	--원걸(right,tired,question): 소생이 어떻게든 방법을 찾아보겠소
	--이때 윈링 (left) 방향
	scene_util.set_direction(ring, 'left', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'up',
			'question', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_54')

	--이때 토끼 2초간 (walk) 좌측 약초 옆으로 이동 시작

	local rabbit_move_pos = medicine_pos +
			unity_class.vector3.right
	local rabbit_waypoint = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(rabbit, rabbit_move_pos, false)

	camera_util.move(rabbit_move_pos, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(rabbit, rabbit_waypoint, nil, 2)

	--토끼 도착하면 (eat) 1초 재생
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_grass_slide_02',
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc',
		loop = true,
	})
	scene_util.play_wait_action(rabbit, self, 'left',
			'eat', 'idle', 1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(medicine_pos)
	local insam = get_field_object('medicine_insam_2')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--윈링(surprise,idle)(jump1회) 0.5초

	character_util.normal_jump(ring, '01_player_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_emotion(ring)

	--윈링(smile,cast): 저건 금의 영기를 가지고 있는 인환삼이란 약재야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(ring, 'down', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
			'cast', 'smile', 'short_story_sr_s6_55')

	--윈링(smile,clap) : 저 토끼 약재까지 찾아내는 재주가 있잖아?
	--이때 원걸(up) 방향
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'clap', sfx_name = '01_clap_01' }, 'smile', 'short_story_sr_s6_56')

	--윈링(down, smile, sing): 어때? 데리고 다니길 잘했지?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(ring, 'down', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
			'sing', 'smile', 'short_story_sr_s6_57')

	--원걸(up)(jump1회): 저, 정도라면 소생도 찾을 수 있었소!
	character_util.normal_jump(jungpa, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'up',
			'idle', 'idle', 'short_story_sr_s6_58')

	--컨트롤해제 메인 마커 위치 변경
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = insam }
	})

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

function local_class:tutorial_jumping_event()
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()
	local rabbit = self.get_rabbit()

	local party_table = {}
	local jump_data = {
		--리더가 보는 방향
		--오른쪽
		target_direction = vector(1, 0, 0),
		jump_distance = vector(6, 0, 0),
		align_position = {
			move_start = {
				{ pos = vector(-1, 0, 0), dir = 'left' },
				{ pos = vector(-2, 0, 0), dir = 'right' },
				{ pos = vector(-2, 0, -1), dir = 'right' }
			},
			move_end = {
				{ pos = vector(0, 0, 0), dir = 'right' },
				{ pos = vector(1, 0, 0), dir = 'right' },
				{ pos = vector(1, 0, -1), dir = 'right' }
			}
		},
		eat_position = vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		rabbit_head_position = {
			vector(1.2, 0.75, 0),
			vector(0.8, 0.75, 1)
		}
	}

	local rabbit_from_scale = unity_class.vector3.one
	local rabbit_to_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.2

	table.insert(party_table, rabbit)
	table.insert(party_table, ring)
	table.insert(party_table, jungpa)

	local jump_move_routine = function(target, start_pos, target_pos, jump_duration, height)
		start_coroutine(function()

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(jump_duration, function(progress)
				local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
				local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
				local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)

				character_util.set_position(target, cur_pos, true)
			end)

			self.success_count = self.success_count + 1
		end)
	end

	self.success_count = 0
	local head_jump_duration = 0.5

	--해당 이벤트 부터 1(smile) 원걸(surprise) 표정 / 둘다 (seat) 애니메이션 고정
	scene_util.set_emotion(ring, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa, self, 'surprise')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--첫 점프
	scene_util.set_anim(rabbit, self, 'swell_jump')

	self.success_count = 0

	local jump_duration = 0.5
	local jump_height = 2

	--토끼 점프시작할때 방향 변경
	for idx = 1, #party_table do
		local target_pos = party_table[idx].Position + jump_data.jump_distance
		local start_pos = party_table[idx].Position

		scene_util.set_direction(party_table[idx], ring.Direction, false)

		jump_move_routine(party_table[idx], start_pos, target_pos, jump_duration, jump_height)
	end

	while self.success_count ~= #party_table do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--A 위치 도착했다면 화면 (shake 0.1 / 0.3초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--2번째 점프
	self.success_count = 0

	for idx = 1, #party_table do
		local target_pos = party_table[idx].Position + jump_data.jump_distance
		local start_pos = party_table[idx].Position

		jump_move_routine(party_table[idx], start_pos, target_pos, jump_duration, jump_height)
	end

	while self.success_count ~= #party_table do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--반대편 위치에 도착했다면 화면 (shake 0.1 / 0.3초)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	--동시에 (1) (2) 동시에 표시된 위치까지 0.5초간 마리오 점프로 정렬
	--동시에 토끼 (swell_out)
	local swell_out_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(rabbit, 'swell_out')

	scene_util.set_anim(rabbit, self, { name = 'swell_out', count = 1 })

	local head_get_off_height = 0.75
	self.success_count = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	for idx = 2, #party_table do
		local start_pos = party_table[idx].Position
		local target_pos = party_table[1].Position + (jump_data.align_position.move_end[idx].pos)
		--local head_jump_duration = (target_pos - start_pos):GetX0z().magnitude / head_jump_move_speed

		scene_util.set_anim(party_table[idx], self, 'get')

		jump_move_routine(party_table[idx], start_pos, target_pos, head_jump_duration, head_get_off_height)
	end
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(head_jump_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_02')
	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(swell_out_duration, rabbit_to_scale, rabbit_from_scale, function(progress, cur_y)
		rabbit.transform.localScale = cur_y
	end)

	while self.success_count ~= #party_table - 1 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:interact_mushroom_event()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 1)

	local rabbit = self.get_rabbit()
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local jungpa = self.get_jungpa()

			align_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

	--윈링(smile,clap): 이제 하나만 더 찾으면 되겠어!

	--원걸(tired,bomb_idle): 그런데 혹시 만귀종들이 오기 전에 재료를 못찾으면 어떻게 되오?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_95')

	--윈링(sleep_deep,bomb_idle): 큰일난거지 뭐.
	--이때 원걸(attack,idle)(jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(jungpa, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s6_96')
	character_util.remove_emotion(jungpa)

	--원걸(tired,release 2회) 그, 그땐 일단 단약을 먹고 비급부터 회수하는 건…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_97')

	--윈링(attack,idle)(jump1회) [shout]: 안돼!
	--이때 화면 shake0.1 / 0.3초
	--이때 원걸 (surprise,idle)(jump1회)

	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(jungpa, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(ring)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s6_98')
	character_util.remove_emotion(jungpa)

	--윈링(sleep_deep,cross_arm): 연단사가 부작용을 뻔히 알면서도 처방한다는 건 말도 안되는 일이야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s6_99')

	--윈링(tired,bomb_idle):아무리 그래도 비급이 사람 목숨보다 귀하겠어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_100')

	--윈링(attack,idle): 그리고 만약에 만귀종이 누군가의 생명을 희생해 비급을 얻으려한다면.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'attack', 'short_story_sr_s6_101')

	--윈링(sleep_deep,bomb_idle): 화은단이고 뭐고 난 그 자리에서 바로 발로 밟아 짓이겨버릴테니까.

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa, self, 'left',

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:block_zone_event(zone_name)
	local ring = self.get_ring()
	local data = self.block_zone_data[zone_name]
	local index = data.index

	--한번 실행하였으면 끝날 때 까지 추가로 들어오는 함수는 막는다
	if self.block_zone_play_wait then
		return
	end

	self.block_zone_play_wait = true

	if index == 1 and self.current_state == self.section_state.look_bear then

		self.sr_util:start_scene(function()
			--하단 빨간존 이탈시도 시 이벤트 재생
			--윈링(left,tired,bomb_idle): 빨리 안하면 저 녀석이 먼저 곰한테 달려들겠어.
			--0.5초간 (walk)모션으로 존에서 0.5칸 떨어진 곳까지 뒷걸음질로 정렬
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
					'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_5_2')

			--오른쪽으로 속도1 / 0.5칸 뒷걸음질 (walk)
			local pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone_name, ring, 'right', 0.5)

			wp_util.move_async(ring, pos, nil, 0.5,
					{ locked_dir = 'left' })

			character_util.reset_locked_dir(ring)

			self.block_zone_play_wait = false
		end)
	elseif index == 2 and self.current_state == self.section_state.broken_road then

		self.sr_util:start_scene(function()
			--하단 빨간존으로 이탈하려고 할 시 이벤트
			--윈링(down,sleep_deep,idle): 기껏 토끼가 약초도 찾아줬는데, 헤맬 필요는 없지.
			--0.5초간 (walk) 모션으로 존과 0.5칸 떨어진 위치로 뒷걸음질 정렬
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
					'idle', 'sleep_deep', 'short_story_sr_s6_59')

			--속도1 위로 0.5칸 방향 고정된채로 이동 (walk)
			local pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone_name, ring, 'up', 0.5)

			wp_util.move_async(ring, pos, nil, 0.5,
					{ locked_dir = 'down' })

			character_util.reset_locked_dir(ring)

			self.block_zone_play_wait = false
		end)
	elseif index == 3 and self.current_state == self.section_state.find_mushroom then

		self.sr_util:start_scene(function()
			--좌측 초록색 존
			--윈링(left,tired,idle): 빨리 해독제에 필요한 약초를 챙겨야 해.
			--속도1 (walk)로 0.5칸 우측으로 이동
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'left',
					'idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_91')

			--속도1 하단으로 0.5칸 이동 (walk)
			local pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone_name, ring, 'right', 0.5)

			wp_util.move_async(ring, pos, nil, 0.5,
					{ locked_dir = 'left' })

			character_util.reset_locked_dir(ring)

			self.block_zone_play_wait = false
		end)

	elseif index == 4 and self.current_state == self.section_state.find_mushroom then

		self.sr_util:start_scene(function()
			--하단 초록색 존
			--윈링(left,tired,idle): 여유부리다 또 놓치면 귀찮아지겠어.
			--속도1 (walk)로 0.5칸 상단으로 이동
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(ring, self, 'down',
					'idle', 'tired', 'short_story_sr_s6_92')

			--속도1 우측으로 0.5칸 이동 (walk)
			local pos = zone_util.get_return_pos_on_enter(zone_name, ring, 'up', 0.5)

			wp_util.move_async(ring, pos, nil, 0.5,
					{ locked_dir = 'down' })

			character_util.reset_locked_dir(ring)

			self.block_zone_play_wait = false
		end)
	else
		self.block_zone_play_wait = false
	end
end
return local_class

end

function local_class:enter()
	-- setting
	self:gimmick_setting()
	self:fx_setting()

	-- Subscribe
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	-- marker
	--quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name,
	--		self.controller.quest_id, true, self.get_shuran_pos(0))
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name,
			{ { zone = 'main_field', target = self.get_shuran_pos(0) } })

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_spirit_rabbit(), self.controller)
	self.crimson_plant_item:dispose()
	self.sapa_npc:dispose()

	if self.fx_magic_circle ~= nil then
		self.fx_magic_circle:Dispose()
		self.fx_magic_circle = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.crimson_plant_item:dispose()
	self.sapa_npc:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's7_talk_jungpa_master_zone') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_jungpa_master
		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.talk_jungpa_master_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.talk_jungpa_master and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's7_show_crimson_plant_zone') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_crimson_plant
		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.show_crimson_plant_event, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.interact_rabbit and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's7_sapa_zone') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.sapa_event
		start_coroutine(self.show_sapa_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.get_crimson_plant and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_spirit_rabbit()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_rabbit_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' and self.crimson_plant_item.custom_event_key == e:GetParamAt(2) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.get_crimson_plant
		self.sr_util:start_scene_with_hide_weapon(self.get_crimson_plant_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end
