function local_class:get_crimson_plant_event()
	local shuran = self.get_shuran()
	local jungpa_master = self.get_jungpa_master()
	local spirit_rabbit = self.get_spirit_rabbit()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--해당 약초에 1초간 인터랙트 유지하면 해당 스프라이트 플레이어에게 습득되며 이벤트 재생
	--아이템 명칭 : 붉은 절벽초
	self.crimson_plant_item:set_consume_target(shuran)
	self.crimson_plant_item:dispose()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--노란원(윈링)(right,idle,idle)초록원(원걸)(left,idle,idle)회색원(토끼)(up,idle,idle)
	local shuran_pos = self.get_crimson_plant_pos() + vector(-1, 0, 1)
	local jungpa_master_pos = shuran_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
	local spirit_rabbit_pos = shuran_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1)

	local wp_key = 'align_wp'

	--(walk)모션으로 0.5초간 해당 대열로 정렬
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuran, shuran_pos, nil, 0.5,
			self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(jungpa_master, jungpa_master_pos, nil, 0.5,
			self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(spirit_rabbit, spirit_rabbit_pos, nil, 0.5,
			self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--윈링(unique/boiling_pot_success) 애니메이션 재생
	scene_util.set_anim_async(shuran, self, 'unique/boiling_pot_success')

	--윈링(smile,idle)(jump1회): 좋았어! 이걸로 해독제의 준비는 다 마쳤어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(shuran, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'idle',
			'smile',
			'short_story_sr_s7_11')

	--원걸(attack,release 2회): 그럼, 이제 서둘러 산을 내려가야 하오!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'attack',
			'short_story_sr_s7_12')

	--원걸(tired,bomb_idle): 늦었다간 만귀종이 약방을 비운 걸 눈치챌 수도 있소.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_13')

	--윈링(idle,bomb_idle): 무해곡은 이 산 아래로 내려가면 있는 거 맞지?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'idle',
			'short_story_sr_s7_14')

	--원걸(idle,release 2회): 맞소. 고지를 넘었으니 이제 내려만 가면 되오.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'idle',
			'short_story_sr_s7_15')

	--윈링(tired,bomb_idle): 정말 한시도 쉴틈이 없네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_16')

	--윈링(tired,question): 어디 지름길이라도 찾아서 편하게 내려가면 좋겠는데.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'question',
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_17')

	--이때 원걸 윈링 (down) 방향
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ shuran, jungpa_master }, 'down', false)
	--토끼 (jump2회)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(spirit_rabbit)
	character_util.normal_double_jump(spirit_rabbit, true)

	--토끼 속도 6으로 경로대로 이동 후 (left,idle,idle) 상태
	local rabbit_move_pos = self.get_shuran_pos(2) + vector(-1, 0, -1)
	local rabbit_wp = {
		vector(rabbit_move_pos.x, 0, spirit_rabbit.Position.z),
		rabbit_move_pos
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	wp_util.move(spirit_rabbit, rabbit_wp, 6, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--이동 시작하면 원걸 윈링 (left) 방향
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ shuran, jungpa_master }, 'left')

	--윈링(left,tired,release2회) : 어디가는 거야?! 토끼야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_18')

	--원걸(left,tired,bomb_idle): 이제야 제 갈 길을 찾은 거 아니겠소?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_18_1')

	--윈링(left,tired,question): 아니야… 뭔가 우리에게 알려주려는 거 같은데?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left',
			'question',
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_18_2')

	character_util.add_listener(spirit_rabbit, self.controller)

	get_field_object('medicine_interact_jump_4').Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--컨트롤 해제 메인 마커 위치 변경
	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_name,
			{ { zone = 'main_field', target = spirit_rabbit } })
end

--- 천보환을 들고 토끼에게 인터렉트
function local_class:interact_rabbit_event()
	local shuran = self.get_shuran()
	local jungpa_master = self.get_jungpa_master()
	local spirit_rabbit = self.get_spirit_rabbit()

	-- 천보환을 소지중인지
	local stage_event_controller = get_stage_event_controller('ShuranMedicineManagerController')
	local manager = stage_event_controller.medicine_manager

	-- 천보환을 소지중이지 않을 경우
	if not manager:check_medicine(manager.medicine_table.medicine_jump.bit) then
		--윈링(tired,question): 뭔가 원하는 게 있는 걸까?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_side_direction(shuran)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, nil,
				'question',
				'tired',
				'short_story_sr_s7_19')
		return
	end

	stage_event_controller:medicine_clear()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(spirit_rabbit, self.controller)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--천보환을 소지한채로 해당 투명벽에 인터랙트시 이벤트 재생
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interact_rabbit

	local shuran_pos = self.get_shuran_pos(2)
	local jungpa_master_pos = shuran_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	local spirit_rabbit_pos = shuran_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1)

	local wp_key = 'align_wp'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuran, shuran_pos, 2, nil,
			self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(jungpa_master, jungpa_master_pos, 2, nil,
			self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(spirit_rabbit, spirit_rabbit_pos, 2, nil,
			self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	--윈링(left,idle,bomb_idle): 이 천보환을 원하는 건가?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle',
			'idle',
			'short_story_sr_s7_20')

	--토끼 (jump2회) 후 (happy) 이모티콘 버블
	character_util.normal_double_jump(spirit_rabbit, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_die_ant_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(spirit_rabbit, nil, 'happy')

	--원걸(right,tired,release 2회): 이젠 내려가기만 하면 되니 천보환은 필요없지 않소?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_21')

	--윈링(left,tired,question): 그래도 이 토끼라면 뭔가 우릴 도와주려는 거 아닐까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left',
			'question',
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_22')

	--윈링(right,idle,idle) 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--윈링(right,smile,idle)(jump1회): 아! 그런 의미인 거니?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(shuran, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'idle',
			'smile',
			'short_story_sr_s7_23')

	--윈링 속도2 (walk)로 하단 1칸 이동 후 (left,idle,idle) 상태
	local shuran_move_pos = shuran.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

	wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran_move_pos, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--윈링 속도1 (walk)로 좌측 0.5칸 이동 후 (left,idle,eat) 1초
	shuran_move_pos = shuran.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran_move_pos, 1, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true,
													   type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'eat')

	--(eat)모션 시작하면 0.5초간 토끼 (shake 0.03/0.5초)
	scene_util.shake(spirit_rabbit, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--윈링 속도1 (walk)로 우측 0.5칸 이동 (left 방향 고정된채로)
	shuran_move_pos = shuran.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	equipping_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(shuran)
	wp_util.move_async(shuran, shuran_move_pos, 1, nil, { locked_dir = 'left' })

	--토끼 (swell) 애니메이션 재생 토끼 1.2배 크기로 서서히 증가
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fat_gnome_03')
	scene_util.set_anim(spirit_rabbit, self, { name = 'swell', loop = false })
	character_util.spine_scale(spirit_rabbit, vector(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), 0.5)

	local mario_jump_move = function(target, pos, land_sfx)
		local play_land_sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(land_sfx, false)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'get')

		character_util.jump(target, 1.5, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(target, target.Position + pos, 0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(target)

		if play_land_sfx then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	wait_all_lua(
			{
				--원걸 (tired,question): 여기서 토끼를 타서 어쩌려는 것이오?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action, jungpa_master, self, 'right',
				'question',
				'tired',
				'short_story_sr_s7_24'
			},
			{
				--윈링 마리오 점프 (x-0.8)(y+0.75) 위치로 이동
				mario_jump_move, shuran, vector(-0.8, 0.75, 0)
			}
	)

	--윈링(right,smile,release 2회): 일단 너도 올라와 봐!
	--이때 윈링(down)방향
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(jungpa_master, 'down', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'smile',
			'short_story_sr_s7_25')

	--원걸(left) 방향 마리오 점프로 (x-0.2)(z-1)(y+0.75)위치로 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(jungpa_master, 'left', false)
	mario_jump_move(jungpa_master, vector(-0.2, 0.75, -1.01))

	--이동 끝나면 (right,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(jungpa_master, 'right', false)

	--윈링(sleep_deep,idle): 생각해보니 전에 여기서 약초를 캐다 발견한 길이 있었거든?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'idle',
			'sleep_deep',
			'short_story_sr_s7_27')

	--원걸(tired,bomb_idle): 그렇소? 도대체 어떻게 발견하신 것이오?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_28')

	--카메라 0.5초동안 사이즈 3으로 확대
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0.5)

	--이때 원걸(tired,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa_master, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(jungpa_master, '01_player_jump_01')

	--윈링(doyagao,idle): 약초를 캐다 굴렀거든. 이 산 절벽 아래로.
	local wind_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true, fade_in_time = 4, volume = 0.6 })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 4 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'idle',
			'doyagao',
			'short_story_sr_s7_29')

	--원걸(tired,release 2회): 이 토끼가 지금 절벽아래로 뛰어내리려고 하고 있단 말이오?!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			'tired',
			'short_story_sr_s7_30')

	--윈링(smile,idle):맞아! 여긴 엄청 가파른 산이라 산 아래까지 쭉 내려갈 수 있어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'idle',
			'smile',
			'short_story_sr_s7_30_1')

	--원걸(tired,cast): 이, 이 토끼가 어디로 튈 줄 알고 그러는 것이오!?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'right',
			'cast',
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'short_story_sr_s7_31')

	--윈링(smile,idle): 아니, 난 확신해. 이 토끼가 우릴 목적지까지 데려다줄거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'idle',
			'smile',
			'short_story_sr_s7_32')

	--윈링(sleep_deep,bomb_idle): 그리고 조금 잘못 튕겨나가도 뛰어서 산을 내려가는 것보단 빠르지 않겠어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'sleep_deep',
			'short_story_sr_s7_33')

	--윈링(smile,seat): 토끼씨! 출발해주세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'seat', keep = true },
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			'short_story_sr_s7_34')

	--원걸(damaged,release 2회): 자, 잠깐만 기다려보시오!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'right',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'damaged', keep = true },
			'short_story_sr_s7_35')

	scene_util.set_anim(jungpa_master, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })

	-- 점프 자연스럽게 하기 위해 포물선 이동
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(spirit_rabbit, self, { name = 'swell_jump', loop = false })
	character_util.jump(shuran, 2, 1)
	character_util.jump(jungpa_master, 2, 1)
	character_util.jump(spirit_rabbit, 2, 1)
	character_util.move_group_distance({ shuran, jungpa_master }, vector(3, 0, 0), 1)
	character_util.move_to(spirit_rabbit, spirit_rabbit.Position + vector(3, -0.5, 0), 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wind_sfx:FadeOut()
	time_util.mod('slow_mod', 0.5)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	time_util.unmod('slow_mod')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--카메라가 (x 17) (z -57.5)(y 1) 위치인 상태 / 사이즈는 3
	camera_util.move_async(vector(17, 1, -57.5), 0)

	--시작기준 캐릭터 위치
	--토끼 (x 13)(z -61.5)(y 20) (down,idle,swell)
	character_util.set_position(spirit_rabbit, vector(13, 20, -61.5))
	scene_util.set_direction(spirit_rabbit, 'down', false)
	--원걸 (x 12.8)(z -61.5)(y 20.75) (down,damaged,prostrate)
	character_util.set_position(jungpa_master, vector(12.8, 20.75, -61.5))
	scene_util.set_direction(jungpa_master, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(jungpa_master, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(jungpa_master, self, 'prostrate')
	--윈링 (x 13.2)(z -61.5)(y 20.75) (down,damaged,prostrate)
	character_util.set_position(shuran, vector(13.2, 20.75, -61.5))
	scene_util.set_direction(shuran, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'prostrate')

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--페이드 인 끝난 후 0.5초 후
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--화면 기준 중앙에서 [shout] 2배 크기: 오, 오른쪽으로 꺽으시오!
	--이때 화면 shake 0.1/ 0.5초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(jungpa_master,
			'short_story_sr_s7_36', true, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5) })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	--1 초 동안 시작기준 캐릭터 위치에서 착지기준 캐릭터 위치까지 이동한다.
	--착지기준 캐릭터 위치
	--토끼 (x 17)(z -61.5)(y 1)

--- 만귀종 등장, 천려 등장 이벤트
function local_class:show_sapa_event()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	local shuran = self.get_shuran()
	local jungpa_master = self.get_jungpa_master()
	local spirit_rabbit = self.get_spirit_rabbit()
	local nanok = self.get_nanok()
	local cyborg_monk = self.get_cyborg_monk()
	local sapa_npcs = {}

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	character_util.set_active_state(nanok, 'enabled')
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	--fx_dead 출력과 동시에 NPC들 표기한 위치에서 생성
	--생성과 동시에 마리오 점프로 표기한 위치까지 2칸 이동 후 착지
	--각 표기한 순서대로 0.5초 간격으로 튀어나온다.
	local first_sapa_move_info = {
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(1), start_pos = vector(36, 1, -59),
		  end_pos = vector(35, 0, -60.5), dir = 'left' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(2), start_pos = vector(33, 1, -56),
		  end_pos = vector(33, 0, -58), dir = 'down' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(3), start_pos = vector(28, 1, -56),
		  end_pos = vector(28, 0, -58), dir = 'down' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(4), start_pos = vector(26, 1, -56),
		  end_pos = vector(26, 0, -58), dir = 'down' },
	}

	local second_sapa_move_info = {
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(5), start_pos = vector(33, 1, -67),
		  end_pos = vector(33, 0, -65), dir = 'up' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(6), start_pos = vector(36, 1, -64),
		  end_pos = vector(35, 0, -62.5), dir = 'left' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(7), start_pos = vector(26, 1, -67),
		  end_pos = vector(26, 0, -65), dir = 'up' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(8), start_pos = vector(28, 1, -67),
		  end_pos = vector(28, 0, -65), dir = 'up' },
	}

	local appear_action = function(target, start_pos, end_pos, dir, duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		self.fx:dead():Instantiate(start_pos)
		character_util.set_position(target, start_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(target, dir, false)
		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'get')
		character_util.jump(target, 2, duration)
		wp_util.move(target, end_pos, nil, duration, { locked_dir = dir,
													   end_callback = function()
														   character_util.remove_anim(target)
														   music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
													   end })
	end

	local sapa_appear_action = function(info)
		for i = 1, #info do
			local sapa_npc = info[i].npc

			table.insert(sapa_npcs, sapa_npc)
			appear_action(sapa_npc, info[i].start_pos, info[i].end_pos, info[i].dir, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
	end

	--NPC들 등장 시작
	local sapa_appear_check = false

	start_coroutine(sapa_appear_action, second_sapa_move_info)

	start_coroutine(function()
		sapa_appear_action(first_sapa_move_info)

		appear_action(nanok, vector(27, 1, -56), vector(27, 0, -58), 'down', 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		sapa_appear_check = true
	end)

	--동시에 0.5초간 카메라 사이즈 5로 바뀜
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 1)

	--동시에 윈링 / 원걸 (right,surpsie,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ shuran, jungpa_master }, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ shuran, jungpa_master }, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.group_normal_jump_async({ shuran, jungpa_master }, '01_player_jump_01')

	--윈링 과 원걸 (right)방향 고정한 채로 속도 2 (walk)로 표기한 대열로 정렬
	--이때 표정은 (attack) 정렬되면 (right,attack,dagger_idle) 상태
	--토끼는 속도 2 (walk)로 정렬
	local shuran_pos = self.get_shuran_pos(3)
	local jungpa_master_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_jungpa_master_pos_1')
	local spirit_rabbit_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_rabbit_pos')

	local wp_key = 'align_wp'

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(shuran, shuran_pos, 2, nil,
			self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(jungpa_master, jungpa_master_pos, 2, nil,
			self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(spirit_rabbit, spirit_rabbit_pos, 2, nil,
			self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ shuran, jungpa_master }, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_group_anim({ shuran, jungpa_master }, self, 'dagger_idle')

	--모든 NPC 등장 후 0.5초 대기 후
	while not sapa_appear_check do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--이동 시작하면 윈링 / 원걸 방향 (left)
	scene_util.set_group_direction({ shuran, jungpa_master }, 'left')

	--이때 카메라 사이즈 4로 복귀
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 1)

	--난옥 (walk) 속도 3 로 하단으로 3.5칸 이동 후 (right,idle,idle)로 정렬
	local nanok_move_pos = nanok.Position + vector(0, 0, -3.5)

	wp_util.move_async(nanok, nanok_move_pos, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	--난옥 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--난옥 (doyagao,clap): 정말 발악하는 게 우스울 정도네?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_evil_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'right',
			'clap',
			'doyagao',
			'short_story_sr_s7_43')

	--난옥 (doyagao,bomb_idle): 겨우 그 정도로 만귀종의 눈을 속일 수 있을거라 생각한거야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'doyagao',
			'short_story_sr_s7_44')

	--윈링(attack,dagger_idle): 어떻게 우리가 여기올 걸 알고있었던 거지…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(shuran, 'short_story_sr_s7_45')

	--난옥(attack,idle): 이미 너희들의 모든 생각이 만귀종의 손아귀에 있단 걸 모르나보군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'right',
			'idle',
			'attack',
			'short_story_sr_s7_45_1')

	--난옥(sleep_deep,cross_arm): 그 얼간이랑 여길 같이 온 이유야 뻔하겠지…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm',
			'sleep_deep',
			'short_story_sr_s7_46')

	--난옥(mad,jingak)[shout]: 당장 화은단을 내놔!
	--이때 화면 shake0.1 / 0.5초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				scene_util.set_emotion(nanok, self, 'mad')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(nanok, self, { name = 'jingak', count = 1, sfx_name = function()
					camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
				end })
			end,
			{
				scene_util.show_shout_speech_async, nanok, 'short_story_sr_s7_47'
			}
	)

	--윈링(mad,release 2회): 흥! 너희들에게 주느니 이 자리에 짖이겨 버리는 게 나아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuran, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'mad', keep = true },
			'short_story_sr_s7_48')

	--해당 대사 끝나고 (attack,dagger_idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuran, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(shuran, self, 'dagger_idle')

	--난옥(sleep_deep,cross_arm): 아직도 뭘 착각하고 있는 것 같은데…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'right',
			'cross_arm',
			'sleep_deep',
			'short_story_sr_s7_49')

	--난옥(doyagao,bomb_idle): 단약만 있으면 네 녀석은 어떻게 되든 상관없다고.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(nanok, self, 'right',
			'bomb_idle',
			'doyagao',
			'short_story_sr_s7_50')

	--원걸(damaged,dagger_idle): 소, 소저! 이번에야말로 꼭 지켜드리겠소!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(jungpa_master, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'dagger_idle', keep = true },
			{ name = 'damaged', keep = true },
			'short_story_sr_s7_51')

	--만귀종 무리가 플레이어에게 1초간 경로대로 다가온다.
	local third_sapa_move_info = {
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(1), pos = vector(-1, 0, 0), dir = 'left' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(2), pos = vector(-1, 0, -1), dir = 'down' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(3), pos = vector(1, 0, -1), dir = 'right' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(4), pos = vector(1, 0, -1), dir = 'right' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(5), pos = vector(-1, 0, 1), dir = 'up' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(6), pos = vector(-1, 0, 0), dir = 'left' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(7), pos = vector(1, 0, 1), dir = 'right' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(8), pos = vector(1, 0, 1), dir = 'right' },
	}

	for i = 1, #third_sapa_move_info do
		local sapa_npc = third_sapa_move_info[i].npc

		wp_util.move(sapa_npc, sapa_npc.Position + third_sapa_move_info[i].pos,
				nil, 1, { locked_dir = third_sapa_move_info[i].dir })
	end

	nanok_move_pos = nanok.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move(nanok, nanok_move_pos, nil, 1)

	--다가오는 동안 1초간 카메라가 사이즈 2.5 까지 확대된다.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local aura_effect = self.fx:cyborg_monk_aura_loop():Instantiate(
			cyborg_monk.Position + vector(0, 0.35, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, cyborg_monk.Transform)

	--해당 위치에 천려가 떨어진다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cybermonk_beads_01')
	character_util.add_fade_color(cyborg_monk, cyborg_monk.Name, unity_class.color.white, 1, 0)
	scene_util.hero_landing(cyborg_monk, 'right',
				shuran.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 10, 0.5)

	--떨어지면 낙하 위치에 fx_lasthit
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cybermonk_explosion_01')
	self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(cyborg_monk.Position)

	--떨어지면 화면 shake 0.1 / 0.2초
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 1)

	--떨어진 순간에 화면내에 NPC들 표정 (attack) (jump1회) 재생
	--이 후 (attack) 표정 유지
	table.insert(sapa_npcs, nanok)

	scene_util.set_group_emotion(sapa_npcs, self, 'attack')
	character_util.group_normal_jump(sapa_npcs, true)

	scene_util.set_group_direction({ shuran, jungpa_master }, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_group_emotion({ shuran, jungpa_master }, self, 'attack')
	character_util.remove_group_anim({ shuran, jungpa_master })
	character_util.group_normal_jump({ shuran, jungpa_master }, '01_player_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	aura_effect:Dispose()
	self.fx:cyborg_monk_aura_end():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(cyborg_monk.Position, 0.35))
	character_util.remove_fade_color(cyborg_monk, cyborg_monk.Name, 1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4, 1)

	--이때 플레이어 파티를 제외하고 천려 반대 쪽으로 속도1 (walk) 바라보던 방향 고정으로 뒷걸음질 1칸
	local force_sapa_move_info = {
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(1), pos = vector(1, 0, 0), dir = 'left' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(2), pos = vector(0, 0, 1), dir = 'down' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(3), pos = vector(-1, 0, 0), dir = 'right' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(4), pos = vector(-1, 0, 0), dir = 'right' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(5), pos = vector(0, 0, -1), dir = 'up' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(6), pos = vector(1, 0, 0), dir = 'left' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(7), pos = vector(-1, 0, 0), dir = 'right' },
		{ npc = self.sapa_npc:get(8), pos = vector(-1, 0, 0), dir = 'right' },
	}

	for i = 1, #force_sapa_move_info do
		local sapa_npc = force_sapa_move_info[i].npc
		local move_pos = sapa_npc.Position + force_sapa_move_info[i].pos

		wp_util.move(sapa_npc, move_pos, 1, nil, { locked_dir = force_sapa_move_info[i].dir })
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_novel_monk', state = 'event', mix = 5 })
	wait_all_lua(
			{
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action, cyborg_monk, self, 'right',
				'idle',
				'idle',
				'short_story_sr_s7_52'

				wait_for_sec, 1
			}

function local_class:knock_back_func(target, dir, power)

			'physics', true, dir, power, 0.05,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
	command_util.publish_knock_back(target.Owner, target, knockback_info, target.Position)
end

--- 레이저 조절 함수
function local_class:energy_laser_func(laser_effect, start_scale, end_scale, duration)
	laser_effect.transform.localScale = start_scale

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_scale = vector_util.lerp(start_scale, end_scale, time_passed / duration)

		laser_effect.transform.localScale = cur_scale

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	laser_effect.transform.localScale = end_scale
end

	local shuran = self.get_shuran()

	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	shuran.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	cyborg_monk.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	self:revive_npc(nanok)
	self:revive_npc(jungpa_master_boss)
	character_util.set_position(jungpa_master_boss, vector(999, 0, 999))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

--- 부활 처리
function local_class:revive_npc(target)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(target)

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = target.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.sender = target
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
end

return local_class

	end

	end

	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = nil
	self.starting_grade = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1')
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.craft_key then
		self:save_craft_result(e:GetParamAt(1))
	end
end
--endregion

-- 조합 결과를 저장하는 함수
function local_class:save_craft_result(craft_id)
	-- 이미 해금된 조합이면 무조건 리턴.
	if self:is_unlock_craft(craft_id) then
		return
	end
	self.current_craft_state = self.quest_progress:GetCustomState('medicine_flag')

	--current state가 -1일 경우 제대로 작동하지 않으므로 초기화 작업
	if self.current_craft_state == -1 then
		self.current_craft_state = 0
	end

	self.current_craft_state = self.current_craft_state | (1 << craft_id)

	start_coroutine(self.save_current_craft_state_routine, self)
end

-- 현재 조합 결과를 저장하는 루틴
function local_class:save_current_craft_state_routine()
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress,
			self.craft_key,
			self.current_craft_state)
end

-- 해당 조합법이 이미 해금되어 있는지?
function local_class:is_unlock_craft(craft_id)
	local bit = 1 << craft_id
	return (self.current_craft_state & bit) == bit
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = nil
	self.starting_grade = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.is_holdable = nil
	self.sr_util = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	---@type ShuranUtil
	self.sr_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Shuran/Common/Util')

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section2')
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	self.main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if not self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')

		self.fx:load_all()
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.main_quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_spa()) then
		self.sr_util:start_scene(self.hot_water_drop_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_well()) then
		self.sr_util:start_scene(self.cool_water_drop_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_well_bowl()) then
		start_coroutine(self.water_destroyed, self, e.FieldObject)
	end
end
--endregion

--region custom
function local_class:hot_water_drop_scene()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_narration_1' })

	if self.has_bowl then
		self:get_water_event(true)
	end
end

function local_class:cool_water_drop_scene()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_narration_2' })

	if self.has_bowl then
		self:get_water_event(false)
	end
end

function local_class:get_water_event(is_hot)
	local bowl = self.get_well_bowl()
	local shuran = get_party_leader()

	bowl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PotCrashBehaviour()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	--공통적인 선택지 등장
	--양동이로 뜬다. (normal)
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_choose_3', 'normal' },
		{ 'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_choose_4', 'normal' },
	})

	local shuran_dir = shuran.Direction
	local side_dir = direction_util.to_str(direction_util.to_side_dir(shuran_dir))

	if result == 1 then
		--온천이나 우물 방향으로 (idle, eat) 동작 1초간 출력
		self.is_holdable = false

		character_util.set_active_state(bowl, 'disabled')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuran, true)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_brewery_01')
		scene_util.play_wait_action(shuran, self, side_dir, 'eat', nil, 1)

		character_util.set_active_state(bowl, 'enabled')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')
		command_util.publish_holdup(shuran, bowl, shuran.Position, 0, false)

		--이후 [breackable]well_bowl을 hold한 채로 등장
		--온천과 우물 인터렉트로 얻은 [breackable]well_bowl은 외형으로는 구별 불가능
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	else
		--아무것도 하지 않는다. (normal)
		--플레이어 컨트롤 회복

		return
	end

	--[breackable]well_bowl을 던지면 fx_common_water_splash_in 출력
	if is_hot then
		--뜨거운 물
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.get_water
		self.current_water_type = self.water_type.hot

	else
		--차가운 물
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.get_water
		self.current_water_type = self.water_type.cool

	end
	--온천과 우물 인터렉트로 얻은 [breackable]pot1 [breackable]well_bowl은 외형으로는 구별 불가능
end

function local_class:water_destroyed(fo)
	--[breackable]pot1 [breackable]well_bowl을 던지면 fx_common_water_splash_in 출력
	if self.current_water_type == self.water_type.hot then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_water_splash_03' })
		self.fx.water_splash_in():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	elseif self.current_water_type == self.water_type.cool then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_water_splash_03' })
		self.fx.water_splash_in():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	end

	--bowl 위치 초기화
	self:reset_bowl()
end

function local_class:clear_state()
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	local bowl = self.get_well_bowl()

	bowl.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	bowl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:reset_bowl()
	local reset_finish = get_field_object('ranma_reset_switch')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent.Create(reset_finish))

	self:clear_state()
end
--endregion custom
return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

--[[QuestAttribute

		QuestName = Ranma @
		Comment = Ranma 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	--region Character
	self.get_wax = function()
		return get_character('ranma_wax')
	end
	self.get_rinse = function()
		return get_character('ranma_rinse')
	end
	self.get_rinse_cat = function()
		return get_character('ranma_rinse_cat')
	end
	self.get_wax_pelican = function()
		return get_character('ranma_wax_pelican')
	end
	--endregion Character

	--region FieldObject
	--뜨거운 물
	self.get_spa = function()
		return get_field_object('ranma_spa_1')

	self.get_well = function()
		return get_field_object('ranma_well_1')
	end

	end
	--endregion FieldObject

		return field_util.get_marker_pos('ranma_bowl_pos')
	end

	end
	--endregion Marker

	--region Etc

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	---@type ShuranUtil
	self.sr_util = self.controller.sr_util

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	self.is_holdable = false

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

		self.sr_util:start_scene(self.get_bowl_scene, self, e.Target)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_rinse_cat()) then
		self.sr_util:start_scene(self.rinse_cat_damaged_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return true
end
--endregion event

--region custom
--섹션 시작 시 세팅 함수
function local_class:pre_setting()
	local bowl = self.get_well_bowl(2)
	local spa = self.get_spa()
	local well = self.get_well()

	local wax = self.get_wax()
	local cat = self.get_rinse_cat()
	local rinse = self.get_rinse()

	character_util.set_active_state(wax, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(cat, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(rinse, 'enabled')

	bowl.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	bowl.Position = self.get_bowl_pos()

	bowl.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	bowl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

	spa.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	well.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	scene_util.set_emotion(wax, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(wax, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })

	scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(cat, self, 'prostrate')

	scene_util.set_emotion(rinse, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(rinse, self, 'prostrate')
	rinse.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

	self.controller.has_bowl = false
end

function local_class:get_bowl_scene(target)
	local bowl = self.get_well_bowl(2)
	local shuran = get_party_leader()

	local shuran_dir = shuran.Direction
	local side_dir = direction_util.to_str(direction_util.to_side_dir(shuran_dir))

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_narration_3' })

	--선택지
	--줍는다.(normal)
	--무시한다.(normal)
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_choose_1', 'normal' },
		{ 'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_choose_2', 'normal' }
	})

	if result == 1 then
		--‘줍는다.’ 선택 시 양동이 방향으로 (idle, eat) 1초간 출력
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })

		scene_util.play_wait_action(shuran, self, side_dir, 'eat', nil, 1)

		eat_sfx:Stop()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		self.controller.fx.dead():Instantiate(target.Bounds.center)
		bowl.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		self.controller.has_bowl = true

	end

	--플레이어 컨트롤 복귀
end

--린스가 물을 맞았을 경우
function local_class:rinse_cat_damaged_event()
	local cat = self.get_rinse_cat()
	local rinse = self.get_rinse()

	--뜨거운 물일 때 (사람으로 변경)
	if self.controller.current_water_type == self.controller.water_type.hot then
		self:ending_scene()

	elseif self.controller.current_water_type == self.controller.water_type.cool then
		--차가운 물일 때
		--고양이(right, damaged, prostrate): 이야앙…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cat, self,
				'right',
				{ name = 'prostrate', keep = true },
				{ name = 'damgaed', keep = true },
				'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_2_1')
	end
end

--둘 다 변신하고, 대화 연출 진행
function local_class:ending_scene()
	--기믹으로 바위 부순 뒤 온천수를 고양이에게 던져서 맞히면 다음과 같이 연출
	local cat = self.get_rinse_cat()
	local wax = self.get_wax()
	local rinse = self.get_rinse()
	local shuran = get_party_leader()

	--FX_dead 출력되며 윈링 파티(left, surprise, idle) 상태에서 1회 점프 진행
	--위와 동시에 고양이 사라지고 린스(left, damaged, prostrate) 등장 후 1초 뒤 shake 0.05 세기로 1초간 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot("01_small_jump_01")
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02' })
	party_util.set_direction('left')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_fox_ball_04' })

	character_util.set_active_state(rinse, 'enabled')

	self:switching_target(cat, rinse, function()
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	character_util.remove_anim(rinse)

	-- Y축 0.4 높이로 0.3초 동안 1회 jump 후 린스 (left, idle, idle) 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(rinse, 'right', 0.3, 0.4)

	--대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--상태 초기화
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rinse)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	local center_pos = self.get_ranma_pos(1, 1)
	local wax_pos = {
		first = {
			self.get_ranma_pos(2, 1),
			self.get_ranma_pos(2, 2)
		},
		second = {
			self.get_ranma_pos(2, 3)
		}
	}
	local rinse_pos = {
		self.get_ranma_pos(3, 1)
	}
	local align_move_key = 'aling_move_key'

	--정렬
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6, 4)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.set_position(wax, wax_pos.first[1])

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(rinse,
					rinse_pos[1], nil, 1, self, align_move_key)
			wp_util.wait_move_end(self, align_move_key)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			party_util.align_party(center_pos, 'right', 1)
		end)
	})

	--대기
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--린스(right right, smile, sing): 도와줘서 고마워!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rinse, self,
			'right',
			'sing',
			{ name = 'smile', keep = true },
			'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_6')

	--린스(right, smile, idle): 발을 헛딛어서 그만 고양이로 변했지 뭐야?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rinse, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_7')

	--위치 세팅
	character_util.set_position(wax, wax_pos[1])

	--이후 아래와 같이 shout 말풍선 출력
	--말풍선 크기는 현재의 1.5배 크게 출력
	local bubble_data = {
		bubble_direction = 'none', viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.5), scale = 1.5 }

	--말풍선 등장할 때 화면 shake 0.1세기로 0.5초간 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

	--위의 말풍선(린스!) 출력될 때, 린스(down, scared, idle) 상태에서 0.3초에 걸쳐 Y축 0.25로 1회 점프
	scene_util.set_direction(rinse, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(rinse, self, 'scared')
	character_util.jump(rinse, 0.25, 0.3)

	--린스!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(wax, 'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_8', true, bubble_data)

	--말풍선 사라지면 왁스(임시:china_hero_boy_ascent)가 (attack, run) 10의 속도로 등장
	--왁스 올 때 달릴 때 출력되는 연기도 함께 출력
	--린스, 왁스가 X축으로 이동할 때, down 방향으로 있고, Z축으로 이동할 때 right 방향 출력
	stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(wax)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lana_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(wax, self, 'attack')
	wp_util.move_async(wax, wax_pos.first, 10, nil, { run = true })

	scene_util.set_direction(rinse, 'right', false)
	wp_util.move_async(wax, wax_pos.second, 10, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'left' })

	-- 바로 스모크 매니저 꺼준다.
	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(wax)

	--왁스(right, tired, cast): 린스! 어디있었어?! 걱정했잖아!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(wax, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast', keep = true },
			{ name = 'tired', keep = true },
			'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_9')

	--린스(left, tired, walk) 동작으로 0.5칸 뒷걸음질 후
	scene_util.set_emotion(rinse, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(rinse, self, 'walk')

	wp_util.move_async(rinse, rinse.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1, nil,
			{ locked_dir = 'right' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rinse)

	--린스(left, attack, idle): 여긴 또 어떻게 알고 온거야?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rinse, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
			'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_10')

	--왁스(right, tired, cast): 다친 곳은 없는거야?  늦어서 미안해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(wax, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_11')

	--린스(left, attack, release 3회): 나는 강한 사람이 좋다고 몇 번을 말해! 그러니 그만 쫒아다녀!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rinse, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 3 },
			nil,
			'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_12')

	--왁스 0.4초에 걸쳐 (right, idle, walk) 상태로 (x축 100.5) 좌표로 이동
	--도착하면 (right, idle, idle) 출력
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(wax)
	wp_util.move_async(wax, wax.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.4)

	--이후 0.3초 후 대사 출력
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--왁스(right, idle, idle): 당신이 우리 린스를 구해준 건가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(wax, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			'short_story_sr_ranma_s1_12_1')

	--선택지
	--난 물 뿌린게 전부야. (mercy)

	if result == 1 then

		--위 선택지 선택 시 대사 출력

		--위 선택지 선택 시 대사 출력
		--윈링 (left, surprise, release 3회): 그것보다 어떻게 동물이 사람으로 변한 거야?!

		--왁스 (right, idle, idle): 다른 사람들이 알면 곤란하니까 비밀로 부탁할게!

	local duck_pos = {

		jump = {
			self.get_ranma_pos(2, 6)

			self.get_ranma_pos(3, 3),

			self.get_ranma_pos(3, 4)

	scene_util.set_direction(duck, 'left', false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(duck)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cat)

			'short_story_sr_ranma_s2_5')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(duck, self,
			'left',
			nil,
			nil,
			'short_story_sr_ranma_s2_6')

	--이후 왁스 린스 아래와 같이 0.7칸 간격으로 딱 붙은 상태로 유지하고 원라인 진행

			character_util.jump(cat, 1, jump_duration)
			wp_util.move_async(cat, cat_pos.jump, nil, jump_duration, { run = true })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
			character_util.jump(duck, 1, jump_duration)
			wp_util.move_async(duck, duck_pos.jump, nil, jump_duration, { run = true })
		end)
	})

	--검은색 부분에서는 jump 출력

	self:clear_setting()

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

---@class ShortStoryHologramDeviceInteractHandler
local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryHologramDeviceInteractHandler')

function local_class:init()
	self.communication_device = {
		get = function(this, number)
			return get_field_object(this.names[number])
		end,

		names = {
			'first_communication_device',
			'second_communication_device',
			'third_communication_device',
		},

		foreach = function(this, action)
			for index, name in pairs(this.names) do
				action(index, get_field_object(name))
			end
		end,

		contains = function(this, target)
			for index, name in pairs(this.names) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_field_object(name)) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	self.listeners = setmetatable({
		high = nil,
		low = nil,
	}, {
		__index = {
			is_empty = function(this)
				return this.high == nil and this.low == nil
			end,

			on_event = function(this, device)
				local is_consumed = false

				if this.high ~= nil then
					is_consumed = this.high:on_device_interact(device)
				end

				if is_consumed then
					return
				end

				if this.low ~= nil then
					this.low:on_device_interact(device)
				end
			end
		}
	})

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.listeners.high = nil
	self.listeners.low = nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.communication_device:contains(e.Target) then
		self.listeners:on_event(e.Target)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:add_listener(listener, priority)
	if self.listeners:is_empty() then
		self.communication_device:foreach(function(_, fo)
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		end)
	end

	self.listeners[priority] = listener
end

function local_class:remove_listener(listener)
	if self.listeners.high == listener then
		self.listeners.high = nil
	end

	if self.listeners.low == listener then
		self.listeners.low = nil
	end

	if self.listeners:is_empty() then
		self.communication_device:foreach(function(_, fo)
			fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end)
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class ShortStoryMainSection6EndController
local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryMainSection6EndController')

function local_class:init()
	self.mana_potion_quest_id = 7001707
	self.hot_spring_quest_id = 7001708

	self.is_notice_call_activated = false

	self.after_notice_call_callback = nil

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		blink = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blink')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.get_souei = function()
		return get_character('souei')
	end

	self.get_milim = function()
		return get_character('milim')
	end

	self.get_shuna = function()
		return get_character('shuna')
	end

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.village_construction = nil

	self.target_happiness = 2000

	self.in_happiness_check_routine = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.fx:create_all()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:exit()

	self.village_construction = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.after_notice_call_callback = nil
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if not self.is_notice_call_activated and not self.in_happiness_check_routine and
			e:GetParamAt(0) == 'changed_village_state' and self:is_all_satisfied() then
		self.in_happiness_check_routine = true

		start_coroutine(function()
			self:wait_and_notice_call_routine()

			self.in_happiness_check_routine = false
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_village_construction()
	if self.village_construction == nil then
		self.village_construction = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Slime/VillageConstruction/VCSystem')
	end

	return self.village_construction
end

function local_class:is_all_satisfied()
	--플레이어가 행복도를 충족시키고 상단 두 서브 이벤트를 클리어하게 되면
	local mana_potion_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.mana_potion_quest_id)
	local hot_spring_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.hot_spring_quest_id)

	return mana_potion_quest ~= nil and mana_potion_quest.IsComplete and
			hot_spring_quest ~= nil and hot_spring_quest.IsComplete and self:is_happiness_satisfied()
end

function local_class:is_happiness_satisfied()
	local village_construction = self:get_village_construction()

	return village_construction:get_cur_happiness() >= self.target_happiness
end

function local_class:wait_and_notice_call_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	while lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if not self:is_happiness_satisfied() then
		return
	end

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	self:notice_call_routine(true)

	-- 강제 저장
	self.village_construction:get_data_storage():force_all_data_save()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
end

function local_class:notice_call_routine(need_align)
	if self.is_notice_call_activated then
		return
	end

	self.is_notice_call_activated = true

	self:notice_call_scene(need_align)

	if self.after_notice_call_callback ~= nil then
		self.after_notice_call_callback()
	end

	self:exit()
end

function local_class:notice_call_scene(need_align)
	local souei = self.get_souei()
	local rimuru = get_party_leader()
	local shuna = self.get_shuna()
	local milim = self.get_milim()

	--1번 : 리무루 (hana#hana_3 (임시))
	--4번 : 슈나 (store_angel_fitness (임시))
	--5번 : 밀림 (mermaid#mermaid_3 (임시))
	--10번 : 소우에이 (sapa_dragontalon_minion (임시))
	--플레이어가 행복도를 충족시키고 상단 두 서브 이벤트를 클리어하게 되면 강제 이벤트가 재생된다.
	--1, 4, 5번 캐릭터 지정된 위치에 정렬.
	if need_align then
		do
			local pivot = rimuru.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
			local util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/ShortStory/Slime/Common/Util')

			util:align_party_by_name_async({
				rimuru = {
					target_pos = pivot,
					direction = 'up'
				},
				shuna = {
					target_pos = pivot + vector(-0.5, 0, -1),
					direction = 'up'
				},
				milim = {
					target_pos = pivot + vector(0.5, 0, -1),
					direction = 'up'
				},
			}, 1)
		end
	else
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(rimuru, 'up')
	end

	--이후 소우에이가 fx_blink 와 함께 생겨남.
	do
		character_util.set_position(souei, rimuru.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward)
		character_util.set_direction(souei, 'down')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')

		self.fx.blink():Instantiate(souei.Position)
	end

	-- 소우에이(down,sleep_deep,nod끝에 정지): 리무루 님!
	do
		local talk_done = false

		scene_util.set_anim(souei, self, {
			name = 'nod',
			count = false,
			one_shot_sfx = false
		})

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			if talk_done then
				return
			end

			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(souei, 0)

			while not talk_done do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(souei, 1)
		end)

		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(souei, self, 'down',
				nil, 'sleep_deep', 'ss_slime_main_s6_1')

		talk_done = true

		character_util.remove_anim(souei)
	end

	-- 리무루(up,idle,idle): 무슨일이야 소우에이?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'ss_slime_main_s6_2')

	-- 소우에이(down,idle,idle): 리리스 님으로부터 연락이 왔습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(souei, self, 'down',
			nil, nil, 'ss_slime_main_s6_3')

	-- 리무루(up,idle,idle): 리리스가 나를? 알겠어 직접 찾아갈게.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self, 'up',
			nil, nil, 'ss_slime_main_s6_4')

	-- 소우에이(down,idle,nod2회): 넵, 알겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(souei, self, 'down',
			'nod', nil, 'ss_slime_main_s6_5')

	--소우에이가 fx_blink 와 함께 사라진다.
	do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')

		self.fx.blink():Instantiate(souei.Position)

		character_util.set_position(souei, vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class ShortStorySlimeTaxiController
local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeTaxiController')

function local_class:init()
	self.main_quest_id = 7001701

	self.taxi = {
		states = {
			out_of_service = 1,
			in_service = 2,
		},
		current_states = 1,
		available_progress = 5,
		get_taxi_marker_name = 'taxi_pos_',

		get = function(idx)
			return get_field_object('taxi_' .. idx)
		end,

		count = 2,
		foreach = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				local fo = this.get(i)

				action(i, fo)
			end
		end
	}

	self.taxi_station = {
		states = {
			before_interact = 1,
			after_interact = 2,
		},
		current_states = 1,
		teleport_marker_name = 'taxi_teleport_pos_',

		get = function(idx)
			return get_field_object('taxi_station_' .. idx)
		end,

		names = {
			'demonworld_entrance',
			'demonworld_police',
			'main_field_entrance'
		},

		data = {
			demonworld_entrance = {
				--도시 입구 정류장
				str_key = 'ss_slime_taxi_5',
				tendency = 'normal',
				twinkle_effect = nil
			},
			demonworld_police = {
				--경찰서 앞 정류장
				str_key = 'ss_slime_taxi_6',
				tendency = 'normal',
				twinkle_effect = nil
			},
			main_field_entrance = {
				--마을 정류장
				str_key = 'ss_slime_taxi_7',
				tendency = 'normal',
				twinkle_effect = nil
			}
		},

		count = 3,
		foreach = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				local fo = this.get(i)

				action(i, fo)
			end
		end,
		contains = function(this, fo)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, this.get(i)) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end,
		return_num = function(this, fo)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, this.get(i)) then
					return i
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)

	if quest_progress == nil or quest_progress.InnerProgress < self.taxi.available_progress then
		self.taxi.current_states = self.taxi.states.out_of_service
		self:taxi_station_signboard_interactable()
	else
		self:start_taxi_service()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.taxi_station.current_states == self.taxi_station.states.before_interact then
		if self.taxi_station:contains(e.Target) then
			self.taxi_station.current_states = self.taxi_station.after_interact

			sp_util.start_scene(self.choose_taxi_station, self, e.Target)

			self.taxi_station.current_states = self.taxi_station.states.before_interact
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if self.taxi.current_states == self.taxi.states.out_of_service and
			e.QuestId == self.main_quest_id and e.CurrentProgress == 5 then
		self.taxi.current_states = self.taxi.states.in_service

		self:start_taxi_service()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:start_taxi_service()
	self.taxi.current_states = self.taxi.states.in_service
	self:taxi_settings()
	self:taxi_station_settings()
end

function local_class:taxi_settings()
	self.taxi:foreach(function(idx, fo)
		fo.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.taxi.get_taxi_marker_name .. idx)
	end)
end

function local_class:taxi_station_settings()
	self:set_taxi_station_activate()
	self:taxi_station_publish_interactable()
	self:taxi_station_twinkle_effect_activate()
end

function local_class:set_taxi_station_visible()
	self.taxi_station:foreach(function(_, fo)
		fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.visible
	end)
end

function local_class:set_taxi_station_activate()
	self.taxi_station:foreach(function(_, fo)
		fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
	end)
end

function local_class:taxi_station_twinkle_effect_activate()
	self.taxi_station:foreach(function(idx, fo)
		local name = self.taxi_station.names
		local station = self.taxi_station.data[name[idx]]
		station.twinkle_effect = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(fo.Position)
	end)
end

function local_class:taxi_station_publish_interactable()
	self.taxi_station:foreach(function(_, fo)
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end)
end

function local_class:taxi_station_signboard_interactable()
	self.taxi_station:foreach(function(_, fo)
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.SignboardInteractable()
		fo.Interactable.Message = 'ss_slime_taxi_1'
	end)
end

function local_class:choose_taxi_station(fo)
	local taxi_station_num = self.taxi_station:return_num(fo)
	local fo_marker_name = self.taxi_station.teleport_marker_name .. taxi_station_num

	local name = self.taxi_station.names
	local station = self.taxi_station.data[name[taxi_station_num]]
	station.twinkle_effect:Dispose()

	if self.taxi.current_states == self.taxi.states.out_of_service then
		--1~5섹션에 해당 정류장 오브젝트 인터렉트 시
		--아직 운행 시간이 되지 않았습니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(fo, { key = 'ss_slime_taxi_1', skip = false })
	elseif self.taxi.current_states == self.taxi.states.in_service then
		self:taxi_station_align_party(fo_marker_name)

		--차량을 타고 이동하시겠습니까?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fo, { key = 'ss_slime_taxi_2', skip = true })

		local selected_station_branch_datas = {
			--『도시 입구 정류장』(normal)
			{ self.taxi_station.data.demonworld_entrance.str_key, self.taxi_station.data.demonworld_entrance.tendency },
			--『경찰서 앞 정류장』(normal)
			{ self.taxi_station.data.demonworld_police.str_key, self.taxi_station.data.demonworld_police.tendency },
			--『마을 정류장』(normal)
			{ self.taxi_station.data.main_field_entrance.str_key, self.taxi_station.data.main_field_entrance.tendency }
		}

		local teleport_marker_data = {
			self.taxi_station.teleport_marker_name .. 1,
			self.taxi_station.teleport_marker_name .. 2,
			self.taxi_station.teleport_marker_name .. 3,
		}

		-- 선택한 정류장은 선택지에서 제거
		table.remove(selected_station_branch_datas, taxi_station_num)
		table.remove(teleport_marker_data, taxi_station_num)

		--선택지
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--(mercy) 네
			{ 'ss_slime_taxi_3', 'mercy' },
			--(brutal) 아니오
			{ 'ss_slime_taxi_4', 'brutal' },
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			local selected_station_num = choose_util.play_choose_event(selected_station_branch_datas)

			self:taxi_station_teleport(teleport_marker_data[selected_station_num])
		end
	end

	station.twinkle_effect = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(fo.Position)
end

function local_class:taxi_station_teleport(teleport_marker_name)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	local fade_duration = 0.6
	screen_util.fade_out_circular(fade_duration, 'linear')

	local taxi_sound_dur = 0.5
	wait_for_sec(taxi_sound_dur)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_icecreamshop_01')

	wait_for_sec(fade_duration - taxi_sound_dur)

	local teleport_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(teleport_marker_name)
	local teleport_marker_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir(teleport_marker_name)
	local teleport_marker_dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(teleport_marker_dir)

	for idx = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[idx]
		local target_pos = teleport_marker_pos - teleport_marker_dir_vector * (idx * constants.dist_between_party_members)

		-- 그리드에 따른 bgm 변경을 위해 스테이트를 변경 하기 위해 move_to 사용
		character_util.move_to_async(member, target_pos, 0, nil, nil, nil, nil)
		member.Direction = teleport_marker_dir
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	coroutine.yield()

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(fade_duration, 'linear')
end

function local_class:taxi_station_align_party(align_marker_name, duration)
	local align_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(align_marker_name)
	local align_marker_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir(align_marker_name)
	local align_marker_dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(align_marker_dir)
	local move_key = 'taxi_station_party_align'
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 1)

	for idx = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[idx]
		local target_pos = align_marker_pos - align_marker_dir_vector * (idx * constants.dist_between_party_members)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos, nil, 1, self, move_key, {
			last_direction = align_marker_dir
		})
	end

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class ShortStorySlimeCommonUtil
local local_class = newclass('ShortStorySlimeCommonUtil')

function local_class:init()
	self.is_loaded = false

	--region OperatorUI

	self.res_holder = nil

	self.operator_ui_bundle_name = 'ondemand/short_story_slime/ui'
	self.operator_ui_asset_name = 'RaphaelOperatorUI'

	self.operator_ui_obj = nil
	self.operator_ui_controller = nil

	--endregion
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_async()
	if self.is_loaded then
		return
	end

	--region 오퍼레이터 UI 로드
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, self.operator_ui_bundle_name, self.operator_ui_asset_name, function(prefab)
				self.operator_ui_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.operator_ui_controller = self.operator_ui_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.QueenShipOperatorUI))
				--아랍어 대응
				if game_string.IsRTL and self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale.x > 0 then
					local scale = self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale
					scale.x = -scale.x

					self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale = scale
					self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.alignment = CS.TMPro.TextAlignmentOptions.TopRight
				end

				self.operator_ui_obj:SetActive(false)
			end)

	--endregion

	self.is_loaded = true
end

function local_class:show_raphael_speech_async(key, data)
	local key_data = {}
	if type_util.is_string(key) then
		key_data = { key }
	else
		key_data = key
	end

	self:set_label_key_async(key_data, data)
end

---라벨에 스트링키로 한글자씩 표시 연출 Async
---@param key_data string|table 라벨 문구 스트링 키 혹은 키 테이블
---@param font_size number 폰트 사이즈 0보다 큰 경우만 세팅하고, 아닌 경우 프리펩에서 defaultLabelFontSize 사용
---@param wait_time number 대사 전부 표시 후 대기 시간이 있는 경우
---@param text_color any 라벨 색상 조정 필요한 경우
---@param dialogue string 다이얼로그 스토리 대사가 있는 경우 세팅. 실제 dialogueKey도 세팅되어야 함
---@param dialogue_key string 다이얼로그 스토리 대사가 있는 경우 해당 키 입력
---@param type_speed number 글자 하나가 나올때 걸리는 시간
---@param end_hide_label boolean 연출이 모두 끝나고 라벨을 꺼줄 경우
---@param sfx_key string 대사 연출 중 루프되는 효과음이 있는 경우
---@param can_skip boolean 대사 중간에 Skip이 가능한 경우
---@param end_hide_obj boolean 대사 연출이 끝나고 UI 오브젝트 끌 경우
---@param before_wait_time number 대사 표시 전 대기 시간이 있는 경우
---@param after_wait_time number 오브젝트 숨김 전 대기 시간이 있는 경우
---@param opening_sfx_key number UI 시작 sfx
---@param closing_sfx_key number UI 종료 sfx
function local_class:set_label_key_async(key_data, data)
	local font_size = lua_helper.get_value(data, "font_size", -1)
	local type_speed = lua_helper.get_value(data, "type_speed", 0.05)
	local wait_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, "wait_time", 2)
	local text_color = lua_helper.get_value(data, "text_color", nil)
	local dialogue = lua_helper.get_value(data, "dialogue", nil)
	local dialogue_key = lua_helper.get_value(data, "dialogue_key", '')
	local end_hide_label = lua_helper.get_value(data, "end_hide_label", false)
	local sfx_key = lua_helper.get_value(data, "sfx_key", '')
	local can_skip = lua_helper.get_value(data, "can_skip", true)
	local end_hide_obj = lua_helper.get_value(data, "end_hide_obj", true)

	local before_wait_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, "before_wait_time", 1)
	local after_wait_time = lua_helper.get_value(data, "after_wait_time", 1)
	local opening_sfx_key = lua_helper.get_value(data, "opening_sfx_key", '01_ui_operator_01')
	local closing_sfx_key = lua_helper.get_value(data, "closing_sfx_key", nil)

	wait_for_sec(before_wait_time)

	if type_util.is_string(opening_sfx_key) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(opening_sfx_key)
	end

	for i = 1, #key_data do
		if i == #key_data then
			yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.SetLabelKeyAsync, self.operator_ui_controller, key_data[i], font_size,
					type_speed, wait_time, text_color, dialogue, dialogue_key, end_hide_label, sfx_key, can_skip, end_hide_obj)
		else
			yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.SetLabelKeyAsync, self.operator_ui_controller, key_data[i], font_size,
					type_speed, wait_time, text_color, dialogue, dialogue_key, end_hide_label, sfx_key, can_skip, false)
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_string(closing_sfx_key) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(closing_sfx_key)
	end

	wait_for_sec(after_wait_time)
end

---오퍼레이터 UI 진동 연출
--- @param magnitude number shake 세기
--- @param duration number shake 시간
--- @param sfx_name string 효과음 이름
--- @param can_skip boolean 터치해서 스킵 가능한지
function local_class:shake(magnitude, duration, sfx_name, can_skip)
	sfx_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(sfx_name, '')
	can_skip = lua_helper.get_or_default(can_skip, true)

	yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.Shake, self.operator_ui_controller,
			magnitude, duration, sfx_name, can_skip)
end

---오퍼레이터 UI 정지
function local_class:stop()
	self.operator_ui_controller:StopPlay()
end

function local_class:show_monologue_speech_async(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args, speech_key)
	local speech_args = {
		key = speech_key,
		skip = true,
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		scale = 0.75,
		-- Center Top
		offset = vector(0, 2.35, 0)
	}
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args, speech_args)
end

function local_class:align_party_by_index_async(align_data, duration)
	local move_key = 'common_util_party_align'
	local min_speed = 1

	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 1)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		local member = user_party[i - 1]
		local data = align_data[i]
		local dist = (data.target_pos - member.Position).magnitude
		local speed = math.max(dist / duration, min_speed)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, data.target_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key, {
			last_direction = data.direction
		})
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
end

function local_class:align_party_by_name_async(align_data, duration)
	local move_key = 'common_util_party_align'
	local min_speed = 1

	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 1)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count do
		local member = user_party[i - 1]
		local data = align_data[member.Name]

		if data == nil then
			goto continue
		end

		local dist = (data.target_pos - member.Position).magnitude
		local speed = math.max(dist / duration, min_speed)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, data.target_pos, speed, nil, self, move_key, {
			last_direction = data.direction,
			run = data.run,
		})

		::continue::
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(demon_queen, 1, 0)

		return

	self.current_state = self.states.quest_activated

	--아이리스 세팅

	local pivot_pos = self.get_pivot_pos() + vector(-2, 0, 0.5)

	character_util.set_active_state(iris, 'enabled')
	iris.Position = pivot_pos

	if quest_progress.InnerProgress == 0 then

		character_util.set_direction(iris,'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(iris, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(iris, self, 'question')
	elseif quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
		self:setting_section_2()
	elseif quest_progress.InnerProgress == 2 then

	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(iris)
	character_util.add_listener(iris, self)


end

	iris.Interactable.Talk = 'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s1_37'

	for i = 1, 5 do

		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'prostrate' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(wizard)

	local vampire_lord = self.characters.vampire_lord()

	character_util.set_active_state(vampire_lord, 'enabled')

	wizard.Position = vampire_lord.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
end

--on_stage_loaded 때 불리면 터져서 분리함
function local_class:setting_quest_marker()
	local quest_progress = self.cs_controller.QuestProgress

	if quest_progress.IsComplete then
		return
	elseif quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 then
		local vampire_lord = self.characters.vampire_lord()
		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
			{ zone = 'demonworld_field', target = vampire_lord }

		quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_marker_key, {
			{ zone = 'demonworld_field', target = iris }
		})
	end
end


return local_class

-- 카메라 촬영 이펙트 효과 연출
function local_class:show_camera_fx(pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_focus_01')
	local camera_pointer = self.get_fx_adultery_camera_target():Instantiate(pos)

	self.picturing_icon.transform.position = pos
	self.picturing_icon:SetActive(true)

	-- 화면 터치 이후 찰칵 하도록
	local qte_success = false
	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
				qte_success = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	while not qte_success do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_pointer:Dispose()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.touch_handler = nil

	local is_success = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_shutter_02')

	time_util.mod('picture', 0)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	self.picturing_icon:SetActive(false)

	field:Tint('picture', unity_color({ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1 }), 0)

	wait_for_unscaled_sec(0.3)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	wait_for_unscaled_sec(0.3)

	if is_success then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1.5)
	end

	time_util.unmod('picture')

	field:RemoveTint('picture', 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	return is_success
end

	--퀘스트 마커 세팅
	local vampire_lord = self.characters.vampire_lord()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.controller.quest_marker_key, {
		{ zone = 'demonworld_field', target = vampire_lord }
	})
end
return local_class

	-- 슈나(left,attack,release 2회): 클로드 님도 아이리스 님을 좋아하고 계세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_13')

	-- 아이리스(right,tired,idle): 클로드 님이요? 그럴리가…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_14')

	-- 슈나(left,smile,cast): 그렇다면 지금 바로 클로드 님께 가서 진심을 전해보세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_15')

	-- 리무루 (tired) 표정 (right) 1초 (left) 1초 1초동안 1칸 하단으로 내려간 후 (up,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_emotion(rimuru, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_direction(rimuru, 'right', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rimuru)
	scene_util.set_direction(rimuru, 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.move_distance_async(rimuru, vector(0, 0, -1), 1, nil, true, true, false)
	scene_util.set_direction(rimuru, 'up', true)

	-- 아이리스(right,damaged,cast): 그건… 그건 너무 갑작스러워요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'damaged' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_16')

	-- 아이리스(right,tired,idle): 갑자기 제가 클로드 님한테 먼저 말을 건다니요…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_17')

	-- 슈나(left,attack,idle)(jump1회): 분명히 클로드 님도 아이리스 님의 말을 기다리고 있을거에요!
	character_util.normal_jump(shuna, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'attack' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_18')

	-- 아이리스(right,blush,idle): 그… 그러기엔…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'blush' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_19')

	-- 슈나(left,smile,relesae2회): 그렇다면 저희가 대신…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_20')

	-- 이때 아이리스(right,surprise,idle)(jump 1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(iris, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(iris, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 아이리스(right,damaged,idle)(jump1회): 괘, 괜찮아요!
	character_util.normal_jump(iris, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'damaged' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_21')

	-- 아이리스(right,attack,cast): 제 마음은… 제가 직접 전할테니까요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_22')

	-- 아이리스(right,damaged,release2회): 이번에 다시 데몬샤이어에 돌아가면 꼭 전할게요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'damaged' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_23')

	-- 슈나(left,tired,bomb_idle): 지금 바로 전하시는게…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'tired' },
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_24')

	-- 리무루 1초간 1칸 위로 올라간 후 (right,idle,idle)
	character_util.move_distance_async(rimuru, vector(0, 0, 1), 1, nil, true, true, false)
	scene_util.set_direction(rimuru, 'right', true)

	-- 리무루(right,tired,bomb_idle): 슈나… 얘기는 해뒀으니 둘의 마음은 알아서 서로 알게될거야.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(rimuru, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'bomb_idle' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_25')

	-- 이때 슈나(left,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(shuna, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(shuna, '01_player_jump_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shuna)

	-- 슈나(left,tired,cast): 죄송합니다. 리무루 님. 제가 실례되는 행동을…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(shuna, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'cast' },
			{ name = 'tired' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_26')

	-- 아이리스(right,smile,nod2회): 아니예요. 덕분에 마음이 후련해졌어요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_27')

	-- 아이리스(get) 자세로 자신 위치 한칸 아래에 스타피스를 던져준다.
	scene_util.set_anim(iris, self, 'get')

	star_piece_util.appear(get_field_object('cupidsarrow_startpiece'), iris.Position)

	-- 3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(iris)

	-- 아이리스(right,smile,idle): 제가 원하던 사진도 찍어오셨고… 이건 제 작은 사례에요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ name = 'smile' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_28')

	-- 아이리스(right,sleep_deep,nod2회): 그럼… 약속대로 마을의 관리를 도와드릴게요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(iris, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'nod', count = 2 },
			{ name = 'sleep_deep' },
			'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_29')

	-- 페이드 인 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	iris.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'ss_slime_cupidsarrow_s3_30' })
	-- 아이리스가 사라져있다.
	-- 나레이션 박스
	-- 아이리스가 관리자로 합류했다!
	-- 미니게임 관리자에 아이리스 추가됨.

	self.controller:complete_hidden_quest_default()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

return local_class
